'===========================================================================
' 颜色转换：#RRGGBB → VBA Long
'===========================================================================
Private Function HexToColor(ByVal hexColor As String) As Long
    Dim r As Long, g As Long, b As Long
    hexColor = Replace(hexColor, "#", "")
    r = CLng("&H" & Mid(hexColor, 1, 2))
    g = CLng("&H" & Mid(hexColor, 3, 2))
    b = CLng("&H" & Mid(hexColor, 5, 2))
    HexToColor = RGB(r, g, b)
End Function

'===========================================================================
' DarkenColor：将颜色加深（HSV 算法），factor 0~1，越小越深
' 内部委托给 AdjustColorHSV，保持色相不变
'===========================================================================
Private Function DarkenColor(ByVal originalColor As Long, ByVal factor As Single) As Long
    Dim hsvFactor As Double
    If factor <= 0 Then factor = 0.01
    hsvFactor = 1# / CDbl(factor)
    DarkenColor = AdjustColorHSV(originalColor, hsvFactor)
End Function

'===========================================================================
' AdjustColorHSV：基于 HSV 模型调整颜色深浅（饱和度和明度联动）
' factor < 1：淡化（提明度降饱和度） | =1：不变 | >1：加深（降明度）
'===========================================================================
Private Function AdjustColorHSV(ByVal originalColor As Long, ByVal factor As Double) As Long
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim r As Double: r = (originalColor Mod 256) / 255#
    Dim g As Double: g = ((originalColor \ 256) Mod 256) / 255#
    Dim b As Double: b = (originalColor \ 65536) / 255#

    Dim maxVal As Double, minVal As Double
    If r >= g And r >= b Then
        maxVal = r: minVal = IIf(g < b, g, b)
    ElseIf g >= r And g >= b Then
        maxVal = g: minVal = IIf(r < b, r, b)
    Else
        maxVal = b: minVal = IIf(r < g, r, g)
    End If
    Dim delta As Double: delta = maxVal - minVal

    Dim H As Double
    If delta = 0 Then
        H = 0
    ElseIf maxVal = r Then
        H = 60# * ((g - b) / delta Mod 6#)
        If H < 0 Then H = H + 360#
    ElseIf maxVal = g Then
        H = 60# * ((b - r) / delta + 2#)
    Else
        H = 60# * ((r - g) / delta + 4#)
    End If
    H = H / 360#

    Dim S As Double
    If maxVal = 0 Then S = 0 Else S = delta / maxVal

    Dim V As Double: V = maxVal

    Dim newV As Double, newS As Double
    If factor = 1 Then
        newV = V: newS = S
    ElseIf factor < 1 Then
        newV = V + (1# - V) * (1# - factor)
        newS = S * factor
    Else
        newV = V * (1# / factor)
        newS = S
    End If

    If newV > 1 Then newV = 1
    If newV < 0 Then newV = 0
    If newS > 1 Then newS = 1
    If newS < 0 Then newS = 0

    Dim newR As Double, newG As Double, newB As Double
    If newS = 0 Then
        newR = newV: newG = newV: newB = newV
    Else
        Dim hh As Double: hh = H * 6#
        Dim i As Integer: i = Int(hh)
        Dim f As Double: f = hh - i
        Dim p As Double: p = newV * (1# - newS)
        Dim q As Double: q = newV * (1# - newS * f)
        Dim t As Double: t = newV * (1# - newS * (1# - f))
        Select Case i
            Case 0: newR = newV: newG = t: newB = p
            Case 1: newR = q: newG = newV: newB = p
            Case 2: newR = p: newG = newV: newB = t
            Case 3: newR = p: newG = q: newB = newV
            Case 4: newR = t: newG = p: newB = newV
            Case 5: newR = newV: newG = p: newB = q
        End Select
    End If

    Dim intR As Integer: intR = Round(newR * 255)
    Dim intG As Integer: intG = Round(newG * 255)
    Dim intB As Integer: intB = Round(newB * 255)
    If intR > 255 Then intR = 255 Else If intR < 0 Then intR = 0
    If intG > 255 Then intG = 255 Else If intG < 0 Then intG = 0
    If intB > 255 Then intB = 255 Else If intB < 0 Then intB = 0

    AdjustColorHSV = VBA.RGB(intR, intG, intB)
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    AdjustColorHSV = originalColor
End Function

'===========================================================================
' 配置单个实例的颜色
'===========================================================================
Public Sub Configure(ByVal lbl As MSForms.Label, _
                     ByVal normalBackHex As String, ByVal hoverBackHex As String, _
                     ByVal normalBorderHex As String, ByVal hoverBorderHex As String, _
                     ByVal normalForeHex As String, ByVal hoverForeHex As String)
    Set Me.btnLabel = lbl
    Me.NormalBackColor = HexToColor(normalBackHex)
    Me.HoverBackColor = HexToColor(hoverBackHex)
    Me.NormalBorderColor = HexToColor(normalBorderHex)
    Me.HoverBorderColor = HexToColor(hoverBorderHex)
    Me.NormalForeColor = HexToColor(normalForeHex)
    Me.HoverForeColor = HexToColor(hoverForeHex)
    ' 统一设 Margin，让 MouseMove 事件始终处理悬停检测
    ' 颜色是否变化由调用方控制，类不替开发者做决定
    Me.Margin = 3
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' 统一添加按钮：内部创建实例、配置颜色、设置回调
' ownerForm：接收回调的窗体（需实现 OnLabelEvent）
' 返回值：创建的 clsLabelButton 实例，调用方可保存引用
'===========================================================================
Public Function Add(ByVal lbl As MSForms.Label, _
                    ByVal normalBackHex As String, ByVal hoverBackHex As String, _
                    ByVal normalBorderHex As String, ByVal hoverBorderHex As String, _
                    ByVal normalForeHex As String, ByVal hoverForeHex As String, _
                    Optional ByVal frmOwner As Object = Nothing) As clsLabelButton
    Dim btn As clsLabelButton
    Set btn = New clsLabelButton
    btn.Configure lbl, normalBackHex, hoverBackHex, _
                  normalBorderHex, hoverBorderHex, _
                  normalForeHex, hoverForeHex
    If Not frmOwner Is Nothing Then
        Set btn.ownerForm = frmOwner
        btn.ctrlTag = lbl.Name
        ' 自动绑定宿主容器 MouseMove（有就绑，没有不绑）
        Set btn.m_hostForm = frmOwner
        Dim parentObj As Object
        Set parentObj = lbl.Parent
        Dim parentType As String
        parentType = TypeName(parentObj)
        If parentType = "Frame" Then
            Set btn.m_hostFrame = parentObj
        ElseIf parentType = "Page" Then
            Set btn.m_hostMultiPage = parentObj.Parent
        End If
    End If
    Set Add = btn
End Function

Private Sub btnLabel_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                               ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    Dim inside As Boolean
    inside = (X >= Margin And X <= btnLabel.Width - Margin And _
              Y >= Margin And Y <= btnLabel.Height - Margin)
    If inside Then Call MouseMoveIcon
    ' 防 MsgBox 卡死：若 isPressed 但左键实际已松开，自动恢复
    'If isPressed Then
        'If (GetAsyncKeyState(VK_LBUTTON) And &H8000) = 0 Then
            'isPressed = False
            'If isHovered Then
                'ApplyHover True
            'Else
                'ApplyHover False
            'End If
        'End If
    'End If
    If Left(btnLabel.Name, 6) = "lblNav" Then
        If inside And Not isHovered Then
            isHovered = True
            If Not isPressed Then ApplyHover True
        ElseIf Not inside And isHovered Then
            isHovered = False
            If Not isPressed Then ApplyHover False
        End If
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If inside And Not isHovered Then
        isHovered = True
        If Not isPressed Then ApplyHover True
    ElseIf Not inside And isHovered Then
        isHovered = False
        If Not isPressed Then ApplyHover False
    End If
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' MouseDown：按下时加深颜色 + 回调窗体
'===========================================================================
Private Sub btnLabel_MouseDown(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                               ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    savedBackColor = btnLabel.backColor
    savedBorderColor = btnLabel.borderColor
    btnLabel.backColor = DarkenColor(btnLabel.backColor, PressDarkenFactor)
    btnLabel.borderColor = DarkenColor(btnLabel.borderColor, PressDarkenFactor)
    isPressed = True
    If Not ownerForm Is Nothing Then
        ownerForm.OnLabelEvent ctrlTag, "MouseDown", X, Y
    End If
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' MouseUp：松开时还原颜色
'===========================================================================
Private Sub btnLabel_MouseUp(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, _
                             ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)
    isPressed = False
    If isHovered Then
        ApplyHover True
    Else
        ApplyHover False
    End If
    If Not ownerForm Is Nothing Then
        ownerForm.OnLabelEvent ctrlTag, "MouseUp", X, Y
    End If
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' 应用悬停/普通样式
'===========================================================================
Private Sub ApplyHover(ByVal hover As Boolean)
    If isActive Then
        btnLabel.backColor = ActiveBackColor
        btnLabel.borderColor = ActiveBorderColor
        btnLabel.foreColor = ActiveForeColor
    ElseIf hover Then
        btnLabel.backColor = HoverBackColor
        btnLabel.borderColor = HoverBorderColor
        btnLabel.foreColor = HoverForeColor
    Else
        btnLabel.backColor = NormalBackColor
        btnLabel.borderColor = NormalBorderColor
        btnLabel.foreColor = NormalForeColor
    End If
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' RefreshState：刷新按钮显示状态（供外部调用，如切换选中项后）
'===========================================================================
Public Sub RefreshState()
    If isActive Then
        btnLabel.backColor = ActiveBackColor
        btnLabel.borderColor = ActiveBorderColor
        btnLabel.foreColor = ActiveForeColor
    ElseIf isPressed Then
        ' 保持按下状态不覆盖
    ElseIf isHovered Then
        btnLabel.backColor = HoverBackColor
        btnLabel.borderColor = HoverBorderColor
        btnLabel.foreColor = HoverForeColor
    Else
        btnLabel.backColor = NormalBackColor
        btnLabel.borderColor = NormalBorderColor
        btnLabel.foreColor = NormalForeColor
    End If
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' SetNavActiveColor：设置所有导航项的选中高亮色（批量设置）
'===========================================================================
Public Sub SetNavActiveColor(ByVal backColor As Long, ByVal borderColor As Long, ByVal foreColor As Long)
    Dim btn As clsLabelButton
    For Each btn In GlobalKeeper
        If Left(btn.ctrlTag, 6) = "lblNav" Then
            btn.ActiveBackColor = backColor
            btn.ActiveBorderColor = borderColor
            btn.ActiveForeColor = foreColor
        End If
    Next
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' SetActiveNav：设置当前选中的导航项，其余自动取消选中
'===========================================================================
Public Sub SetActiveNav(ByVal navTag As String)
    Dim btn As clsLabelButton
    For Each btn In GlobalKeeper
        If Left(btn.ctrlTag, 6) = "lblNav" Then
            btn.isActive = (btn.ctrlTag = navTag)
            btn.RefreshState
        End If
    Next
End Sub

'===========================================================================
' ResetInactiveLabels：重置所有非激活 Label 的 hover 状态
' 用于 UserForm_MouseMove 中兜底还原，防止鼠标快速划过时颜色残留
' 不会影响 isActive=True 的导航项（选中态保持）
'===========================================================================
Public Sub ResetInactiveLabels()
    Dim btn As clsLabelButton
    For Each btn In GlobalKeeper
        If Not btn.isActive And btn.isHovered Then
            btn.isHovered = False
            btn.RefreshState
        End If
    Next
End Sub

Private Sub m_hostFrame_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal Y As Single)

'===========================================================================
' ResetSelf：只还原当前按钮自身的 hover 状态（轻量调用）
'===========================================================================
Private Sub ResetSelf()
    If Not isActive And isHovered Then
        isHovered = False
        isPressed = False
        RefreshState
    End If
End Sub

Private Function MouseCursor(CursorType As Long) As Long
    Dim lngRet As Long
    lngRet = LoadCursorBynum(0&, CursorType)
    lngRet = SetCursor(lngRet)
End Function

Private Function MouseMoveIcon()
    Call MouseCursor(IDC_HAND)
End Function

Option Explicit

' 主转换过程
Sub ConvertXlamToXlsm()
    Dim xlamPath As String
    Dim xlsmPath As String
    Dim sourceWB As Workbook
    Dim targetWB As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim comp As Object
    Dim codeModule As Object
    Dim newModule As Object
    Dim logMsg As String
    Dim errorOccurred As Boolean
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 选择源xlam文件
    xlamPath = SelectFile("请选择要转换的ASAP Utilities.xlam文件", "加载宏文件 (*.xlam)", "*.xlam")
    If xlamPath = "" Then
        MsgBox "未选择文件，操作取消", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 设置目标文件路径
    xlsmPath = Left(xlamPath, InStrRev(xlamPath, ".")) & "xlsm"
    
    ' 检查目标文件是否存在
    If Dir(xlsmPath) <> "" Then
        If MsgBox("目标文件已存在，是否覆盖？", vbYesNo, "文件已存在") = vbNo Then
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
    
    ' 禁用屏幕更新
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    logMsg = "=== Xlam 转 Xlsm 转换日志 ===" & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "开始时间: " & Now() & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "源文件: " & xlamPath & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "目标文件: " & xlsmPath & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    ' 打开源加载宏文件
    logMsg = logMsg & "[步骤1] 打开源文件..." & vbCrLf
    Set sourceWB = Workbooks.Open(Filename:=xlamPath, ReadOnly:=True, IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True)
    logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 源文件打开成功" & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "  工作表数量: " & sourceWB.Worksheets.Count & vbCrLf
    
    ' 创建新的工作簿
    logMsg = logMsg & vbCrLf & "[步骤2] 创建新工作簿..." & vbCrLf
    Set targetWB = Workbooks.Add
    logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 新工作簿创建成功" & vbCrLf
    
    ' 复制所有工作表
    logMsg = logMsg & vbCrLf & "[步骤3] 复制工作表..." & vbCrLf
    Dim wsCount As Integer
    wsCount = 0
    For Each ws In sourceWB.Worksheets
        ws.Copy After:=targetWB.Worksheets(targetWB.Worksheets.Count)
        wsCount = wsCount + 1
    Next ws
    logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 已复制 " & wsCount & " 个工作表" & vbCrLf
    
    ' 删除默认工作表
    logMsg = logMsg & vbCrLf & "[步骤4] 清理默认工作表..." & vbCrLf
    On Error Resume Next
    targetWB.Worksheets("Sheet1").Delete
    targetWB.Worksheets("Sheet2").Delete
    targetWB.Worksheets("Sheet3").Delete
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 默认工作表已删除" & vbCrLf
    
    ' 复制所有VBA模块
    logMsg = logMsg & vbCrLf & "[步骤5] 复制VBA模块..." & vbCrLf
    Dim moduleCount As Integer, skipCount As Integer
    moduleCount = 0
    skipCount = 0
    
    ' 检查是否可以访问VBProject
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim test As Object
    Set test = sourceWB.VBProject
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 无法访问VBProject！请检查宏安全设置" & vbCrLf
        errorOccurred = True
        GoTo Finalize
    End If
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 复制模块
    For Each comp In sourceWB.VBProject.VBComponents
        ' 排除工作表和图表
        If comp.Type <> 100 And comp.Type <> 101 Then ' vbext_ct_Worksheet = 100, vbext_ct_Chart = 101
            On Error Resume Next
            Set newModule = targetWB.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(comp.Type)
            If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 跳过模块 '" & comp.Name & "' (添加失败: " & Err.Description & ")" & vbCrLf
                Err.Clear
                skipCount = skipCount + 1
                GoTo NextComp
            End If
            On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
            
            newModule.Name = comp.Name
            
            ' 复制代码
            Set codeModule = comp.codeModule
            With newModule.codeModule
                If codeModule.CountOfLines > 0 Then
                    .AddFromString codeModule.Lines(1, codeModule.CountOfLines)
                End If
            End With
            
            moduleCount = moduleCount + 1
            logMsg = logMsg & "  ? 已复制模块: " & comp.Name & " (" & codeModule.CountOfLines & " 行)" & vbCrLf
        End If

' 批量转换多个xlam文件
Sub BatchConvertXlamToXlsm()
    Dim fd As Object ' 使用Object避免引用问题
    Dim selectedItems As Variant
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim xlamPath As String
    Dim xlsmPath As String
    Dim sourceWB As Workbook
    Dim targetWB As Workbook
    Dim comp As Object
    Dim codeModule As Object
    Dim newModule As Object
    Dim successCount As Integer
    Dim failCount As Integer
    Dim logMsg As String
    
    ' 创建文件对话框
    On Error Resume Next
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "无法创建文件对话框！错误: " & Err.Description, vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    With fd
        .title = "请选择要转换的xlam文件（可多选）"
        .Filters.Clear
        .Filters.Add "加载宏文件 (*.xlam)", "*.xlam"
        .AllowMultiSelect = True
        
        ' 显示对话框
        If .Show <> -1 Then
            MsgBox "未选择文件，操作取消", vbInformation
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        ' 修复：正确获取选中的文件（使用数组方式）
        ReDim selectedItems(1 To .selectedItems.Count)
        For i = 1 To .selectedItems.Count
            selectedItems(i) = .selectedItems(i)
        Next i
    End With
    Set fd = Nothing
    
    ' 检查是否选择了文件
    If UBound(selectedItems) < 1 Then
        MsgBox "未选择任何文件", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 初始化计数器
    successCount = 0
    failCount = 0
    logMsg = "=== 批量转换日志 ===" & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "开始时间: " & Now() & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "文件数量: " & UBound(selectedItems) & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    
    ' 禁用屏幕更新
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    ' 遍历选择的文件
    For i = LBound(selectedItems) To UBound(selectedItems)
        xlamPath = selectedItems(i)
        xlsmPath = Left(xlamPath, InStrRev(xlamPath, ".")) & "xlsm"
        
        On Error Resume Next
        
        ' 打开源文件
        Set sourceWB = Workbooks.Open(Filename:=xlamPath, ReadOnly:=True)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            logMsg = logMsg & "? 失败: " & xlamPath & vbCrLf
            logMsg = logMsg & "  原因: " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
            failCount = failCount + 1
            Err.Clear
            GoTo NextFile
        End If
        
        ' 创建新工作簿
        Set targetWB = Workbooks.Add
        
        ' 复制工作表
        For Each comp In sourceWB.Worksheets
            comp.Copy After:=targetWB.Worksheets(targetWB.Worksheets.Count)
        Next comp
        
        ' 删除默认工作表
        On Error Resume Next
        targetWB.Worksheets("Sheet1").Delete
        targetWB.Worksheets("Sheet2").Delete
        targetWB.Worksheets("Sheet3").Delete
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        ' 复制VBA模块
        On Error Resume Next
        For Each comp In sourceWB.VBProject.VBComponents
            If comp.Type <> 100 And comp.Type <> 101 Then
                Set newModule = targetWB.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(comp.Type)
                If Err.Number = 0 Then
                    newModule.Name = comp.Name
                    Set codeModule = comp.codeModule
                    If codeModule.CountOfLines > 0 Then
                        newModule.codeModule.AddFromString codeModule.Lines(1, codeModule.CountOfLines)
                    End If
                End If
                Err.Clear
            End If
        Next comp
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        ' 保存
        targetWB.SaveAs Filename:=xlsmPath, FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbookMacroEnabled
        
        ' 关闭
        sourceWB.Close SaveChanges:=False
        targetWB.Close SaveChanges:=False
        
        successCount = successCount + 1
        logMsg = logMsg & "? 成功: " & xlsmPath & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
        
NextFile:
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next i
    
    ' 恢复设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    
    ' 显示结果
    logMsg = logMsg & "=== 批量转换完成 ===" & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "成功: " & successCount & " 个" & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "失败: " & failCount & " 个" & vbCrLf
    logMsg = logMsg & "完成时间: " & Now()
    
    MsgBox logMsg, vbInformation, "批量转换结果"
End Sub

Private Sub VBAPassword()    '你要解保护的Excel文件路径
    Filename = Application.GetOpenFilename("Excel文件（*.xls & *.xla & *.xlt）,*.xls;*.xla;*.xlt", , "VBA破解")
    If Dir(Filename) = "" Then
        MsgBox "没找到相关文件,清重新设置。"
        Exit Sub
    Else
        FileCopy Filename, Filename & ".bak"    '备份文件。
    End If
    Dim GetData As String * 5
    Open Filename For Binary As #1
    Dim CMGs As Long
    Dim DPBo As Long
    For i = 1 To LOF(1)
        Get #1, i, GetData
        If GetData = "CMG=""" Then CMGs = i
        If GetData = "[Host" Then DPBo = i - 2: Exit For
    Next
    If CMGs = 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先对VBA编码设置一个保护密码...", 32, "提示"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim St As String * 2
    Dim s20 As String * 1
    '取得一个0D0A十六进制字串
    Get #1, CMGs - 2, St
    '取得一个20十六制字串
    Get #1, DPBo + 16, s20
    '替换加密部份机码
    For i = CMGs To DPBo Step 2
        Put #1, i, St
    Next
    '加入不配对符号
    If (DPBo - CMGs) Mod 2 <> 0 Then
        Put #1, DPBo + 1, s20
    End If
    MsgBox "文件解密成功......", 32, "提示"
    Close #1
End Sub

Private Declare Sub MoveMemory Lib "kernel32" Alias "RtlMoveMemory" (Destination As Long, Source As Long, ByVal Length As Long)
Private Declare Function VirtualProtect Lib "kernel32" (lpAddress As Long, ByVal dwSize As Long, ByVal flNewProtect As Long, lpflOldProtect As Long) As Long

Dim HookBytes(0 To 5) As Byte
Dim OriginBytes(0 To 5) As Byte
Dim pFunc As Long
Dim Flag As Boolean
Private Function GetPtr(ByVal Value As Long) As Long
    GetPtr = Value
End Function
Public Sub RecoverBytes()
    If Flag Then MoveMemory ByVal pFunc, ByVal VarPtr(OriginBytes(0)), 6
End Sub
Public Function Hook() As Boolean
    Dim TmpBytes(0 To 5) As Byte
    Dim p As Long
    Dim OriginProtect As Long
    
    Hook = False
    pFunc = GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("user32.dll"), "DialogBoxParamA")
    If VirtualProtect(ByVal pFunc, 6, &H40, OriginProtect) <> 0 Then
        MoveMemory ByVal VarPtr(TmpBytes(0)), ByVal pFunc, 6
        If TmpBytes(0) <> &H68 Then
            MoveMemory ByVal VarPtr(OriginBytes(0)), ByVal pFunc, 6
            p = GetPtr(AddressOf MyDialogBoxParam)
            HookBytes(0) = &H68
            MoveMemory ByVal VarPtr(HookBytes(1)), ByVal VarPtr(p), 4
            HookBytes(5) = &HC3
            MoveMemory ByVal pFunc, ByVal VarPtr(HookBytes(0)), 6
            Flag = True
            Hook = True
        End If
    End If
End Function
Private Function MyDialogBoxParam(ByVal hInstance As Long, _

Private Function VBAPassword(FileName As String, Optional Protect As Boolean = False)
      If Dir(FileName) = "" Then
         Exit Function
      Else
         FileCopy FileName, FileName & ".bak"
      End If
      Dim GetData As String * 5
      Open FileName For Binary As #1
      Dim CMGs As Long
      Dim DPBo As Long
      For i = 1 To LOF(1)
          Get #1, i, GetData
          If GetData = "CMG=""" Then CMGs = i
          If GetData = "[Host" Then DPBo = i - 2: Exit For
      Next
      If CMGs = 0 Then
         MsgBox "请先对VBA编码设置一个保护密码...", 32, "提示"
         Exit Function
      End If
      If Protect = False Then
         Dim St As String * 2
         Dim s20 As String * 1
         Get #1, CMGs - 2, St
         Get #1, DPBo + 16, s20
         For i = CMGs To DPBo Step 2
             Put #1, i, St
         Next
         If (DPBo - CMGs) Mod 2 <> 0 Then
            Put #1, DPBo + 1, s20
         End If
         MsgBox "尊主，爆破密码成功！解除密码文件为*已破", 32, "提示"
      Else
         Dim MMs As String * 5
         MMs = "DPB="""
         Put #1, CMGs, MMs
         MsgBox "对文件特殊加密成功......", 32, "提示"
      End If
      Close #1
End Function

Sub VBAPassword1() '你要解保护的Excel文件路径
    FileName = Application.GetOpenFilename("Excel文件（*.xls & *.xla & *.xlt）,*.xls;*.xla;*.xlt", , "VBA破解")
    If Dir(FileName) = "" Then
        MsgBox "没找到相关文件,清重新设置。"
        Exit Sub
    Else
        FileCopy FileName, FileName & ".bak" '备份文件。
    End If
    Dim GetData As String * 5
    Open FileName For Binary As #1
    Dim CMGs As Long
    Dim DPBo As Long
    For i = 1 To LOF(1)
        Get #1, i, GetData
        If GetData = "CMG=""" Then CMGs = i
        If GetData = "[Host" Then DPBo = i - 2: Exit For
    Next
    If CMGs = 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先对VBA编码设置一个保护密码...", 32, "提示"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim St As String * 2
    Dim s20 As String * 1
    '取得一个0D0A十六进制字串
    Get #1, CMGs - 2, St
    '取得一个20十六制字串
    Get #1, DPBo + 16, s20
    '替换加密部份机码
    For i = CMGs To DPBo Step 2
        Put #1, i, St
    Next
    '加入不配对符号
    If (DPBo - CMGs) Mod 2 <> 0 Then
        Put #1, DPBo + 1, s20
    End If
    MsgBox "文件解密成功......", 32, "提示"
    Close #1

Sub CreateHeading3AfterReset()
    Dim doc As Document
    Dim style As Style
    Dim styleNames As New Collection
    Dim newStyle As Style

    Set doc = ActiveDocument

    ' 备份样式名称
    For Each style In doc.Styles
        If style.NameLocal <> "标题 3" Then
            styleNames.Add style.NameLocal
        End If
    Next style

    ' 清空样式库
    For Each style In doc.Styles
        If style.BuiltIn = False Then
            style.Delete
        End If
    Next style

    ' 创建标题 3 样式
    On Error Resume Next
    Set newStyle = doc.Styles.Add(Name:="标题 3")
    On Error GoTo 0

    If newStyle Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "创建标题 3 样式失败，请手动检查。"
    Else
        MsgBox "标题 3 样式创建成功。"
    End If

    ' 恢复其他样式
    Dim styleName As Variant
    For Each styleName In styleNames
        doc.Styles.Add styleName
    Next styleName
End Sub

重置样式库
Sub ResetStylesAndCreateHeading3()
    On Error Resume Next
    ActiveDocument.Styles("标题 3").Delete
    On Error GoTo 0
    ActiveDocument.UpdateStyles
    Dim styleObj As Style
    Set styleObj = ActiveDocument.Styles.Add(Name:="标题 3")
    If styleObj Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "仍然无法创建标题 3 样式，请手动检查样式库。"
    End If
End Sub

    Cells(currRow, currCol).Interior.ColorIndex = xlNone    ' 1不是质数，清空颜色

    ' 6. 定义乌拉姆螺旋的方向（右→上→左→下，循环）
    ' 格式：Array(行变化量, 列变化量)
    directions = Array( _
                     Array(0, 1), _
                     Array(-1, 0), _
                     Array(0, -1), _
                     Array(1, 0))
    dirIndex = 0    ' 初始方向：右
    step = 1    ' 初始移动步数
    dirCount = 0    ' 记录已走的方向数（每2个方向步数+1）
    num = 2    ' 下一个要填充的数字

    ' 7. 循环生成螺旋（容错：防止超出工作表范围）
    On Error Resume Next
    Do While num <= maxNum
        ' 按当前方向走step步
        For i = 1 To step
            ' 更新当前位置
            currRow = currRow + directions(dirIndex)(0)
            currCol = currCol + directions(dirIndex)(1)

            ' 填充数字
            Cells(currRow, currCol).Value = num

            num = num + 1
            If num > maxNum Then Exit Do
        Next i

        ' 切换方向（循环右→上→左→下）
        dirIndex = (dirIndex + 1) Mod 4
        dirCount = dirCount + 1

        ' 每走2个方向，移动步数+1（乌拉姆螺旋的核心规则）
        If dirCount Mod 2 = 0 Then
            step = step + 1
        End If
    Loop
    On Error GoTo 0

    MsgBox "乌拉姆螺旋已生成（1到" & maxNum & "）！质数已自动填充绿色。", vbInformation
End Sub

Sub MergeToLastColumnRight()

    Dim row As Range
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim mergedText As String

    ' 让用户选择区域（取消则退出）

    Set selectedRange = Application.InputBox( _
                            Prompt:="请选择需要合并内容的单元格区域", _
                            Title:="选择区域", _
                            Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If selectedRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "已取消操作。", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 设置分隔符（固定为分号）
    delimiter = ";"

    ' 计算目标列：选择区域的最后一列 + 1
    targetColumn = selectedRange.Column + selectedRange.Columns.Count + 1

    ' 遍历每行合并内容并写入目标列
    For Each row In selectedRange.Rows
        mergedText = ""    ' 重置当前行的合并文本

        ' 拼接当前行的所有单元格内容
        For Each cell In row.Cells
            If Len(Trim(cell.Value)) > 0 Then    ' 忽略空单元格

                Else
                    mergedText = mergedText & delimiter & cell.Value    ' 后续部分加分隔符

            End If
        Next cell

        ' 写入目标列（当前行的 targetColumn 列）
        Cells(row.row, targetColumn).Value = mergedText

    Dim i As Long

    Const GMEM_MOVEABLE = &H2
    Const GMEM_ZEROINIT = &H40

    End If

    ' 将字符串转换为ANSI字节数组（含终止符\0）
    byteData = StrConv(cellValue & Chr(0), vbFromUnicode)  ' 手动添加null终止符

        hGlobal = GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE Or GMEM_ZEROINIT, UBound(byteData) + 1)
        If hGlobal <> 0 Then

            If lpGlobal <> 0 Then
                ' 精确复制字节数组到内存（避免垃圾数据）
                CopyMemory lpGlobal, byteData(0), UBound(byteData) + 1
                GlobalUnlock hGlobal

    Dim vArray As Variant

Public Sub BubbleSortLen(ByRef vArray As Variant)
    Dim i As Long
    Dim j As Long
    Dim sTemp As String

    For i = LBound(vArray) To UBound(vArray) - 1
        For j = i To UBound(vArray)
            If Len(vArray(j)) > Len(vArray(i)) Then
                sTemp = vArray(i)
                vArray(i) = vArray(j)
                vArray(j) = sTemp
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
End Sub

Sub DeleteFilesBySuffix()

    Dim lastRow As Long

    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim filePattern As String
    Dim fileName As String
    Dim deletedCount As Long
    Dim errorCount As Long
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    deletedCount = 0
    errorCount = 0
    
    Const FILE_SUFFIX As String = "_进制码生成器.xlsm"
    
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        folderPath = ws.Cells(i, "A").Value
        folderPath = Replace(folderPath, "/", "\")
    
        If folderPath <> "" Then
            If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) <> "" Then
                filePattern = "*" & FILE_SUFFIX
                fileName = Dir(folderPath & "\" & filePattern)
    
                Do While fileName <> ""
                    On Error Resume Next
                    Kill folderPath & "\" & fileName
                    If Err.Number = 0 Then
                        deletedCount = deletedCount + 1
                    Else
                        errorCount = errorCount + 1
                    End If
                    On Error GoTo 0
                    fileName = Dir
                Loop
            Else
                errorCount = errorCount + 1
            End If
        Else
            errorCount = errorCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

'批量提取数据
Sub ExtractXLSMData_WithLog()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim xlsmFile As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim sourceWs As Worksheet
    Dim targetAddress As String
    Dim resultRow As Long
    Dim logMsg As String
    Dim successCount As Long, failCount As Long
    Dim startTime As Date
    
    ' 记录开始时间
    startTime = Now
    
    ' 初始化统计变量
    successCount = 0
    failCount = 0
    
    ' 设置当前工作表
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row       ' 获取 B 列最后一行
    
    ' 禁用屏幕更新、自动计算和事件处理以提高性能
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    
    ' 创建日志列（如果不存在）
    If ws.Cells(1, "T").Value = "" Then
        ws.Cells(1, "T").Value = "处理日志"
    End If
    
    ' 遍历 B 列的文件夹路径（从第 2 行开始，第 1 行是表头）
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        On Error GoTo ProcessError
        
        logMsg = ""
        folderPath = ws.Cells(i, "B").Value
        resultRow = i                                          ' 结果写入当前行
        
        ' 每处理50个文件释放一次资源
        If i Mod 50 = 0 Then
            DoEvents ' 释放系统资源
            ws.Application.StatusBar = "已处理 " & i & " 个文件，共 " & lastRow - 1 & " 个..."
        End If
        
        ' 1. 检查文件夹路径是否为空
        If folderPath = "" Then
            logMsg = "B" & i & " 单元格路径为空，跳过"
            GoTo ProcessComplete
        End If
        
        ' 2. 检查路径是否存在
        If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then
            logMsg = "路径不存在: " & folderPath
            GoTo ProcessComplete
        End If
        
        ' 3. 查找文件夹下的 .xlsm 文件（只取第一个）
        xlsmFile = Dir(folderPath & "\*.xlsm")
        If xlsmFile = "" Then
            logMsg = "未找到 .xlsm 文件: " & folderPath
            GoTo ProcessComplete
        End If
        
        ' 4. 尝试打开 .xlsm 文件
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folderPath & "\" & xlsmFile, ReadOnly:=True, UpdateLinks:=False)
        
        ' 5. 获取文件中的第一个工作表
        Set sourceWs = wb.Worksheets(1)
        
        ' 6. 遍历 D1:R1 获取目标单元格地址并提取内容
        Dim hasData As Boolean
        hasData = False
        
        For j = 4 To 19
            targetAddress = ws.Cells(1, j).Value               ' 读取 D1:S1 的单元格地址
            
            If targetAddress <> "" Then
                ' 验证目标地址格式是否正确
                If IsValidCellAddress(targetAddress) Then
                    ws.Cells(resultRow, j).Value = sourceWs.Range(targetAddress).Value
                    If Not IsError(ws.Cells(resultRow, j).Value) Then
                        hasData = True
                    Else
                        logMsg = logMsg & " 目标单元格 " & targetAddress & " 包含错误值"
                    End If
                Else
                    logMsg = logMsg & " 无效的单元格地址: " & targetAddress
                End If
            End If
        Next j
        
        ' 7. 写入工作表名称到 S 列
        ws.Cells(resultRow, "T").Value = sourceWs.name
        
        ' 8. 统计成功情况
        If hasData Then
            successCount = successCount + 1
            logMsg = "处理成功: " & xlsmFile & logMsg
        Else
            failCount = failCount + 1
            logMsg = "无有效数据提取: " & xlsmFile & logMsg
        End If
        
ProcessCleanup:
        ' 确保工作簿已关闭
        If Not wb Is Nothing Then
            wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
            Set wb = Nothing
        End If
        Set sourceWs = Nothing
        
        GoTo ProcessComplete
        
ProcessError:
        logMsg = "处理出错: " & Err.Description
        failCount = failCount + 1
        Resume ProcessCleanup
        
ProcessComplete:
        ' 记录日志到 T 列
'        ws.Cells(resultRow, "T").Value = logMsg
        
        ' 重置错误处理
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next i
    
    ' 恢复Excel设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    ws.Application.StatusBar = False
    
    ' 显示处理结果
'    MsgBox "处理完成！" & vbCrLf & _
'            "共处理: " & (lastRow - 1) & " 个文件夹" & vbCrLf & _
'            "成功提取: " & successCount & " 个文件" & vbCrLf & _
'            "失败/跳过: " & failCount & " 个文件" & vbCrLf & _
'            "耗时: " & Format(Now - startTime, "hh:mm:ss") & vbCrLf & _
'            "详情请查看 T 列日志", vbInformation
End Sub

'根据模板文件和数据批量生成文件
Sub WriteToTemplateAndSave()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim templatePath As String
    Dim wbTemplate As Workbook
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long, col As Long
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim fileName As String
    Dim fullPath As String
    Dim targetCell As String
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False ' 禁用警告对话框
    
    ' 设置当前工作表
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    ' 模板文件路径
    templatePath = ws.Range("X1").Value
    
    ' 检查模板文件是否存在
    If Len(Dir(templatePath)) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "模板文件不存在：" & templatePath, vbCritical
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取当前工作表数据最后一行行号
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
    
    ' 遍历数据行（从第2行开始，第1行是表头）
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' 获取文件夹路径（B列）
        folderPath = ws.Cells(i, "B").Value
        
        ' 获取文件名（C列，假设已包含扩展名）
        fileName = ws.Cells(i, "C").Value
        
        ' 处理路径中的斜杠问题
        folderPath = Replace(folderPath, "/", "\")
        
        ' 确保路径以反斜杠结尾
        If Right(folderPath, 1) <> "\" Then folderPath = folderPath & "\"
        
        ' 构建完整文件路径
        fullPath = folderPath & fileName
        
        ' 检查文件夹路径是否存在
        If Len(Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory)) = 0 Then
            MsgBox "文件夹不存在：" & folderPath & vbCrLf & "行号：" & i, vbCritical
            GoTo NextRecord
        End If
        
        ' 打开模板工作簿
        Set wbTemplate = Workbooks.Open(templatePath, ReadOnly:=False)
        
        ' 遍历 D 到 R 列（列号 4 到 18）
        For col = 4 To 18
            ' 获取第一行对应列的目标单元格地址
            targetCell = ws.Cells(1, col).Value
            
            If targetCell <> "" Then
                ' 将当前行对应列的值写入模板文件的目标单元格
                On Error Resume Next
                wbTemplate.Worksheets(1).Range(targetCell).Value = ws.Cells(i, col).Value
                If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                    Debug.Print "写入错误: 行=" & i & ", 列=" & col & ", 目标单元格=" & targetCell & ", 错误=" & Err.Description
                    Err.Clear
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        Next col
        
        ' 另存为新文件（自动替换已存在的文件）
        On Error Resume Next
        wbTemplate.SaveAs fileName:=fullPath
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "保存文件失败：" & fullPath & vbCrLf & "错误：" & Err.Description, vbCritical
            Err.Clear
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        ' 关闭模板工作簿
        wbTemplate.Close SaveChanges:=False
        
NextRecord:
        ' 释放对象
        Set wbTemplate = Nothing
    Next i
    
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True ' 恢复警告对话框
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "操作完成！共处理 " & (lastRow - 1) & " 条记录", vbInformation
End Sub

Sub MergeCells(source As Range, target As Range)
    Dim current As Range
    Dim start As Integer
    '遍历原始单元格区域的每一个单元格
    For Each current In source
        '拼接单元格的所有内容内容
        target.Value = target.Value & current.Text
    Next
    '遍历原始单元格区域内每一个单元格
    '标识目标单元格当前文本的开始位置
    start = 1
    For Each current In source
        '设置目标单元格每一段内容的字体样式
        '设置目标单元格新拼接内容的字体样式
        With target.Characters(start, Len(current.Text)).Font
            .Name = current.Font.Name
            .FontStyle = current.Font.FontStyle
            .Size = current.Font.Size
            .Strikethrough = current.Font.Strikethrough
            .Superscript = current.Font.Superscript
            .Subscript = current.Font.Subscript
            .OutlineFont = current.Font.OutlineFont
            .Shadow = current.Font.Shadow
            .Underline = current.Font.Underline
            .ColorIndex = current.Font.ColorIndex
        End With
        '重置目标单元格的文本开始位置
        start = start + Len(current.Text)
    Next
End Sub

Function strToUcase(rg As Range) As String
    Dim strTemp As String, strResult As String
    Dim strSplit() As String, lngIndex As Long
    
    strTemp = rg.Text
    strSplit = Split(strTemp, " ")
    
    For lngIndex = LBound(strSplit) To UBound(strSplit)
        strTemp = Trim(strSplit(lngIndex))
        strTemp = LCase(strTemp)
        strSplit(lngIndex) = UCase(Left(strTemp, 1)) & Mid(strTemp, 2)
    Next
    
    If UBound(strSplit) > 0 Then
        ReDim Preserve strSplit(UBound(strSplit) + 1)
        strSplit(UBound(strSplit)) = strSplit(0)
        strSplit(0) = ""
    End If
    
    strTemp = Join(strSplit, " ")
    strToUcase = Trim(strTemp)
End Function

'Range.SpecialCells方法表示定位，语法为：Range.SpecialCells(Type, Value)
'参数Type代表单元格类型，赋值为xlCellTypeBlanks表示空白单元格，赋值为xlCellTypeConstants表示常量单元格，xlCellTypeFormulas表示公式单元格，xlCellTypeVisible表示所有可见单元格
'参数Value用于限定值的类型，赋值为16表示错误值，赋值为4表示逻辑值，赋值为4表示数值，赋值为2表示文本
Sub 定位所有错误值()
    Dim ValueErr As Range, FormulaErr As Range, ErrBl As Boolean '声明变量
    On Error Resume Next '如果程序出错继续执行下一句
    Set ValueErr = Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeConstants, 16) '定位错误值单元格
    If Err <> 0 Then '如果定位出错(表示没有)
        ErrBl = True '将布尔变量赋值为True
        Err.Clear    '清除错误，避免影响后续的判断
    End If
    Set FormulaErr = Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeFormulas, 16) '定位错误公式单元格
    If Err <> 0 Then '如果定位出错(表示没有)
        '如果变量ErrBl的值为True，那么提示用户不存在错误值，否则定位错误值所在单元格

        '如果变量ErrBl的值为True，那么定位错误公式所在单元格，否则定位错误值和错误公式所在单元格

    End If
End Sub

Sub BatchInsertImgsWithPreview(start As Range, folderPath As String)

    imgIndex = 0

Function RecSort(arr, Optional z& = 0, Optional c& = 0)
   '参数-1：arr 对一维数组arr中的内容进行A-Z排序
   '参数-2：z   可以指定z=1 去重复、z=0 不去重复 默认z=0不去重复
   '参数-3：c   可以指定对数值内容的排序模式
   '        默认c=0 保持原数据格式(文本、数值分开排序,先数值后文本) 如: 1、3、12、"1"、"12"、"2"、"21"、"3" 
   '              c=1 一律按数值排序如 1、2、3、21、33
   '             c=-1 一律按文本排序如 "1"、"2"、"21"、"3"、"33"

    Dim i&, j&, k&, l&, n&, u&, t
    l = LBound(arr): n = l: u = UBound(arr)
    ReDim trr(l To u) '定义存放排序结果的数组trr
    
    For i = l To u '遍历检查
        t = arr(i): If IsNumeric(t) Then If c = 1 Then t = Val(t) Else If c = -1 Then t = CStr(t)
        '如为数值 则根据c参数转换　c=1 转为数值　=0 保持原来格式　=-1 转为文本数值
        For j = l To n '遍历检查已有数据
            If z Then If trr(j) = t Then n = n - 1: Exit For 'z=1 去重复/=0 重复可
            If trr(j) > t Then
                For k = n To j + 1 Step -1 '倒序交換位置空出新位置
                    trr(k) = trr(k - 1)
                Next
                trr(k) = t '空出位置插入新值t
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
        If j > n Then trr(j - 1) = t '最后位置插入新值t
        n = n + 1
    Next
    If z Then ReDim Preserve trr(l To n - 1) '去重复时重新定义数组trr大小
    RecSort = trr '输出排序后的一维数组结果
End Function

Function ArraySortIndex(ar, h&, ParamArray sr())
    'by kagawa 2015/12/4-12/7 主要参考借鉴了Zamyi大侠的二维数组多key排序算法
    '本函数 对二维数组排序后 返回index
    '第1参数ar：为待排序二维数组
    '第2参数h：为不参与排序的标题行的行数
    '第3参数sr：为按权重优先顺序key、Sort值交替排列的一维数组、或以逗号分隔直接写入Key、Sort值。
    Dim br, y, sr2, i&, i2&, i3&, i4&, j&, j2&, k&, l&, u&, s&, t
    l = LBound(ar) + h: u = UBound(ar) '获取数组起始、结束位置
    ReDim x&(l To u), z(l To u + 1) As Boolean '定义存放Index序号的数组x、标记段落结束位置的数组z
    For i = l To u
        x(i) = i 'Index赋值为数组行序号、这以后排序就只需改变这个Index位置、原始数组无需改变
    Next
    z(u + 1) = True '标记最后结束位置
    If UBound(sr) = 0 Then sr2 = sr(0) Else sr2 = sr '判断第3参数是数组、还是多Key、Sort值序列
    j = sr2(0): If sr2(1) Mod 2 Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j, l, u) Else Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j, l, u)
    '按key1先进行QuickSort排序
    If sr2(1) = 1 Then Call AZE(ar, x, j, l, u) '如果Sort值=1则需要调用AZE过程、把空值移动到最后
    For k = 2 To UBound(sr2) Step 2 '接着循环继续key2以后的排序
        '        br = ArrayChongZu(ar, x, h): [k1].Resize(UBound(br) - LBound(br) + 1, UBound(br, 2) - LBound(br, 2) + 1) = br
        j2 = sr2(k): s = sr2(k + 1) '读取排序key的列序号j2 和Sort值s
        i = l: t = ar(x(i), j): i2 = i 'Do循环检查是否前key相同【注意，仅仅前key相同部分需要继续排序】
        Do
            Do
                i2 = i2 + 1: If z(i2) Then Exit Do Else If ar(x(i2), j) <> t Then z(i2) = True: Exit Do
                '递增检查如果到了前前key的结束位置、或前key不同则停止退出Do循环
            Loop
            If i2 - i > 1 Then '如果间隔>1 则本key需要排序处理【注意排序区间是小范围i,i2-1】
                If s Mod 2 Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j2, i, i2 - 1) Else Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j2, i, i2 - 1)
                If s = 1 Then Call AZE(ar, x, j2, i, i2 - 1) '如果Sort值=1则需要调用AZE过程、把空值移动到最后
            End If
            If i2 > u Then Exit Do Else i = i2: t = ar(x(i), j) '循环到最后时退出、否则继续从i2重新开始Do循环
        Loop
        j = j2 '更新前key列位置j
    Next
    '全部排序循环结束后、为保证最后的排序稳定性、检查最后的key值相同时必须按Index值排序。
    i = l: t = ar(x(i), j): i2 = i
    Do
        Do
            i2 = i2 + 1: If z(i2) Then Exit Do Else If ar(x(i2), j) <> t Then Exit Do '检查方法相同
        Loop
        If i2 - i > 1 Then Call QuickSort(x, i, i2 - 1) '如果间隔>1 则Index值需要排序处理
        If i2 > u Then Exit Do Else i = i2: t = ar(x(i), j) '循环到最后时退出、否则继续
    Loop
    ArraySortIndex = x '多key稳定排序处理结束、返回排序结果的Index数组x
End Function
Private Function ArrayChongZu(ar, nr, h&)
    'Output Result Array 按排序后nr数组顺序、引用原数组对应Index值各列返回数组排序结果
    'ar--源数组
    'br--新序号
    'h---标题行数
    Dim br, i&, i2&, j2&, l&, l2&, u&, u2&
    l = LBound(ar) + h: u = UBound(ar)
    l2 = LBound(ar, 2): u2 = UBound(ar, 2)
    br = ar
    For i = l To u
        i2 = nr(i) '引用原数组对应Index值
        For j2 = l2 To u2
            br(i, j2) = ar(i2, j2) '按排序结果引用原数组对应值返回
        Next
    Next
    ArrayChongZu = br
End Function
Private Function QuickSort(x, l&, u&) 'A-Z QuickSort '最后稳定排序时对相同key的Index值升序排序
    'x=要排序的数组
    'l 开始排序的下标
    'u 结束排序的下标
    Dim i&, j&, n, r
    i = l: j = u: r = x((l + u) \ 2)
    While i < j
        While x(i) < r: i = i + 1: Wend 'A-Z
            While x(j) > r: j = j - 1: Wend 'A-Z
                If i <= j Then: n = x(i): x(i) = x(j): x(j) = n: i = i + 1: j = j - 1
            Wend
            If l < j Then Call QuickSort(x, l, j)
            If i < u Then Call QuickSort(x, i, u)
End Function
Private Function QuickSort1(ar, x, j2&, l&, u&) 'A-Z QuickSort 按原数组j2列对应内容进行升序排序
    Dim i&, j&, n, r
    i = l: j = u: r = ar(x((l + u) \ 2), j2)
    While i < j
        While ar(x(i), j2) < r And i < u: i = i + 1: Wend   'A-Z
            While ar(x(j), j2) > r And j > l: j = j - 1: Wend   'A-Z
                If i <= j Then n = x(i): x(i) = x(j): x(j) = n: i = i + 1: j = j - 1
            Wend
            If l < j Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j2, l, j)
            If i < u Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j2, i, u)
End Function
Private Function QuickSort2(ar, x, j2&, l&, u&) 'Z-A QuickSort 按原数组j2列对应内容进行降序排序
    Dim i&, j&, n, r
    i = l: j = u: r = ar(x((l + u) \ 2), j2)
    While i < j
        While ar(x(i), j2) > r And i < u: i = i + 1: Wend 'Z-A
            While ar(x(j), j2) < r And j > l: j = j - 1: Wend 'Z-A
                If i <= j Then n = x(i): x(i) = x(j): x(j) = n: i = i + 1: j = j - 1
            Wend
            If l < j Then Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j2, l, j)
            If i < u Then Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j2, i, u)
End Function
Private Function AZE(ar, x, j, l&, u&) 'Sort值=1时、把排序完成后的空值移动到最后
    Dim i&, i2&, y
    For i = l To u
        If ar(x(i), j) <> "" Then '检查直到非空位置时停止
            y = x '复制Index数组x到y
            For i2 = l To i - 1
                x(u - i + i2 + 1) = y(i2) '前面的空值对应Index值移动到最后
            Next
            For i2 = i To u
                x(i2 - i + l) = y(i2) '后面的非空值对应Index值移动到前面
            Next
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
End Function
Function RankAdvanced(arr_rng, ncol, rankType As EnumRankType)
    '对arr数组(2维)排序 对数组的ncol列作为关键字进行排序
    '返回一个 n行一列的数组
    '排名方式 0-中式,1-美式
    Dim brr, i, crr, arr, drr, j
    arr = arr_rng
    brr = ArraySortIndex(arr, 0, ncol, 2)
    ReDim crr(1 To UBound(arr), 1 To 1)
    ReDim drr(1 To UBound(arr), 1 To 1)
    crr(1, 1) = 1
    If rankType = 1 Then '美式
        For i = 2 To UBound(brr)
            If brr(i, ncol) = brr(i - 1, ncol) Then
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1)
            Else
                crr(i, 1) = i
            End If
        Next
    Else '中式
        For i = 2 To UBound(brr)
            If brr(i, ncol) = brr(i - 1, ncol) Then

            Else
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1) + 1
            End If
        Next
    End If
    '名次按原位置摆放
    For i = 1 To UBound(arr)
        For j = 1 To UBound(brr)
            If arr(i, ncol) = brr(j, ncol) Then
                drr(i, 1) = crr(j, 1)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    RankAdvanced = drr
End Function

Function Transpose2(arr As Variant)
    Dim brr(), i, j, n
    n = NumberOfArrayDimensions(arr)
    If n = 1 Then
        ReDim brr(LBound(arr) To UBound(arr), 1 To 1)
        For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
            brr(i, 1) = arr(i)
        Next
    Else
        ReDim brr(LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2), LBound(arr) To UBound(arr))
        For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
            For j = LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2)
                brr(j, i) = arr(i, j)
            Next
        Next
    End If
    Transpose2 = brr
End Function

'函数ZZ功能，根据正规表达式，替换或判断或提取字符串
'参数 str 源字符串
'参数 Parttern 正则表达式字符串
'参数 ActionID  函数功能 1正则方法一，替换符合正规表达式的字符
                        '2正则方法二 判断是否有符合正规表达式
                        '3正则方法三,提取符合正规表达式的字符
'参数 Repstr 指定替换的字符，可选项，默认为空
Function ZZ(Str As String, Parttern As String, ActionID As Integer, Optional RepStr As String = "")
    Dim regex As Object
    Set regex = CreateObject("vbscript.regexp")
    With regex
        .Global = True
        .IgnoreCase = True
        .MultiLine = True
        .Pattern = Parttern
    End With
    Select Case ActionID
        Case 1:
            ZZ = regex.Replace(Str, RepStr)
        Case 2:
            ZZ = regex.test(Str)
        Case 3:
            Dim matches As Object
            Set matches = regex.Execute(Str)
            For Each Match In matches
                ZZ = ZZ & Match.Value
            Next
    End Select
End Function

Sub 工作簿拆分()
  On Error Resume Next
  Dim Pathstr As String, i As Long, ActiveWB As String
  With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)    '创建文件对话框的实例
    If .Show Then  '如果在对话框中单击了"确定"
      Pathstr = .SelectedItems(1)  '将选定的路径赋予变量
    Else
      Exit Sub  '否则退出程序
    End If
  End With
  Pathstr = Pathstr & IIf(Right(Pathstr, 1) = "\", "", "\")    '如果不是“\”结尾则添加“\”
  Application.ScreenUpdating = False
  ActiveWB = ActiveWorkbook.Name    '记录活工作簿名
  For i = 1 To Sheets.Count    '循环所有工作表
    Sheets(i).Copy    '复制工作表到新工作簿中（忽略了参数）
    '将工作簿另存，文件名由工作表名决定。而文件的后缀名则由Excel程序的版本决定
    ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs Filename:=Pathstr & Workbooks(ActiveWB).Sheets(i).Name & IIf(Application.Version * 1 < 12, ".xls", ".xlsx"), FileFormat:=xlWorkbookDefault, CreateBackup:=False
    With ActiveSheet.UsedRange    '引用已用区域
      '查找“=*]*'!”，也就是检查是否存在外部引用
      Set cell = .Find("=*]*'!", LookIn:=xlFormulas, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, LookAt:=xlPart, MatchCase:=True)
      If cell Is Nothing Then GoTo line
      FirstAddress = cell.Address    '记录第一个找到的地址
      Do
        cell = cell.Value  '将公式转换成值
        Set cell = .FindNext(cell)  '查找下一个
        If cell Is Nothing Then Exit Do  '如果未找进到则退出循环
        If cell.Address = FirstAddress Then Exit Do  '如果回到第一次找到的单元格则退出循环
      Loop
    End With
line:
    ActiveWindow.Close  '关闭窗口
    Workbooks(ActiveWB).Activate  '激活待拆分的工作簿
  Next i
  Application.ScreenUpdating = True  '恢复屏幕更新
  Shell "EXPLORER.EXE " & Pathstr, vbNormalFocus  '打开文件夹
End Sub

Sub MergeWorkbooks()
Dim fldPath As String
    Dim p As String, f As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim arr As Variant
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, m As Long
    Dim brr As Variant
    Dim fileName As String
    Dim colCount As Long
    Dim fName As String
        With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
        .Title = "请选择要合并的文件夹"
        If .Show <> -1 Then
            MsgBox "未选择文件夹，退出！", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
        fldPath = .SelectedItems(1) & "\"
    End With
    ' 关闭卡顿
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    ' 路径
    p = ThisWorkbook.Path & "\"
    f = Dir(p & "*.xls*")
    m = 0
    
    ' 先定义超大数组（动态）
    ReDim brr(1 To 100000, 1 To 100) ' 足够大
    
    Do While f <> ""
        If f <> ThisWorkbook.Name Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Set wb = Workbooks.Open(fileName:=p & f, ReadOnly:=True)
            On Error GoTo 0
            
            If Not wb Is Nothing Then
                ' 取第一个工作表有效数据
                With wb.Sheets(1)
                    If .[B4].CurrentRegion.Rows.Count >= 2 Then
                        arr = .[B4].CurrentRegion
                        colCount = UBound(arr, 2)
                        
                        ' 循环读取（从第2行开始）
                        For i = 2 To UBound(arr)
                            m = m + 1
                            brr(m, 1) = Split(f, ".xls")(0)   ' 工作簿名
                            brr(m, 2) = .Name                 ' 工作表名
                            
                            ' 复制数据
                            For j = 1 To colCount

                                End If
                            Next j
                        Next i
                    End If
                End With
                
                wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
                Set wb = Nothing
            End If
        End If
        f = Dir()
    Loop
    
    ' 写入结果
    If m > 0 Then
        ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1).[A3].CurrentRegion.Offset(1).ClearContents
        ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1).[A4].Resize(m, 100) = brr
    End If
    
    ' 恢复环境

' 按表格完整信息批量添加VBA引用（含版本号）
Sub BatchAddReferencesFromTable()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim guid As String
    Dim major As Long, minor As Long
    Dim ref As Object
    Dim addedCount As Long
    Dim existCount As Long
    Dim errorCount As Long

    On Error Resume Next
    If ThisWorkbook.VBProject Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox " 请先在【文件→选项→信任中心→信任中心设置→宏设置】，" & vbCrLf & _
               "勾选【信任对VBA工程对象模型的访问】", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Sheet1")
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "C").End(xlUp).Row ' 以C列GUID判断最后一行
    
    addedCount = 0
    existCount = 0
    errorCount = 0
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' 读取C列GUID，跳过空行
        guid = Trim(ws.Cells(i, "C").Value)
        If guid = "" Then GoTo NextLine
        
        ' 读取D列主版本、E列次版本，空值自动补默认1,0
        major = Val(ws.Cells(i, "D").Value)
        minor = Val(ws.Cells(i, "E").Value)
        If major = 0 Then major = 1 ' 主版本为空默认1
        ' 次版本为空默认0
        
        ' 5. 检查引用是否已存在，避免重复添加
        If IsReferenceExists(guid) Then
            existCount = existCount + 1
            GoTo NextLine
        End If
        
        ' 6. 按GUID+版本号添加引用
        On Error Resume Next
        Set ref = ThisWorkbook.VBProject.References.AddFromGuid(guid, major, minor)
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            addedCount = addedCount + 1
'            Debug.Print " 成功添加: " & ws.Cells(i, "A").Value & " | 版本: " & major & "." & minor
        Else
            errorCount = errorCount + 1
'            Debug.Print " 添加失败: " & ws.Cells(i, "A").Value & " | 错误: " & Err.Description
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
        
NextLine:
    Next i
    
    ' 7. 弹出最终统计结果
    MsgBox " 批量添加引用完成！" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "新增引用: " & addedCount & " 个" & vbCrLf & _
           "已存在跳过: " & existCount & " 个" & vbCrLf & _
           "添加失败: " & errorCount & " 个", vbInformation
    
    ' 释放对象
    Set ref = Nothing
    Set ws = Nothing
End Sub

Sub SplitWorksheetFixed()
    Dim sourceSheet As Worksheet
    Dim newSheet As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim sheetName As String
    Dim time1 As Date
    Dim markers As Collection
    Dim i As Long, cycle As Integer

    time1 = Now()
    sheetName = "4434"
    Set sourceSheet = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("CS_" & sheetName & "汇总")

    ' 获取总行数（使用非合并单元格的列确定实际数据行数）
    lastRow = sourceSheet.Cells(sourceSheet.Rows.Count, 2).End(xlUp).Row    ' 使用B列获取行数，避免A列合并单元格的影响

    ' 查找所有标记行（A列中字符数大于5的单元格）
    Set markers = New Collection
    For i = 2 To lastRow    ' 从第2行开始（跳过标题行）
        If Len(CStr(sourceSheet.Cells(i, 1).Value)) > 5 Then
            markers.Add i
        End If
    Next i

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False

    ' 为每个标记创建新工作表
    For cycle = 1 To markers.Count
        ' 复制整个源工作表
        sourceSheet.Copy After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count)
        Set newSheet = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count)
        newSheet.Name = sheetName & Format(cycle, "00")

        ' 计算当前周期的数据行范围（固定7行）
        Dim startRow As Long, endRow As Long
        startRow = markers(cycle)    ' 标记行
        endRow = startRow + 6    ' 固定7行（包括标记行）

        ' 确保不超过工作表末尾
        If endRow > lastRow Then
            endRow = lastRow
        End If

        ' 获取新工作表的实际行数（使用非合并单元格的列）
        Dim newLastRow As Long
        newLastRow = newSheet.Cells(newSheet.Rows.Count, 2).End(xlUp).Row    ' 使用B列获取行数

        ' 删除不属于当前周期的行（从下往上删除，避免行号变化）
        ' 先删除后面的行
        If endRow < lastRow Then
            ' 计算在新工作表中要删除的行范围
            Dim deleteStart As Long
            deleteStart = endRow + 1    ' 当前周期结束后的第一行

            ' 确保不会删除标题行
            If deleteStart > 1 Then
                newSheet.Rows(deleteStart & ":" & newLastRow).Delete
            End If
        End If

        ' 再删除前面的行（保留标题行）
        If startRow > 2 Then
            ' 删除当前周期之前的数据行（保留标题行）
            newSheet.Rows("2:" & (startRow - 1)).Delete
        End If

        ' 定位到A1单元格
        newSheet.Range("A1").Select

        ' 确保新工作表只有正确的行数
        Dim finalRowCount As Long
        finalRowCount = newSheet.Cells(newSheet.Rows.Count, 2).End(xlUp).Row

        ' 如果还有多余的行，删除它们（从下往上检查）
        If finalRowCount > 8 Then    ' 标题行 + 7行数据
            For i = finalRowCount To 9 Step -1
                ' 检查当前行是否包含数据（使用非合并单元格的列）
                If newSheet.Cells(i, 2).Value <> "" Then
                    ' 如果包含数据，停止删除
                    Exit For
                Else
                    ' 如果不包含数据，删除空行
                    newSheet.Rows(i).Delete
                End If
            Next i
        End If
        newSheet.Range("A1").Select
        Application.Goto newSheet.Range("A1"), True
    Next cycle

    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.EnableEvents = True

'    MsgBox "耗时:" & Format(Now() - time1, "hh:mm:ss") & vbCrLf & _
'           "工作表拆分完成，共创建" & markers.Count & "个工作表"
End Sub

Sub CustomFilter()
    Dim sourceRange As Range
    Dim filterGroupRange As Range
    Dim current As Range
    Dim filter As String
    Dim filterArray As Variant
    Dim isExist As Variant
    Dim targetFilterArray As Variant

    With ActiveSheet
        Set sourceRange = .Range("A1:D10")   ' 活动表的数据筛选范围
        Set filterGroupRange = .Range("C2:C10") ' 活动表的筛选分组范围
    End With

        If sourceRange.AutoFilter Then sourceRange.AutoFilter
        For Each current In filterGroupRange
            If Trim(current.Value) <> "" Then ' 跳过空单元格
                filterArray = Split(current.Value, ",")
                ' 清理数组：去空格、转大写、去空值（解决"A"匹配不到"a"/"A "的问题）
                filterArray = CleanFilterArray(filterArray)
                isExist = Application.Match(UCase(Trim(filter)), filterArray, 0)
                If Not IsError(isExist) Then
                    targetFilterArray = filterArray ' 匹配成功，获取筛选数组
                    Exit For
                End If
            End If
        Next current
        
        ' 仅当找到匹配数组时执行筛选（避免空数组筛选）
        If Not IsEmpty(targetFilterArray) Then
            sourceRange.AutoFilter Field:=3, _
                Criteria1:=targetFilterArray, Operator:=xlFilterValues
'            MsgBox "筛选成功！" & vbCrLf & "关键词：" & filter & vbCrLf & "筛选值：" & Join(targetFilterArray, ",")

        End If
    End If

' 辅助函数：清理筛选数组（去空格、转大写、去空值）
Private Function CleanFilterArray(arr As Variant) As Variant
    Dim tempArr() As String
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    Dim val As String
    
    j = 0
    ReDim tempArr(0 To UBound(arr))
    
    For i = 0 To UBound(arr)
        val = UCase(Trim(arr(i))) ' 转大写+去空格，统一匹配规则
        If val <> "" Then ' 跳过空值
            tempArr(j) = val
            j = j + 1
        End If
    Next i
    
    If j > 0 Then
        ReDim Preserve tempArr(0 To j - 1)
        CleanFilterArray = tempArr
    Else
        CleanFilterArray = Empty
    End If
End Function

'一维数组自定义排序
Function RecSort(arr, Optional z& = 0, Optional c& = 0)
   '参数-1：arr 对一维数组arr中的内容进行A-Z排序
   '参数-2：z   可以指定z=1 去重复、z=0 不去重复 默认z=0不去重复
   '参数-3：c   可以指定对数值内容的排序模式
   '        默认c=0 保持原数据格式(文本、数值分开排序,先数值后文本) 如: 1、3、12、"1"、"12"、"2"、"21"、"3" 
   '              c=1 一律按数值排序如 1、2、3、21、33
   '             c=-1 一律按文本排序如 "1"、"2"、"21"、"3"、"33"

    Dim i&, j&, k&, l&, n&, u&, t
    l = LBound(arr): n = l: u = UBound(arr)
    ReDim trr(l To u) '定义存放排序结果的数组trr
    
    For i = l To u '遍历检查
        t = arr(i): If IsNumeric(t) Then If c = 1 Then t = Val(t) Else If c = -1 Then t = CStr(t)
        '如为数值 则根据c参数转换　c=1 转为数值　=0 保持原来格式　=-1 转为文本数值
        For j = l To n '遍历检查已有数据
            If z Then If trr(j) = t Then n = n - 1: Exit For 'z=1 去重复/=0 重复可
            If trr(j) > t Then
                For k = n To j + 1 Step -1 '倒序交換位置空出新位置
                    trr(k) = trr(k - 1)
                Next
                trr(k) = t '空出位置插入新值t
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
        If j > n Then trr(j - 1) = t '最后位置插入新值t
        n = n + 1
    Next
    If z Then ReDim Preserve trr(l To n - 1) '去重复时重新定义数组trr大小
    RecSort = trr '输出排序后的一维数组结果
End Function

Function ArraySortIndex(ar, h&, ParamArray sr())
    'by kagawa 2015/12/4-12/7 主要参考借鉴了Zamyi大侠的二维数组多key排序算法
    '本函数 对二维数组排序后 返回index
    '第1参数ar：为待排序二维数组
    '第2参数h：为不参与排序的标题行的行数
    '第3参数sr：为按权重优先顺序key、Sort值交替排列的一维数组、或以逗号分隔直接写入Key、Sort值。
    Dim br, y, sr2, i&, i2&, i3&, i4&, j&, j2&, k&, l&, u&, s&, t
    l = LBound(ar) + h: u = UBound(ar) '获取数组起始、结束位置
    ReDim x&(l To u), z(l To u + 1) As Boolean '定义存放Index序号的数组x、标记段落结束位置的数组z
    For i = l To u
        x(i) = i 'Index赋值为数组行序号、这以后排序就只需改变这个Index位置、原始数组无需改变
    Next
    z(u + 1) = True '标记最后结束位置
    If UBound(sr) = 0 Then sr2 = sr(0) Else sr2 = sr '判断第3参数是数组、还是多Key、Sort值序列
    j = sr2(0): If sr2(1) Mod 2 Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j, l, u) Else Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j, l, u)
    '按key1先进行QuickSort排序
    If sr2(1) = 1 Then Call AZE(ar, x, j, l, u) '如果Sort值=1则需要调用AZE过程、把空值移动到最后
    For k = 2 To UBound(sr2) Step 2 '接着循环继续key2以后的排序
        '        br = ArrayChongZu(ar, x, h): [k1].Resize(UBound(br) - LBound(br) + 1, UBound(br, 2) - LBound(br, 2) + 1) = br
        j2 = sr2(k): s = sr2(k + 1) '读取排序key的列序号j2 和Sort值s
        i = l: t = ar(x(i), j): i2 = i 'Do循环检查是否前key相同【注意，仅仅前key相同部分需要继续排序】
        Do
            Do
                i2 = i2 + 1: If z(i2) Then Exit Do Else If ar(x(i2), j) <> t Then z(i2) = True: Exit Do
                '递增检查如果到了前前key的结束位置、或前key不同则停止退出Do循环
            Loop
            If i2 - i > 1 Then '如果间隔>1 则本key需要排序处理【注意排序区间是小范围i,i2-1】
                If s Mod 2 Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j2, i, i2 - 1) Else Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j2, i, i2 - 1)
                If s = 1 Then Call AZE(ar, x, j2, i, i2 - 1) '如果Sort值=1则需要调用AZE过程、把空值移动到最后
            End If
            If i2 > u Then Exit Do Else i = i2: t = ar(x(i), j) '循环到最后时退出、否则继续从i2重新开始Do循环
        Loop
        j = j2 '更新前key列位置j
    Next
    '全部排序循环结束后、为保证最后的排序稳定性、检查最后的key值相同时必须按Index值排序。
    i = l: t = ar(x(i), j): i2 = i
    Do
        Do
            i2 = i2 + 1: If z(i2) Then Exit Do Else If ar(x(i2), j) <> t Then Exit Do '检查方法相同
        Loop
        If i2 - i > 1 Then Call QuickSort(x, i, i2 - 1) '如果间隔>1 则Index值需要排序处理
        If i2 > u Then Exit Do Else i = i2: t = ar(x(i), j) '循环到最后时退出、否则继续
    Loop
    ArraySortIndex = x '多key稳定排序处理结束、返回排序结果的Index数组x
End Function
Private Function ArrayChongZu(ar, nr, h&)
    'Output Result Array 按排序后nr数组顺序、引用原数组对应Index值各列返回数组排序结果
    'ar--源数组
    'br--新序号
    'h---标题行数
    Dim br, i&, i2&, j2&, l&, l2&, u&, u2&
    l = LBound(ar) + h: u = UBound(ar)
    l2 = LBound(ar, 2): u2 = UBound(ar, 2)
    br = ar
    For i = l To u
        i2 = nr(i) '引用原数组对应Index值
        For j2 = l2 To u2
            br(i, j2) = ar(i2, j2) '按排序结果引用原数组对应值返回
        Next
    Next
    ArrayChongZu = br
End Function
Private Function QuickSort(x, l&, u&) 'A-Z QuickSort '最后稳定排序时对相同key的Index值升序排序
    'x=要排序的数组
    'l 开始排序的下标
    'u 结束排序的下标
    Dim i&, j&, n, r
    i = l: j = u: r = x((l + u) \ 2)
    While i < j
        While x(i) < r: i = i + 1: Wend 'A-Z
            While x(j) > r: j = j - 1: Wend 'A-Z
                If i <= j Then: n = x(i): x(i) = x(j): x(j) = n: i = i + 1: j = j - 1
            Wend
            If l < j Then Call QuickSort(x, l, j)
            If i < u Then Call QuickSort(x, i, u)
End Function
Private Function QuickSort1(ar, x, j2&, l&, u&) 'A-Z QuickSort 按原数组j2列对应内容进行升序排序
    Dim i&, j&, n, r
    i = l: j = u: r = ar(x((l + u) \ 2), j2)
    While i < j
        While ar(x(i), j2) < r And i < u: i = i + 1: Wend   'A-Z
            While ar(x(j), j2) > r And j > l: j = j - 1: Wend   'A-Z
                If i <= j Then n = x(i): x(i) = x(j): x(j) = n: i = i + 1: j = j - 1
            Wend
            If l < j Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j2, l, j)
            If i < u Then Call QuickSort1(ar, x, j2, i, u)
End Function
Private Function QuickSort2(ar, x, j2&, l&, u&) 'Z-A QuickSort 按原数组j2列对应内容进行降序排序
    Dim i&, j&, n, r
    i = l: j = u: r = ar(x((l + u) \ 2), j2)
    While i < j
        While ar(x(i), j2) > r And i < u: i = i + 1: Wend 'Z-A
            While ar(x(j), j2) < r And j > l: j = j - 1: Wend 'Z-A
                If i <= j Then n = x(i): x(i) = x(j): x(j) = n: i = i + 1: j = j - 1
            Wend
            If l < j Then Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j2, l, j)
            If i < u Then Call QuickSort2(ar, x, j2, i, u)
End Function
Private Function AZE(ar, x, j, l&, u&) 'Sort值=1时、把排序完成后的空值移动到最后
    Dim i&, i2&, y
    For i = l To u
        If ar(x(i), j) <> "" Then '检查直到非空位置时停止
            y = x '复制Index数组x到y
            For i2 = l To i - 1
                x(u - i + i2 + 1) = y(i2) '前面的空值对应Index值移动到最后
            Next
            For i2 = i To u
                x(i2 - i + l) = y(i2) '后面的非空值对应Index值移动到前面
            Next
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
End Function
Function RankAdvanced(arr_rng, ncol, rankType As EnumRankType)
    '对arr数组(2维)排序 对数组的ncol列作为关键字进行排序
    '返回一个 n行一列的数组
    '排名方式 0-中式,1-美式
    Dim brr, i, crr, arr, drr, j
    arr = arr_rng
    brr = ArraySortIndex(arr, 0, ncol, 2)
    ReDim crr(1 To UBound(arr), 1 To 1)
    ReDim drr(1 To UBound(arr), 1 To 1)
    crr(1, 1) = 1
    If rankType = 1 Then '美式
        For i = 2 To UBound(brr)
            If brr(i, ncol) = brr(i - 1, ncol) Then
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1)
            Else
                crr(i, 1) = i
            End If
        Next
    Else '中式
        For i = 2 To UBound(brr)
            If brr(i, ncol) = brr(i - 1, ncol) Then
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1)
            Else
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1) + 1
            End If
        Next
    End If
    '名次按原位置摆放
    For i = 1 To UBound(arr)
        For j = 1 To UBound(brr)
            If arr(i, ncol) = brr(j, ncol) Then
                drr(i, 1) = crr(j, 1)
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Next
    RankAdvanced = drr
End Function
Function RankMoni(target, rng_arr, rankType As EnumRankType)
    '仿照系统排名函数 返回 target在rngarr数列中的名次
    '返回一个 n行一列的数组
    '排名方式 0-中式,1-美式
    Dim brr, i, crr, arr, ncol
    arr = rng_arr
    brr = ArraySortIndex(arr, 0, 1, 2)
    ReDim crr(1 To UBound(arr), 1 To 1)
    crr(1, 1) = 1
    ncol = 1
    If target = brr(1, ncol) Then
        RankMoni = 1
        Exit Function
    End If
    '不是第一名
    If rankType = 1 Then '美式
        For i = 2 To UBound(brr)
            If brr(i, ncol) = brr(i - 1, ncol) Then
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1)
            Else
                crr(i, 1) = i
            End If
            If target = brr(i, ncol) Then
                RankMoni = crr(i, 1)
                Exit Function
            End If
        Next
    Else '中式
        For i = 2 To UBound(brr)
            If brr(i, ncol) = brr(i - 1, ncol) Then
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1)
            Else
                crr(i, 1) = crr(i - 1, 1) + 1
            End If
            If target = brr(i, ncol) Then
                RankMoni = crr(i, 1)
                Exit Function
            End If
        Next
    End If
    RankMoni = crr
End Function

'按工作表名称拆分文件保存
Sub EachShtToWorkbook()
    Dim sht As Worksheet
    Dim strPath As String, strFileName As String, strFullPath As String
    Dim fileFormat As XlFileFormat
    Dim formatExt As String, formatDesc As String
    Dim selectFormat As Variant
    Dim successCount As Long, failCount As Long
    Dim invalidChar As String
    
    '==================== 1. 选择保存文件夹 ====================
    With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
        .Title = "选择文件保存根目录"
        If .Show <> -1 Then
            MsgBox "已取消操作", vbInformation, "提示"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        strPath = .SelectedItems(1)
    End With
    
    '补全路径末尾反斜杠
    If Right(strPath, 1) <> "\" Then strPath = strPath & "\"
    
    '==================== 2. 选择保存文件格式 ====================
    '格式选项，可根据需要增删
    Dim formatList As Variant
    formatList = Array( _
        "1. Excel 工作簿 (*.xlsx) - 无宏", _
        "2. Excel 启用宏工作簿 (*.xlsm) - 带宏", _
        "3. Excel 97-2003 工作簿 (*.xls) - 旧格式", _
        "4. PDF 文档 (*.pdf)", _
        "5. 单个网页文件 (*.mht)", _
        "6. XML 电子表格 2003 (*.xml)", _
        "7. CSV 逗号分隔文件 (*.csv)")
    
    '生成选择提示文本
    Dim promptText As String
    promptText = "请选择保存格式（输入数字1-7）：" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    For i = LBound(formatList) To UBound(formatList)
        promptText = promptText & formatList(i) & vbCrLf
    Next i
    
    '获取用户选择
    selectFormat = InputBox(promptText, "选择保存格式", "1")
    If selectFormat = False Then Exit Sub '点击取消退出
    
    '校验输入是否为有效数字
    If Not IsNumeric(selectFormat) Or selectFormat < 1 Or selectFormat > 7 Then
        MsgBox "输入无效，请输入1-7之间的数字", vbExclamation, "错误"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    '根据选择赋值格式常量、扩展名、描述
    Select Case selectFormat
        Case 1
            fileFormat = xlOpenXMLWorkbook 'xlsx
            formatExt = ".xlsx"
            formatDesc = "Excel无宏工作簿"
        Case 2
            fileFormat = xlOpenXMLWorkbookMacroEnabled 'xlsm
            formatExt = ".xlsm"
            formatDesc = "Excel启用宏工作簿"
        Case 3
            fileFormat = xlExcel8 'xls 97-2003
            formatExt = ".xls"
            formatDesc = "Excel旧版工作簿"
        Case 4
            fileFormat = xlTypePDF 'PDF（专项导出，不使用SaveAs）
            formatExt = ".pdf"
            formatDesc = "PDF文档"
        Case 5
            fileFormat = xlSingleFileWebPage 'mht
            formatExt = ".mht"
            formatDesc = "单个网页文件"
        Case 6
            fileFormat = xlXMLSpreadsheet 'xml
            formatExt = ".xml"
            formatDesc = "XML电子表格"
        Case 7
            fileFormat = xlCSV 'csv
            formatExt = ".csv"
            formatDesc = "CSV逗号分隔文件"
    End Select
    
    '==================== 3. 初始化环境 ====================
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False '关闭覆盖确认弹窗
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False '关闭屏幕刷新
    successCount = 0
    failCount = 0
    invalidChar = "\/:*?""<>|" 'Windows文件名非法字符
    
    '==================== 4. 遍历工作表批量保存 ====================
    For Each sht In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
        On Error GoTo ErrorHandler '单个工作表出错不中断整体循环
        
        '4.1 清理工作表名，生成合法文件名
        strFileName = sht.Name
        '替换非法字符为下划线
        For i = 1 To Len(invalidChar)
            strFileName = Replace(strFileName, Mid(invalidChar, i, 1), "_")
        Next i
        '拼接完整路径
        strFullPath = strPath & strFileName & formatExt
        
        '4.2 复制工作表到新工作簿
        sht.Copy '复制后自动新建仅包含该工作表的工作簿
        
        '4.3 按格式保存文件
        If selectFormat = 4 Then
            'PDF格式：专项导出
            ActiveWorkbook.ExportAsFixedFormat _
                Type:=xlTypePDF, _
                Filename:=strFullPath, _
                Quality:=xlQualityStandard
            ActiveWorkbook.Close SaveChanges:=False 'PDF导出后直接关闭，无需保存
        Else
            'Excel/网页/XML/CSV格式：SaveAs保存
            ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs _
                Filename:=strFullPath, _
                fileFormat:=fileFormat
            ActiveWorkbook.Close SaveChanges:=True '保存后关闭
        End If
        
        '4.4 成功计数
        successCount = successCount + 1
        GoTo NextSheet
        
ErrorHandler:
        '错误计数+提示
        failCount = failCount + 1
        MsgBox "工作表【" & sht.Name & "】保存失败：" & Err.Description, vbCritical, "错误"
        '关闭残留的新工作簿
        If Not ActiveWorkbook Is ThisWorkbook Then
            ActiveWorkbook.Close SaveChanges:=False
        End If
        
NextSheet:
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next sht
    
    '==================== 5. 恢复环境+完成提示 ====================
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    '结果汇总提示
    Dim resultMsg As String
    resultMsg = "处理完成！" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    resultMsg = resultMsg & "成功保存：" & successCount & " 个文件" & vbCrLf
    resultMsg = resultMsg & "失败跳过：" & failCount & " 个文件" & vbCrLf
    resultMsg = resultMsg & "保存格式：" & formatDesc & vbCrLf
    resultMsg = resultMsg & "保存路径：" & strPath
    
    MsgBox resultMsg, vbInformation, "处理完成"
End Sub

Sub DelEmtyDir(ByVal strPath As String)


    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    If strPath = "Fase" Or strPath = "" Then Exit Sub
    
    If Right(strPath, 1) <> "\" Then strPath = strPath & "\"
    strDirName = Dir(strPath, vbDirectory)  '取得子文件夹
    Do While strDirName <> ""
        '指定文件夹下有子文件夹
        If strDirName <> "." And strDirName <> ".." Then    '判断是否为子文件夹
            If (GetAttr(strPath & strDirName) And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory Then
                LastDir = strDirName
                Set fld = fso.GetFolder(strPath & strDirName)
                If fld.Size = 0 Then    '文件夹大小为0,表示为空
                   fld.Delete   '删除该文件夹
                    '取得上级文件夹的名称字符串
                   strFld = Left(strPath & strDirName, InStrRev(strPath$ & strDirName, "\") - 1)
                   Call DelEmtyDir(strFld)  '递归调用本过程删除上级文件夹
                Else    '文件夹不为空
                  Call DelEmtyDir(strPath & strDirName)
                    '递归调用本过程删除下级子文件夹
                End If
                strDirName = Dir(strPath, vbDirectory)  '处理下一个子文件夹
                Do Until strDirName = LastDir Or strDirName = ""
                    strDirName = Dir
                Loop
                If strDirName = "" Then Exit Do '若没有子文件夹,退出该过程
            End If
        End If
        strDirName = Dir    '处理下一个子文件夹
    Loop
    
    Set fso = Nothing
End Sub

Public Sub 查找(ByVal 路径 As String)  '查找文件的过程
  Dim Dirs() As String, Dir_Count As Long, File_Name As String, File_Name_2 As String, j
  If Right(路径, 1) <> "\" Then 路径 = 路径 & "\" '如果路径最后一位非\则追加一个\
  File_Name = Dir(路径 & "*.*", vbDirectory)  '获取文件文录名称
  Do While Len(File_Name) <> 0  '只要文件目录名存在（目录字符长度大于字）就循环下去
    If Left$(File_Name, 1) <> "." Then  '如果左边第一字符为"."
      File_Name_2 = 路径 & File_Name  '获取子目录
      If (GetAttr(File_Name_2) And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory Then  '如果是文件夹
        Dir_Count = Dir_Count + 1  '计算子目录数量
        ReDim Preserve Dirs(1 To Dir_Count) As String  '重新声明数组的储存空间
        Dirs(Dir_Count) = File_Name_2  '将子目录名称写入数组Dirs中
      Else  '如果不是文件夹目录
        i = i + 1  '累加变量，该变量等于文件数量
        ReDim Preserve arr(1 To 3, 1 To i)  '重新声明数组的储存空间
        arr(1, i) = 路径  '将文件路径写入数组
        arr(2, i) = File_Name  '将文件名写入数组
        arr(3, i) = FileLen(路径 & File_Name) / 1024 / 1024  '将文件大小写入数组
      End If
    End If
    File_Name = Dir()  '查找下一个文件
  Loop
  For j = 1 To Dir_Count  '遍历数组Dirs，即将子目录进行查找
    查找 Dirs(j)  '调用自身再执行文件查找
  Next j
End Sub

Sub 提取文件信息()
  Dim arr(1 To 10000) As String
  Dim f, i, k, f2, f3, x
  Dim arr1(1 To 100000, 1 To 6) As String, q As Integer
  Dim fso As Object, myfile As Object
  arr(1) = ThisWorkbook.path & "\"
  i = 1: k = 1
  Do While i < UBound(arr)
    If arr(i) = "" Then Exit Do
    f = Dir(arr(i), vbDirectory)
    Do
      If InStr(f, ".") = 0 And f <> "" Then
        k = k + 1
        arr(k) = arr(i) & f & "\"
      End If
      f = Dir
    Loop Until f = ""
    i = i + 1
  Loop
  '*******下面是提取各个文件夹的文件***
  Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
  For x = 1 To UBound(arr)
      If arr(x) = "" Then Exit For
       f3 = Dir(arr(x) & "*.*")
     Do While f3 <> ""
       q = q + 1
       arr1(q, 6) = arr(x) & f3
       Set myfile = fso.GetFile(arr1(q, 6))
       arr1(q, 1) = f3
       arr1(q, 2) = myfile.Size
       arr1(q, 3) = myfile.DateCreated
       arr1(q, 4) = myfile.DateLastModified
       arr1(q, 5) = myfile.DateLastAccessed
       f3 = Dir
     Loop
  Next x
  Range("a2").Resize(1000, 6) = ""
  Range("a2").Resize(q, 6) = arr1
End Sub

Dim jg(), k&, tms# '因为是递归，所以事先指定存放结果的公用变量数组jg以及计数器k和起始时间tms
Sub ListFilesFso()
    sb& = InputBox("Search Type: AllFiles=0/Files=1/Folder=-1/All Folder=-2", "Find Files", 0) '选定返回模式
    SpFile$ = InputBox("匹配文件名或文件类型", "Find Files", ".xl") '指定匹配要求，留空则匹配全部
    If SpFile Like ".*" Then SpFile = LCase(SpFile) & "*" '如果指定了文件类型则一律转换为大写字母方便比较
    With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
        If .Show Then myPath$ = .SelectedItems(1) Else Exit Sub
    End With
    If Right(myPath, 1) <> "" Then myPath = myPath & ""
    ReDim jg(65535, 3)
    jg(0, 0) = "Ext": jg(0, 1) = IIf(sb < 0, IIf(Len(SpFile), "Filename", "No"), "Filename")
    jg(0, 2) = "Folder": jg(0, 3) = "Path"
    '定义存放文件名结果的数组jg 、并写入标题
    tms = Timer: k = 0: Call ListAllFso(myPath, sb, SpFile) '调用递归过程检查指定文件夹及其子文件夹
    If sb < 0 And Len(SpFile) = 0 Then Application.StatusBar = "Get " & k & " Folders."
    [a1].CurrentRegion = "": [a1].Resize(k + 1, 4) = jg: [a1].CurrentRegion.AutoFilter Field:=1
    '输出结果到工作表，并启用筛选模式
End Sub
Function ListAllFso(myPath$, Optional sb& = 0, Optional SpFile$ = "") '递归检查子文件夹的过程代码
    Set fld = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject").GetFolder(myPath)
    On Error Resume Next
    If sb >= 0 Or Len(SpFile) Then '如果模式为0或1、或指定了匹配文件要求，则遍历各个文件
        For Each f In fld.Files '用FSO方法遍历文件.Files
            t = False '匹配状态初始化
            n = InStrRev(f.Name, "."): fnm = Left(f.Name, n - 1): x = LCase(Mid(f.Name, n))
            If Err.Number Then Err.Clear
            If SpFile = " " Then 'Space 如果匹配要求为空则匹配全部
                t = True
            ElseIf SpFile Like ".*" Then '如果匹配要求为文件类型则
                If x Like SpFile Then t = True '当文件符合文件类型要求时匹配，否则不匹配
            Else '否则为需要匹配文件名称中的一部分
                If InStr(fnm, SpFile) Then t = True '如果匹配则状态为True
            End If
            If t Then k = k + 1: jg(k, 0) = x: jg(k, 1) = "'" & fnm: jg(k, 2) = fld.Name: jg(k, 3) = fld.Path
        Next
        Application.StatusBar = Format(Timer - tms, "0.0s") & " Get " & k & " Files , Searching in Folder ... " & fld.Path
    End If
    For Each fd In fld.SubFolders '然后遍历检查所有子文件夹.SubFolders
        If sb < 0 And Len(SpFile) = 0 Then k = k + 1: jg(k, 0) = "fld": jg(k, 1) = k: jg(k, 2) = fd.Name: jg(k, 3) = fld.Path
        If sb Mod 2 = 0 Then Call ListAllFso(fd.Path, sb, SpFile)
    Next
End Function

    Dim v, r As Range

    If IsEmpty(v) Then Exit Sub
    Set r = ActiveSheet.UsedRange.Find(What:=v, LookIn:=xlValues, LookAt:=xlWhole)
    If r Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    ActiveSheet.Cells.ClearOutline
    Do

        Set r = ActiveSheet.UsedRange.FindNext(r)
    Loop Until r Is Nothing Or r.Address = ActiveCell.Address

    For Each wb In Workbooks
