'需引用Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications Extensibility 5.3
' 主过程：从指定目录导入所有VBA模块+窗体到当前活动工作簿
' 导入目录和你的导出代码匹配：桌面\VBA导出文件\模块\  桌面\VBA导出文件\窗体\
Sub 导入所有VBA组件()
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim strRootPath As String, strModulePath As String, strFormPath As String
    Dim moduleFile As Object, formFile As Object
    Dim fileExt As String, compName As String
    Dim importCount As Integer ' 统计导入成功数量
    
    ' 初始化对象和计数
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    importCount = 0
    On Error Resume Next ' 捕获文件读取/导入错误
    
    ' 1. 设置导入根路径（和你的导出代码完全匹配，可自行修改）
    strRootPath = CreateObject("WScript.Shell").SpecialFolders("Desktop") & "\VBA导出文件\"
    strModulePath = strRootPath & "模块\"  ' 模块（.bas）存放目录
    strFormPath = strRootPath & "窗体\"    ' 窗体（.frm/.frx）存放目录
    
    ' 2. 检查根目录是否存在，不存在则提示并退出
    If Not fso.FolderExists(strRootPath) Then
        MsgBox "导入目录不存在！" & vbCrLf & strRootPath & vbCrLf & "请先执行「导出所有VBA组件」创建目录并放入文件", vbCritical, "路径错误"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 3. 导入【模块/类模块】（.bas文件）
    If fso.FolderExists(strModulePath) Then
        For Each moduleFile In fso.GetFolder(strModulePath).Files
            fileExt = LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(moduleFile.path))
            ' 仅处理.bas文件
            If fileExt = "bas" Then
                ' 获取组件名称（去掉文件名后缀）
                compName = fso.GetBaseName(moduleFile.path)
                ' 先删除同名组件（避免重复导入报错）
                Call DeleteVBComponent(compName)
                ' 导入模块到当前工作簿
                ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents.Import moduleFile.path
                If err.Number = 0 Then importCount = importCount + 1
                err.Clear ' 清除错误标识
            End If
        Next moduleFile
    End If
    
    ' 4. 导入【用户窗体】（.frm文件，自动关联.frx资源文件）
    If fso.FolderExists(strFormPath) Then
        For Each formFile In fso.GetFolder(strFormPath).Files
            fileExt = LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(formFile.path))
            ' 仅处理.frm文件（导入frm会自动加载同名frx资源）
            If fileExt = "frm" Then
                ' 获取组件名称（去掉文件名后缀）
                compName = fso.GetBaseName(formFile.path)
                ' 先删除同名窗体（避免重复导入报错）
                Call DeleteVBComponent(compName)
                ' 导入窗体到当前工作簿
                ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents.Import formFile.path
                If err.Number = 0 Then importCount = importCount + 1
                err.Clear ' 清除错误标识
            End If
        Next formFile
    End If
    
    ' 5. 导入完成提示
    If importCount > 0 Then
        MsgBox "VBA组件导入成功！" & vbCrLf & _
               "共导入：" & importCount & " 个组件" & vbCrLf & _
               "模块路径：" & strModulePath & vbCrLf & _
               "窗体路径：" & strFormPath, vbInformation, "导入完成"
    Else
        MsgBox "未找到可导入的VBA文件（.bas/.frm），请检查目录是否有文件", vbExclamation, "无文件可导入"
    End If
    
    ' 释放对象
    Set fso = Nothing
    Set moduleFile = Nothing
    Set formFile = Nothing
End Sub

' 辅助过程：删除指定名称的VBA组件（避免重复导入）
Private Sub DeleteVBComponent(compName As String)
    Dim vbc As VBComponent
    On Error Resume Next
    ' 遍历组件，找到同名则删除
    For Each vbc In ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents
        If vbc.Name = compName Then
            ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents.Remove vbc
            Exit For
        End If
    Next vbc
    Set vbc = Nothing
End Sub

Sub OPEN_导出所有VBA组件(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim vbc As Object    ' 后期绑定，避免VBComponent类型报错
    Dim strRootPath As String  ' 根文件夹路径
    Dim strModulePath As String  ' 模块保存路径
    Dim strFormPath As String    ' 窗体保存路径
    Dim strFileName As String
    Dim fso As Object    ' 文件系统对象（后期绑定）
    Dim activeWB As Object    ' 当前活动工作簿对象
    Dim exportCount As Integer    ' 统计导出数量

    ' ===== 1. 基础校验 =====
    ' 检查是否有活动工作簿
    If ActiveWorkbook Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未打开任何Excel工作簿！请先打开需要导出VBA组件的工作簿", vbCritical, "错误"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set activeWB = ActiveWorkbook

    ' 初始化文件系统对象
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    exportCount = 0
    On Error Resume Next    ' 捕获导出/创建文件夹错误

    ' ===== 2. 设置保存路径（桌面→VBA导出文件） =====
    strRootPath = fso.BuildPath(CreateObject("WScript.Shell").SpecialFolders("Desktop"), "VBA导出文件\")
    strModulePath = fso.BuildPath(strRootPath, "模块\")  ' 模块单独存放
    strFormPath = fso.BuildPath(strRootPath, "窗体\")    ' 窗体单独存放

    ' ===== 3. 自动创建文件夹（封装为内部函数，无需额外Call） =====
    If Not fso.FolderExists(strRootPath) Then fso.CreateFolder (strRootPath)
    If Not fso.FolderExists(strModulePath) Then fso.CreateFolder (strModulePath)
    If Not fso.FolderExists(strFormPath) Then fso.CreateFolder (strFormPath)

    ' ===== 4. 遍历【当前活动工作簿】的所有VBA组件 =====
    For Each vbc In activeWB.VBProject.VBComponents
        ' 用数值替代枚举常量（避免引用缺失报错）：
        ' 1=标准模块(vbext_ct_StdModule)，2=类模块(vbext_ct_ClassModule)，3=用户窗体(vbext_ct_MSForm)
        Select Case vbc.Type
            ' 导出标准模块、类模块（保存为 .bas 文件）
        Case 1, 2
            strFileName = fso.BuildPath(strModulePath, vbc.Name & ".bas")
            ' 处理非法文件名（替换特殊字符）
            strFileName = fso.BuildPath(fso.GetParentFolderName(strFileName), Replace(fso.GetFileName(strFileName), "/\*?|<>", "_"))
            vbc.Export strFileName
            If err.Number = 0 Then exportCount = exportCount + 1
            err.Clear

            ' 导出用户窗体（保存为 .frm 主文件 + .frx 资源文件）
        Case 3
            strFileName = fso.BuildPath(strFormPath, vbc.Name & ".frm")
            ' 处理非法文件名
            strFileName = fso.BuildPath(fso.GetParentFolderName(strFileName), Replace(fso.GetFileName(strFileName), "/\*?|<>", "_"))
            vbc.Export strFileName  ' 窗体导出会自动生成 .frm 和 .frx（如有图片等资源）
            If err.Number = 0 Then exportCount = exportCount + 1
            err.Clear
        End Select
    Next vbc

    ' ===== 5. 导出结果提示 =====
    If exportCount > 0 Then
        MsgBox "导出完成！" & vbCrLf & _
               "共导出 " & exportCount & " 个VBA组件" & vbCrLf & _
               "模块路径：" & strModulePath & vbCrLf & _
               "窗体路径：" & strFormPath, vbInformation
    Else
        MsgBox "未导出任何VBA组件！" & vbCrLf & _
               "当前工作簿【" & activeWB.Name & "】无标准模块/类模块/用户窗体", vbExclamation
    End If

    ' ===== 6. 释放对象 =====
    Set fso = Nothing
    Set activeWB = Nothing
    Set vbc = Nothing
End Sub

'F辅助函数： 从控件标题生成可能的idMso
Private Function GenerateIdMsoFromCaption(caption As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim words() As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim word As String

    ' 移除快捷键标记 (&) 和标点
    result = caption
    result = Replace(result, "&", "")
    result = Replace(result, "...", "")
    result = Replace(result, "(", "")
    result = Replace(result, ")", "")
    result = Replace(result, ".", "")
    result = Replace(result, " ", " ")

    ' 分割单词
    words = Split(result, " ")

    result = ""
    For i = 0 To UBound(words)
        word = Trim(words(i))
        If Len(word) > 0 Then
            If i = 0 Then
                ' 第一个单词首字母小写（通常动词）
                result = LCase(Left(word, 1)) & Mid(word, 2)
            Else
                ' 后续单词首字母大写
                result = result & UCase(Left(word, 1)) & Mid(word, 2)
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    GenerateIdMsoFromCaption = result
End Function

    Dim row As Long
    Dim bar As Object         ' CommandBar
    Dim ctl As Object         ' CommandBarControl
    
    ' 创建/使用工作表
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("VBE内置菜单列表")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count))
        ws.Name = "VBE内置菜单列表"
    End If
    
    ' 标题
    row = 1
    ws.Cells(row, 1) = "菜单条名称"
    ws.Cells(row, 2) = "控件标题"
    ws.Cells(row, 3) = "ID"
    ws.Cells(row, 4) = "类型"
    row = 2
    
    ' 关闭屏幕更新
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 遍历 VBE 所有 CommandBar
    On Error Resume Next
    For Each bar In Application.VBE.CommandBars
        DoEvents
        
        ' 遍历每个菜单条的控件
        For Each ctl In bar.Controls
            If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                Err.Clear
                GoTo NextCtl
            End If
            
            ' 写入表格
            ws.Cells(row, 1) = bar.Name
            ws.Cells(row, 2) = ctl.caption
            ws.Cells(row, 3) = ctl.id
            ws.Cells(row, 4) = Choose(ctl.Type, "Button", "Edit", "Dropdown", "ComboBox", "Popup", "Split")
            
            row = row + 1
            If row Mod 100 = 0 Then DoEvents
            
NextCtl:
        Next ctl
    Next bar
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "完成！共输出 " & row - 2 & " 条 VBE 内置菜单", vbInformation
End Sub

' 模块名称：MTP_FormIcon
' 功能说明：通用窗体图标设置模块。提供 ChangeFormIcon 函数，可将指定
'           图标句柄应用到任意 UserForm 窗体左上角（同时设置小图标与
'           大图标），供多个窗体共用调用，无需在每个窗体重复声明 API。
' 适用场景：在任意 UserForm 的 Initialize 事件中调用 ChangeFormIcon。
' 调用示例：Call ChangeFormIcon(Me, Image1.Picture.Handle)
' 说明：    Image 控件需提前加载 .ico 图标文件（Picture 属性）。
' 作者：    Excel催化剂
' 日期：    2026-08-01
Option Explicit
#If VBA7 Then
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function SendMessage Lib "user32" Alias "SendMessageA" ( _
        ByVal hWnd As LongPtr, ByVal wMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As LongPtr, lParam As Any) As LongPtr
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function DrawMenuBar Lib "user32" (ByVal hWnd As LongPtr) As Long
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function FindWindow Lib "user32" Alias "FindWindowA" ( _
        ByVal lpClassName As String, ByVal lpWindowName As String) As LongPtr
#Else
    Private Declare Function SendMessage Lib "user32" Alias "SendMessageA" ( _
        ByVal hWnd As Long, ByVal wMsg As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, lParam As Any) As Long
    Private Declare Function DrawMenuBar Lib "user32" (ByVal hWnd As Long) As Long
    Private Declare Function FindWindow Lib "user32" Alias "FindWindowA" ( _
        ByVal lpClassName As String, ByVal lpWindowName As String) As Long
#End If

Private Const WM_SETICON As Long = &H80
Private Const ICON_SMALL As Long = 0&
Private Const ICON_BIG As Long = 1&


' 函数名称：ChangeFormIcon
' 功能说明：为指定 UserForm 设置左上角图标，同时刷新小图标与大图标。
' 入参说明：
'   frmForm - 需要设置图标的 UserForm 对象引用（通常传入 Me）
'   hIcon   - 图标句柄，通常通过 Image 控件的 Picture.Handle 获取；
'             省略时（=0）清除当前图标，恢复默认。
' 返回值：  Boolean —— 成功返回 True，未找到窗口或出错返回 False。
' 注意事项：应在 UserForm_Initialize 事件中调用；此时窗体窗口已创建，
'           FindWindow 可按 Caption 找到句柄。若窗体 Caption 为空或
'           与其他窗口重名，建议先设置唯一 Caption 再调用。
' 调用示例：
'   Private Sub UserForm_Initialize()
'       Call ChangeFormIcon(Me, Image1.Picture.Handle)
'   End Sub

Public Function ChangeFormIcon(ByVal frmForm As Object, Optional ByVal hIcon As Long = 0&) As Boolean
    Dim hWnd As LongPtr

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    ' 通过窗体标题查找窗口句柄
    hWnd = FindWindow(vbNullString, frmForm.Caption)
    If hWnd = 0 Then
        ChangeFormIcon = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 同时设置小图标和大图标
    SendMessage hWnd, WM_SETICON, ICON_SMALL, ByVal hIcon
    SendMessage hWnd, WM_SETICON, ICON_BIG, ByVal hIcon
    DrawMenuBar hWnd

    ChangeFormIcon = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    ChangeFormIcon = False
End Function

'将十进制数转换为 34 进制，并按指定的n位数显示，不足位数用0补齐
Function Base34Serial(num As Long, n As Long) As String
    Dim base34Chars As String
    base34Chars = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    Dim result As String
    Do While num > 0
        result = Mid(base34Chars, num Mod 34 + 1, 1) & result
        num = num \ 34
    Loop
    ' 用0补齐位数
    While Len(result) < n
        result = "0" & result
    Wend
    Base34Serial = result
End Function

Function URLEncodePlus(strURL)
  'ANSI编码,空格处理成+号
  Dim i
  Dim tempStr
  For i = 1 To Len(strURL)
    If Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) < 0 Then
      tempStr = "%" & Right(CStr(Hex(Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)))), 2)
      tempStr = "%" & Left(CStr(Hex(Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)))), Len(CStr(Hex(Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1))))) - 2) & tempStr
      URLEncodePlus = URLEncodePlus & tempStr
    ElseIf (Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) >= 65 And Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) <= 90) Or (Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) >= 97 And Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) <= 122) Or (Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) >= 48 And Asc(Mid(strURL, i, 1)) <= 57) Then

    Else

' 自定义函数：删除指定工作表中某列的空值和0值行
' 参数说明：
'   sheetName   - 工作表名称（字符串）
'   columnLetter - 列字母，如 "B", "C", "AA" 等（字符串）
'   checkZero    - 是否检查0值，默认为True（可选参数）
'   checkEmpty   - 是否检查空值，默认为True（可选参数）
' 返回值：
'   删除的行数
Function DeleteBlankAndZeroRows(ByVal sheetName As String, ByVal columnLetter As String, _
                                 Optional ByVal checkZero As Boolean = True, _
                                 Optional ByVal checkEmpty As Boolean = True) As Long
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim deleteCount As Long
    Dim cellValue As Variant
    
    ' 检查工作表是否存在
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(sheetName)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "工作表 '" & sheetName & "' 不存在！", vbExclamation
        DeleteBlankAndZeroRows = -1
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 获取指定列的最后一行
    With ws
        lastRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, columnLetter).End(xlUp).Row
    End With
    
    If lastRow < 1 Then
        DeleteBlankAndZeroRows = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 关闭屏幕更新和事件，提高性能
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    
    deleteCount = 0
    
    ' 从下往上遍历，删除符合条件的行
    For i = lastRow To 1 Step -1
        cellValue = ws.Cells(i, columnLetter).Value
        
        ' 判断是否需要删除
        If ShouldDeleteRow(cellValue, checkZero, checkEmpty) Then
            ws.Rows(i).Delete
            deleteCount = deleteCount + 1
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 恢复设置
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    
    DeleteBlankAndZeroRows = deleteCount
    
    Exit Function
    
ErrorHandler:
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    
    MsgBox "删除时发生错误：" & Err.Description & vbCrLf & _
           "错误号：" & Err.Number & vbCrLf & _
           "工作表：" & sheetName & vbCrLf & _
           "列：" & columnLetter & vbCrLf & _
           "行号：" & i, vbCritical
    DeleteBlankAndZeroRows = -1
End Function

' 辅助函数：判断某行是否应该删除
Private Function ShouldDeleteRow(ByVal cellValue As Variant, ByVal checkZero As Boolean, ByVal checkEmpty As Boolean) As Boolean
    Dim isEmptyOrSpace As Boolean
    Dim isZero As Boolean
    
    ' 检查空值
    If checkEmpty Then
        ' 判断是否为真正的空值或空字符串
        If IsEmpty(cellValue) Then
            isEmptyOrSpace = True
        ElseIf VarType(cellValue) = vbString Then
            ' 字符串类型：空字符串或只有空格
            If cellValue = "" Or Trim(cellValue) = "" Then
                isEmptyOrSpace = True
            End If
        ElseIf cellValue = Null Then
            isEmptyOrSpace = True
        End If
    End If
    
    ' 检查零值
    If checkZero Then
        ' 数值0或文本"0"
        If VarType(cellValue) = vbString Then
            If Trim(cellValue) = "0" Or Trim(cellValue) = "零" Then
                isZero = True
            End If
        Else
            ' 数值类型：等于0
            If IsNumeric(cellValue) And cellValue = 0 Then
                isZero = True
            End If
        End If
    End If
    
    ShouldDeleteRow = isEmptyOrSpace Or isZero
End Function

            End With

Public Function DEC_to_HEX(ByVal Dec As Long) As String '转16进制
        Dim a As String
        DEC_to_HEX = ""
        Do While Dec > 0
            a = CStr(Dec Mod 16)
            Select Case a
                Case "10": a = "A"
                Case "11": a = "B"
                Case "12": a = "C"
                Case "13": a = "D"
                Case "14": a = "E"
                Case "15": a = "F"
            End Select
            DEC_to_HEX = a & DEC_to_HEX
            Dec = Dec \ 16
        Loop
    End Function

Sub SplitDataToFourColumns()

    rowCount = lastRow - 1                                     '实际要处理的数据行数，减去标题行那1行
    '将A列数据（除标题行）读取到数组中
    ReDim arr(1 To rowCount, 1 To 1)
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        arr(i - 1, 1) = Cells(i, 1).Value
    Next i
    '弹出输入框让用户输入要拆分到的列数N

        Exit Sub
    End If
    n = CInt(cfls)
    '计算平均拆分后每列的行数
    colCount = rowCount \ cfls
    If rowCount Mod cfls > 0 Then
        colCount = colCount + 1
    End If
 
    '将数据拆分到B、C、D、E四列（从B2单元格开始）
    For j = 0 To cfls - 1
        For i = 1 To colCount
            If (i + j * colCount) <= rowCount Then
                Cells(1 + i, 2 + j).Value = arr(i + j * colCount, 1)
            End If
        Next i
    Next j
    LinkFirstAndLastCellValueInBColumn cfls

    '对拆分后的数据的首尾提取值,并写在每列数据的末尾处
Sub LinkFirstAndLastCellValueInBColumn(ByVal y As Integer)
    For i = 2 To y + 1
        Dim lastRow As Long
        Dim firstValue As String
        Dim lastValue As String
        Dim lastRowbt As Long
        '获取B列最后一个有数据的行号（跳过标题行，从第二行开始算）

        lastValue = Cells(lastRow, i).Value

        '    将两个值连接起来并赋值给B1单元格
        Cells(lastRowbt + 1, i).Value = firstValue & "~" & lastValue
    Next i
End Sub

Sub 检查有无重复值()
    ' 创建一个Scripting.Dictionary对象，用于存储数据并快速判断数据是否重复
    ' Scripting.Dictionary可以通过键值对的形式来高效地进行数据的查找和唯一性判断
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 弹出输入框，提示用户选择一个列（通过单击列标），并获取用户选择的列范围
    ' Type:=8 表示允许用户选择一个单元格区域，这里期望用户选择的是一个列
    Dim selectedRange As Range
    On Error Resume Next
    Set selectedRange = Application.InputBox(prompt:="请选择一个列（单击列标）", Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' 判断用户是否取消了选择操作，如果selectedRange为Nothing，表示用户取消了，弹出提示并退出过程
    If selectedRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "你没有选择任何列，操作取消。"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' 检查用户选择的是否是一个列，如果选择的列数大于1，则不符合要求，弹出提示并退出过程
    If selectedRange.Columns.Count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "你只能选择一个列。"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取所选列最后一个有数据的行号
    ' 使用Cells函数结合Rows.Count获取工作表的总行数，定位到所选列的最后一行
    ' 然后通过End(xlUp)方法向上查找，找到最后一个有数据的单元格所在行号，并赋值给lastRow变量
    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = Cells(Rows.Count, selectedRange.Column).End(xlUp).Row
    
    ' 声明变量data，用于临时存储从单元格中读取的值
    ' 声明变量duplicateAddresses，用于拼接重复数据所在单元格的地址，初始为空字符串
    ' 声明循环计数器i，用于遍历所选列的数据行
    Dim data As Variant
    Dim duplicateAddresses As String
    Dim i As Long
    ' 从所选列的第2行开始（通常第1行是标题行，跳过标题行进行数据检查），循环到最后一行
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' 获取当前行、所选列单元格的值，并赋值给data变量
        data = Cells(i, selectedRange.Column).Value
        ' 使用Scripting.Dictionary对象的Exists方法判断data的值是否已经作为键存在于字典中
        ' 如果已经存在，说明遇到了重复数据
        If dict.Exists(data) Then
            ' 如果duplicateAddresses还是空字符串，说明是第一次发现重复数据，直接将当前单元格地址赋值给它
            ' 如果不为空字符串，则将当前单元格地址通过字符串拼接的方式添加到duplicateAddresses后面，中间用逗号隔开
            duplicateAddresses = duplicateAddresses & ", " & Cells(i, selectedRange.Column).Address
        Else
            ' 如果data的值不存在于字典中，将其作为键添加到字典中，对应的值在这里简单设为1，重点是利用键的唯一性来判断重复
            dict(data) = 1
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 根据duplicateAddresses变量是否为空来判断是否存在重复数据
    ' 如果不为空，说明存在重复数据，弹出消息框显示所选列存在重复数据以及重复数据所在单元格地址
    ' 如果为空，则弹出消息框提示所选列没有重复数据
    If duplicateAddresses <> "" Then
        MsgBox "所选列存在重复数据，重复数据所在单元格地址为：" & duplicateAddresses
    Else
        MsgBox "所选列没有重复数据。"
    End If
End Sub

Function 模糊匹配分类(查找文本 As String, 字典表 As Range, 结果列 As Long) As String
    '参数说明：

    '结果列：返回结果的列号（在字典表中的位置，通常为2）

Sub CopyLatestDateData()

    End If
    ' 让用户选择料号所在列

    On Error GoTo 0

        Exit Sub
    End If
    partNumberCol = selectedColRange.Column
    ' 让用户选择记录日期所在列
    On Error Resume Next
    Set selectedColRange = Application.InputBox("请选择记录日期所在的列（点击该列的任意单元格即可）", "选择日期列", Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0

        MsgBox "未选择日期列，操作取消。"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 创建新的目标工作表
    Set targetSheet = ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
    targetSheet.Name = "最新日期数据"
    ' 复制源工作表的表头到目标工作表
    dataRange.Rows(1).Copy Destination:=targetSheet.Rows(1)
    ' 获取数据区域的最后一行
    lastRow = dataRange.Rows.Count + dataRange.Row - 1
    ' 创建字典对象
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    ' 遍历源工作表的数据，将料号和对应的行号存入字典
    For i = dataRange.Row + 1 To lastRow

'XOR偏移反转加密
' 固定密钥与偏移（必须和加密完全一致）
Private Const KEY = "AI2026COLOR"
Private Const OFFSET = 42
' 加密函数（原文 → 密文）
Function Encrypt(s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, kLen As Long, pos As Long
    Dim code As Long, keyCode As Long
    Dim res As String
    kLen = Len(KEY)
    res = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        code = AscW(Mid(s, i, 1))       ' 取字符编码
        pos = (i - 1) Mod kLen + 1     ' 密钥位置（正确循环）
        keyCode = AscW(Mid(KEY, pos, 1))
        code = code Xor keyCode         ' XOR
        code = code + OFFSET            ' 偏移 +42
        res = res & Hex(code) & ","
    Next i
    If Len(res) > 0 Then res = Left(res, Len(res) - 1)
    Encrypt = StrReverse(res)           ' 反转
End Function
' 解密函数（密文 → 原文）
Function Decrypt(s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, kLen As Long, pos As Long
    Dim rev As String, arr As Variant
    Dim code As Long, keyCode As Long
    Dim res As String
    If s = "" Then Decrypt = "": Exit Function
    rev = StrReverse(s)                 ' 反转回来
    arr = Split(rev, ",")               ' 分割
    kLen = Len(KEY)
    res = ""
    For i = 0 To UBound(arr)
        code = val("&H" & arr(i))       ' 十六进制转数字
        code = code - OFFSET            ' 偏移 -42
        pos = i Mod kLen + 1            ' 密钥位置（必须和加密一致）
        keyCode = AscW(Mid(KEY, pos, 1))
        code = code Xor keyCode         ' XOR 回去
        res = res & ChrW(code)          ' 还原字符
    Next i
    Decrypt = res
End Function

                     SourceType:=xlDatabase, _

标题: 数据区间范围重叠验证
内容:
'1.XLAM 加载宏使用完全正常
'2.只处理你选中的区域，不碰其他数据
'3.任意两列通用，不绑定列号
'4.跳过隐藏行
'5.区间重叠就标红 +提示
'数据区间范围重叠验证
Sub CheckOverlapRanges()
    Dim selRng As Range
    Dim visibleRows As Range
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim arr() As Variant
    Dim rowNumArr() As Long
    Dim col1 As Long, col2 As Long
    Dim i As Long, k As Long
    Dim startVal As Variant, endVal As Variant
    Dim prevStart As Variant, prevEnd As Variant
    Dim hasOverlap As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    ' 1. 获取选中区域
    On Error Resume Next
    Set selRng = Selection
    On Error GoTo 0

    If selRng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选择数据区域！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 2. 必须选中 2 列
    If selRng.Columns.Count <> 2 Then
        MsgBox "请选择【两列】数据：第一列=起始，第二列=结尾", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 3. 获取选中的两列号（动态，任意列都能用）
    col1 = selRng.Column
    col2 = selRng.Column + 1

    ' 4. 只取可见行（跳过隐藏行）
    On Error Resume Next
    Set visibleRows = selRng.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If visibleRows Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "没有可见数据！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set ws = visibleRows.Parent
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    selRng.Interior.ColorIndex = xlNone ' 清除之前颜色

    ' 5. 把【非空、可见】数据存入数组
    ReDim arr(1 To visibleRows.Count, 1 To 2)
    ReDim rowNumArr(1 To visibleRows.Count)
    k = 0

    For Each cell In visibleRows.Rows
        startVal = cell.Cells(1, 1).Value
        endVal = cell.Cells(1, 2).Value

        ' 跳过空单元格
        If startVal <> "" And endVal <> "" And IsNumeric(startVal) And IsNumeric(endVal) Then
            k = k + 1
            arr(k, 1) = startVal
            arr(k, 2) = endVal
            rowNumArr(k) = cell.Row
        End If
    Next cell

    If k = 0 Then
        MsgBox "所选区域无有效数字！", vbExclamation
        GoTo 结束
    End If

    ' 6. 按你的规则逐行检查
    hasOverlap = False

    ' 从第2行开始，每一行都和上一行对比
    For i = 2 To k
        startVal = arr(i, 1)
        endVal = arr(i, 2)
        prevStart = arr(i - 1, 1)
        prevEnd = arr(i - 1, 2)

        ' 规则1：当前行的起始/结尾是否在上一行的区间内
        If (startVal >= prevStart And startVal <= prevEnd) Then
            ws.Cells(rowNumArr(i), col1).Interior.Color = vbRed
            hasOverlap = True
        End If

        If (endVal >= prevStart And endVal <= prevEnd) Then
            ws.Cells(rowNumArr(i), col2).Interior.Color = vbRed
            hasOverlap = True
        End If

        ' 规则2：当前行的起始/结尾是否与上一行的起始/结尾重复
        If startVal = prevStart Or startVal = prevEnd Then
            ws.Cells(rowNumArr(i), col1).Interior.Color = vbRed
            hasOverlap = True
        End If

        If endVal = prevStart Or endVal = prevEnd Then
            ws.Cells(rowNumArr(i), col2).Interior.Color = vbRed
            hasOverlap = True
        End If

        ' 额外：如果上一行的起始/结尾与当前行重复，也要标红上一行的单元格
        If prevStart = startVal Or prevStart = endVal Then
            ws.Cells(rowNumArr(i - 1), col1).Interior.Color = vbRed
            hasOverlap = True
        End If

        If prevEnd = startVal Or prevEnd = endVal Then
            ws.Cells(rowNumArr(i - 1), col2).Interior.Color = vbRed
            hasOverlap = True
        End If
    Next i

结束:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    If hasOverlap Then
        MsgBox "检测到重叠/重复数据，已填充红色！", vbExclamation
    Else
        MsgBox "未检测到重叠/重复数据！", vbInformation
    End If
End Sub

Sub CountTZHLine_WithRowNum1()

'把C列单元格的多行内容拆分成单列的，并复制A列对应的编号
Sub SplitCColumnMultiLine_SyncA()
    Dim sht As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    Dim arrLines As Variant, newRow As Long
    
    Set sht = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = sht.Cells(sht.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row
    newRow = lastRow + 1
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    For i = 1 To lastRow
        If Len(sht.Cells(i, "C").Value) > 0 Then
            arrLines = Split(sht.Cells(i, "C").Value, vbLf)
            For j = LBound(arrLines) To UBound(arrLines)
                sht.Cells(newRow, "A").Value = sht.Cells(i, "A").Value
                sht.Cells(newRow, "C").Value = Trim(arrLines(j))
                newRow = newRow + 1
            Next j
        End If
    Next i
    
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "拆分完成！共生成 " & (newRow - lastRow - 1) & " 行新数据"
End Sub

Sub ListCommonBuiltInControls()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim cb As CommandBar
    Dim ctl As CommandBarControl
    Dim i As Long
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("常用内置命令")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
        ws.Name = "常用内置命令"
    End If
    
    ws.Cells.Clear
    ws.Range("A1:C1") = Array("ID", "名称", "FaceId")
    ws.Range("A1:C1").Font.Bold = True
    i = 2
    
    For Each cb In Application.CommandBars
        For Each ctl In cb.Controls
            If ctl.id > 0 And ctl.id < 2000 And ctl.Type = msoControlButton Then
                If Not dict.Exists(CStr(ctl.id)) Then
                    dict(CStr(ctl.id)) = True
                    ws.Cells(i, 1) = ctl.id
                    ws.Cells(i, 2) = Replace(ctl.Caption, "&", "")
                    ws.Cells(i, 3) = ctl.FaceId
                    i = i + 1
                End If
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
    With ws.Sort
        .SortFields.Clear
        .SortFields.Add key:=ws.Range("A2:A" & i), Order:=xlAscending
        .SetRange ws.Range("A1:C" & i)
        .Header = xlYes
        .Apply
    End With
    
    MsgBox "常用内置命令导出完成：" & (i - 2) & " 个", vbInformation
            Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True

    Dim ctl As Object         ' CommandBarControl
    
    ' 创建/使用工作表
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("VBE内置菜单列表")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.count))

    End If

    ws.Cells(row, 2) = "控件标题"
    ws.Cells(row, 3) = "ID"
    ws.Cells(row, 4) = "类型"
    row = 2
    
    ' 关闭屏幕更新
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 遍历 VBE 所有 CommandBar
    On Error Resume Next
    For Each Bar In Application.VBE.CommandBars
        DoEvents
        
        ' 遍历每个菜单条的控件
        For Each ctl In Bar.Controls
            If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                Err.Clear
                GoTo NextCtl
            End If
            
            ' 写入表格

            ws.Cells(row, 2) = ctl.caption
            ws.Cells(row, 3) = ctl.id

            row = row + 1
            If row Mod 100 = 0 Then DoEvents
            
NextCtl:
        Next ctl
    Next Bar
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "完成！共输出 " & row - 2 & " 条 VBE 内置菜单", vbInformation

Sub ListAllBuiltInControls()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim cb As CommandBar
    Dim ctl As CommandBarControl
    Dim i As Long
    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 创建/使用工作表
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("内置命令列表")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count))
        ws.Name = "内置命令列表"
    End If
    
    ws.Cells.Clear
    ws.Range("A1:E1").Value = Array("ID", "标题", "类型", "所在菜单", "FaceId")
    ws.Range("A1:E1").Font.Bold = True
    
    i = 2
    
    ' 遍历所有菜单
    For Each cb In Application.CommandBars
        For Each ctl In cb.Controls
            If ctl.id > 1 And ctl.id < 60000 Then  ' 过滤无效ID
                If Not dict.Exists(CStr(ctl.id)) Then
                    dict(CStr(ctl.id)) = True
                    
                    ws.Cells(i, 1) = ctl.id
                    ws.Cells(i, 2) = Replace(ctl.Caption, "&", "") ' 去掉快捷键&
                    ws.Cells(i, 3) = TypeName(ctl)
                    ws.Cells(i, 4) = cb.Name
'                    ws.Cells(i, 5) = ctl.FaceId
                    i = i + 1
                End If
            End If
        Next
    Next
    
    ' 按ID排序
    With ws.Sort
        .SortFields.Clear
        .SortFields.Add key:=ws.Range("A2:A" & i), Order:=xlAscending
        .SetRange ws.Range("A1:E" & i)
        .Header = xlYes
        .Apply
    End With
    
    MsgBox "导出完成！共 " & (i - 2) & " 个内置命令", vbInformation
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = True
End Sub

Sub ExportAllWorksheetChartsToImages()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim shp As Shape
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim chartCount As Integer
    Dim totalCount As Integer
    
    '选择保存目录
    With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
        .Title = "请选择图片保存目录"
        .InitialFileName = Environ("USERPROFILE") & "\Desktop\"
        If .Show = -1 Then
            folderPath = .SelectedItems(1)
            If Right(folderPath, 1) <> "\" Then
                folderPath = folderPath & "\"
            End If
        Else
            MsgBox "未选择保存目录，操作取消！", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End With
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    totalCount = 0
    
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        chartCount = 0
        
        For Each shp In ws.Shapes
            If shp.Type = msoChart Then
                chartCount = chartCount + 1
                
                '调整图表尺寸后导出
                With shp.Chart
                    .Parent.Width = 400
                    .Parent.Height = 300
                    .Export Filename:=folderPath & ws.Name & "_" & Format(chartCount, "00") & ".png", _
                            FilterName:="PNG"
                End With
                
                totalCount = totalCount + 1
            End If
        Next shp
    Next ws
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    If totalCount > 0 Then
        MsgBox "导出完成！" & vbCrLf & _
               "共导出 " & totalCount & " 个图表" & vbCrLf & _
               "保存位置：" & folderPath, vbInformation, "导出成功"
    Else

Sub 自动创建气泡图()
    ' 定义图表相关对象变量
    Dim sht As Worksheet, cht As Chart, ser As Series, dat As DataLabels, chtobj As ChartObject, po As Point
    Dim ax As Axis, ay As Axis, ax2 As Axis, leg As Legend, legkey As LegendKey
    
    ' 定义数据数组与循环变量
    Dim X1, Y1, X2, Y2, Z2, i
    Dim lastRow As Long
    
    ' 指定工作表：绘制气泡图
    Set sht = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("绘制气泡图")
    
    ' 自动获取B列最后一行数据行号（动态适配数据长度）
    lastRow = sht.Cells(sht.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
    
    ' 读取数据：X1=A列分类名称，Y1=B列数值
    X1 = Application.Transpose(sht.Range("A2:A" & lastRow).Value)
    Y1 = Application.Transpose(sht.Range("B2:B" & lastRow).Value)
    
    ' 定义气泡图所需数组，长度与Y1保持一致（解决下标越界）
    ReDim X2(1 To UBound(Y1))
    ReDim Y2(1 To UBound(Y1))
    ReDim Z2(1 To UBound(Y1))
    
    ' 循环处理每一行数据
    For i = 1 To UBound(Y1)
        Y1(i) = Y1(i) * 1                   ' 确保数值为数字格式
        X2(i) = 1000                        ' 散点图X固定值（让气泡靠右对齐）
        Y2(i) = i - 0.5                     ' 散点图Y坐标，对应条形图高度位置
        Z2(i) = Round(Y1(i) / Application.Sum(Y1) * 200, 2) ' 计算占比，决定气泡大小
    Next i
    
    ' 在工作表A11位置创建图表对象，宽500，高300
    Set chtobj = sht.ChartObjects.Add(sht.Range("A11").Left, 0, 500, 300)
    Set cht = chtobj.Chart
    
    ' 开始设置图表整体样式
    With cht
        ' 设置条形图之间的间距
        .ChartGroups(1).GapWidth = 50
        
        '  设置图表区域（整个图表外框）样式
        With .ChartArea

Sub RemoveQuotesFromTextFile(filePath As String, Symbol1 As String, Symbol2 As String)
    Dim fileSystem As Object
    Set fileSystem = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Dim file As Object
    Set file = fileSystem.OpenTextFile(filePath, 1, False, -2) '以二进制读取模式打开文件，参数 -2表示自动检测文件编码格式
    
    Dim fileContent As String
    fileContent = file.ReadAll                                 '读取文件全部内容

    On Error Resume Next                                       '开启错误处理，忽略运行时错误（后续可检查Err对象判断是否删除成功）
    Kill filePath
    
    fileContent = Replace(fileContent, Symbol1, Symbol2)       '替换指定字符

    On Error GoTo 0
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then

    End If

' 功能：将二维数组写入txt（支持UTF-8/ANSI）
    ' 参数：
    '   arr - 二维数组
    '   filePath - 文件路径
    '   encoding - "UTF-8"(默认) 或 "ANSI"
Function WriteArrayToTxt(arr As Variant, filePath As String, Optional encoding As String = "UTF-8") As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    If Not IsArray(arr) Then Exit Function
    If Dir(filePath) <> "" Then Kill filePath
    
    Dim firstRow As Long, lastRow As Long
    Dim firstCol As Long, lastCol As Long
    firstRow = LBound(arr, 1)
    lastRow = UBound(arr, 1)
    firstCol = LBound(arr, 2)
    lastCol = UBound(arr, 2)
    
    Select Case UCase(encoding)
    Case "ANSI"
        Dim fileNum As Integer: fileNum = FreeFile
        Open filePath For Output As #fileNum
        
        Dim i As Long, j As Long
        Dim lineContent As String
        For i = firstRow To lastRow
            lineContent = arr(i, firstCol)
            For j = firstCol + 1 To lastCol
                lineContent = lineContent & vbTab & arr(i, j)
            Next j
            Print #fileNum, lineContent
        Next i
        Close #fileNum
        
    Case Else
        ' 使用二进制模式写入，避免BOM
        With CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
            .Type = 1  ' 二进制模式
            .Open
            
            ' 手动添加UTF-8内容（不包含BOM）
            Dim rowContent As String
            Dim utf8Bytes() As Byte
            For i = firstRow To lastRow
                rowContent = arr(i, firstCol)
                For j = firstCol + 1 To lastCol
                    rowContent = rowContent & vbTab & arr(i, j)
                Next j
                rowContent = rowContent & vbCrLf
                
                ' 将字符串转换为UTF-8字节数组
                utf8Bytes = StrConv(rowContent, vbFromUnicode)
                .Write utf8Bytes
            Next i
            
            .SaveToFile filePath, 2  ' 覆盖写入
            .Close
        End With
    End Select
    
    WriteArrayToTxt = True
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    If fileNum > 0 Then Close #fileNum
    MsgBox "写入失败：" & Err.Description & vbCrLf & "路径: " & filePath, vbCritical
    WriteArrayToTxt = False
End Function

' 极简高速排序函数
Sub TurboSort(arr() As Variant, sortCol As Long, sortOrder As String)
    ' 参数说明：
    ' arr - 二维数组（自动跳过第1行标题）
    ' sortCol - 排序列号（从1开始）
    ' sortOrder - "ASC"或"DESC"

    ' 检查有效数据行
    If UBound(arr) < 2 Then Exit Sub

    ' 检查sortCol是否超出数组列数范围
    If sortCol > UBound(arr, 2) Then
        MsgBox "排序列超出数组列数范围。"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 执行快速排序（跳过标题行）
    Call QuickSortCore(arr, 2, UBound(arr), sortCol, UCase(Trim(sortOrder)))
End Sub

' 核心快速排序算法
Private Sub QuickSortCore(arr() As Variant, ByVal low As Long, ByVal high As Long, _
                         ByVal sortCol As Long, ByVal sortOrder As String)
    If low < high Then
        Dim pivotVal As Variant
        Dim i As Long, j As Long, k As Long
        pivotVal = arr(high, sortCol)
        i = low - 1
        j = high
        k = low - 1

        Dim isDateAll As Boolean, isNumericAll As Boolean
        isDateAll = True
        isNumericAll = True

        '预先判断数据类型
        For k = low To high
            If Not IsDate(arr(k, sortCol)) Then
                isDateAll = False
            End If
            If Not IsNumeric(arr(k, sortCol)) Then
                isNumericAll = False
            End If
        Next k

        Do While True
            Do
                i = i + 1
                If isDateAll Then
                    If sortOrder = "ASC" And CDate(arr(i, sortCol)) > CDate(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                    If sortOrder = "DESC" And CDate(arr(i, sortCol)) < CDate(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                ElseIf isNumericAll Then
                    If sortOrder = "ASC" And CDbl(arr(i, sortCol)) > CDbl(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                    If sortOrder = "DESC" And CDbl(arr(i, sortCol)) < CDbl(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                Else
                    If sortOrder = "ASC" And StrComp(CStr(arr(i, sortCol)), CStr(pivotVal), vbTextCompare) > 0 Then Exit Do
                    If sortOrder = "DESC" And StrComp(CStr(arr(i, sortCol)), CStr(pivotVal), vbTextCompare) < 0 Then Exit Do
                End If
            Loop

            Do
                j = j - 1
                If j = low Then Exit Do
                If isDateAll Then
                    If sortOrder = "ASC" And CDate(arr(j, sortCol)) < CDate(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                    If sortOrder = "DESC" And CDate(arr(j, sortCol)) > CDate(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                ElseIf isNumericAll Then
                    If sortOrder = "ASC" And CDbl(arr(j, sortCol)) < CDbl(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                    If sortOrder = "DESC" And CDbl(arr(j, sortCol)) > CDbl(pivotVal) Then Exit Do
                Else
                    If sortOrder = "ASC" And StrComp(CStr(arr(j, sortCol)), CStr(pivotVal), vbTextCompare) < 0 Then Exit Do
                    If sortOrder = "DESC" And StrComp(CStr(arr(j, sortCol)), CStr(pivotVal), vbTextCompare) > 0 Then Exit Do
                End If
            Loop

            If i >= j Then Exit Do
            SwapArrayRows arr, i, j
            If arr(i, sortCol) = pivotVal Then
                k = k + 1
                SwapArrayRows arr, k, i
            End If
        Loop

        SwapArrayRows arr, i, high
        j = i - 1
        For k = low To j
            If arr(k, sortCol) = pivotVal Then
                j = j - 1
                SwapArrayRows arr, k, j
                k = k - 1
            End If
        Next k

        QuickSortCore arr, low, j, sortCol, sortOrder
        QuickSortCore arr, i + 1, high, sortCol, sortOrder
    End If
End Sub
' 极速行交换
Private Sub SwapArrayRows(arr() As Variant, ByVal row1 As Long, ByVal row2 As Long)
    If row1 = row2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim tempRow() As Variant
    ReDim tempRow(LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2))

    Dim col As Long
    For col = LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2)
        tempRow(col) = arr(row1, col)
    Next col

    For col = LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2)
        arr(row1, col) = arr(row2, col)
    Next col

    For col = LBound(arr, 2) To UBound(arr, 2)
        arr(row2, col) = tempRow(col)
    Next col
End Sub

' 函数：在指定位置批量创建文件夹
Function BatchCreateFolders(folderNames As Variant, basePath As String) As Boolean
    ' 功能：在指定位置批量创建文件夹
    ' 参数：
    '   folderNames: 包含文件夹名称的数组
    '   basePath: 基础路径，如 "C:\Users\Desktop\插件文件夹\"
    ' 返回：成功返回True，失败返回False
    
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim folderName As Variant
    Dim fullPath As String
    Dim folderExists As Boolean
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 创建文件系统对象
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' 检查基础路径是否存在
    If Not fso.folderExists(basePath) Then
        MsgBox "错误：基础路径不存在！" & vbCrLf & basePath, vbExclamation
        BatchCreateFolders = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 确保基础路径以反斜杠结尾
    If Right(basePath, 1) <> "\" Then
        basePath = basePath & "\"
    End If
    
    ' 遍历数组并创建文件夹
    For Each folderName In folderNames
        ' 过滤非法字符
        folderName = Replace(folderName, "/", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, "\", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, ":", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, "*", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, "?", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, """", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, "<", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, ">", "")
        folderName = Replace(folderName, "|", "")
        
        ' 跳过空名称
        If Trim(folderName) = "" Then
            GoTo NextFolder
        End If
        
        ' 构建完整路径
        fullPath = basePath & folderName
        
        ' 检查文件夹是否已存在
        folderExists = fso.folderExists(fullPath)
        
        ' 创建文件夹（如果不存在）
        If Not folderExists Then
            fso.CreateFolder fullPath
        End If
        
NextFolder:
    Next folderName
    
    BatchCreateFolders = True
    Exit Function
    
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "创建文件夹时出错: " & Err.Description, vbCritical
    BatchCreateFolders = False
End Function

' 函数：将指定范围的数据转换为一维数组
Function ConvertRangeToArray(targetRange As Range) As Variant
    Dim dataArray As Variant
    Dim resultArray() As Variant
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, k As Long
    
    ' 检查范围是否有效
    If targetRange Is Nothing Then
        ConvertRangeToArray = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 获取范围数据
    dataArray = targetRange.Value
    
    ' 根据范围维度调整数组
    If targetRange.Cells.Count = 1 Then
        ' 只有一个单元格
        ReDim resultArray(1 To 1)
        resultArray(1) = dataArray(1, 1)
    ElseIf targetRange.Columns.Count = 1 Then
        ' 单列多行范围
        ReDim resultArray(1 To targetRange.Rows.Count)
        For i = 1 To targetRange.Rows.Count
            resultArray(i) = dataArray(i, 1)
        Next i
    ElseIf targetRange.Rows.Count = 1 Then
        ' 单行多列范围
        ReDim resultArray(1 To targetRange.Columns.Count)
        For j = 1 To targetRange.Columns.Count
            resultArray(j) = dataArray(1, j)
        Next j
    Else
        ' 多行多列范围 - 转换为一维数组（按行排列）
        ReDim resultArray(1 To targetRange.Cells.Count)
        k = 1
        For i = 1 To targetRange.Rows.Count
            For j = 1 To targetRange.Columns.Count
                resultArray(k) = dataArray(i, j)
                k = k + 1
            Next j
        Next i
    End If
    
    ConvertRangeToArray = resultArray
End Function

        .OnAction = "MyCustomFunction"

    Set colItems = objWMIService.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_DiskDrive")
    
    For Each objItem In colItems
        serialNumber = objItem.serialNumber

        If serialNumber <> "" Then
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
    X = serialNumber
    '在立即窗口输出

    SimpleEncrypt X, 2

' 主入口函数
Public Function ShowDynamicForm( _
    ByVal wsName As String, _
    ByVal labelRange As String, _
    ByVal valueRange As String, _
    ByVal controlTypeRange As String, _
    ByVal validationRange As String, _
    Optional ByVal wb As Workbook = Nothing, _
    Optional ByVal formTitle As String = "设置", _
    Optional ByVal modal As Boolean = True, _
    Optional ByVal folderRows As String = "", _
    Optional ByVal startTop As Long = 2, _
    Optional ByVal rowHeight As Long = 22, _
    Optional ByVal leftMargin As Long = 5, _
    Optional ByVal labelWidth As Long = 10, _
    Optional ByVal controlWidth As Long = 390, _
    Optional ByVal formWidth As Long = 400, _
    Optional ByVal labelControlGap As Long = 5, _
    Optional ByVal fontName As String = "微软雅黑", _
    Optional ByVal fontSize As Long = 9, _
    Optional ByVal ExtraProcName As String = "", _
    Optional ByVal ExtraModuleName As String = "", _
    Optional ByVal ShowSaveTip As Boolean = True _
) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    If wb Is Nothing Then
        Dim wbSearch As Workbook
        Dim wsSearch As Worksheet
        For Each wbSearch In Application.Workbooks
            If Not wbSearch Is ThisWorkbook Then
                On Error Resume Next
                Set wsSearch = wbSearch.Worksheets(wsName)
                If err.Number = 0 Then
                    Set wb = wbSearch
                    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
                    Exit For
                End If
                err.Clear
            End If
        Next wbSearch
        If wb Is Nothing Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Set wsSearch = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(wsName)
            If err.Number = 0 Then Set wb = ThisWorkbook
            err.Clear
            On Error GoTo ErrHandler
        End If
    End If

    Set m_wb = wb
    m_wsName = wsName
    m_labelRange = labelRange
    m_valueRange = valueRange
    m_controlTypeRange = controlTypeRange
    m_validationRange = validationRange
    m_formTitle = formTitle
    m_modal = modal
    m_folderRows = folderRows
    m_result = False

    m_startTop = startTop
    m_rowHeight = rowHeight
    m_leftMargin = leftMargin
    m_labelWidth = labelWidth
    m_controlWidth = controlWidth
    m_formWidth = formWidth
    m_labelControlGap = labelControlGap
    m_fontName = fontName
    m_fontSize = fontSize
    m_ExtraProcName = Trim(ExtraProcName)
    
    m_btnWidth = 80
    m_btnHeight = 22
    m_btnGap = 40
    m_btnTopGap = 5
    m_btnBottomGap = 15

    Set m_BtnHandlers = New Collection

    Dim frm As Object
    Set frm = VBA.UserForms.Add("frmDynamic")
    Set m_frm = frm

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Call BuildDynamicForm(frm)
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    If modal Then
        frm.Show vbModal
    Else
        frm.Show vbModeless
    End If

    ShowDynamicForm = m_result

    Set m_BtnHandlers = Nothing
    Set m_frm = Nothing
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "显示窗体失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    ShowDynamicForm = False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' 构建窗体【完整修复版，解决布尔行生成文本框问题】
Public Sub BuildDynamicForm(frm As Object)
    On Error GoTo BuildErr
    If m_wb Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "工作簿引用为空", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = m_wb.Worksheets(m_wsName)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "找不到工作表：" & m_wsName, vbCritical
        err.Clear
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo BuildErr
    Dim i As Long
    For i = frm.Controls.count - 1 To 0 Step -1
        frm.Controls.Remove frm.Controls(i).NAME
    Next i
    frm.Caption = m_formTitle
    Dim rngLabels As range, rngValues As range, rngTypes As range, rngValidations As range
    Set rngLabels = ws.range(m_labelRange)
    Set rngValues = ws.range(m_valueRange)
    Set rngTypes = ws.range(m_controlTypeRange)
    Set rngValidations = ws.range(m_validationRange)
    Dim itemCount As Long
    itemCount = rngLabels.Cells.count
    If rngValues.Cells.count < itemCount Then itemCount = rngValues.Cells.count
    If rngTypes.Cells.count < itemCount Then itemCount = rngTypes.Cells.count
    If rngValidations.Cells.count < itemCount Then itemCount = rngValidations.count
    ' 计算 labelWidth
    If m_labelWidth <= 0 Then
        Dim measureLabel As Object
        Dim maxLabelW As Long
        maxLabelW = 0
        For i = 1 To itemCount
            Set measureLabel = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "lblMeasure" & i, True)
            With measureLabel
                .Caption = rngLabels.Cells(i).value & ""
                .Font.NAME = m_fontName
                .Font.size = m_fontSize
                .AutoSize = True
            End With
            If measureLabel.Width > maxLabelW Then maxLabelW = measureLabel.Width
            frm.Controls.Remove "lblMeasure" & i
        Next i
        m_labelWidth = maxLabelW + 6
    End If
    If m_controlWidth <= 0 Then
        m_controlWidth = 300
    End If
    Dim actualFormWidth As Long
    actualFormWidth = m_leftMargin + m_labelWidth + m_labelControlGap + m_controlWidth + m_leftMargin + FORM_BORDER_W
    If m_formWidth > 0 And m_formWidth > actualFormWidth Then
        actualFormWidth = m_formWidth
        m_controlWidth = m_formWidth - m_leftMargin - m_labelWidth - m_labelControlGap - m_leftMargin - FORM_BORDER_W
    End If
    frm.Width = actualFormWidth
    Dim topPos As Long
    topPos = m_startTop
    Dim labelObj As Object, ctrlObj As Object
    Dim labelText As String, ctrlType As String, valText As String
    Dim minVal As Double, maxVal As Double
    Dim hasRange As Boolean, isFolder As Boolean, isBoolean As Boolean
    For i = 1 To itemCount
        labelText = rngLabels.Cells(i).value & ""
        ctrlType = UCase(Trim(rngTypes.Cells(i).value & ""))
        valText = rngValidations.Cells(i).value & ""
        minVal = 0: maxVal = 0
        hasRange = False
        isFolder = IsFolderRow(rngLabels.Cells(i).row)
        Call ParseValidation(valText, isBoolean, hasRange, minVal, maxVal)
        ' 创建标签
        Set labelObj = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "lblRow" & i, True)
        On Error Resume Next
        labelObj.Caption = labelText
        labelObj.Left = m_leftMargin
        labelObj.Top = topPos + 2
        labelObj.Width = m_labelWidth
        labelObj.Height = m_rowHeight - 4
        labelObj.Font.NAME = m_fontName
        labelObj.Font.size = m_fontSize
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "创建标签失败（行" & i & "）：" & err.Description, vbCritical
            err.Clear
        End If
        On Error GoTo BuildErr
        
        ' ==========核心修复：判断条件兼容中英文布尔标识==========
        If isBoolean Or ctrlType = "CHECKBOX" Or ctrlType = "是否" Or ctrlType = "布尔" Or ctrlType = "BOOLEAN" Then
            ' 生成复选框
            Set ctrlObj = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.CheckBox.1", "chkRow" & i, True)
            On Error Resume Next
            ctrlObj.Left = m_leftMargin + m_labelWidth + m_labelControlGap
            ctrlObj.Top = topPos + 2
            ctrlObj.Width = m_controlWidth
            ctrlObj.Height = m_rowHeight - 4
            ctrlObj.value = IsTrueValue(rngValues.Cells(i).value)
            ctrlObj.Caption = ""
            ctrlObj.Font.NAME = m_fontName
            ctrlObj.Font.size = m_fontSize
            If err.Number <> 0 Then
                MsgBox "复选框属性错误（行" & i & "）：" & err.Number & " " & err.Description, vbCritical
                err.Clear
            End If
            On Error GoTo BuildErr
            ' 复选框Tag
            ctrlObj.Tag = i & "|" & rngValues.Cells(i).Address
        Else
            ' 生成文本框
            Set ctrlObj = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", "txtRow" & i, True)
            On Error Resume Next
            ctrlObj.Left = m_leftMargin + m_labelWidth + m_labelControlGap
            ctrlObj.Top = topPos + 1
            ctrlObj.Width = m_controlWidth
            ctrlObj.Height = m_rowHeight - 3
            ctrlObj.Text = rngValues.Cells(i).value & ""
            ctrlObj.Font.NAME = m_fontName
            ctrlObj.Font.size = m_fontSize
            ctrlObj.WordWrap = False
            If hasRange Then
                ctrlObj.textAlign = 1
            End If
            If err.Number <> 0 Then
                MsgBox "文本框属性错误（行" & i & "）：" & err.Number & " " & err.Description, vbCritical
                err.Clear
            End If
            On Error GoTo BuildErr
            ' 文本框完整Tag
            Dim isNumField As String
            isNumField = IIf(hasRange, "1", "0")
            ctrlObj.Tag = i & "|" & IIf(hasRange, "1", "0") & "|" & minVal & "|" & maxVal & "|" & IIf(isFolder, "1", "0") & "|" & rngValues.Cells(i).Address & "|" & isNumField
        End If
        
        topPos = topPos + m_rowHeight
    Next i
    ' 创建按钮
    Dim btnTop As Long
    btnTop = topPos + m_btnTopGap
    Dim btnCancel As Object
    Set btnCancel = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "btnCancel", True)
    On Error Resume Next
    btnCancel.Caption = "取消"
    btnCancel.Left = m_leftMargin + m_labelWidth + m_labelControlGap + m_controlWidth - m_btnWidth
    btnCancel.Top = btnTop
    btnCancel.Width = m_btnWidth
    btnCancel.Height = m_btnHeight
    btnCancel.Font.NAME = m_fontName
    btnCancel.Font.size = m_fontSize
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "取消按钮属性错误：" & err.Number & " " & err.Description, vbCritical
        err.Clear
    End If
    On Error GoTo BuildErr
    Dim btnOK As Object
    Set btnOK = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "btnOK", True)
    On Error Resume Next
    btnOK.Caption = "确定"
    btnOK.Left = btnCancel.Left - m_btnGap - m_btnWidth
    btnOK.Top = btnTop
    btnOK.Width = m_btnWidth
    btnOK.Height = m_btnHeight
    btnOK.Font.NAME = m_fontName
    btnOK.Font.size = m_fontSize
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "确定按钮属性错误：" & err.Number & " " & err.Description, vbCritical
        err.Clear
    End If
    On Error GoTo BuildErr
    ' 绑定按钮事件
    Dim clsOK As DynamicButton
    Set clsOK = New DynamicButton
    Set clsOK.btn = btnOK
    clsOK.ButtonType = "OK"
    Set clsOK.ParentForm = frm
    m_BtnHandlers.Add clsOK
    Dim clsCancel As DynamicButton
    Set clsCancel = New DynamicButton
    Set clsCancel.btn = btnCancel
    clsCancel.ButtonType = "CANCEL"
    Set clsCancel.ParentForm = frm
    m_BtnHandlers.Add clsCancel
    frm.Height = btnTop + m_btnHeight + m_btnBottomGap + FORM_BORDER_H
    frm.Width = actualFormWidth
    Exit Sub
BuildErr:
    MsgBox "构建窗体失败（行" & Erl() & "）：" & err.Number & " " & err.Description, vbCritical
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
' 保存配置【修复全局UI锁死，兼容多标签】
Public Function SaveDynamicFormValues(frm As Object) As Boolean
    Dim bScreen As Boolean, bEvents As Boolean, bAlerts As Boolean
    ' 缓存原始全局状态，防止标签插件失效
    bScreen = Application.ScreenUpdating
    bEvents = Application.EnableEvents
    bAlerts = Application.DisplayAlerts
    
    On Error GoTo SaveErr
    
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = ThisWorkbook
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets("插件设置")
    On Error GoTo SaveErr
    
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "找不到【插件设置】工作表！", vbCritical
        SaveDynamicFormValues = False
        Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
        DoEvents
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim ctrlObj As Object
    Dim i As Long
    Dim minVal As Double, maxVal As Double
    Dim hasRange As Boolean, isFolder As Boolean
    Dim cellAddr As String
    Dim parts() As String
    Dim valText As String
    Dim numVal As Variant
    Dim isNumericField As Boolean
    Dim saveCount As Long
    saveCount = 0
    
    ' 仅遍历控件时临时关闭，不要全程锁死
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    For Each ctrlObj In frm.Controls
        If typeName(ctrlObj) = "TextBox" Or typeName(ctrlObj) = "CheckBox" Then
            If ctrlObj.Tag <> "" Then
                parts = Split(ctrlObj.Tag, "|")
                
                If typeName(ctrlObj) = "CheckBox" Then
                    If UBound(parts) >= 1 Then
                        i = CLng(parts(0))
                        cellAddr = parts(1)
                        ws.range(cellAddr).value = IIf(ctrlObj.value, True, False)
                        saveCount = saveCount + 1
                    End If
                Else
                    If UBound(parts) >= 6 Then
                        i = CLng(parts(0))
                        hasRange = (parts(1) = "1")
                        minVal = CDbl(parts(2))
                        maxVal = CDbl(parts(3))
                        isFolder = (parts(4) = "1")
                        cellAddr = parts(5)
                        isNumericField = (parts(6) = "1")
                        valText = Trim(ctrlObj.Text)
                        
                        If valText = "" Then
                            If hasRange Then
                                Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
                                MsgBox "【" & GetLabelCaption(frm, i) & "】不能为空，请输入数值", vbExclamation
                                ctrlObj.SetFocus
                                SaveDynamicFormValues = False
                                DoEvents
                                Exit Function
                            Else
                                ws.range(cellAddr).value = valText
                                saveCount = saveCount + 1
                            End If
                        Else
                            If isNumericField Then
                                Dim pureNum As String
                                pureNum = ExtractPureNumber(valText)
                                If pureNum = "" Then
                                    Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
                                    MsgBox "【" & GetLabelCaption(frm, i) & "】必须输入数值", vbExclamation
                                    ctrlObj.SetFocus
                                    SaveDynamicFormValues = False
                                    DoEvents
                                    Exit Function
                                End If
                                If Not IsNumeric(pureNum) Then
                                    Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
                                    MsgBox "【" & GetLabelCaption(frm, i) & "】输入的不是有效数值：" & valText, vbExclamation
                                    ctrlObj.SetFocus
                                    SaveDynamicFormValues = False
                                    DoEvents
                                    Exit Function
                                End If
                                numVal = CDbl(pureNum)
                                If hasRange Then
                                    If numVal < minVal Or numVal > maxVal Then
                                        Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
                                        MsgBox "【" & GetLabelCaption(frm, i) & "】数值必须在 " & minVal & " ~ " & maxVal & " 之间" & vbCrLf & "当前值：" & numVal, vbExclamation
                                        ctrlObj.SetFocus
                                        SaveDynamicFormValues = False
                                        DoEvents
                                        Exit Function
                                    End If
                                End If
                            End If
                            If isFolder Then
                                If Not ValidateFolderPath(valText) Then
                                    Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
                                    MsgBox "【" & GetLabelCaption(frm, i) & "】文件夹不存在或路径不正确：" & vbCrLf & valText, vbExclamation
                                    ctrlObj.SetFocus
                                    SaveDynamicFormValues = False
                                    DoEvents
                                    Exit Function
                                End If
                            End If
                            ws.range(cellAddr).value = valText
                            saveCount = saveCount + 1
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next ctrlObj
    
    ' 保存文件
    wb.Save
    
    ' 立刻恢复原始UI状态，修复多标签消失
    Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
    DoEvents
    
    SaveDynamicFormValues = True
    If m_ShowSaveTip Then
    MsgBox "保存成功！共保存 " & saveCount & " 项设置", vbInformation
End If
'    Debug.Print "要执行的过程名：" & m_ExtraProcName
    
    ' 动态调用自定义过程
If m_ExtraProcName <> "" Then
    On Error Resume Next
    ' 第一步：同模块直接调用，本模块过程优先，不会报错
    Call Application.Run(m_ExtraProcName)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        ' 第二步：同模块调用失败，尝试全局任意模块公共过程
        Dim tempMacro As String
        tempMacro = m_ExtraProcName
        Application.Run tempMacro
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "执行后续过程【" & m_ExtraProcName & "】失败：" & err.Description, vbExclamation
            err.Clear
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo SaveErr
End If
Exit Function
SaveErr:
    Call RestoreAppSettingWithCache(bScreen, bEvents, bAlerts)
    DoEvents
    MsgBox "保存失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    SaveDynamicFormValues = False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Sub ParseValidation(ByVal valText As String, ByRef isBoolean As Boolean, ByRef hasRange As Boolean, ByRef minVal As Double, ByRef maxVal As Double)
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    Dim s As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim cleanText As String
    Dim dashPos As Long
    Dim leftPart As String
    Dim rightPart As String
    
    s = LCase(Trim(valText))
    isBoolean = False
    hasRange = False
    minVal = 0
    maxVal = 0
    
    If s = "" Then Exit Sub
    
    ' 布尔类型
    If InStr(s, "boolean") > 0 Or InStr(s, "是否") > 0 Or InStr(s, "checkbox") > 0 Or InStr(s, "两种") > 0 Then
        isBoolean = True
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 纯数值类型
    If InStr(s, "数值") > 0 Or InStr(s, "数字") > 0 Or InStr(s, "number") > 0 Then
        hasRange = True
        minVal = -1E+15
        maxVal = 1E+15
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 手动去空格和中文符号
    cleanText = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        Select Case Mid(s, i, 1)
            Case " ", "（", "）", "(", ")"
                ' 跳过
            Case Else
                cleanText = cleanText & Mid(s, i, 1)
        End Select
    Next i
    
    ' 移除中文后缀
    Dim suffixArr As Variant
    suffixArr = Array("以内", "范围", "之间", "区间", "左右")
    For i = LBound(suffixArr) To UBound(suffixArr)
        If InStr(cleanText, suffixArr(i)) > 0 Then
            cleanText = Left(cleanText, InStr(cleanText, suffixArr(i)) - 1)
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 查找数字-数字模式
    dashPos = InStr(2, cleanText, "-")
    If dashPos > 0 Then
        leftPart = Trim(Left(cleanText, dashPos - 1))
        rightPart = Trim(Mid(cleanText, dashPos + 1))
        
        leftPart = ExtractOnlyNumber(leftPart)
        rightPart = ExtractOnlyNumber(rightPart)
        
        If IsNumeric(leftPart) And IsNumeric(rightPart) Then
            minVal = CDbl(leftPart)
            maxVal = CDbl(rightPart)
            hasRange = True
        End If
    End If
    
ErrHandler:
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Private Function ExtractOnlyNumber(ByVal Text As String) As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    
    For i = 1 To Len(Text)
        Select Case Mid(Text, i, 1)
            Case "0" To "9", ".", "-"
                result = result & Mid(Text, i, 1)
        End Select
    Next i
    
    ExtractOnlyNumber = result
End Function

Private Function IsFolderRow(ByVal rowNum As Long) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    Dim folderText As String
    Dim parts() As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim cleanText As String
    
    IsFolderRow = False
    folderText = Trim(m_folderRows & "")
    
    If folderText = "" Then
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 手动去空格和中文逗号
    cleanText = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(folderText)
        Select Case Mid(folderText, i, 1)
            Case " ", "，"
                ' 跳过
            Case Else
                cleanText = cleanText & Mid(folderText, i, 1)
        End Select
    Next i
    
    If cleanText = "" Then
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    parts = Split(cleanText, ",")
    
    For i = LBound(parts) To UBound(parts)
        If parts(i) <> "" Then
            If CLng(parts(i)) = rowNum Then
                IsFolderRow = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
ErrHandler:
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Function IsTrueValue(ByVal v As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim s As String
    s = UCase(Trim(v & ""))
    IsTrueValue = (s = "TRUE" Or s = "是" Or s = "1" Or s = "-1" Or s = "YES")
End Function

Private Function ValidateFolderPath(ByVal pathText As String) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim attr As Long
    
    ValidateFolderPath = False
    folderPath = Trim(pathText)
    
    If folderPath = "" Then
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 手动替换反斜杠，不用 Replace
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To Len(folderPath)
        If Mid(folderPath, i, 1) = "/" Then
            folderPath = Left(folderPath, i - 1) & "\" & Mid(folderPath, i + 1)
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 确保以反斜杠结尾
    If Right(folderPath, 1) <> "\" Then
        folderPath = folderPath & "\"
    End If
    
    If Len(folderPath) < 3 Then
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 检查文件夹是否存在
    On Error Resume Next
    attr = GetAttr(folderPath)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    If (attr And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory Then
        ValidateFolderPath = True
    End If
    
ErrHandler:
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Private Function ExtractPureNumber(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, ch As String
    Dim started As Boolean
    s = Trim(s)
    
    If IsNumeric(s) Then
        ExtractPureNumber = s
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim numStr As String
    numStr = ""
    started = False
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        ch = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If (ch >= "0" And ch <= "9") Then
            numStr = numStr & ch
            started = True
        ElseIf ch = "." And started Then
            If InStr(numStr, ".") = 0 Then
                numStr = numStr & ch
            Else
                Exit For
            End If
        ElseIf ch = "-" And Not started And i = 1 Then
            numStr = numStr & ch
        Else
            If started Then Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    
    If numStr <> "" Then
        If Right(numStr, 1) = "-" Then numStr = Left(numStr, Len(numStr) - 1)
        If numStr = "." Then numStr = ""
    End If
    
    ExtractPureNumber = numStr
End Function
