' 解析 ws 参数：允许传 Worksheet 对象，也允许直接传工作表名称（字符串），彻底避免类型不符
Private Function ResolveWs(ByVal wsOrName As Variant) As Object
    Dim wsObj As Object
    Dim tryName As String
    On Error Resume Next
    If IsMissing(wsOrName) Or IsEmpty(wsOrName) Then
        ' 未传 ws：自动从 ActiveWorkbook 查找 "常用列表"
        tryName = "常用列表"
        If Not ActiveWorkbook Is Nothing Then
            Set wsObj = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(tryName)
        End If
        If wsObj Is Nothing And Not ThisWorkbook Is Nothing Then
            Set wsObj = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(tryName)
        End If
    ElseIf VarType(wsOrName) = vbString Then
        tryName = CStr(wsOrName)
        Set wsObj = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(tryName)
        If wsObj Is Nothing Then
            If Not ActiveWorkbook Is Nothing Then
                Set wsObj = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(tryName)
            End If
        End If
    Else
        Set wsObj = wsOrName
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set ResolveWs = wsObj
End Function

' 诊断用：把 ResolveWs 失败信息拼成可读字符串
Private Function WsNotFoundMsg(ByVal tryName As String) As String
    Dim thisName As String, activeName As String
    On Error Resume Next
    thisName = ThisWorkbook.NAME
    activeName = ActiveWorkbook.NAME
    On Error GoTo 0
    WsNotFoundMsg = "未找到目标工作表" & IIf(tryName <> "", "「" & tryName & "」", "") & "。" & vbCrLf & _
                    "ThisWorkbook=" & thisName & "，ActiveWorkbook=" & activeName & "。" & vbCrLf & _
                    "请确认：1) 当前活动工作簿已打开该工作表；2) 调用时直接传名称字符串 ""常用列表""；3) 或在代码里 Set ws = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(""常用列表"")。"
End Function


' 主入口：根据传入的字段数组动态创建并显示编辑窗体
' 参数：
'   formTitle      窗体标题
'   fieldLabels    字段标签数组（下标从 1 开始）
'   fieldValues    字段初始值数组
'   fieldAddresses 字段对应工作表单元格地址数组（无需保存可传空字符串）
'   wsOrName       要保存的工作表：可传 Worksheet 对象，也可直接传工作表名称字符串（如 "常用列表"）；Nothing 则只显示不保存
'   modal          True=模态显示，False=非模态
'   labelWidth     标签列固定宽度（像素），0=按文字自动测量
'   formWidth      窗体总宽度（像素），0=使用默认 400
'   rowGap         每行中间的空白间隔（像素），0=使用默认 0
'   addMode        True=新建（追加到末尾行）；False=编辑（写回原行）
' 返回：True=用户点击了确定并保存成功；False=取消或失败

Public Function ShowFieldEditForm( _
    ByVal formTitle As String, _
    ByRef fieldLabels As Variant, _
    ByRef fieldValues As Variant, _
    ByRef fieldAddresses As Variant, _
    Optional ByVal wsOrName As Variant, _
    Optional ByVal modal As Boolean = True, _
    Optional ByVal labelWidth As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal formWidth As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal rowGap As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal addMode As Boolean = False _
) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    Dim lb As Long, ub As Long
    lb = LBound(fieldLabels)
    ub = UBound(fieldLabels)
    If LBound(fieldValues) <> lb Or UBound(fieldValues) <> ub Then
        MsgBox "fieldLabels 与 fieldValues 数组长度不一致", vbCritical
        ShowFieldEditForm = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If LBound(fieldAddresses) <> lb Or UBound(fieldAddresses) <> ub Then
        MsgBox "fieldAddresses 数组长度与字段数不一致", vbCritical
        ShowFieldEditForm = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Set m_frm = Nothing
    Set m_Handlers = Nothing
    
    Dim frm As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set frm = VBA.UserForms.Add("frmDynamic")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If frm Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "找不到空白窗体 frmDynamic。" & vbCrLf & _
               "请先在 VBE 中插入一个用户窗体，把它的 Name 属性改为 frmDynamic（里面不要放任何控件），再重试。", vbCritical
        ShowFieldEditForm = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    Set m_frm = frm
    
    Set m_Handlers = New Collection
    
    Dim wsObj As Object
    Set wsObj = ResolveWs(wsOrName)
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Call BuildFieldEditForm(frm, formTitle, fieldLabels, fieldValues, fieldAddresses, wsObj, labelWidth, formWidth, rowGap, addMode)
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    If modal Then
        frm.Show vbModal
    Else
        frm.Show vbModeless
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    Dim h As CEditFormHandler
    Dim ret As Boolean
    ret = False
    For Each h In m_Handlers
        If h.ButtonType = "OK" And h.result = True Then
            ret = True
        End If
    Next h
    
    ShowFieldEditForm = ret
    
    Set m_Handlers = Nothing
    Set m_frm = Nothing
    Exit Function
    
ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "显示编辑窗体失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    ShowFieldEditForm = False
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function


' 辅助：从 ListBox 当前选中行构造字段数组
' 参数：
'   lb            列表框
'   wsOrName      数据源工作表（对象或名称字符串）
'   labels/values/addresses 返回数组（下标从 1 开始）
'   columnHeads   列表框是否把表头作为单独一行显示。
'                 你的文件管理窗体用 .List = Range("A1:B"&lastRow) 且 ColumnHeads=False，
'                 此时表头(A1/B1)就是 List(0)，数据与表头在同一 List 里，故默认 False。
'                 若你的列表框 ColumnHeads=True 且 RowSource 不含表头行，则传 True。
'   dataStartRow  工作表中数据起始行号（0=自动跟随 columnHeads：False->1 / True->2）
' 返回：字段数，0 表示未选中

Public Function GetListBoxFieldArrays( _
    lb As MSForms.ListBox, _
    ByVal wsOrName As Variant, _
    ByRef labels As Variant, _
    ByRef values As Variant, _
    ByRef addresses As Variant, _
    Optional ByVal columnHeads As Boolean = False, _
    Optional ByVal dataStartRow As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal headerRow As Long = 1 _
) As Long
    If lb.listIndex < 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先选中要编辑的行", vbExclamation
        GetListBoxFieldArrays = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim wsObj As Object
    Set wsObj = ResolveWs(wsOrName)
    If wsObj Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "读取列表框失败：" & WsNotFoundMsg("常用列表"), vbCritical
        GetListBoxFieldArrays = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim colCount As Long
    colCount = lb.ColumnCount
    If colCount < 1 Then colCount = 1
    
    ReDim labels(1 To colCount)
    ReDim values(1 To colCount)
    ReDim addresses(1 To colCount)
    
    Dim c As Long
    
    ' 数据行对应工作表行号：优先用 Find 定位（与你删除按钮的逻辑一致，最可靠）
    ' 用选中行 A 列的值去工作表 A 列查找，找到的行号就是真实工作表行，绝不偏移。
    Dim keyVal As String
    keyVal = lb.List(lb.listIndex, 0) & ""
    Dim sheetRow As Long
    sheetRow = 0
    On Error Resume Next
    If keyVal <> "" Then
        sheetRow = wsObj.range("A:A").Find(What:=keyVal, LookIn:=-4163, LookAt:=1).row
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If sheetRow <= 1 Then
        ' Find 没找到（或命中表头行），回退为 ListIndex + dataStartRow 推算
        If dataStartRow <= 0 Then dataStartRow = IIf(columnHeads, 2, 1)
        sheetRow = lb.listIndex + dataStartRow
    End If

    ' 标签取工作表表头行（默认第 1 行），值取选中行的 List，地址按定位到的 sheetRow
    On Error Resume Next
    For c = 1 To colCount
        labels(c) = wsObj.Cells(headerRow, c).value & ""
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            err.Clear
            labels(c) = lb.List(0, c - 1) & ""
        End If
        values(c) = lb.List(lb.listIndex, c - 1) & ""
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            MsgBox "读取列表框选中行数据失败（列 " & c & "）。" & vbCrLf & _
                   "ColumnCount=" & colCount & "，ListCount=" & lb.ListCount & _
                   "，ListIndex=" & lb.listIndex & "。", vbCritical
            GetListBoxFieldArrays = 0
            Exit Function
        End If
        err.Clear
        addresses(c) = wsObj.Cells(sheetRow, c).Address
    Next c
    On Error GoTo 0

    GetListBoxFieldArrays = colCount
End Function


' 构建窗体内部控件
' 布局常量都集中在这里，想调整直接改这些数字即可

Public Sub BuildFieldEditForm( _
    frm As Object, _
    ByVal formTitle As String, _
    ByRef fieldLabels As Variant, _
    ByRef fieldValues As Variant, _
    ByRef fieldAddresses As Variant, _
    ByVal wsObj As Object, _
    Optional ByVal labelWidth As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal formWidth As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal rowGap As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal addMode As Boolean = False _
)
    If wsObj Is Nothing And addMode = False Then
        MsgBox "构建窗体失败：编辑模式下未指定目标工作表 ws。" & vbCrLf & WsNotFoundMsg("常用列表"), vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    EnsureDefaults

    On Error GoTo BuildErr
    
    Dim lb As Long, ub As Long, i As Long
    lb = LBound(fieldLabels)
    ub = UBound(fieldLabels)
    

    ' 依据传入的 rowGap 决定实际行距（0=使用默认 DEFAULT_ROW_gGAP）
    Dim rowGapActual As Long
    rowGapActual = DEFAULT_ROW_gGAP
    If rowGap > 0 Then rowGapActual = rowGap

    ' 清理旧控件
    Dim j As Long
    For j = frm.Controls.count - 1 To 0 Step -1
        frm.Controls.Remove frm.Controls(j).NAME
    Next j
    
    If addMode Then
        frm.Caption = formTitle & "（新建）"
    Else
        frm.Caption = formTitle & "（编辑）"
    End If
    
    Dim actualFormW As Long
    actualFormW = gDEFAULT_FORM_W
    If formWidth > 0 Then actualFormW = formWidth
    
    ' 测量标签最大宽度
    Dim maxLabelW As Long
    maxLabelW = 0
    If labelWidth > 0 Then
        maxLabelW = labelWidth
    Else
        Dim measureLbl As Object
        For i = lb To ub
            Set measureLbl = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "lblMeasure" & i, True)
            measureLbl.Caption = fieldLabels(i)
            measureLbl.AutoSize = True
            If measureLbl.Width > maxLabelW Then maxLabelW = measureLbl.Width
            frm.Controls.Remove "lblMeasure" & i
        Next i
    End If
    
    If maxLabelW < gMIN_LABEL_W Then maxLabelW = gMIN_LABEL_W
    If maxLabelW > gMAX_LABEL_W Then maxLabelW = gMAX_LABEL_W
    
    ' 文本框宽度 = 窗体宽 - 左边距 - 标签宽 - 间距 - 右边距 - 边框修正
    Dim textW As Long
    textW = actualFormW - gLEFT_M - maxLabelW - gGAP - gLEFT_M - 12
    If textW < 120 Then textW = 120
    
    Dim topPos As Long
    topPos = gTOP_M
    
    Dim lbl As Object, txt As Object
    For i = lb To ub
        Set lbl = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "lblRow" & i, True)
        lbl.Caption = fieldLabels(i)
        lbl.Left = gLEFT_M
        lbl.Top = topPos + 4
        lbl.Width = maxLabelW
        lbl.Height = gROW_H - 8
        lbl.AutoSize = False
        lbl.Font.NAME = gFONT_NAME
        lbl.Font.size = gFONT_SIZE
        
        Set txt = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", "txtRow" & i, True)
        txt.value = fieldValues(i)
        txt.Left = gLEFT_M + maxLabelW + gGAP
        txt.Top = topPos
        txt.Width = textW
        txt.Height = gROW_H - 4
        txt.WordWrap = False
        txt.Font.NAME = gFONT_NAME
        txt.Font.size = gFONT_SIZE
        txt.Tag = fieldAddresses(i) & ""
        
        topPos = topPos + gROW_H + rowGapActual
    Next i
    
    ' 按钮
    Dim btnTop As Long
    btnTop = topPos + 14
    
    Dim btnCancel As Object
    Set btnCancel = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "btnCancel", True)
    btnCancel.Caption = "取消"
    btnCancel.Left = actualFormW - gLEFT_M - 80 - 12
    btnCancel.Top = btnTop
    btnCancel.Width = 80
    btnCancel.Height = 26
    btnCancel.Font.NAME = gFONT_NAME
    btnCancel.Font.size = gFONT_SIZE
    
    Dim btnOK As Object
    Set btnOK = frm.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "btnOK", True)
    btnOK.Caption = "确定"
    btnOK.Left = btnCancel.Left - 90
    btnOK.Top = btnTop
    btnOK.Width = 80
    btnOK.Height = 26
    btnOK.Font.NAME = gFONT_NAME
    btnOK.Font.size = gFONT_SIZE
    
    frm.Width = actualFormW
    frm.Height = btnTop + 26 + 40
    
    ' 编辑模式下如果所有文本框 Tag 都是空，保存时会找不到原地址，提前提示
    If addMode = False Then
        Dim hasAddr As Boolean
        hasAddr = False
        For i = lb To ub
            If (fieldAddresses(i) & "") <> "" Then hasAddr = True: Exit For
        Next i
        If hasAddr = False Then
            MsgBox "编辑模式下所有字段地址为空，保存时会变成新增一行。" & vbCrLf & _
                   "请检查 GetListBoxFieldArrays 是否正确返回了 addresses 数组。", vbExclamation
        End If
    End If
    
    ' 绑定事件
    Dim hOK As CEditFormHandler
    Set hOK = New CEditFormHandler
    Set hOK.btn = btnOK
    hOK.ButtonType = "OK"
    Set hOK.ParentForm = frm
    Set hOK.ws = wsObj
    hOK.FieldCount = lb
    hOK.FieldLast = ub
    hOK.IsAddMode = addMode
    m_Handlers.Add hOK
    
    Dim hCancel As CEditFormHandler
    Set hCancel = New CEditFormHandler
    Set hCancel.btn = btnCancel
    hCancel.ButtonType = "CANCEL"
    Set hCancel.ParentForm = frm
    m_Handlers.Add hCancel
    
    Exit Sub
BuildErr:
    MsgBox "构建窗体失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 便捷入口：新建记录（在现有数据末尾追加一行）
' 参数：
'   formTitle   窗体标题
'   wsOrName    目标工作表（对象或名称字符串）
'   colCount    字段数（列数）。<=0 时按表头行最后一列自动推断
'   headerRow   表头所在行（默认 1，用于取字段标签）
'   labelWidth/formWidth/rowGap 同 ShowFieldEditForm
' 返回：True=用户点击确定并新增成功

Public Function ShowAddForm( _
    ByVal formTitle As String, _
    Optional ByVal wsOrName As Variant, _
    Optional ByVal colCount As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal headerRow As Long = 1, _
    Optional ByVal labelWidth As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal formWidth As Long = 0, _
    Optional ByVal rowGap As Long = 0 _
) As Boolean
    Dim wsObj As Object
    Set wsObj = ResolveWs(wsOrName)
    If wsObj Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "新建失败：" & WsNotFoundMsg("常用列表") & vbCrLf & _
               "（你传入的参数类型代码=" & VarType(wsOrName) & "）", vbCritical
        ShowAddForm = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim B As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = colCount
    If lastCol <= 0 Then
        ' xlToLeft = -4159
        lastCol = 2

    End If
    If lastCol < 1 Then lastCol = 1

    ReDim labels(1 To lastCol)
    ReDim values(1 To lastCol)
    ReDim addresses(1 To lastCol)

    For B = 1 To lastCol
        labels(B) = wsObj.Cells(headerRow, B).value & ""
        values(B) = ""       ' 新建时初始为空
        addresses(B) = ""    ' 新建模式由 SaveValues 追加到末尾行，不依赖地址
    Next B

    ShowAddForm = ShowFieldEditForm(formTitle, labels, values, addresses, wsObj, True, labelWidth, formWidth, rowGap, True)
End Function

Option Explicit
' ★ 2026-07 v2：修复"运行中 Excel 自动退出/闪退"
'   根因1（致命）：SetTimer 用 hWnd=NULL(0&) 调用时，Windows 会【忽略】传入的
'     nIDEvent(TIMER_ID)，自行生成一个新的定时器 ID 并作为返回值（存入 g_TimerHandle）。
'     要销毁它，KillTimer 必须传【返回值 g_TimerHandle】，而不是常量 TIMER_ID。
'     原代码 KillTimer 0&, TIMER_ID 永远杀不掉定时器 →
'       ① 关闭/重载时旧定时器不死；
'       ② 每次 StartBackupTimer 又 SetTimer 一个新的 → 定时器越堆越多；
'       多个定时器并发回调、在保存过程中重入 SaveCopyAs → Excel 崩溃闪退。
'   根因2：TimerProc 无重入保护。WM_TIMER 可能在上一次保存/备份尚未结束时再次触发，
'     造成对象模型重入调用 → 崩溃。
'   修复：KillTimer 改用 g_TimerHandle；TimerProc 增加 g_InTimer 重入锁 +
'     Application 就绪判断；保存/备份期间不再被重入打断。

' ---- Windows API 声明（32/64 位兼容）----
#If VBA7 Then
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function SetTimer Lib "user32" ( _
        ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal nIDEvent As LongPtr, _
        ByVal uElapse As Long, ByVal lpTimerFunc As LongPtr) As LongPtr
    Private Declare PtrSafe Function KillTimer Lib "user32" ( _
        ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal nIDEvent As LongPtr) As Long
#Else
    Private Declare Function SetTimer Lib "user32" ( _
        ByVal hwnd As Long, ByVal nIDEvent As Long, _
        ByVal uElapse As Long, ByVal lpTimerFunc As Long) As Long
    Private Declare Function KillTimer Lib "user32" ( _
        ByVal hwnd As Long, ByVal nIDEvent As Long) As Long
#End If

'【获取宿主工作簿】查找包含"插件设置"工作表的工作簿
Private Function GetHostWorkbook() As Workbook
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(SET_SHEET_NAME)
    If err.Number = 0 Then
        Set GetHostWorkbook = ThisWorkbook
        On Error GoTo 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0

    For Each wb In Application.Workbooks
        If Not wb Is ThisWorkbook Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Set ws = wb.Worksheets(SET_SHEET_NAME)
            If err.Number = 0 Then
                Set GetHostWorkbook = wb
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Function
            End If
            err.Clear
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next wb

    Set GetHostWorkbook = ThisWorkbook
End Function

'【重载所有配置】
Public Sub ReloadAllConfig()
    Dim cfgWs As Worksheet
    Dim vEnable As Variant
    Dim wbHost As Workbook

    Set wbHost = GetHostWorkbook()

    g_AutoSaveMinute = 5
    g_AutoBackupMinute = 10
    g_MinBackupGap = 5
    g_HeartbeatSec = 30
    g_TimerEnabled = False

    On Error Resume Next
    Set cfgWs = wbHost.Worksheets(SET_SHEET_NAME)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    vEnable = UCase(Trim(CStr(cfgWs.range(CELL_ENABLE).value)))
    g_TimerEnabled = (vEnable = "TRUE" Or vEnable = "是" Or vEnable = "1" Or vEnable = "-1")

    g_AutoSaveMinute = ReadConfigNum(cfgWs.range(CELL_SAVE_INTERVAL), 5, 1)
    g_AutoBackupMinute = ReadConfigNum(cfgWs.range(CELL_BACKUP_INTERVAL), 10, 1)
    g_MinBackupGap = ReadConfigNum(cfgWs.range(CELL_MIN_BACKUP_GAP), 5, 1)
    g_HeartbeatSec = ReadConfigNum(cfgWs.range(CELL_HEARTBEAT_SEC), 30, 10)

    g_BackupPath = Trim(CStr(cfgWs.range(CELL_BACKUP_PATH).value))
    If g_BackupPath = "" Then g_BackupPath = Environ$("USERPROFILE") & "\Documents\自动备份\"
    If Right(g_BackupPath, 1) <> "\" Then g_BackupPath = g_BackupPath & "\"

    ' 保留份数：0 或空 = 不清理（保留全部历史备份）；N = 每个文件仅保留最新 N 份
    g_BackupKeep = ReadConfigNum(cfgWs.range(CELL_BACKUP_KEEP), 0, 0)

    Call ResetTimerNow
End Sub

'【读取配置数值】
Private Function ReadConfigNum(rng As range, defaultVal As Long, minVal As Long) As Long
    ReadConfigNum = defaultVal
    If rng Is Nothing Then Exit Function
    If IsNumeric(rng.value) Then
        ReadConfigNum = CLng(rng.value)
        If ReadConfigNum < minVal Then ReadConfigNum = defaultVal
    End If
End Function

'【重置计时】
Public Sub ResetTimerNow()
    g_NextAutoSave = Now + TimeSerial(0, g_AutoSaveMinute, 0)
    g_NextAutoBackup = Now + TimeSerial(0, g_AutoBackupMinute, 0)
    If g_LastBackupTime = 0 Then g_LastBackupTime = Now - TimeSerial(0, g_MinBackupGap + 1, 0)
End Sub

'【启动定时器】停止旧定时器 -> 重载配置 -> 启动 API 定时器
Public Sub StartBackupTimer()
    Call StopBackupTimer
    g_IsShuttingDown = False
    g_InTimer = False

    Call ReloadAllConfig
    g_LastHeartbeat = Now

    Dim ms As Long
    ms = g_HeartbeatSec * 1000
    If ms < 1000 Then ms = 30000          ' 兜底：最小 1 秒，默认 30 秒

    ' ★ 启动 API 定时器（hWnd=NULL，返回值是真正的定时器 ID，必须保存以便 KillTimer）
    g_TimerHandle = SetTimer(0&, TIMER_ID, ms, AddressOf TimerProc)

    ' 打开后立即备份（仅当开关已开启）
    If g_TimerEnabled Then Call PerformAutoBackup(True)
End Sub

'【停止定时器】销毁 API 定时器
Public Sub StopBackupTimer()
    g_IsShuttingDown = True
    g_TimerEnabled = False
    On Error Resume Next
    If g_TimerHandle <> 0 Then
        ' ★ v2 关键修复：hWnd=NULL 时必须用 SetTimer 的返回值 g_TimerHandle 来 KillTimer，
        '    不能用常量 TIMER_ID（那个值被系统忽略，会导致定时器杀不掉、越堆越多）。
        KillTimer 0&, g_TimerHandle
        g_TimerHandle = 0
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

'【统一停止所有定时器】关闭时调用（保留旧名，供 ThisWorkbook / Auto_Close 调用）
Public Sub StopAllTimers()
    Call StopBackupTimer
End Sub

' ★ 核心：API 定时器回调
'   作为系统回调，内部绝对不能抛出未处理错误，否则会导致 Excel 崩溃。
'   整体用 On Error Resume Next 包裹，并加重入锁防止保存/备份期间被再次触发。
Public Sub TimerProc(ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal uMsg As Long, _
                     ByVal nIDEvent As LongPtr, ByVal dwTime As Long)
    On Error Resume Next

    ' 正在关闭 -> 立即退出
    If g_IsShuttingDown Then Exit Sub
    ' ★ v2 重入保护：上一次任务还没跑完就不再进入，避免重入 SaveCopyAs 崩溃
    If g_InTimer Then Exit Sub
    ' ★ Excel 忙（编辑单元格 / 弹窗 / 拖拽等）时跳过本次，等下一拍
    If Not Application.Ready Then Exit Sub

    g_InTimer = True

    g_LastHeartbeat = Now

    ' 开关未开启时定期尝试重载配置（解决 xlam 启动时宿主工作簿尚未打开的问题）
    If Not g_TimerEnabled Then Call ReloadAllConfig
    If g_TimerEnabled Then Call CheckTimerTasks

    g_InTimer = False
End Sub

'【核心时间校验】
Private Sub CheckTimerTasks()
    On Error GoTo CheckErr
    Dim curTime As Date
    curTime = Now

    If curTime >= g_NextAutoSave Then
        Call PerformAutoSave
        g_NextAutoSave = curTime + TimeSerial(0, g_AutoSaveMinute, 0)
    End If

    If curTime >= g_NextAutoBackup Then
        Call PerformAutoBackup(True)
        g_NextAutoBackup = curTime + TimeSerial(0, g_AutoBackupMinute, 0)
    End If
    Exit Sub
CheckErr:
End Sub

'【自动保存】遍历所有已打开工作簿逐个 Save
Private Sub PerformAutoSave()
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    For Each wb In Application.Workbooks
        If wb.path <> "" Then
            On Error Resume Next
            wb.Save
            err.Clear
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next wb
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

'【自动备份】遍历所有已打开工作簿 SaveCopyAs 到统一目录
Private Sub PerformAutoBackup(Optional ByVal skipGapCheck As Boolean = False)
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim folderPath As String, bakPath As String, rawName As String
    Dim backupCount As Long
    Dim diffMin As Long

    On Error GoTo BakErr

    If Not skipGapCheck Then
        diffMin = DateDiff("n", g_LastBackupTime, Now)
        If diffMin < g_MinBackupGap Then Exit Sub
    End If

    folderPath = g_BackupPath

    If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        MkDir folderPath
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            err.Clear
            Exit Sub
        End If
        On Error GoTo BakErr
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False

    For Each wb In Application.Workbooks
        If wb.path <> "" Then
            rawName = wb.NAME
            rawName = VBA.Strings.Replace(rawName, ".xlsm", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)
            rawName = VBA.Strings.Replace(rawName, ".xlsx", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)
            rawName = VBA.Strings.Replace(rawName, ".xls", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)
            bakPath = folderPath & rawName & "_自动备份_" & Format(Now, "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss") & ".xlsm"

            On Error Resume Next
            wb.SaveCopyAs bakPath
            If err.Number = 0 Then backupCount = backupCount + 1
            err.Clear
            On Error GoTo BakErr
        End If
    Next wb

    g_LastBackupTime = Now

    If g_BackupKeep > 0 And backupCount > 0 Then Call CleanupBackupFolder

BakCleanup:
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Sub
BakErr:
    Resume BakCleanup
End Sub

'【手动备灾备份】将当前活动工作簿备份到配置的备灾路径
Public Sub DisasterBackup()
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim cfgWs As Worksheet
    Dim netDir As String, savePath As String, rawName As String
    Dim wbHost As Workbook

    Set wb = ActiveWorkbook
    If wb Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "没有活动工作簿", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If wb.path = "" Then
        MsgBox "文件未保存", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set wbHost = GetHostWorkbook()
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cfgWs = wbHost.Worksheets(SET_SHEET_NAME)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "缺少【" & SET_SHEET_NAME & "】工作表", vbCritical
        err.Clear
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo DisErr

    netDir = Trim(cfgWs.range(CELL_DISASTER_PATH).value)
    If netDir = "" Then
        MsgBox "请填写备灾路径", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If Right(netDir, 1) <> "\" Then netDir = netDir & "\"

    rawName = wb.NAME
    rawName = VBA.Strings.Replace(rawName, ".xlsm", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)
    rawName = VBA.Strings.Replace(rawName, ".xlsx", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)
    rawName = VBA.Strings.Replace(rawName, ".xls", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)
    savePath = netDir & rawName & "备灾" & Format(Now, "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss") & ".xlsm"

    If Dir(netDir, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        MsgBox "路径不可访问：" & netDir, vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    wb.SaveCopyAs savePath
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    MsgBox "备灾完成", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
DisErr:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "备灾失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
End Sub

'【备份目录清理】每个名称只保留最新 N 份（N = 保留份数 B23；0/空 = 不清理）
Public Sub CleanupBackupFolder()
    If g_BackupKeep <= 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim folderPath As String
    folderPath = g_BackupPath
    If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then Exit Sub

    On Error GoTo CleanErr

    Dim dict As Object
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim fileName As String
    Dim baseName As String, pos As Long

    fileName = Dir(folderPath & "*.xlsm")
    Do While fileName <> ""
        pos = InStr(1, fileName, "_自动备份_", vbTextCompare)
        If pos > 0 Then
            baseName = Left(fileName, pos + Len("_自动备份") - 1)
            If Not dict.exists(baseName) Then dict.Add baseName, New Collection
            dict(baseName).Add folderPath & fileName
        End If
        fileName = Dir()
    Loop

    If dict.count = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim key As Variant, col As Collection
    Dim files() As String, dates() As Date
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, n As Long

    For Each key In dict.Keys
        Set col = dict(key)
        n = col.count
        If n > g_BackupKeep Then
            ReDim files(1 To n)
            ReDim dates(1 To n)
            For i = 1 To n
                files(i) = col(i)
                dates(i) = ExtractBackupDate(files(i))
            Next i
            Dim tmpFile As String, tmpDate As Date
            For i = 1 To n - 1
                For j = i + 1 To n
                    If dates(i) < dates(j) Then
                        tmpDate = dates(i): dates(i) = dates(j): dates(j) = tmpDate
                        tmpFile = files(i): files(i) = files(j): files(j) = tmpFile
                    End If
                Next j
            Next i
            For i = g_BackupKeep + 1 To n
                On Error Resume Next
                Kill files(i)
                err.Clear
                On Error GoTo CleanErr
            Next i
        End If
    Next key

    Set dict = Nothing
    Exit Sub
CleanErr:
End Sub

'【提取备份时间戳】
Private Function ExtractBackupDate(ByVal filePath As String) As Date
    Dim fName As String, pos As Long, ts As String
    Dim y As Long, m As Long, d As Long
    Dim hh As Long, mm As Long, ss As Long

    fName = Mid(filePath, InStrRev(filePath, "\") + 1)
    pos = InStr(1, fName, "_自动备份_", vbTextCompare)
    If pos = 0 Then Exit Function

    ts = Mid(fName, pos + Len("_自动备份_"))
    ts = VBA.Strings.Replace(ts, ".xlsm", "", Compare:=vbTextCompare)

    If Len(ts) >= 15 Then
        y = CLng(Mid(ts, 1, 4))
        m = CLng(Mid(ts, 5, 2))
        d = CLng(Mid(ts, 7, 2))
        hh = CLng(Mid(ts, 10, 2))
        mm = CLng(Mid(ts, 12, 2))
        ss = CLng(Mid(ts, 14, 2))
        ExtractBackupDate = DateSerial(y, m, d) + TimeSerial(hh, mm, ss)
    End If
End Function

Sub RefreshTheCurrentDocumentReferenceLibrary()
    Dim oWK As Worksheet
    Set oWK = ActiveSheet
    oWK.Cells.Clear
    arr = VBA.Array("引用的名称", "引用的路径", "GUID", "Major", "Minor", "说明")
    iCol = UBound(arr) + 1
    oWK.range("a1").Resize(1, iCol) = arr
    Dim oRef As Reference
    With oWK

        '遍历所有的引用
        For Each oRef In ThisWorkbook.VBProject.References
            With oRef
                oWK.Cells(i, 1) = .NAME
                oWK.Cells(i, 2) = .fullPath
                oWK.Cells(i, 3) = .GUID
                oWK.Cells(i, 4) = .Major
                oWK.Cells(i, 5) = .Minor
                oWK.Cells(i, 6) = .Description
                i = i + 1
            End With
        Next
    End With

'根据表格清单批量恢复引用库
Sub BatchRestoreReferenceLibraries()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, r As Long
    Dim refName As String, refPath As String, refGUID As String
    Dim refMajor As Long, refMinor As Long
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row
    
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        MsgBox "当前工作表无引用清单数据，请先运行【遍历所有已使用的引用】导出清单", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    For r = 2 To lastRow
        refName = Trim(ws.Cells(r, 1).value)
        refPath = Trim(ws.Cells(r, 2).value)
        refGUID = Trim(ws.Cells(r, 3).value)
        refMajor = CLng(ws.Cells(r, 4).value)
        refMinor = CLng(ws.Cells(r, 5).value)
        
        If refName <> "" Then
            If Not RefIsExist(refName) Then
                On Error GoTo AddByPath
                ThisWorkbook.VBProject.References.AddFromGuid _
                    GUID:=refGUID, Major:=refMajor, Minor:=refMinor
                Debug.Print "成功添加(GUID): " & refName

Application.MacroOptions _
    Macro:=funcName, _
    Description:=fullDesc, _
    HelpFile:=HELP_FILE_EMPTY, _
    category:=CUSTOM_FUNC_CATEGORY, _
    ArgumentDescriptions:=argArr

Application.MacroOptions _
    Macro:=funcName, _
    Description:=fullDesc, _
    HelpFile:=HELP_FILE_EMPTY, _
    category:=CUSTOM_FUNC_CATEGORY
        End If

' 无Replace的XML转义函数
' 作用：将 & < > 等特殊字符转义为XML实体，避免破坏XML结构
Private Function EscapeXml(ByVal Text As String) As String
    If Text = "" Then
        EscapeXml = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim result As String
    result = Text
    Dim temp As String
    Dim k As Integer
    '转义 &
    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = "&" Then
            temp = temp & "&"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp
    '转义 <
    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = "<" Then
            temp = temp & "<"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp
    '转义 >
    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = ">" Then
            temp = temp & ">"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp
    EscapeXml = result
End Function

' ★★★ 点击按钮应用自定义数字格式 — v4 最终版 ★★★
'   处理步骤：
'   Step1 NormalizeGeneralToken：把 G/通用格式 / g/通用格式 替换为 General
'         （G/通用格式 是中文Excel的显示名，不是VBA NumberFormat的合法值）
'   Step2 ProcessBracketTags：
'         - 去掉 \[ 前导反斜杠（\[蓝色] → [蓝色]，否则Excel当字面文本）
'         - 把中括号内的中文颜色名转为英文（[蓝色] → [Blue]）
'         - 纯颜色段追加 General（[Blue] → [Blue]General）
'         - 非颜色标签原样保留（[DBNum1]、[$-804]、[>0] 等不动）
'   Step3 多重兜底应用：转换后 → 去色版 → General
'   全程不用 Replace
Public Sub ApplyCellFormatByID(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim fmtID As String, fmtArr As Variant
    Dim rawFmt As String, finalFmt As String
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请先选中单元格区域！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    fmtID = Trim(control.Tag)
    If g_CellFormatDict Is Nothing Then
        Call RefreshCellFormatLibrary
    End If
    If Not g_CellFormatDict.exists(fmtID) Then
        Call RefreshCellFormatLibrary
        If Not g_CellFormatDict.exists(fmtID) Then
            MsgBox "未匹配到该格式配置", vbCritical
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
    fmtArr = g_CellFormatDict(fmtID)
    rawFmt = fmtArr(0)
    finalFmt = rawFmt
    '===== Step1: G/通用格式 → General =====
    finalFmt = NormalizeGeneralToken(finalFmt)
    '===== Step2: 中括号标签全处理（去反斜杠 + 中文色名→英文 + 纯颜色段补General） =====
    finalFmt = ProcessBracketTags(finalFmt)
    '===== Step3: 多重兜底应用 =====
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    On Error Resume Next
    ' 优先方案：使用转换后的代码
    Selection.NumberFormat = finalFmt
    ' 备选方案1：如果上面失败，去掉所有 [Color] 标签，只保留数字占位符
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        Selection.NumberFormat = StripAllColorTags(finalFmt)
    End If
 
    ' 备选方案2：如果还是失败，直接用 General
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        Selection.NumberFormat = "General"
    End If
 
    ' 如果最终仍然失败，弹错提示
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        Selection.NumberFormat = "General"
        MsgBox "格式代码不兼容，已恢复为通用格式" & vbCrLf & _
               "原始代码：" & rawFmt & vbCrLf & _
               "转换后代码：" & finalFmt, vbExclamation
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    Selection.WrapText = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
'    Application.StatusBar = "已应用格式：" & control.Caption
End Sub
 
' ★ Step1 辅助：NormalizeGeneralToken
'   扫描格式字符串，把 G/通用格式 或 g/通用格式 替换为 General
'   跳过双引号内的内容（引号内是字面文本，不应被替换）
'   原因：G/通用格式 是中文Excel格式对话框的显示名，
'         不是 VBA NumberFormat 的合法值；
'         Excel 会把 G/通用格式 逐字解析为字面文本 g-"通""用""格""式"
Private Function NormalizeGeneralToken(ByVal fmt As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim token As String
    Dim tokenLen As Long
    Dim inQuotes As Boolean
    token = "G/通用格式"
    tokenLen = Len(token)   ' G / 通 用 格 式 = 6字符
    inQuotes = False
    result = ""
    i = 1
    Do While i <= Len(fmt)
        Dim ch As String
        ch = Mid(fmt, i, 1)
        ' 遇到双引号，切换引号状态
        If ch = "" Then
            inQuotes = Not inQuotes
            result = result & ch
            i = i + 1
        ' 仅在引号外做替换
        ElseIf Not inQuotes And i + tokenLen - 1 <= Len(fmt) Then
            Dim substr As String
            substr = Mid(fmt, i, tokenLen)
            ' 匹配 G/通用格式 或 g/通用格式（大小写不敏感）
            If substr = token Or substr = "g/通用格式" Then
                result = result & "General"
                i = i + tokenLen
            Else
                result = result & ch
                i = i + 1
            End If
        Else
            result = result & ch
            i = i + 1
        End If
    Loop
    NormalizeGeneralToken = result
End Function
 
' ★ Step2 辅助：ProcessBracketTags
'   综合处理所有中括号标签，按分号逐段处理：
'   1. 去掉 \[ 前导反斜杠（\[蓝色] → [蓝色]）
'   2. 判断纯颜色段 → 转英文色名 + 追加 General
'   3. 非纯颜色段 → 扫描段内所有 [xxx] 标签，色名转英文，非色名原样保留
Private Function ProcessBracketTags(ByVal fmt As String) As String
    Dim parts As Variant
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim seg As String
    parts = SplitBySemicolon(fmt)
    result = ""
    For i = LBound(parts) To UBound(parts)
        seg = TrimMy(parts(i))
        If i > LBound(parts) Then result = result & ";"
        If seg = "" Then
            ' 空段保持
        ElseIf IsPureColorSection(seg) Then
            ' ★ 纯颜色段：去掉 \[，提取颜色名，转英文，追加 General
            Dim colorName As String
            colorName = ExtractColorName(seg)
            colorName = ConvertChineseColorToEnglish(colorName)
            result = result & "[" & colorName & "]General"
        Else
            ' ★ 非纯颜色段：扫描段内所有 [xxx] 或 \[xxx] 标签
            '   颜色名 → 英文；非颜色名（DBNum1、$-804、>0 等）原样保留
            '   同时去掉 \[ 的反斜杠
            result = result & ConvertSegmentColors(seg)
        End If
    Next i
    ProcessBracketTags = result
End Function
 
' ★ 辅助：IsPureColorSection（v4版：加了 IsValidColorName 校验）
'   判断片段是否是「纯颜色段」（整段就是 \[颜色名] 或 [颜色名]）
'   排除：[DBNum1]、[$-804]、[>0]、[蓝色]0.00 等非纯颜色标签
Private Function IsPureColorSection(ByVal seg As String) As Boolean
    If seg = "" Then
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim inner As String
    ' 判断开头：\[ 或 [
    If Left(seg, 2) = "\[" Then
        inner = Mid(seg, 3)
    ElseIf Left(seg, 1) = "[" Then
        inner = Mid(seg, 2)
    Else
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
 
    ' 判断结尾：必须是 ]
    If Len(inner) = 0 Then
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Right(inner, 1) <> "]" Then
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
 
    ' 提取颜色名
    Dim colorName As String
    colorName = Left(inner, Len(inner) - 1)
    ' 颜色名内不应含 [ ] = > <（排除条件、组合标签）
    If InStr(colorName, "[") > 0 Or InStr(colorName, "]") > 0 Then
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    If InStr(colorName, "=") > 0 Or InStr(colorName, ">") > 0 Or InStr(colorName, "<") > 0 Then
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
 
    ' ★ v4新增：必须是合法的颜色名（排除 DBNum1、$-804、h、m、s 等）
    If Not IsValidColorName(colorName) Then
        IsPureColorSection = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    IsPureColorSection = True
End Function
 
' ★ 辅助：IsValidColorName
'   校验是否为 Excel NumberFormat 的合法颜色名
'   支持：中文8色、英文8色、调色板 颜色1~56 / Color1~56
'   排除：DBNum1、$-804、h、m、s、>=90 等
Private Function IsValidColorName(ByVal colorName As String) As Boolean
    ' 中文标准8色
    Select Case colorName
        Case "黑色", "蓝色", "青色", "绿色", "洋红", "红色", "白色", "黄色"
            IsValidColorName = True
            Exit Function
    End Select
 
    ' 英文标准8色（大小写不敏感）
    Dim lowerCN As String
    lowerCN = LCase$(colorName)
    Select Case lowerCN
        Case "black", "blue", "cyan", "green", "magenta", "red", "white", "yellow"
            IsValidColorName = True
            Exit Function
    End Select
 
    ' 中文调色板：颜色1 ~ 颜色56
    If Left(colorName, 2) = "颜色" And Len(colorName) >= 3 Then
        Dim numStr As String
        numStr = Mid(colorName, 3)
        If IsNumeric(numStr) Then
            Dim numVal As Long
            numVal = CLng(numStr)
            If numVal >= 1 And numVal <= 56 Then
                IsValidColorName = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    End If
 
    ' 英文调色板：Color1 ~ Color56（大小写不敏感）
    If Left(lowerCN, 5) = "color" And Len(lowerCN) >= 6 Then
        Dim numStr2 As String
        numStr2 = Mid(lowerCN, 6)
        If IsNumeric(numStr2) Then
            Dim numVal2 As Long
            numVal2 = CLng(numStr2)
            If numVal2 >= 1 And numVal2 <= 56 Then
                IsValidColorName = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    End If
 
    ' 以上都不匹配 → 不是合法颜色名
    IsValidColorName = False
End Function
 
' ★ 辅助：ExtractColorName
'   从纯颜色段 \[蓝色] 或 [蓝色] 中提取颜色名
Private Function ExtractColorName(ByVal seg As String) As String
    Dim inner As String
    If Left(seg, 2) = "\[" Then
        inner = Mid(seg, 3)
    ElseIf Left(seg, 1) = "[" Then
        inner = Mid(seg, 2)
    Else
        ExtractColorName = seg
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Right(inner, 1) = "]" Then
        ExtractColorName = Left(inner, Len(inner) - 1)
    Else
        ExtractColorName = inner
    End If
End Function
 
' ★ 辅助：ConvertChineseColorToEnglish
'   把中文颜色名转换为英文（NumberFormat 只认英文色名）
'   黑色→Black  蓝色→Blue  青色→Cyan  绿色→Green
'   洋红→Magenta 红色→Red  白色→White  黄色→Yellow
'   颜色N→ColorN  非中文色名原样返回
Private Function ConvertChineseColorToEnglish(ByVal colorName As String) As String
    Select Case colorName
        Case "黑色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Black"
        Case "蓝色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Blue"
        Case "青色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Cyan"
        Case "绿色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Green"
        Case "洋红":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Magenta"
        Case "红色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Red"
        Case "白色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "White"
        Case "黄色":  ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Yellow"
        Case Else
            ' 颜色N → ColorN
            If Left(colorName, 2) = "颜色" And Len(colorName) >= 3 Then
                ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = "Color" & Mid(colorName, 3)
            Else
                ' 已经是英文色名或其他内容 → 原样返回
                ConvertChineseColorToEnglish = colorName
            End If
    End Select
End Function
 
' ★ 辅助：ConvertSegmentColors
'   扫描段内所有 [xxx] 或 \[xxx] 标签：
'   - 如果 xxx 是合法颜色名 → 去掉 \[ 前导反斜杠 + 转英文色名
'   - 如果 xxx 不是颜色名（如 DBNum1、$-804、>0、h）→ 去掉 \[ 反斜杠，内容原样保留
'   - 双引号内的 [xxx] 不处理（是字面文本）
Private Function ConvertSegmentColors(ByVal seg As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim inBracket As Boolean
    Dim inQuotes As Boolean
    Dim bracketContent As String
    Dim skipBackslash As Boolean
    result = ""
    i = 1
    inBracket = False
    inQuotes = False
    bracketContent = ""
    skipBackslash = False
    Do While i <= Len(seg)
        Dim ch As String
        ch = Mid(seg, i, 1)
        ' 双引号切换状态
        If ch = "" Then
            inQuotes = Not inQuotes
            result = result & ch
            i = i + 1
        ' 引号内：原样输出，不做任何转换
        ElseIf inQuotes Then
            result = result & ch
            i = i + 1
        ' 引号外：处理 \[ → [（去掉反斜杠）
        ElseIf ch = "\" And i + 1 <= Len(seg) And Mid(seg, i + 1, 1) = "[" Then
            skipBackslash = True
            i = i + 1  ' 跳过 \，下轮处理 [
        ' 引号外：处理 [ → 开始收集括号内容
        ElseIf ch = "[" And Not inBracket Then
            inBracket = True
            bracketContent = ""
            i = i + 1
        ' 引号外：处理 ] → 结束括号，判断内容是否为颜色名
        ElseIf ch = "]" And inBracket Then
            inBracket = False
            ' 判断 bracketContent 是否为合法颜色名
            If IsValidColorName(bracketContent) Then
                ' 颜色名 → 转英文
                result = result & "[" & ConvertChineseColorToEnglish(bracketContent) & "]"
            Else
                ' 非颜色名（DBNum1、$-804、>0、h 等）→ 原样保留
                result = result & "[" & bracketContent & "]"
            End If
            bracketContent = ""
            i = i + 1
        ' 在括号内：收集内容
        ElseIf inBracket Then
            bracketContent = bracketContent & ch
            i = i + 1
        ' 引号外、括号外：原样输出
        Else
            result = result & ch
            i = i + 1
        End If
    Loop
    ConvertSegmentColors = result
End Function
 
' 辅助：按分号拆分（不依赖 Split 的全角/特殊字符问题）
Private Function SplitBySemicolon(ByVal s As String) As Variant
    Dim arr() As String
    Dim charIdx As Long, buf As String, cnt As Long
    buf = ""
    cnt = 0
    ReDim arr(0 To cnt)
    For charIdx = 1 To Len(s)
        Dim c As String
        c = Mid(s, charIdx, 1)
        If c = ";" Then
            arr(cnt) = buf
            cnt = cnt + 1
            ReDim Preserve arr(0 To cnt)
            buf = ""
        Else
            buf = buf & c
        End If
    Next charIdx
    arr(cnt) = buf
    SplitBySemicolon = arr
End Function
 
' 辅助：StripAllColorTags（兜底方案）
'   去掉格式中所有 [Color] 标签，只保留数字占位符
Private Function StripAllColorTags(ByVal fmt As String) As String
    Dim parts As Variant
    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim seg As String
    Dim buf As String
    Dim k As Long
    Dim ch As String
    Dim inBracket As Boolean
    parts = SplitBySemicolon(fmt)
    result = ""
    For i = LBound(parts) To UBound(parts)
        seg = parts(i)
        buf = ""
        inBracket = False
        For k = 1 To Len(seg)
            ch = Mid(seg, k, 1)
            If ch = "\" And k + 1 <= Len(seg) And Mid(seg, k + 1, 1) = "[" Then
                ' 跳过 \[ 组合
            ElseIf ch = "[" Then
                inBracket = True
            ElseIf ch = "]" And inBracket Then
                inBracket = False
            ElseIf Not inBracket Then
                buf = buf & ch
            End If
        Next k
        If i > LBound(parts) Then result = result & ";"
        result = result & TrimMy(buf)
    Next i
    StripAllColorTags = result
End Function
 
' 辅助：去除字符串首尾的空格和制表符（不用 Replace）
Private Function TrimMy(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim startPos As Long, endPos As Long
    Dim k As Long
    Dim ch As String
    startPos = 1
    endPos = Len(s)
    For k = 1 To Len(s)
        ch = Mid(s, k, 1)
        If ch <> " " And ch <> Chr(9) Then
            startPos = k
            Exit For
        End If
    Next k
    For k = Len(s) To 1 Step -1
        ch = Mid(s, k, 1)
        If ch <> " " And ch <> Chr(9) Then
            endPos = k
            Exit For
        End If
    Next k
    If startPos > endPos Then
        TrimMy = ""
    Else
        TrimMy = Mid(s, startPos, endPos - startPos + 1)
    End If
End Function

Public Sub GetFormulaMenuContent(control As IRibbonControl, ByRef content)

        xml = xml & "</menu>"
        content = xml
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 使用Scripting.Dictionary代替Collection
    Set categories = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row

    ' 收集不重复分类
    If lastRow > 1 Then
        For i = 2 To lastRow
            currCat = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 3).value & "")
            If Len(currCat) > 0 Then
                ' 使用Dictionary避免重复
                If Not categories.exists(currCat) Then
                    categories.Add currCat, currCat
                End If
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    ' 构建XML
    xml = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">"

    If categories.count > 0 Then
        For Each category In categories.Keys
            ' 最安全的ID生成方式 - 手动处理
            Dim safeID As String
            safeID = ""
            Dim j As Integer
            Dim ch As String

            ' 手动构建ID，完全避开Replace函数
            For j = 1 To Len(category)
                ch = Mid(category, j, 1)
                If ch = " " Then
                    ' 空格转为下划线
                    safeID = safeID & "_"
                Else
                    safeID = safeID & ch
                End If
            Next j

            ' 确保ID不为空
            If safeID = "" Then safeID = "Default"

            ' 添加分类菜单
            xml = xml & "<menu id=""menuCat" & safeID & """ imageMso=""AlignJustify"" label=""" & category & """>"

            ' 添加该分类下的功能按钮
            For i = 2 To lastRow
                If Trim(ws.Cells(i, 3).value & "") = category Then
                    Dim menuName As String
                    Dim procName As String

                    menuName = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 1).value & "")
                    procName = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value & "")

                    If menuName = "" Then menuName = "未命名"
                    If procName = "" Then procName = "未指定"

                    xml = xml & "<button "
                    xml = xml & "id=""btn" & i & "_" & safeID & """ "
                    xml = xml & "label=""" & Left(menuName, 30) & """ "
                    xml = xml & "tag=""" & procName & """ "
                    xml = xml & "onAction=""ExecuteDynamicProcedure"" "
                    xml = xml & "getScreentip=""GetFormulaScreentip_KJGN"" "
                    xml = xml & "imageMso=""PersonaStatusOffline""/>"
                End If
            Next i

            xml = xml & "</menu>"
        Next category

        xml = xml & "<menuSeparator id=""sep1""/>"
    Else
        xml = xml & "<button id=""btnAddData"" label=""请先在功能列表添加数据"" onAction=""GNGList""/>"
        xml = xml & "<menuSeparator id=""sep1""/>"
    End If

    xml = xml & "<button id=""btnManage"" tag=""功能管理"" label=""功能管理"" onAction=""FunctionManagement"" visible=""" & ManageButtonVisibility & """ image=""GL001"" />"
    xml = xml & "</menu>"
    content = xml

    Set categories = Nothing
    Set ws = Nothing
End Sub

'提示函数：鼠标悬停时显示过程名称和详细提示
Public Sub GetFormulaScreentip_KJGN(control As IRibbonControl, ByRef screentip)
    Dim procedureName As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim tipContent As String ' 存储第4列的提示内容

    procedureName = Trim(control.Tag) ' tag中存储的是过程名称
    If procedureName = "" Then
        screentip = "此过程无功能提示"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 查找对应的提示内容（第4列）
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("功能列表")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        screentip = "未找到【功能列表】表"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    tipContent = ""
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row
    
    ' 查找对应的行：通过B列（过程名称）匹配，然后获取第4列（提示内容）
    For i = 1 To lastRow
        If Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value) = procedureName Then ' B列匹配过程名
            tipContent = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value) & "：" & Trim(ws.Cells(i, 4).value) ' 获取第4列的内容
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    ' 设置提示文本：只显示第4列的内容
    If tipContent <> "" Then
        screentip = "" & tipContent
    Else
        screentip = "无相关提示内容"
    End If
End Sub

'执行函数：调用B列对应的过程
Public Sub ExecuteDynamicProcedure(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim procedureName As String
    Dim errMsg As String
    
    ' 直接从tag中获取过程名称
    procedureName = Trim(control.Tag)
    If procedureName = "" Then
        MsgBox "未指定过程名称", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 尝试执行过程 - 不传递参数
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Application.Run procedureName
    Exit Sub
    
ErrorHandler:
    If err.Number = 1004 Then ' 找不到过程
        errMsg = "找不到过程: '" & procedureName & "'" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                 "可能原因:" & vbCrLf & _
                 "1. 过程名称拼写错误" & vbCrLf & _
                 "2. 过程不是Public的" & vbCrLf & _
                 "3. 过程不存在于当前工作簿" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
                 "请在VBA编辑器中检查是否存在名为 '" & procedureName & "' 的过程"
    ElseIf err.Number = 450 Then ' 参数错误
        ' 尝试执行无参数版本
        On Error Resume Next
        Application.Run procedureName
        If err.Number = 0 Then
            Exit Sub
        End If
        errMsg = "执行过程失败: " & procedureName & vbCrLf & _
                 "错误号: " & err.Number & vbCrLf & _
                 "错误描述: " & err.Description & vbCrLf & _
                 "该过程可能需要特定参数"
    Else
        errMsg = "执行过程失败: " & procedureName & vbCrLf & _
                 "错误号: " & err.Number & vbCrLf & _
                 "错误描述: " & err.Description
    End If
    
    MsgBox errMsg, vbCritical, "执行错误"
End Sub

Public Sub GetBuiltInMenuContent(control As IRibbonControl, ByRef content)
    Dim xml As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim categories As Object
    Dim category As Variant
    Dim currCat As String
    Dim catIndex As Integer

    ' 第一步：获取工作表
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("内置功能")
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.count))
        ws.NAME = "内置功能"
        ws.range("A1:D1").value = Array("idMso/control标签", "分组", "提示", "显示名称")
        ws.range("A2").value = "<control idMso=""NameManager"" label=""名称管理"" />"
        ws.range("B2").value = "公式工具"
        ws.range("C2").value = "管理工作簿中的命名区域"
        ws.range("D2").value = ""

        xml = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">"
        xml = xml & "<button id=""btnRefresh"" label=""请配置功能"" onAction=""MSF_OpenSheet"" imageMso=""Table""/>"
        xml = xml & "</menu>"
        content = xml
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 第二步：收集分类
    Set categories = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row
    catIndex = 0

    If lastRow > 1 Then
        For i = 2 To lastRow
            currCat = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value & "")
            If Len(currCat) > 0 And Not categories.exists(currCat) Then
                categories.Add currCat, currCat
                catIndex = catIndex + 1
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    ' 第三步：拼接XML
    xml = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">"

    If categories.count > 0 Then
        catIndex = 0
        For Each category In categories.Keys
            catIndex = catIndex + 1
            Dim safeCatID As String: safeCatID = "Cat_" & catIndex

            ' 【修复】将category转换为字符串
            Dim catName As String
            catName = CStr(category)

            ' 拼接分类菜单
            xml = xml & "<menu id=""menu" & safeCatID & """ imageMso=""AlignJustify"" label=""" & XML_Encode(catName) & """>"

            ' 遍历该分类下的所有行
            For i = 2 To lastRow
                If Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value & "") = catName Then
                    Dim idMsoOrControl As String: idMsoOrControl = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 1).value & "")
                    Dim tipText As String: tipText = XML_Encode(Trim(ws.Cells(i, 3).value & ""))

                    If idMsoOrControl <> "" Then
                        ' 判断是否是control标签
                        If InStr(1, idMsoOrControl, "<control ", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                            xml = xml & idMsoOrControl
                        Else
                            ' 普通idMso按钮
                            Dim buttonLabel As String
                            If Trim(ws.Cells(i, 4).value & "") <> "" Then
                                buttonLabel = XML_Encode(Trim(ws.Cells(i, 4).value & ""))
                            Else
                                buttonLabel = idMsoOrControl
                            End If

                            xml = xml & "<button " & "id=""btn_" & i & "_" & catIndex & """ " & "label=""" & buttonLabel & """ " & "tag=""" & idMsoOrControl & """ " & "onAction=""MSF_ExecuteBuiltIn"" "

                            If Len(tipText) > 0 Then
                                xml = xml & "supertip=""" & tipText & """ "
                            End If

                            xml = xml & "imageMso=""" & idMsoOrControl & """ />"
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next i
            xml = xml & "</menu>"
        Next category
        xml = xml & "<menuSeparator id=""sep1""/>"
    Else
        xml = xml & "<button id=""btnAddData"" label=""请先在内置功能表添加数据"" onAction=""MSF_OpenSheet"" imageMso=""Table""/>"
        xml = xml & "<menuSeparator id=""sep1""/>"
    End If

    ' 添加管理按钮
    xml = xml & "<button id=""btnManageMSF"" label=""内置功能管理"" onAction=""MSF_OpenSheet"" visible=""" & ManageButtonVisibility & """ image=""GL001"" />"
    xml = xml & "</menu>"
    content = xml

    Set categories = Nothing
    Set ws = Nothing
    Exit Sub

ErrHandler:
    xml = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">"
    xml = xml & "<button id=""btnError"" label=""加载失败：" & XML_Encode(err.Description) & """ imageMso=""Warning""/>"
    xml = xml & "</menu>"
    content = xml
    Set categories = Nothing
    Set ws = Nothing
End Sub

' 辅助函数：转义XML特殊字符，完全避免Replace错误
Private Function XML_Encode(ByVal inputValue As Variant) As String
    Dim Str As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim ch As String
    Dim result As String

    ' 处理空值
    If IsNull(inputValue) Or IsEmpty(inputValue) Then
        XML_Encode = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 转换为字符串，并处理可能的错误
    On Error Resume Next
    Str = CStr(inputValue)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        XML_Encode = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' 如果字符串为空，直接返回
    If Len(Str) = 0 Then
        XML_Encode = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 【修复】手动遍历字符进行转义，完全避免使用Replace函数
    result = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(Str)
        ch = Mid(Str, i, 1)
        Select Case ch
        Case "&"
            result = result & "&"
        Case "<"
            result = result & "<"
        Case ">"
            result = result & ">"
        Case """"
            result = result & """
        Case "'"
            result = result & "'"
        Case Else
            result = result & ch
        End Select
    Next i

    XML_Encode = result
End Function

Public Sub MSF_ExecuteBuiltIn(control As IRibbonControl)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim idMso As String
    idMso = control.Tag

    '    Debug.Print "MSF_ExecuteBuiltIn: 执行 " & idMso
    If Len(idMso) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "未指定功能ID", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 尝试不同的执行方式，以支持各种类型控件
    Dim Success As Boolean
    Success = False
    
    ' 方式1：标准ExecuteMso方法（适用于大多数控件）
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.CommandBars.ExecuteMso idMso
    If err.Number = 0 Then
        Success = True
    Else
        err.Clear
        
        ' 方式2：特殊控件处理
        Select Case idMso
            ' MacroRecord特殊处理
            Case "MacroRecord"
                Application.OnKey "^r"
                Application.SendKeys "^r", True
                Success = True
            
            ' ControlsGallery特殊处理
            Case "ControlsGallery"
                ' 尝试打开开发工具选项卡
                Application.CommandBars.ExecuteMso "VisualBasic"
                Success = True
            
            ' 可以添加更多特殊控件处理
            Case Else
                ' 方式3：尝试通过CommandBars.FindControl查找并执行
                Dim ctl As CommandBarControl
                Set ctl = Application.CommandBars.FindControl(id:=idMso)
                If Not ctl Is Nothing Then
                    ctl.Execute
                    Success = True
                End If
        End Select
    End If
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    If Not Success Then
        ' 如果所有方式都失败，显示自定义错误信息
        MsgBox "执行功能失败：" & idMso & vbCrLf & _
               "此功能可能需要手动操作或不支持程序化执行", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Exit Sub

           "错误：" & err.Description, vbCritical
End Sub

            lineText = cm.lines(i, 1)

Sub UncommentCode()
    Dim cm As Object
    Dim selLine As Long, selCol As Long, selEndLine As Long, selEndCol As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim lineText As String
    Dim commentPos As Long
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cm = Application.VBE.ActiveCodePane.codeModule
    If cm Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    
    Application.VBE.ActiveCodePane.GetSelection selLine, selCol, selEndLine, selEndCol
    
    If selLine > 0 And selEndLine > 0 Then
        For i = selLine To selEndLine
            lineText = cm.lines(i, 1)

                If Trim(Left(lineText, commentPos - 1)) = "" Then
                    cm.ReplaceLine i, Mid(lineText, commentPos + 1)

Sub Remove_Comments()
    Dim oCodeMod As codeModule, procType As Long, Start_Line As Long, End_Line As Long
    Dim Process_Name As String, Cursor_Line As Long, Item As Long, Annotation_Position As Long, CodeRow As String
    Set oCodeMod = Application.VBE.ActiveCodePane.codeModule
    Application.VBE.ActiveCodePane.GetSelection Cursor_Line, 0, 0, 0
    Process_Name = oCodeMod.ProcOfLine(Cursor_Line, procType)
    If Process_Name <> "" Then
        Start_Line = oCodeMod.ProcStartLine(Process_Name, procType)
        End_Line = (Start_Line + oCodeMod.ProcCountLines(Process_Name, procType)) - 1
        For Item = End_Line To Start_Line Step -1
            CodeRow = oCodeMod.lines(Item, 1)
            If Len(Trim(CodeRow)) > 0 Then
                Annotation_Position = InStr(1, CodeRow, "'")
                If Annotation_Position > 0 Or InStr(1, CodeRow, "Rem") > 0 Then
                    If Annotation_Position = 1 Then CodeRow = "" Else CodeRow = Del_Comments(CodeRow)
                    If Left(Replace(CodeRow, " ", ""), 3) = "Rem" Then CodeRow = ""
                    oCodeMod.ReplaceLine Item, CodeRow
                End If
            End If
        Next
    End If
End Sub
Function Del_Comments(MyCode As String) As String
    Dim iCount As Long, Item As Long
    Del_Comments = MyCode
    For Item = 1 To Len(MyCode)
        If Mid(MyCode, Item, 1) = """" Then
            iCount = iCount + 1
        ElseIf Mid(MyCode, Item, 1) = "'" Then
            If iCount Mod 2 = 0 Then Del_Comments = Mid(MyCode, 1, Item - 1)
        End If
    Next
End Function

    Process_Name = oCodeMod.ProcOfLine(Cursor_Line, procType)
    If Process_Name <> "" Then
        Start_Line = oCodeMod.ProcStartLine(Process_Name, procType)
        End_Line = Start_Line + oCodeMod.ProcCountLines(Process_Name, procType) - 1
        bodyStart = oCodeMod.ProcBodyLine(Process_Name, procType)
        For Item = bodyStart To End_Line
            CodeRow = oCodeMod.lines(Item, 1)
            If Len(Trim(CodeRow)) > 0 Then
                Annotation_Position = InStr(1, CodeRow, "'")
                If Annotation_Position > 0 Or InStr(1, CodeRow, "Rem") > 0 Then
                    If Annotation_Position = 1 Then
                        CodeRow = ""
                    Else
                        CodeRow = Del_Comments(CodeRow)
                    End If
                    If Left(Replace(CodeRow, " ", ""), 3) = "Rem" Then CodeRow = ""
                    oCodeMod.ReplaceLine Item, CodeRow
                End If
            End If
        Next
    End If
    Call DLEvtModule
End Sub
'删除模块内部注释
Sub ClearAllModuleProcedureComments()
    Dim oCodeMod As codeModule
    Dim i As Long, lastLine As Long
    Dim procName As String, procType As Long
    Dim bodyStart As Long, bodyEnd As Long
    Dim Item As Long
    Dim CodeRow As String, Annotation_Position As Long
    Set oCodeMod = Application.VBE.ActiveCodePane.codeModule
    lastLine = oCodeMod.CountOfLines
    i = 1
    Do While i <= lastLine
        procName = oCodeMod.ProcOfLine(i, procType)
        If procName <> "" Then
            bodyStart = oCodeMod.ProcBodyLine(procName, procType)
            bodyEnd = oCodeMod.ProcStartLine(procName, procType) + oCodeMod.ProcCountLines(procName, procType) - 1
            For Item = bodyEnd To bodyStart Step -1
                CodeRow = oCodeMod.lines(Item, 1)
                If Trim(CodeRow) = "" Then GoTo NextLine
                Annotation_Position = InStr(1, CodeRow, "'")
                If Annotation_Position > 0 Or InStr(1, UCase(CodeRow), "REM") > 0 Then
                    If Annotation_Position = 1 Then
                        CodeRow = ""
                    Else
                        CodeRow = Del_Comments(CodeRow)
                    End If
                    If Trim(CodeRow) <> "" Then
                        If UCase(Left(Trim(CodeRow), 3)) = "REM" Then
                            CodeRow = ""
                        End If
                    End If
                    oCodeMod.ReplaceLine Item, CodeRow
                End If
            Next
NextLine:
            i = bodyEnd + 1
        Else
            i = i + 1
        End If
    Loop
    Call DLEvtModule
End Sub
'代码缩进 代码来源：http://www.mrexcel.com/forum/excel-questions/666280-problem-smart-indenter.html
Sub miApplyIndent()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Dim aCodePane As VBIDE.codePane
    Dim aLineNumber As Long, aStartColumn As Long, aEndColumn As Long
    Dim aLine As String, aIndentLevel As Integer, aLineIsAfterUnderscore As Boolean
    Dim aIncThisIndent As Boolean, aDecThisIndent As Boolean
    Dim aIncNextIndent As Boolean, aDecNextIndent As Boolean
    Set aCodePane = ActiveWorkbook.VBProject.VBE.ActiveCodePane
    For aLineNumber = 1 To ActiveWorkbook.VBProject.VBE.SelectedVBComponent.codeModule.CountOfLines
        aLine = aCodePane.codeModule.lines(aLineNumber, 1)
        Do Until Left(aLine, 1) <> " "
            aCodePane.codeModule.ReplaceLine aLineNumber, Mid(aLine, 2)
            aLine = aCodePane.codeModule.lines(aLineNumber, 1)
        Loop
    Next aLineNumber
    For aLineNumber = 1 To ActiveWorkbook.VBProject.VBE.SelectedVBComponent.codeModule.CountOfLines
        aLine = aCodePane.codeModule.lines(aLineNumber, 1)
        Select Case Left(aLine, IIf(InStr(aLine, " ") = 0, 999, InStr(aLine, " ") - 1))
        Case "Do", "For", "Private", "Select", "Sub", "While", "With", "Function"
            aIncNextIndent = True
        Case "If"
            If Right(aLine, 4) = "Then" Then aIncNextIndent = True
        Case "Loop", "Next", "End"
            aDecThisIndent = True
        Case "Case", "Else", "ElseIf"
            aDecThisIndent = True
            aIncNextIndent = True
        End Select
        If Right(aLine, 2) = " _" And Not aLineIsAfterUnderscore Then
            aIncNextIndent = True
            aLineIsAfterUnderscore = True
        ElseIf Right(aLine, 2) <> " _" And aLineIsAfterUnderscore Then
            aDecNextIndent = True
            aLineIsAfterUnderscore = False
        End If
        If aIncThisIndent Then aIndentLevel = aIndentLevel + 1: aIncThisIndent = False
        If aDecThisIndent Then aIndentLevel = aIndentLevel - 1: aDecThisIndent = False
        On Error GoTo lIndentError
        aCodePane.codeModule.ReplaceLine aLineNumber, Space$(aIndentLevel * 4) & aLine
        On Error GoTo 0
        If aIncNextIndent Then aIndentLevel = aIndentLevel + 1: aIncNextIndent = False
        If aDecNextIndent Then aIndentLevel = aIndentLevel - 1: aDecNextIndent = False
    Next aLineNumber
    Exit Sub
lIndentError:
    If aIndentLevel < 0 Then aIndentLevel = 0
    Resume Next
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

' 辅助过程：处理单个分类文件夹的导入逻辑
' fso：文件系统对象 | vbaProj：当前工作簿VBA工程 | folderPath：待处理文件夹路径
' ext：目标文件扩展名（bas/cls/frm） | isDocModule：是否为文档模块（True/False）
' successCount：成功导入计数器（按引用传递，累计计数）
Private Sub ImportSingleFolder(fso As Object, vbaProj As Object, folderPath As String, _
                               ext As String, isDocModule As Boolean, ByRef successCount As Integer)
    Dim sourceFolder As Object, currentFile As Object
    Dim fileExtension As String, moduleName As String

    Set sourceFolder = fso.GetFolder(folderPath)
    ' 遍历当前文件夹下所有文件
    For Each currentFile In sourceFolder.files
        fileExtension = LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(currentFile.path))
        ' 仅处理指定扩展名的文件
        If fileExtension = ext Then
            moduleName = fso.GetBaseName(currentFile.NAME)
            ' 区分：文档模块特殊处理 | 非文档模块标准导入
            If isDocModule Then
                Call ProcessDocModule(fso, vbaProj, currentFile.path, moduleName, successCount)
            Else
                Call ProcessNormalModule(vbaProj, currentFile.path, moduleName, successCount)
            End If
        End If
    Next currentFile

    Set sourceFolder = Nothing
    Set currentFile = Nothing
End Sub

' 子过程：处理【非文档模块】（标准模块/类模块/窗体）→ 删除同名后导入
Private Sub ProcessNormalModule(vbaProj As Object, filePath As String, moduleName As String, _
                                ByRef successCount As Integer)
    Dim existingComponent As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    ' 检查是否存在同名模块，存在则删除
    For Each existingComponent In vbaProj.VBComponents
        If existingComponent.NAME = moduleName Then
            vbaProj.VBComponents.Remove existingComponent
            Exit For
        End If
    Next existingComponent
    ' 导入新模块
    vbaProj.VBComponents.Import filePath
    ' 导入成功则计数器+1
    If err.Number = 0 Then
        successCount = successCount + 1
    Else
        MsgBox "导入模块 " & moduleName & " 时出错: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "导入错误"
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set existingComponent = Nothing
End Sub

' 子过程：处理【文档模块】（Sheet/ACTIVEWORKBOOK）→ 清空原有代码后写入纯业务代码
Private Sub ProcessDocModule(fso As Object, vbaProj As Object, filePath As String, moduleName As String, _
                             ByRef successCount As Integer)
    Dim fileContent As String, textStream As Object
    Dim targetComponent As Object, foundTarget As Boolean
    Dim codeStartPos As Long, moduleCode As String

    foundTarget = False
    ' 读取文档模块文件内容
    Set textStream = fso.OpenTextFile(filePath, 1)    ' 1=只读模式
    fileContent = textStream.ReadAll
    textStream.Close

    ' 查找工作簿中是否存在同名的文档模块（Sheet/ACTIVEWORKBOOK）
    For Each targetComponent In vbaProj.VBComponents
        If targetComponent.NAME = moduleName Then
            foundTarget = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next targetComponent

    ' 找到目标模块才执行后续操作
    If foundTarget Then
        ' 定位纯业务代码开始位置（跳过VBA系统属性定义）
        codeStartPos = InStr(fileContent, "Attribute VB_Exposed = True") + Len("Attribute VB_Exposed = True") + 1
        ' 确保定位到有效位置
        If codeStartPos > Len("Attribute VB_Exposed = True") + 1 Then
            ' 提取纯业务代码
            moduleCode = Mid(fileContent, codeStartPos)
            ' 代码非空则覆盖写入
            If Len(Trim(moduleCode)) > 0 Then
                On Error Resume Next
                ' 清空目标模块原有所有代码
                targetComponent.codeModule.DeleteLines 1, targetComponent.codeModule.CountOfLines
                ' 写入新的纯业务代码
                targetComponent.codeModule.AddFromString moduleCode
                If err.Number = 0 Then
                    successCount = successCount + 1
                Else
                    MsgBox "写入文档模块 " & moduleName & " 时出错: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "导入错误"
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        End If
    Else
        MsgBox "无法找到目标文档模块 " & moduleName & "，请确保工作簿中存在此模块。", vbExclamation, "导入警告"
    End If

    Set textStream = Nothing
    Set targetComponent = Nothing
End Sub

Option Explicit
Public Sub OpenModuleBySelectedCell()
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Dim selectedCell As range
    Dim targetName As String
    Dim vbProj As Object, vbComp As Object
    Dim sht As Object
    Dim codeName As String
    
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请先选中包含组件名称的单元格！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set selectedCell = Selection.Cells(1, 1)
    targetName = Trim(selectedCell.value)

    If targetName = "" Then
        MsgBox "选中的单元格为空，请输入有效的组件名称！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set vbProj = ThisWorkbook.VBProject
    Set vbComp = Nothing
    
    ' 先判断是否为工作表显示名，存在则直接切换工作表，不再打开VBA
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sht = ThisWorkbook.sheets(targetName)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    If Not sht Is Nothing Then
        sht.Activate
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 不是工作表，走原有VBA组件打开逻辑
    '第一步：优先按组件名直接查找（标准模块/类/窗体/ThisWorkbook/工作表代码名）
    On Error Resume Next
    Set vbComp = vbProj.VBComponents(targetName)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    '找不到，则遍历所有工作表，匹配显示名称，获取CodeName再查找组件
    If vbComp Is Nothing Then
        For Each sht In ThisWorkbook.sheets
            If sht.NAME = targetName Then
                codeName = sht.codeName
                On Error Resume Next
                Set vbComp = vbProj.VBComponents(codeName)
                On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
                Exit For
            End If
        Next sht
    End If

    If vbComp Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未找到【" & targetName & "】组件！" & vbCrLf & _
               "1. 若为工作表：确认表格标签名称无误" & vbCrLf & _
               "2. 若为模块/窗体：填写VBA工程内代码名称", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    '显示VBE并激活组件
    With Application.VBE.MainWindow
        .Visible = True
        .WindowState = 2 '最大化
    End With
    vbComp.Activate
    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    Select Case err.Number
    Case 70
        MsgBox "自动打开失败：权限不足！" & vbCrLf & _
               "1. 文件→选项→信任中心→信任中心设置→宏设置" & vbCrLf & _
               "2. 勾选「信任对VBA工程对象模型的访问」" & vbCrLf & _
               "3. 重启Excel后重试", vbCritical
    Case Else
        MsgBox "打开失败（错误码：" & err.Number & "）：" & err.Description & vbCrLf & _
               "手动打开：Alt+F11，在工程资源管理器查找", vbCritical
    End Select

'提取标准模块的所有过程
Sub ListAllStdModuleProcedures_Fast()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim vbp As Object
    Dim comp As Object
    Dim codeMod As Object
    Dim procName As String
    Dim lineStart As Long
    Dim lineText As String
    Dim seq As Long, iRow As Long
    Dim accessType As String
    Dim isRibbon As Boolean
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    Set vbp = ThisWorkbook.VBProject
    
    '表头 A1:E1 对应：序号,过程名称,访问级别,模块名称,功能区分组
    ws.range("A1:E1") = Array("序号", "过程名称", "级别", "父模块", "类型")
    ws.Rows(1).Font.Bold = True
    seq = 0
    iRow = 2
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    '遍历所有组件，只处理标准模块 Type=1
    For Each comp In vbp.VBComponents
        If comp.Type = 1 Then
            Set codeMod = comp.codeModule
            lineStart = codeMod.CountOfDeclarationLines + 1 '跳过声明区
            
            Do While lineStart <= codeMod.CountOfLines
                On Error Resume Next
                procName = codeMod.ProcOfLine(lineStart, 0)
                If err.Number <> 0 Then
                    err.Clear
                    lineStart = lineStart + 1
                    GoTo NextLine
                End If
                
                If procName = "" Then
                    lineStart = lineStart + 1
                    GoTo NextLine
                End If
                
                lineText = Trim(codeMod.lines(lineStart, 1))
                
                '判断 Public / Private
                If InStr(1, lineText, "Private", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                    accessType = "Private"
                Else
                    accessType = "Public"
                End If
                
                '判断功能区回调
                isRibbon = False
                Dim lowTxt As String
                lowTxt = LCase(lineText)
                If InStr(lowTxt, "getcustomui") > 0 _
                    Or InStr(lowTxt, "onaction") > 0 _
                    Or InStr(lowTxt, "_click") > 0 _
                    Or InStr(lowTxt, "ribbon") > 0 Then
                    isRibbon = True
                End If
                
                '写入 A~E 列
                seq = seq + 1
                ws.Cells(iRow, "A") = seq
                ws.Cells(iRow, "B") = procName
                ws.Cells(iRow, "C") = accessType
                ws.Cells(iRow, "D") = comp.NAME
                ws.Cells(iRow, "E") = IIf(isRibbon, "功能区回调", "普通过程")
                iRow = iRow + 1
                
                '直接跳到过程末尾，避免逐行卡死
                lineStart = lineStart + codeMod.ProcCountLines(procName, 0)
NextLine:
            Loop
        End If
    Next comp
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    
    MsgBox "完成！共提取 " & seq & " 个标准模块过程", vbInformation
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "A自定义函数"
' 入参：正整数-正整数（Excel列号，1~16384）
' 返回：列标字符串，异常入参返回空值并提示
' 功能：Excel数字列号转英文字母列标（1→A、26→Z、27→AA、53→BA）
Function IndexToCol(正整数 As Integer) As String
Attribute IndexToCol.VB_Description = "Excel数字列号转英文字母列标（1→A、26→Z、27→AA、53→BA）\r\n参数：正整数→字母序号（Excel列号：1~16384之间）"
Attribute IndexToCol.VB_ProcData.VB_Invoke_Func = " \n21"
    Dim col As String
    Dim ci As Integer, qi As Integer
    col = ""
    qi = 正整数

    ' 新增：入参校验（仅处理正整数，排除0/负数/非数字）
    If qi < 1 Or qi > 16384 Then
        MsgBox "请输入有效Excel列号（1~16384）！", vbExclamation, "入参错误"
        IndexToCol = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    While qi > 0
        ci = qi Mod 26
        If ci = 0 Then ci = 26    ' 26的模为0时，强制设为26（对应Z）
        col = Chr(ci + Asc("A") - 1) & col
        qi = (qi - ci) / 26
    Wend

    IndexToCol = col
End Function

' 入参：字母序号-列标字符串（如A/AA/XFD）
' 返回：列号数字，异常入参返回0并提示
' 功能：Excel列标转数字（A→1、Z→26、AA→27、BA→53）
Function ColToIndex(字母序号 As String) As Integer
Attribute ColToIndex.VB_Description = "Excel列标转数字（A→1、Z→26、AA→27、BA→53）\r\n字母序号→列标字符串（Excel列号：A~XFD之间）"
Attribute ColToIndex.VB_ProcData.VB_Invoke_Func = " \n21"
    Dim i As Integer, res As Integer
    res = 0
    字母序号 = UCase(字母序号)    ' 统一转为大写，兼容小写输入（如a/aa）

    ' 入参校验：仅保留A-Z的字母，排除其他字符
    For i = 1 To Len(字母序号)
        If Mid(字母序号, i, 1) < "A" Or Mid(字母序号, i, 1) > "Z" Then
            MsgBox "请输入有效列标（如A/AA/XFD）！", vbExclamation, "入参错误"
            ColToIndex = 0
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    For i = 1 To Len(字母序号)
        res = res * 26 + (Asc(Mid(字母序号, i, 1)) - Asc("A") + 1)
    Next i

    ' 校验是否超出Excel最大列号
    If res > 16384 Then
        MsgBox "列标超出Excel最大范围（最大为XFD=16384）！", vbExclamation
        res = 0
    End If

    ColToIndex = res
End Function
'数字转中文大写函数

Function NumToChar(Number As Double) As String
    Dim strNum As String
    Dim arrNum(), arrChar(), arrUnits(), arr()
    Dim k As Long, i As Long, temp As Double
    Dim posYuan As Long, posJiao As Long
    
    ' 数字汉字映射
    arrChar = Array("零", "壹", "贰", "叁", "肆", "伍", "陆", "柒", "捌", "玖")
    ' 单位顺序：分、角、元、拾、佰、仟、万、拾、佰、仟、亿、拾、佰、仟、兆、拾、佰、仟、京
    arrUnits = Array("分", "角", "元", "拾", "佰", "仟", "万", "拾", "佰", "仟", "亿", "拾", "佰", "仟", "兆", "拾", "佰", "仟", "京")
    
    temp = Abs(Round(Number, 2)) * 100
    strNum = CStr(temp)
    k = 0
    ReDim arr(0 To Len(strNum) - 1)
    
    For i = Len(strNum) To 1 Step -1
        Dim digitStr As String
        Dim digitNum As Long
        digitStr = Mid(strNum, i, 1)
        digitNum = CLng(digitStr)
        
        If digitNum = 0 Then
            ' 当前位为0，判断是否保留单位
            If InStr("元万亿兆", arrUnits(k)) > 0 Then
                arr(k) = arrUnits(k)
            Else
                arr(k) = "零"
            End If
        Else
            arr(k) = arrChar(digitNum) & arrUnits(k)
        End If
        k = k + 1
    Next i
    
    ' 反向拼接
    strNum = ""
    For i = UBound(arr) To LBound(arr) Step -1
        strNum = strNum & arr(i)
    Next i
    
    '  修复：先判断是否存在元/角，再截取，避免Left(,0)报错
    posYuan = InStr(strNum, "元")
    posJiao = InStr(strNum, "角")
    
    ' 整数无角分，加整
    If Round(Number, 0) = Number Then
        If posYuan > 0 Then
            strNum = Left(strNum, posYuan) & "整"
        Else
            strNum = strNum & "元整"
        End If
    ' 仅到角，无分，加整
    ElseIf Round(Number, 1) = Number Then
        If posJiao > 0 Then
            strNum = Left(strNum, posJiao) & "整"
        End If
    End If
    
    ' 连续零合并
    Do While InStr(strNum, "零零") > 0
        strNum = Replace(strNum, "零零", "零")
    Loop
    
    ' 清理多余零+单位
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "零兆", "兆")
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "零亿", "亿")
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "零万", "万")
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "零元", "元")
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "兆亿", "兆")
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "兆万", "兆")
    strNum = Replace(strNum, "亿万", "亿")
    
    ' 负数、零处理
    If Number < 0 Then
        strNum = "负" & strNum
    ElseIf Abs(Number) < 0.01 Then
        strNum = "零元整"
    End If
    
    NumToChar = strNum
End Function

Function CZ(查找值 As Variant, 查找值所在区域 As Variant, Optional 目标值所在列 As Variant, Optional 确认返回第几个目标值 As Variant = 1, Optional 模糊查找 As Integer = 0, Optional 区间 As Integer = 0)
'特别感谢萨克斯、Anytime帮助修改完成本函数
    Application.Volatile
    Dim arr, brr, Crr, drr, i As Long, p As Integer, q As Integer, r As Integer, ST As String
    If typeName(查找值所在区域) = "Range" Then
        Set 查找值所在区域 = Intersect(查找值所在区域, 查找值所在区域.Parent.usedRange)
    End If
    If typeName(目标值所在列) = "Range" Then
        Set 目标值所在列 = Intersect(目标值所在列, 目标值所在列.Parent.usedRange)
    End If
    arr = 查找值所在区域
    brr = 目标值所在列
    If UBound(arr) = 1 Then
        arr = Application.Transpose(arr)
        brr = Application.Transpose(brr)
    End If
    If 区间 <> 0 Then
        For i = 1 To UBound(arr)
            If IsNumeric(arr(i, 1)) Then If 查找值 < arr(i, 1) Then If 区间 < 0 Then 查找值 = arr(i - 1, 1): Exit For
            If IsNumeric(arr(i, 1)) Then If 查找值 < arr(i, 1) Then If 区间 > 0 Then 查找值 = arr(i, 1): Exit For
            If IsNumeric(arr(i, 1)) Then If 查找值 = arr(i, 1) Then 查找值 = arr(i, 1): Exit For
            If IsNumeric(arr(i, 1)) Then If 查找值 > WorksheetFunction.max(arr) Then 查找值 = WorksheetFunction.max(arr): Exit For
            If 查找值 = "" Then Exit For
        Next
    End If
    On Error Resume Next    '容错处理
    If Not (IsNumeric(确认返回第几个目标值)) Then 确认返回第几个目标值 = 确认返回第几个目标值(1)
    If 模糊查找 = 2 Then   '1：常规模糊查找，2：超级模糊查找
        ST = "*"
        For p = 1 To Len(查找值)
            ST = ST & Mid(查找值, p, 1) & "*"
        Next p
        查找值 = ST
    End If

    If 查找值 = "" Or 查找值 = "*" Then GoTo AA
    For i = 1 To UBound(arr)
        If IsNumeric(brr) Then
            If 模糊查找 = 2 Then If arr(i, 1) Like 查找值 Then CZ = CZ & arr(i, brr) & "龖"
            If 模糊查找 = 1 Then If InStr(arr(i, 1), 查找值) Then CZ = CZ & arr(i, brr) & "龖"
            If 模糊查找 < 1 Then If (arr(i, 1) = 查找值) Or (arr(i, 1) = "" & 查找值) Or ("" & arr(i, 1) = 查找值) Then CZ = CZ & arr(i, brr) & "龖"
        Else
            If 模糊查找 = 2 Then If arr(i, 1) Like 查找值 Then CZ = CZ & brr(i, 1) & "龖"
            If 模糊查找 = 1 Then If InStr(arr(i, 1), 查找值) Then CZ = CZ & brr(i, 1) & "龖"
            If 模糊查找 < 1 Then If (arr(i, 1) = 查找值) Or (arr(i, 1) = "" & 查找值) Or ("" & arr(i, 1) = 查找值) Then CZ = CZ & brr(i, 1) & "龖"
        End If
    Next
    Crr = Split(CZ, "龖")
    CZ = Replace(Left(CZ, Len(CZ) - 1), "龖", ",")
    If Abs(确认返回第几个目标值) > Abs(UBound(Crr)) Then 确认返回第几个目标值 = UBound(Crr) + 1
    If 确认返回第几个目标值 > 0 Then CZ = Crr(确认返回第几个目标值 - 1)
    If 确认返回第几个目标值 < 0 Then CZ = Crr(UBound(Crr) + 确认返回第几个目标值)

    If IsNumeric(CZ) And InStr(CZ, ",") = 0 Then CZ = Val(CZ)

AA:
End Function

'1.合并单元格求和=P_SUM_BY_HEBING(C2)，2.横向合并单元格求和=P_SUM_BY_HEBING(I5,,0)
Function P_SUM_BY_HEBING(ByVal sum_cell As range, Optional ByVal hebing_cell As range, Optional ByVal is_by_col As Integer = 1)
    Dim thisCell As range, new_area As range, first_cell As range, cells_count As Integer
    Dim sr As Long, sc As Long, fr As Long, fc As Long

    If Not hebing_cell Is Nothing Then
        Set thisCell = hebing_cell
    Else
        Set thisCell = Application.thisCell
    End If

    Set first_cell = thisCell.mergeArea.Cells(1, 1)
    sr = sum_cell.row
    sc = sum_cell.column
    fr = first_cell.row
    fc = first_cell.column

    If thisCell.MergeCells Then
        If is_by_col = 0 Then
            cells_count = thisCell.mergeArea.Columns.count - 1
            Set new_area = range(Cells(sr, fc), Cells(sr, fc + cells_count))
        Else
            cells_count = thisCell.mergeArea.Rows.count - 1
            Set new_area = range(Cells(fr, sc), Cells(fr + cells_count, sc))
        End If
        P_SUM_BY_HEBING = WorksheetFunction.sum(new_area)
    Else
        P_SUM_BY_HEBING = sum_cell
    End If
End Function
