' 验证内容是否符合工作表名称规则
Function IsValidSheetName(NAME As String) As Boolean
    Dim txt As String, i As Integer
    txt = Trim(NAME)
    Dim invalidChars As String: invalidChars = "\/?*[]:"
    
    ' 1. 非空校验
    If txt = "" Then
        MsgBox "工作表名称不能为空！", vbExclamation, "提示"
        IsValidSheetName = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 2. 长度校验
    If Len(txt) > 31 Then
        MsgBox "工作表名称不能超过31个字符！", vbExclamation, "提示"
        IsValidSheetName = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 3. 非法字符校验（逐个检查，100%拦截）
    For i = 1 To Len(invalidChars)
        If InStr(txt, Mid(invalidChars, i, 1)) > 0 Then
            MsgBox "工作表名称不能包含：\ / ? * [ ] :", vbExclamation, "提示"
            IsValidSheetName = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 4. 同名校验（可选，建议保留）
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(txt)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "工作表名称【" & txt & "】已存在！", vbExclamation, "提示"
        IsValidSheetName = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    IsValidSheetName = True
End Function
'提取第N个引号内的内容（从1开始）=GetQuotedString(A1, 1)
Function GetQuotedString(ByVal Text As String, ByVal Index As Integer) As String
    Dim regEx As Object
    Dim matches As Object
    
    Set regEx = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
    With regEx
        .Global = True
        .pattern = """([^""]*)"""
    End With
    
    Set matches = regEx.Execute(Text)
    
    If Index > 0 And Index <= matches.count Then
        GetQuotedString = matches(Index - 1).SubMatches(0)
    Else
        GetQuotedString = ""
    End If
End Function

'注意传入的参数必须和占位字符串个数一致，否则就会多出Error 448的内容
' 自定义顺序替换函数：传N个参数，只替换前N个占位，剩余占位保留
Public Function MultiReplace(ByVal tplText As String, ByVal placeholder As String, _
    Optional v1 As Variant = Empty, Optional v2 As Variant = Empty, Optional v3 As Variant = Empty, _
    Optional v4 As Variant = Empty, Optional v5 As Variant = Empty, Optional v6 As Variant = Empty, _
    Optional v7 As Variant = Empty, Optional v8 As Variant = Empty, Optional v9 As Variant = Empty, _
    Optional v10 As Variant = Empty) As String
Attribute MultiReplace.VB_Description = "说明：顺序替换占位字符串函数\r\n传N个参数，只替换前N个占位，剩余占位保留\r\n参数1：占位字符串或单个字符\r\n参数2~N：要依次替换的内容，可以是字符串、字符或空值（最多10个）"
Attribute MultiReplace.VB_ProcData.VB_Invoke_Func = " \n21"
    
    On Error GoTo ErrCatch
    Dim tagLen As Long
    Dim pos As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim arrVals As Variant
    Dim curText As String
    Dim replaceVal As String
    Dim validCount As Long
    
    curText = CStr(tplText)
    tagLen = Len(placeholder)
    MultiReplace = curText
    
    ' 占位符为空直接返回原文
    If tagLen = 0 Then Exit Function
    
    ' 把所有可选参数打包
    arrVals = Array(v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7, v8, v9, v10)
    
    ' 统计用户实际传入了多少个有效参数（跳过默认Empty）
    validCount = 0
    For i = LBound(arrVals) To UBound(arrVals)
        If Not IsEmpty(arrVals(i)) Then
            validCount = validCount + 1
        Else
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 没有传入任何替换参数，直接返回原文本
    If validCount = 0 Then Exit Function
    
    pos = 1
    ' 只循环【有效参数个数】次，有几个参数就处理几个占位
    For i = 1 To validCount
        replaceVal = CStr(arrVals(i - 1))
        pos = InStr(pos, curText, placeholder, vbBinaryCompare)
        ' 找不到更多占位就提前退出
        If pos = 0 Then Exit For
        
        ' 执行替换
        curText = Left$(curText, pos - 1) & replaceVal & Mid$(curText, pos + tagLen)
        ' 下一轮查找起点后移，防止重复匹配同一位置
        pos = pos + Len(replaceVal)
    Next i
    
    MultiReplace = curText
    Exit Function

ErrCatch:
    ' 出错只返回原始文本，不会输出错误字符
    MultiReplace = tplText
End Function

' XML转义函数（处理特殊字符）
Private Function EscapeXml(ByVal Text As String) As String
    If Text = "" Then
        EscapeXml = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim result As String
    result = Text

    Dim temp As String
    Dim k As Integer

    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = "&" Then
            temp = temp & "&"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp

    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = "<" Then
            temp = temp & "<"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp

    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = ">" Then
            temp = temp & ">"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp

    EscapeXml = result
End Function

'随机数据生成器中专用：点击事件：自定义随机填充按钮
Public Sub RandFill_Click(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim wsRand As Worksheet, colIndex As Integer, lastRow As Long
    Dim targetRng As range, arrData As Variant, cell As range, rndIndex As Long
    Dim defaultAddr As String
    Dim currentMode As Boolean

    ' 获取选择模式
    currentMode = GetSelectionMode()

    colIndex = Val(Right(control.id, Len(control.id) - InStr(control.id, "_")))
    If colIndex < 2 Then
        MsgBox "功能列配置异常！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 使用缓存的工作表
    Set wsRand = GetRandomWorksheet()

    If wsRand Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未找到「随机填充」表！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    lastRow = wsRand.Cells(wsRand.Rows.count, colIndex).End(xlUp).row
    If lastRow < 3 Then
        MsgBox "第" & colIndex & "列无填充数据（需从第3行开始配置）！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    arrData = wsRand.range(wsRand.Cells(4, colIndex), wsRand.Cells(lastRow, colIndex)).value

    If currentMode Then
        If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
            MsgBox "请先选中单元格区域！", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
        Set targetRng = Selection
    Else
        defaultAddr = IIf(TypeOf Selection Is range, Selection.Address, "")
        On Error Resume Next
        Set targetRng = Application.InputBox( _
                            Prompt:="请选择填充区域：", _
                            Title:="随机填充：" & wsRand.Cells(1, colIndex).value, _
                            Default:=defaultAddr, Type:=8)
        Call BeginCode
        On Error GoTo 0
        If targetRng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    End If

    Randomize
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    targetRng.ClearContents
    For Each cell In targetRng
        If cell.MergeCells And cell.Address <> cell.mergeArea.Cells(1).Address Then GoTo NextCell
        rndIndex = Int(Rnd * UBound(arrData)) + 1
        If cell.MergeCells Then
            cell.mergeArea.value = arrData(rndIndex, 1)
        Else
            cell.value = arrData(rndIndex, 1)
        End If
NextCell:
    Next cell
    Call EndCode

    Set wsRand = Nothing: Set targetRng = Nothing
End Sub

'无可选参数版本
Public Function RandomNumber(Optional ByVal dummy As Long = -9999) As Long
    Dim setWs As Worksheet
    Dim realMin As Long, realMax As Long
    
    'dummy=-9999代表不传参，读取单元格；传任意数字则报错提示使用自定义函数
    If dummy = -9999 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        Set setWs = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("插件设置")
        On Error GoTo 0
        realMin = IIf(IsNumeric(setWs.[B25]), CLng(setWs.[B25]), 1)
        realMax = IIf(IsNumeric(setWs.[B26]), CLng(setWs.[B26]), 100)
    Else
        MsgBox "如需自定义区间，请调用 RandomNumber_Custom(min,max)", vbExclamation
        RandomNumber = 0
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    If realMin > realMax Then
        Dim tmp As Long
        tmp = realMin: realMin = realMax: realMax = tmp
    End If
    
    Randomize Timer
    RandomNumber = Int((realMax - realMin + 1) * Rnd + realMin)
End Function

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    '选择标题区域
    If currentMode Then
        If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
            MsgBox "请先选中包含标题行的单元格区域！", vbExclamation
            GoTo RestoreApp
        End If
        Set targetHeaders = Selection
    Else
        defaultAddr = IIf(TypeOf Selection Is range, Selection.Address, "")
        On Error Resume Next
        Set targetHeaders = Application.InputBox( _
                                Prompt:="请选择包含标题行的单元格区域（一行）：", _
                                Title:="随机数据生成器 - 选择标题行", _
                                Default:=defaultAddr, Type:=8)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If targetHeaders Is Nothing Then GoTo RestoreApp
    End If

    If targetHeaders.Rows.count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "只能选择一行标题行！", vbExclamation
        GoTo RestoreApp
    End If

    '输入生成行数
    On Error Resume Next
    dataRows = Application.InputBox( _
                   Prompt:="请输入要生成的随机数据行数：", _
                   Title:="随机数据生成器 - 设置行数", _
                   Default:=10, Type:=1)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If dataRows <= 0 Then GoTo RestoreApp

    Set wsRand = GetRandomWorksheet()
    If wsRand Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未找到【随机填充】工作表！", vbExclamation
        GoTo RestoreApp
    End If

    Set dateColumns = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    dateColumns.Add "日期", True
    dateColumns.Add "Date", True
    dateColumns.Add "年月日", True

    Set outputRange = targetHeaders.Offset(1, 0).Resize(dataRows, targetHeaders.Columns.count)
    outputRange.ClearContents

    ReDim resultArr(1 To dataRows, 1 To targetHeaders.Columns.count)
    Randomize

    For i = 1 To targetHeaders.Columns.count
        Set headerCell = targetHeaders.Cells(1, i)
        headerValue = Trim(headerCell.value & "")
        If headerValue = "" Then GoTo NextColumn

        ReDim colArr(1 To dataRows)

        If InStr(headerValue, "姓名") > 0 Then
            For j = 1 To dataRows
                colArr(j) = GenerateRandomName()
            Next j
        ElseIf InStr(headerValue, "序号") > 0 Then
            For j = 1 To dataRows
                colArr(j) = j
            Next j
        ElseIf Right(headerValue, 1) = "额" Or Right(headerValue, 1) = "量" Then
            For j = 1 To dataRows
                colArr(j) = RandomNumber()
            Next j
        ElseIf dateColumns.exists(headerValue) Then
            For j = 1 To dataRows
                colArr(j) = RandomDate()
            Next j
        Else
            colIndex = 0
            For j = 2 To wsRand.Cells(1, wsRand.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).column
                If Trim(wsRand.Cells(1, j).value & "") = headerValue Then
                    colIndex = j
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next j
            If colIndex > 0 Then
                lastRow = wsRand.Cells(wsRand.Rows.count, colIndex).End(xlUp).row
                If lastRow >= 4 Then
                    dataArray = wsRand.range(wsRand.Cells(4, colIndex), wsRand.Cells(lastRow, colIndex)).value
                    For j = 1 To dataRows
                        rndIndex = Int(Rnd * UBound(dataArray, 1)) + 1
                        colArr(j) = dataArray(rndIndex, 1)
                    Next j
                End If
            End If
        End If

        '填充总数组
        For j = 1 To dataRows
            resultArr(j, i) = colArr(j)
        Next j

NextColumn:
    Next i '对应外层 For i 循环，配对完整，无语法报错

    '一次性写入数据
    outputRange.value = resultArr

    '批量设置单元格格式
    For i = 1 To targetHeaders.Columns.count
        headerValue = Trim(targetHeaders.Cells(1, i).value & "")
        If Right(headerValue, 1) = "额" Then
            outputRange.Columns(i).NumberFormat = "#,##0.00"
        ElseIf Right(headerValue, 1) = "量" Then
            outputRange.Columns(i).NumberFormat = "0"
        ElseIf dateColumns.exists(headerValue) Then
            outputRange.Columns(i).NumberFormat = "yyyy-mm-dd"
        End If
    Next i

RestoreApp:
    Call EndCode
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    Set targetHeaders = Nothing
    Set wsRand = Nothing
    Set outputRange = Nothing
    Set dateColumns = Nothing
End Sub

'随机数据生成器中专用：随机日期生成器 - 生成当前年份的随机日期
Public Function RandomDate() As Date
    Dim currentYear As Integer
    Dim startDate As Date
    Dim endDate As Date
    Dim daysDiff As Long
    
    currentYear = Year(Date)
    startDate = DateSerial(currentYear, 1, 1)
    endDate = DateSerial(currentYear, 12, 31)
    
    daysDiff = DateDiff("d", startDate, endDate)
    RandomDate = startDate + Int(Rnd * (daysDiff + 1))
End Function

'随机数据生成器中专用：随机日期范围生成器 - 生成指定范围内的随机日期
Public Function RandomDateInRange(ByVal startDate As Date, ByVal endDate As Date) As Date
    Dim daysDiff As Long
    daysDiff = DateDiff("d", startDate, endDate)
    RandomDateInRange = startDate + Int(Rnd * (daysDiff + 1))
End Function

'随机数据生成器中专用：随机姓名批量
Private Function GenerateRandomName() As String
    Dim arrSurname As Variant
    Dim arrName As Variant
    Dim A As Long, B As Long, c As Long
    Dim strName As String
    Call BeginCode
    ' 姓氏数组
    arrSurname = Array("赵", "钱", "孙", "李", "周", "吴", "郑", "王", "冯", "陈", "诸", "卫", "蒋", "沈", "韩", "杨", "朱", "秦", "尤", "许", "何", "吕", "施", "张", "孔", "曹", "严", "华", "金", "魏")
    ' 名字数组
    arrName = Array("方", "丽", "红", "姚", "潭", "路", "塘", "娴", "康", "玉", "婉", "嘉", "琼", "桂", "娣", "娅", "姣", "璐", "娅", "琦", "晶", "妍", "茜", "秋", "珊", "莎", "锦", "黛", "青", "倩")
    ' 生成随机索引
    A = Int(Rnd * (UBound(arrSurname) + 1))
    B = Int(Rnd * (UBound(arrName) + 1))
    c = Int(Rnd * (UBound(arrName) + 1))
    ' 生成姓名（复姓用1个字名，单姓用2个字名）
    If Len(arrSurname(A)) >= 2 Then
        strName = arrSurname(A) & arrName(B)
    Else
        strName = arrSurname(A) & arrName(B) & arrName(c)
    End If
    Call EndCode
    GenerateRandomName = strName
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "B_智能格式"
'智能设置数据单元格格式工具 — 百分比修复版 v3
'修复要点：
'1. 百分比字段不再对单元格值乘以 100，直接整列应用 0.00% 格式。
'2. 格式串（C列）按原样使用，不再做去空格/清洗，避免把“0_ ”等有效格式洗成“0_”导致报错。
'3. 字段名（B列）仍做清洗，用于匹配。
'4. 支持“工作表被保护”的场景：格式化前自动取消保护（无密码直接解；有密码则弹窗索取一次），结束后恢复原保护及原有允许项。
'5. 主流程保存并恢复 ScreenUpdating / Calculation 状态，异常时也不把 Excel 留在手动计算。
'使用前请确保：【智能格式】表的 C 列已为“比例”等字段配置含 % 的格式字符串（如 0.00%）。
'如果单元格里保存的已经是“5 表示 5%”这种放大后的数值，请先将其换算为 0.05 再运行本工具。

Option Explicit

'配置工作表名称
Const CELL_FORMAT_SHEET_NAME As String = "智能格式"
'B列=字段名称，C列=格式
Const COL_FIELD_NAME As Long = 2
Const COL_FORMAT_TEXT As Long = 3

' 清洗文本：过滤换行、回车、制表、全角空格，仅保留正常可见字符
' 仅用于字段名匹配；格式串本身不调用此函数，避免破坏格式语义（如“0_ ”末尾空格）。
Private Function CleanAllHiddenChar(ByVal txt As String) As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim singleChr As String
    Dim resultStr As String
    resultStr = ""
    
    For i = 1 To Len(txt)
        singleChr = Mid(txt, i, 1)
        Select Case AscW(singleChr)
            Case 9, 10, 13, 12288 '跳过制表/换行/回车/全角空格
            Case Else
                resultStr = resultStr & singleChr
        End Select
    Next i
    CleanAllHiddenChar = TrimMy(resultStr)
End Function

Private Function TrimMy(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim startPos As Long, endPos As Long
    Dim k As Long
    Dim ch As String
    startPos = 1
    endPos = Len(s)
    
    For k = 1 To Len(s)
        ch = Mid(s, k, 1)
        If ch <> " " And ch <> Chr(9) Then
            startPos = k
            Exit For
        End If
    Next k
    
    For k = Len(s) To 1 Step -1
        ch = Mid(s, k, 1)
        If ch <> " " And ch <> Chr(9) Then
            endPos = k
            Exit For
        End If
    Next k
    
    If startPos > endPos Then
        TrimMy = ""
    Else
        TrimMy = Mid(s, startPos, endPos - startPos + 1)
    End If
End Function

' 根据字段名从配置表查找对应格式
Private Function FindFieldMatchFormat(ByVal fieldName As String) As String
    Dim fmtWs As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim currField As String
    Dim cleanInput As String, cleanCfg As String
    
    FindFieldMatchFormat = ""
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Set fmtWs = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(CELL_FORMAT_SHEET_NAME)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If fmtWs Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未找到工作表【智能格式】", vbCritical
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    lastRow = fmtWs.Cells(fmtWs.Rows.count, COL_FIELD_NAME).End(xlUp).row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    
    cleanInput = CleanAllHiddenChar(fieldName)
    
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        currField = CStr(fmtWs.Cells(i, COL_FIELD_NAME).value & "")
        cleanCfg = CleanAllHiddenChar(currField)
        
        If cleanCfg = cleanInput Then
            ' 格式串原样返回，不清洗，保留末尾空格等格式语义
            FindFieldMatchFormat = CStr(fmtWs.Cells(i, COL_FORMAT_TEXT).value & "")
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
End Function

Public Sub AutoFormatByFieldName(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim selRng As range, headerRng As range, oneHeader As range
    Dim fmtCode As String, dataRng As range
    Dim matchCnt As Long, skipCnt As Long
    Dim oldScreenUpdating As Boolean
    Dim oldCalculation As XlCalculation
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim wasProtected As Boolean
    Dim sheetPwd As String
    Dim allowFmtCells As Boolean, allowFmtCols As Boolean, allowFmtRows As Boolean
    Dim allowInsCols As Boolean, allowInsRows As Boolean, allowDelCols As Boolean, allowDelRows As Boolean
    Dim allowSort As Boolean, allowFilter As Boolean, allowPivot As Boolean, allowHyperlinks As Boolean
    
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请先选中包含表头的数据区域！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set selRng = Selection
    Set headerRng = selRng.Rows(1)
    Set ws = selRng.Worksheet
    
    ' 若数据表被保护，先记录原有允许项并尝试取消保护
    wasProtected = ws.ProtectContents
    If wasProtected Then
        On Error Resume Next
        allowFmtCells = ws.Protection.AllowFormattingCells
        allowFmtCols = ws.Protection.AllowFormattingColumns
        allowFmtRows = ws.Protection.AllowFormattingRows
        allowInsCols = ws.Protection.AllowInsertingColumns
        allowInsRows = ws.Protection.AllowInsertingRows
        allowDelCols = ws.Protection.AllowDeletingColumns
        allowDelRows = ws.Protection.AllowDeletingRows
        allowSort = ws.Protection.AllowSorting
        allowFilter = ws.Protection.AllowFiltering
        allowPivot = ws.Protection.AllowUsingPivotTables
        allowHyperlinks = ws.Protection.AllowInsertingHyperlinks
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        sheetPwd = ""
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Unprotect
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            err.Clear
            sheetPwd = InputBox("工作表【" & ws.NAME & "】已保护，无法设置格式。" & vbCrLf & _
                                "请输入保护工作表密码（留空或取消将跳过该表格式化）：", "需要密码")
            If sheetPwd <> "" Then ws.Unprotect sheetPwd
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
        
        If ws.ProtectContents Then
            MsgBox "工作表【" & ws.NAME & "】保护未能解除，相关列将无法格式化。" & vbCrLf & _
                   "请先手动取消保护，或在保护时勾选“设置单元格格式”权限。", vbExclamation
        End If
    End If
    
    oldScreenUpdating = Application.ScreenUpdating
    oldCalculation = Application.Calculation
    
    On Error GoTo CleanFail
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    
    matchCnt = 0: skipCnt = 0
    
    For Each oneHeader In headerRng.Cells
        fmtCode = FindFieldMatchFormat(CStr(oneHeader.value & ""))
        
        If fmtCode = "" Then
            skipCnt = skipCnt + 1
        Else
            Set dataRng = GetColumnDataRange(oneHeader)
            If dataRng Is Nothing Then
                skipCnt = skipCnt + 1
            Else
                Call BatchApplyColumnFormat(dataRng, fmtCode)
                matchCnt = matchCnt + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next oneHeader
    
CleanExit:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = oldScreenUpdating
    Application.Calculation = oldCalculation
    
    ' 恢复工作表保护（沿用原密码与原有允许项）
    If wasProtected And Not ws.ProtectContents Then
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Protect Password:=sheetPwd, _
                    AllowFormattingCells:=allowFmtCells, _
                    AllowFormattingColumns:=allowFmtCols, _
                    AllowFormattingRows:=allowFmtRows, _
                    AllowInsertingColumns:=allowInsCols, _
                    AllowInsertingRows:=allowInsRows, _
                    AllowDeletingColumns:=allowDelCols, _
                    AllowDeletingRows:=allowDelRows, _
                    AllowSorting:=allowSort, _
                    AllowFiltering:=allowFilter, _
                    AllowUsingPivotTables:=allowPivot, _
                    AllowInsertingHyperlinks:=allowHyperlinks
        On Error GoTo 0
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    MsgBox "自动格式化完成！" & vbCrLf & _
           "成功匹配并格式化列：" & matchCnt & " 列" & vbCrLf & _
           "无匹配格式跳过列：" & skipCnt & " 列", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
    
CleanFail:
    MsgBox "格式化过程中出现错误：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    Resume CleanExit
End Sub

' 根据表头单元格获取下方纯数据区域
Private Function GetColumnDataRange(ByVal headerCell As range) As range
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim colNum As Long, lastDataRow As Long
    Set ws = headerCell.Worksheet
    colNum = headerCell.column
    lastDataRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, colNum).End(xlUp).row
    If lastDataRow <= headerCell.row Then
        Set GetColumnDataRange = Nothing
        Exit Function
    End If
    Set GetColumnDataRange = ws.range(ws.Cells(headerCell.row + 1, colNum), ws.Cells(lastDataRow, colNum))
End Function

' 批量设置自定义单元格格式
' 逻辑保持与原版一致：非百分比格式直接按原串设置；百分比格式不再乘100，直接应用 0.00%。
Private Sub BatchApplyColumnFormat(ByVal targetRng As range, ByVal rawFmt As String)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    If InStr(rawFmt, "%") > 0 Then
        ' 百分比：直接设置两位百分比格式，不改动单元格数值
        targetRng.NumberFormat = "0.00%"
    Else
        targetRng.NumberFormat = rawFmt
    End If
    
    err.Clear
    targetRng.WrapText = True
End Sub

' 主过程：多值筛选，自选列、逗号分隔输入筛选值
Sub MultiValueColumnFilter()
    Dim targetCol As Long
    Dim inputStr As String
    Dim valArr As Variant
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim cellTxt As String
    Dim cellRng As range
    '1. 获取当前激活工作表（任意工作表通用）
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    '2. 弹窗让用户选择筛选列
    On Error Resume Next
    Set cellRng = Application.InputBox( _
        Prompt:="请点击任意单元格选择需要筛选的列", _
        Title:="选择筛选列", _
        Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If cellRng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未选择列，操作取消", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    targetCol = cellRng.column '提取选中区域的列号
    '3. 弹窗输入逗号分隔的筛选值
    inputStr = InputBox( _
        Prompt:="请输入需要保留的内容，多个值用英文逗号,分隔" & vbCrLf & "示例：张三,李四,100,测试", _
        Title:="输入筛选条件")
    If Trim(inputStr) = "" Then
        MsgBox "未输入筛选值，操作取消", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    '4. 分割字符串为数组、清除每个值首尾空格
    valArr = Split(inputStr, ",")
    For i = LBound(valArr) To UBound(valArr)
        valArr(i) = Trim(CStr(valArr(i)))
    Next i
    '5. 取消原有所有隐藏行，重置筛选
    ws.Rows.Hidden = False
    If ws.FilterMode Then ws.ShowAllData
    '6. 获取数据最后一行
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, targetCol).End(xlUp).row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        MsgBox "所选列无有效数据", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    '7. 倒序循环筛选，不在列表内的行隐藏
    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1
        If IsError(ws.Cells(i, targetCol).value) Then
            ws.Rows(i).Hidden = True
        Else
            cellTxt = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(i, targetCol).value))
            If Not ValueExistInArray(cellTxt, valArr) Then
                ws.Rows(i).Hidden = True
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    MsgBox "筛选完成！", vbInformation
End Sub
 
' 辅助函数：判断文本是否存在于数组（不区分大小写）
Private Function ValueExistInArray(checkTxt As String, arr As Variant) As Boolean
    Dim X As Long
    For X = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
        If UCase(arr(X)) = UCase(checkTxt) Then
            ValueExistInArray = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next X
    ValueExistInArray = False
End Function

    Dim She As Object: Set She = rng.Parent

    End With

    Dim Dic As Object: Set Dic = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
    Set edy(0) = Application.InputBox(Str, "LELEDY", Type:=8) '选区（可不连续）
    Set edy(1) = edy(0).Parent '选区所在表
    Set edy(2) = Application.Intersect(edy(0), edy(1).usedRange) '选区是否在已用区域中
    '选区内容存入字典
    If typeName(edy(0)) = "Range" Then
        If typeName(edy(2)) = "Nothing" Then
            Dic("") = ""
        Else
            If edy(2).count > 1 Then Set edy(2) = edy(2).SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)  '选区为区域识别为可见
            Dim Tro&, Trt&, Trh&, cnt&, arr, Var: arr = Split(edy(2).Address, ",") '将选区处理后的地址转为一维数组
            For Tro = 0 To UBound(arr)
                With edy(1).range(arr(Tro))
                    Var = .value '每个地址的二维内容数组
                    cnt = .count + IIf(err = 18, "Ctrl+Break ", 0) '每个地址的单元格数量
                    If cnt = 1 Then If IsError(Var) Then Dic(.Text) = "" Else Dic(CStr(Var)) = ""
                    If cnt > 1 Then
                        For Trt = 1 To UBound(Var, 1)
                            For Trh = 1 To UBound(Var, 2)
                                If IsError(Var(Trt, Trh)) Then Dic(.Cells(Trt, Trh).Text) = "" Else Dic(CStr(Var(Trt, Trh))) = ""
                            Next
                        Next
                    End If
                End With
            Next
        End If
 
        '多项指定筛选
        With She.AutoFilter.range
            .AutoFilter Field:=Num, Criteria1:=Dic.Keys, Operator:=xlFilterValues
        End With
    End If
 
    '释放内存
    Set rng = Nothing
    Set She = Nothing
    Set edy = Nothing
    Set Dic = Nothing
    Erase arr, Var
End Sub

'反向筛选
Public Sub AntiFilter()

    On Error Resume Next
    Dim rng As Object: Set rng = Application.Intersect(ActiveSheet.AutoFilter.range, Selection.Columns(1).EntireColumn)

    '判断当前单元格所在列是否进行过筛选
    Dim col&: col = ActiveSheet.AutoFilter.range.column
    Dim Rwo&: Rwo = ActiveSheet.AutoFilter.range.row
    Dim Num&: Num = rng.column - col + 1
    With She.AutoFilter.Filters(Num)
        If .On Then
            '获取整列数据
            Dim Tro&, Dic As Object: Set Dic = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
            Dim Var1: Var1 = She.range(rng.Address).value
            Dim Trt As Integer
            For Tro = 2 To UBound(Var1, 1)
                For Trt = 1 To UBound(Var1, 2)
                    If IsError(Var1(Tro, Trt)) Then Dic(She.Cells(Rwo + Tro - 1, rng.column).Text) = "" Else Dic(Trim(CStr(Var1(Tro, Trt)))) = ""
                Next
            Next
            '获取当前选项
            arr1 = .Criteria1
            arr2 = .Criteria2
            err.Number = 0: col = UBound(arr1)
            If err.Number Then
                If arr1 = "=" And Len(arr2) = 0 Then Dic.Remove ""
                If arr1 = "=" And Len(arr2) > 0 Then Dic.Remove "": Dic.Remove Mid(arr2, 2)
                If Len(arr1) > 0 And Len(arr2) = 0 Then Dic.Remove Mid(arr1, 2)
            Else
                If Len(arr2) = 0 Then
                    For Tro = 1 To UBound(arr1)
                        Dic.Remove Mid(arr1(Tro), 2, Len(arr1(Tro)))
                    Next
                End If
            End If
        Else
            If MsgBox("当前单元格所在列未进行指定筛选", vbOKOnly, "LELEDY") = vbOK Then Exit Sub
        End If
    End With
 
    '反向筛选
    With She.AutoFilter.range
        .AutoFilter Field:=Num, Criteria1:=Dic.Keys, Operator:=xlFilterValues
    End With
 
    '释放内存
    Set rng = Nothing: Set She = Nothing: Set Dic = Nothing
    Erase Var1, arr1, arr2
End Sub
 
' 反向筛选（按选中单元格反选）
' 功能：选中某列中的若干单元格（连续或不连续），筛选不含这些值的行
' 验证：选中单元格必须在同一列，否则提示用户
' 作者：根据 LELEDY 原版 AntiFilter 改写
'Option Explicit
'Private Const xlFilterValues As Long = 7
' Excel 常量（late binding 时需手动定义）
Public Sub AntiFilterBySelection()
    On Error GoTo EH
    Dim She As Object           ' 工作表对象
    Dim rng As Object          ' 筛选区域与选中列的交集
    Dim col As Long             ' 筛选区域起始列号
    Dim Rw As Long              ' 筛选区域起始行号
    Dim Num As Long             ' 目标列在筛选区域中的字段序号（Field 参数）
    Dim Dic As Object           ' 字典：存储整列去重后的所有值
    Dim SelVals As Object      ' 字典：存储选中单元格的值（去重）
    Dim key As Variant
    Dim Tro As Long
    Dim Var1 As Variant        ' 整列数据数组
    Dim Sel As Object          ' Selection 对象
    Dim Area As Object
    Dim c As Object
    Dim FirstCol As Long       ' 选中区域第一列的列号（用于验证是否同一列）
    Dim bSameCol As Boolean
    Dim sVal As String
    Dim sTmp As String
    Dim Trt As Long            ' 修正：Var1 是二维数组，列号用 Long
    ' 第1步：验证工作表是否启用了自动筛选
    If ActiveSheet Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Set She = ActiveSheet
    On Error Resume Next
    If She.AutoFilterMode = False And She.FilterMode = False Then
        MsgBox "当前工作表未启用筛选功能！", vbExclamation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    ' 获取筛选区域
    If She.AutoFilter Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未检测到自动筛选区域！", vbExclamation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' 第2步：验证选中单元格是否在筛选区域内
    Set rng = Nothing
    On Error Resume Next
    ' Selection.EntireColumn 返回选中单元格所在的整列 Range 对象
    Set rng = Application.Intersect(She.AutoFilter.range, Selection.EntireColumn)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If rng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "选中单元格不在筛选区域内！", vbExclamation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    ' 第3步：验证选中单元格是否在同一列
    Set Sel = Selection
    FirstCol = 0
    bSameCol = True
    ' 遍历所有 Area（不连续选区会有多个 Area）
    For Each Area In Sel.Areas
        If FirstCol = 0 Then
            FirstCol = Area.column
        Else
            If Area.column <> FirstCol Then
                bSameCol = False
                Exit For
            End If
        End If
    Next Area
    If Not bSameCol Then
        MsgBox "选中单元格不在同一列，请重新选择！", vbExclamation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    ' 第4步：获取选中单元格的值（去重存入字典 SelVals）
    Set SelVals = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each Area In Sel.Areas
        For Each c In Area.Cells
            If Not IsEmpty(c.value) Then
                If IsError(c.value) Then
                    sVal = c.Text
                Else
                    sVal = Trim(CStr(c.value))
                End If
                If sVal <> "" Then SelVals(sVal) = ""
            End If
        Next c
    Next Area
    If SelVals.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "选中单元格中没有有效数据！", vbExclamation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    ' 第5步：获取整列所有去重值（存入字典 Dic）
    col = She.AutoFilter.range.column
    Rw = She.AutoFilter.range.row
    Num = rng.column - col + 1   ' 目标列在 AutoFilter 中的 Field 序号
    Var1 = She.range(rng.Address).value   ' 读取整列数据到数组
    Set Dic = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    If IsArray(Var1) Then
        For Tro = 2 To UBound(Var1, 1)          ' 从第2行开始（跳过标题行）
            For Trt = 1 To UBound(Var1, 2)
                If IsError(Var1(Tro, Trt)) Then
                    sTmp = She.Cells(Rw + Tro - 1, rng.column).Text
                Else
                    sTmp = Trim(CStr(Var1(Tro, Trt)))
                End If
                If sTmp <> "" Then Dic(sTmp) = ""
            Next Trt
        Next Tro
    Else
        ' 筛选区域只有一行（标题行）时，Var1 不是数组
        MsgBox "筛选区域中没有数据行！", vbInformation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    ' 第6步：从 Dic 中移除选中单元格的值（反向筛选的核心）
    For Each key In SelVals.Keys
        If Dic.exists(key) Then Dic.Remove key
    Next key
    ' 如果移除后 Dic 为空，说明整列值都被反选掉了
    If Dic.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "反向筛选后无剩余数据（整列值均被排除）！", vbInformation, "LELEDY"
        Exit Sub
    End If
 
    ' 第7步：执行反向筛选
She.AutoFilter.range.AutoFilter Field:=Num, Criteria1:=Dic.Keys, Operator:=7
    ' 第8步：释放内存
    Set She = Nothing
    Set rng = Nothing
    Set Dic = Nothing
    Set SelVals = Nothing
    Set Sel = Nothing
    Erase Var1
    Exit Sub
EH:
    MsgBox "反向筛选出错：" & err.Description & vbCrLf & "错误号：" & err.Number, vbCritical, "LELEDY"
    Set She = Nothing
    Set rng = Nothing
    Set Dic = Nothing
    Set SelVals = Nothing
    Set Sel = Nothing
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "B右键菜单"
Option Explicit
Private Const g_strRightMenuTag As String = "MY_GLOBAL_CELL_MENU"
Private Const g_strConfigSheetName As String = "sheet右键菜单"

'支持：1按钮 2分隔线 3内置命令(自动匹配图标、标题提示)；增加Level层级参数，控制菜单的层级是一级列表还是子列表
Public Sub CreateGlobalRightMenu()
    Dim objCellMenu As CommandBar
    Dim objPopupMenu As CommandBarPopup '子菜单：自定义工具箱
    Dim objTopBtn As CommandBarButton  '新增：同级顶级按钮
    Dim objBtn As CommandBarButton
    Dim shtConfig As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim menuType As Integer
    Dim builtInID As Long
    Dim ctl As CommandBarControl
    Dim menuLevel As Long '新增：H列层级标识
    Dim popupIndex As Long '记录【自定义工具箱】菜单的索引，用于插入同级按钮

    Call RemoveGlobalRightMenu

    On Error Resume Next
    Set shtConfig = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(g_strConfigSheetName)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If shtConfig Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未找到配置表：" & g_strConfigSheetName, vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    lastRow = shtConfig.Cells(shtConfig.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Set objCellMenu = Application.CommandBars("Cell")
    '创建固定子菜单：自定义工具箱（Level=2的内容全部放这里）
    Set objPopupMenu = objCellMenu.Controls.Add( _
        Type:=msoControlPopup, Before:=1, Temporary:=False)
    objPopupMenu.Caption = "自定义工具箱"
    objPopupMenu.Tag = g_strRightMenuTag
    objPopupMenu.BeginGroup = True
    
    '===== 关键：记录工具箱菜单的索引位置 =====
    popupIndex = objPopupMenu.Index

    For i = 2 To lastRow
        '读取H列层级，默认2（子菜单）
        On Error Resume Next
        menuLevel = CLng(shtConfig.Cells(i, "H").value)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If menuLevel <> 1 Then menuLevel = 2 '非法值统一归为子菜单

        menuType = 0
        On Error Resume Next
        menuType = CInt(shtConfig.Cells(i, "A").value)
        On Error GoTo 0

        Select Case menuLevel
            Case 1 '========= 同级顶级菜单（紧跟在【自定义工具箱】后面，不再末尾）=========
                Select Case menuType
                    Case 1 '自定义按钮
                        'Before:=popupIndex + 1 插入到工具箱菜单下一位
                        Set objTopBtn = objCellMenu.Controls.Add(msoControlButton, Before:=popupIndex + 1)
                        With objTopBtn
                            .Caption = shtConfig.Cells(i, "B").value
                            .FaceId = shtConfig.Cells(i, "C").value
                            .OnAction = shtConfig.Cells(i, "D").value
                            .TooltipText = shtConfig.Cells(i, "E").value
                            .style = msoButtonIconAndCaption
                            .Tag = g_strRightMenuTag & "_TOP_BTN"
                        End With
                        '每新增一个同级按钮，索引+1，保证下一个继续紧跟
                        popupIndex = popupIndex + 1
                        
                    Case 2 '分隔线（顶级分隔）
                        Set objTopBtn = objCellMenu.Controls.Add(msoControlButton, Before:=popupIndex + 1)
                        objTopBtn.BeginGroup = True
                        objTopBtn.Visible = False
                        objTopBtn.Tag = g_strRightMenuTag & "_TOP_SEP"
                        popupIndex = popupIndex + 1
                        
                    Case 3 '内置命令顶级
                        builtInID = 0
                        On Error Resume Next
                        builtInID = CLng(shtConfig.Cells(i, "D").value)
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        If builtInID > 0 Then
                            Set ctl = Nothing
                            On Error Resume Next
                            Set ctl = Application.CommandBars.FindControl(id:=builtInID)
                            On Error GoTo 0
                            Set objTopBtn = objCellMenu.Controls.Add(msoControlButton, Before:=popupIndex + 1)
                            With objTopBtn
                                If Not ctl Is Nothing Then
                                    .Caption = IIf(Trim(shtConfig.Cells(i, "B")) <> "", shtConfig.Cells(i, "B"), ctl.Caption)
                                    .FaceId = ctl.FaceId
                                    .TooltipText = IIf(Trim(shtConfig.Cells(i, "E")) <> "", shtConfig.Cells(i, "E"), ctl.TooltipText)
                                Else
                                    .Caption = "未知命令(" & builtInID & ")"
                                End If
                                .OnAction = "'RunBuiltInCommand " & builtInID & "'"
                                .style = msoButtonIconAndCaption
                                .Tag = g_strRightMenuTag & "_TOP_BUILTIN"
                            End With
                            popupIndex = popupIndex + 1
                        End If
                End Select

            Case 2 '========= 原有逻辑：放入【自定义工具箱】子菜单内部 =========
                Select Case menuType
                    Case 1   ' 自定义按钮
                        Set objBtn = objPopupMenu.Controls.Add(msoControlButton)
                        With objBtn
                            .Caption = shtConfig.Cells(i, "B").value
                            .FaceId = shtConfig.Cells(i, "C").value
                            .OnAction = shtConfig.Cells(i, "D").value
                            .TooltipText = shtConfig.Cells(i, "E").value
                            .style = msoButtonIconAndCaption
                            .Tag = g_strRightMenuTag & "_BTN"
                        End With
                    Case 2   ' 分隔线
                        Set objBtn = objPopupMenu.Controls.Add(msoControlButton)
                        objBtn.BeginGroup = True
                        objBtn.Visible = False
                        objBtn.Tag = g_strRightMenuTag & "_SEP"
                    Case 3   ' 内置命令
                        builtInID = 0
                        On Error Resume Next
                        builtInID = CLng(shtConfig.Cells(i, "D").value)
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        If builtInID > 0 Then
                            Set ctl = Nothing
                            On Error Resume Next
                            Set ctl = Application.CommandBars.FindControl(id:=builtInID)
                            On Error GoTo 0
                            Set objBtn = objPopupMenu.Controls.Add(msoControlButton)
                            With objBtn
                                If Not ctl Is Nothing Then
                                    .Caption = IIf(Trim(shtConfig.Cells(i, "B")) <> "", shtConfig.Cells(i, "B"), ctl.Caption)
                                    .FaceId = ctl.FaceId
                                    .TooltipText = IIf(Trim(shtConfig.Cells(i, "E")) <> "", shtConfig.Cells(i, "E"), ctl.TooltipText)
                                Else
                                    .Caption = "未知命令(" & builtInID & ")"
                                End If
                                .OnAction = "'RunBuiltInCommand " & builtInID & "'"
                                .style = msoButtonIconAndCaption
                                .Tag = g_strRightMenuTag & "_BUILTIN"
                            End With
                        End If
                End Select
        End Select
    Next i

    Set objPopupMenu = Nothing
    Set objCellMenu = Nothing
    Set shtConfig = Nothing
End Sub

' 执行内置命令内置命令
Public Sub RunBuiltInCommand(ByVal id As Long)
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.CommandBars.FindControl(id:=id).Execute
End Sub

'精准清除全局右键菜单
Public Sub RemoveGlobalRightMenu()
    Dim Bar As CommandBar
    Dim ctl As CommandBarControl
    Set Bar = Application.CommandBars("Cell")
    
    '1. 删除【自定义工具箱】子菜单
    For Each ctl In Bar.Controls
        If ctl.Tag = g_strRightMenuTag Then
            ctl.Delete
        End If
    Next ctl
    
    '2. 删除所有同级顶级菜单（TOP标记）
    For Each ctl In Bar.Controls
        If InStr(1, ctl.Tag, g_strRightMenuTag & "_TOP_", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            ctl.Delete
        End If
    Next ctl
End Sub

'刷新菜单（先清除再创建）
Public Sub RefreshGlobalRightMenu()
    Call RemoveGlobalRightMenu
    Call CreateGlobalRightMenu
End Sub

Public Sub GetSoftwareMenuContent(control As IRibbonControl, ByRef content)
    Dim xml As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    xml = ""

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = Nothing
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("常用软件")
    If ws Is Nothing Then Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("Sheet1")
    If ws Is Nothing Then Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        content = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">" & _
                  "<button id=""btnCreateSheet"" label=""创建常用软件表"" " & _
                  "onAction=""CreateSoftwareSheet"" imageMso=""AddIn"" />" & _
                  "</menu>"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    xml = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">"

    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row
    If lastRow > 1 Then
        For i = 2 To lastRow
            Dim softwareID As String, softwareName As String, softwarePath As String

            softwareID = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 1).value & "")
            softwareName = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value & "")
            softwarePath = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 3).value & "")

            If softwareID <> "" And softwareName <> "" And softwarePath <> "" Then
                Dim cleanID As String
                Dim j As Integer
                Dim tempID As String
                
                ' 修复：手动移除空格和下划线
                tempID = ""
                For j = 1 To Len(softwareID)
                    Dim ch As String
                    ch = Mid(softwareID, j, 1)
                    If ch <> " " And ch <> "_" Then
                        tempID = tempID & ch
                    End If
                Next j

' XML转义函数
Private Function EscapeXml(ByVal Text As String) As String
    If Text = "" Then
        EscapeXml = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim result As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim ch As String

    result = ""

    For i = 1 To Len(Text)
        ch = Mid(Text, i, 1)
        Select Case ch
        Case "&": result = result & "&"
        Case "<": result = result & "<"
        Case ">": result = result & ">"
        Case """": result = result & """
        Case "'": result = result & "'"
        Case Else: result = result & ch
        End Select
    Next i

    EscapeXml = result
End Function

' 生成条件格式菜单

' XML配置中应该使用：getContent="GetCondFormatMenuContent"
Public Sub GetCondFormatMenuContent(control As IRibbonControl, ByRef content)
    Dim xml As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    Dim categories As Collection
    Dim category As Variant
    Dim currCat As String

    ' 初始化content变量，确保始终有值
    content = ""

    On Error Resume Next

    Set ws = Nothing
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("条件格式")

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        content = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">" & _
                  "<button id=""btnCFError"" label=""请创建条件格式表"" onAction=""CreateCondFormatSheet"" imageMso=""ConditionalFormatting"" />" & _
                  "</menu>"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Set categories = New Collection
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row

    If lastRow > 1 Then
        For i = 2 To lastRow
            If Not IsError(ws.Cells(i, 3).value) Then
                currCat = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 3).value & "")
                If currCat <> "" Then
                    Dim exists As Boolean
                    exists = False
                    For Each category In categories
                        If category = currCat Then
                            exists = True
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next category

                    If Not exists Then
                        categories.Add currCat
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    ' 初始化XML菜单结构，确保命名空间正确
    xml = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">"

    If categories.count > 0 Then
        For Each category In categories
            Dim catStr As String
            catStr = CStr(category)

            Dim cleanID As String
            cleanID = ""
            For j = 1 To Len(catStr)
                Dim ch As String
                ch = Mid(catStr, j, 1)
                If ch <> " " Then
                    cleanID = cleanID & ch
                End If
            Next j

            If cleanID = "" Then
                cleanID = "Cat" & Format(Timer * 1000, "0")
            End If

            ' 生成分类菜单XML，确保格式正确
            xml = xml & "<menu id=""menuCFCat" & cleanID & """ "
            xml = xml & "imageMso=""AlignJustify"" "
            xml = xml & "label=""" & EscapeXml(catStr) & """ >"

            For i = 2 To lastRow
                If Not IsError(ws.Cells(i, 3).value) Then
                    If Trim(ws.Cells(i, 3).value & "") = catStr Then
                        Dim cfName As String, cfFormula As String, cfColor As String, displayText As String

                        cfName = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 1).value & "")
                        cfFormula = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 4).value & "")
                        cfColor = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 5).value & "")

                        If cfName = "" Then cfName = "未命名"

                        displayText = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 2).value & "")
                        If Len(displayText) > 30 Then
                            displayText = Left(displayText, 27) & "..."
                        End If

                        Dim safeDisplay As String
                        safeDisplay = EscapeXml(displayText)

                        Dim safeTag As String
                        safeTag = EscapeXml(cfName)

                        ' 生成按钮XML，确保格式正确
                        xml = xml & "<button id=""btnCF" & i & "_" & cleanID & """ "
                        xml = xml & "label=""" & safeDisplay & """ "
                        xml = xml & "tag=""" & safeTag & """ "
                        xml = xml & "onAction=""ApplyConditionalFormat"" "
                        xml = xml & "imageMso=""ConditionalFormattingColorScalesGallery"" />"
                    End If
                End If
            Next i

            xml = xml & "</menu>"
        Next category

        xml = xml & "<menuSeparator id=""sepCFFixedItems""/>"
    Else
        xml = xml & "<button id=""btnCFAddData"" label=""请先添加条件格式数据"" onAction=""CreateCondFormatSheet"" imageMso=""ConditionalFormatting"" />"
        xml = xml & "<menuSeparator id=""sepCFFixedItems""/>"
    End If

    ' 生成管理按钮XML
    xml = xml & "<button id=""btnManageCondFormats"" label=""条件格式管理"" onAction=""ManageCondFormats"" visible=""" & ManageButtonVisibility & """ image=""GL001"" />"
'    xml = xml & "<button id=""btnManageCondFormats"" "
'    xml = xml & "label=""条件格式管理"" "
'    xml = xml & "onAction=""ManageCondFormats"" "
'    xml = xml & "imageMso=""ConditionalFormatting"" />"
    
    ' 闭合菜单标签
    xml = xml & "</menu>"
    
    ' 首先将构建好的xml赋值给content
    content = xml
    
    ' 确保始终返回有效的XML内容
    If content = "" Or InStr(content, "</menu>") = 0 Then
        ' 如果content变量为空或不包含闭合标签，返回一个默认的错误提示菜单
        content = "<menu xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2006/01/customui"">" & _
                  "<button id=""btnCFDebug"" label=""条件格式菜单加载失败"" onAction=""DebugCondFormatMenu"" imageMso=""AlertWarning"" />" & _
                  "</menu>"
    End If
    
    ' 移除注释可以查看生成的XML内容
    ' Debug.Print "条件格式菜单XML: " & content

    Set ws = Nothing
    Set categories = Nothing
End Sub

' 应用条件格式
Public Sub ApplyConditionalFormat(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim tagVal As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim cfFormula As String
    Dim cfColor As String

    tagVal = Trim(control.Tag)
    If tagVal = "" Then
        MsgBox "未指定条件格式标识", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请先选中要设置条件格式的单元格", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("条件格式")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未找到【条件格式】表", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    cfFormula = ""
    cfColor = ""
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "A").End(xlUp).row
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If Trim(ws.Cells(i, 1).value) = tagVal Then
            cfFormula = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 4).value)
            cfColor = Trim(ws.Cells(i, 5).value)
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i

    If cfFormula = "" Then
        MsgBox "未找到条件格式: " & tagVal, vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 应用条件格式
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim Cf As FormatCondition
    With Selection
        ' 添加新的条件格式
        .FormatConditions.Add Type:=xlExpression, Formula1:=cfFormula
        Set Cf = .FormatConditions(.FormatConditions.count)
        Cf.SetFirstPriority
        
        ' 设置填充颜色
        If cfColor <> "" Then
            With Cf.Interior
                .PatternColorIndex = xlAutomatic
                .Color = HexToRGB(cfColor)
                .TintAndShade = 0
            End With
        End If
        
        Cf.StopIfTrue = False
    End With
    
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "应用条件格式时出错: " & err.Description, vbCritical
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo 0
    Set ws = Nothing
    Set Cf = Nothing
End Sub

' 颜色转换函数：将十六进制颜色代码转换为RGB值
' 改为Public以便在其他模块中使用
Public Function HexToRGB(hexColor As Variant) As Long
    Dim r As Long, g As Long, B As Long
    Dim tempHex As String

    On Error Resume Next

    ' 检查参数是否为错误值
    If IsError(hexColor) Then
        HexToRGB = 0    ' 默认黑色
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 将参数转换为字符串
    tempHex = CStr(hexColor)

    ' 检查参数是否为空
    If tempHex = "" Then
        HexToRGB = 0    ' 默认黑色
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 移除#号
    If Left(tempHex, 1) = "#" Then
        tempHex = Mid(tempHex, 2)
    End If

    ' 方法1：使用循环移除空格（最可靠）
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(tempHex)
        If Mid(tempHex, i, 1) <> " " Then
            result = result & Mid(tempHex, i, 1)
        End If
    Next i
    tempHex = result

    ' 方法2：如果还是想用Replace，正确用法是：
    ' tempHex = Replace(tempHex, " ", "", 1, -1, vbTextCompare)
    ' 或者简单写为：
    ' tempHex = Replace(tempHex, " ", "")
    ' 但在某些VBA版本中可能需要完整的参数

    ' 清除错误状态
    err.Clear

    ' 确保长度为6
    If Len(tempHex) <> 6 Then
        HexToRGB = 0    ' 默认黑色
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' 解析RGB值
    r = Val("&H" & Mid(tempHex, 1, 2))
    g = Val("&H" & Mid(tempHex, 3, 2))
    B = Val("&H" & Mid(tempHex, 5, 2))

    ' 确保RGB值在0-255范围内
    If r < 0 Or r > 255 Then r = 0
    If g < 0 Or g > 255 Then g = 0
    If B < 0 Or B > 255 Then B = 0

    ' 转换为RGB颜色值
    HexToRGB = (r * 65536) + (g * 256) + B

    ' 检查是否有错误
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        HexToRGB = 0    ' 出错时返回黑色
        err.Clear
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

' XML转义函数（处理特殊字符）
Private Function EscapeXml(ByVal Text As String) As String
    If Text = "" Then
        EscapeXml = ""
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim result As String
    result = Text

    Dim temp As String
    Dim k As Integer

    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = "&" Then
            temp = temp & "&"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp

    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = "<" Then
            temp = temp & "<"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp

    temp = ""
    For k = 1 To Len(result)
        If Mid(result, k, 1) = ">" Then
            temp = temp & ">"
        Else
            temp = temp & Mid(result, k, 1)
        End If
    Next k
    result = temp

    EscapeXml = result
End Function

' 核心函数：根据传入的格式参数，设置选中区域的格式；支持空值跳过：参数为空则不修改对应属性
Public Sub ApplyCellFormat(ByVal targetRng As range, _
                           Optional ByVal fontName As String = "", _
                           Optional ByVal fontSize As Variant = Empty, _
                           Optional ByVal Bold As Variant = Empty, _
                           Optional ByVal FontColor As String = "", _
                           Optional ByVal FillColor As String = "", _
                           Optional ByVal HorizontalAlign As String = "", _
                           Optional ByVal NumberFormat As String = "")
    If targetRng Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    With targetRng
        ' 1. 设置字体名称（非空才执行）
        If fontName <> "" Then .Font.NAME = fontName
        ' 2. 设置字号（非空且为数字才执行）
        If IsNumeric(fontSize) And Not IsEmpty(fontSize) Then .Font.size = fontSize
        ' 3. 设置加粗（非空才执行）
        If Not IsEmpty(Bold) Then .Font.Bold = CBool(Bold)
        ' 4. 设置文字颜色（非空才执行，兼容RGB/内置颜色）
        If FontColor <> "" Then
            If LCase(FontColor) = "false" Then
                ' 设置为无颜色（清除颜色）
                .Font.Color = xlAutomatic
                .Font.Color = vbBlack
            Else
                On Error Resume Next ' 容错颜色格式错误
                .Font.Color = ThisWorkbook.colors(FontColor)    ' 尝试内置颜色
                If err.Number <> 0 Then
                    .Font.Color = RGB( _
                                      Val("&H" & Mid(FontColor, 2, 2)), _
                                      Val("&H" & Mid(FontColor, 4, 2)), _
                                      Val("&H" & Mid(FontColor, 6, 2)) _
                                      )    ' 尝试RGB代码
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        End If
        ' 5. 设置填充颜色（非空才执行）
        If FillColor <> "" Then
            If LCase(FillColor) = "false" Then
                ' 设置为无填充
                .Interior.ColorIndex = xlNone
            Else
                On Error Resume Next
                .Interior.Color = ThisWorkbook.colors(FillColor)
                If err.Number <> 0 Then
                    .Interior.Color = RGB( _
                                          Val("&H" & Mid(FillColor, 2, 2)), _
                                          Val("&H" & Mid(FillColor, 4, 2)), _
                                          Val("&H" & Mid(FillColor, 6, 2)) _
                                          )
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        End If
        ' 6. 设置水平对齐（非空才执行）
        If HorizontalAlign <> "" Then
            Select Case LCase(HorizontalAlign)
                Case "左", "left": .HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
                Case "中", "center": .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                Case "右", "right": .HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                Case "两端对齐", "justify": .HorizontalAlignment = xlJustify
            End Select
        End If
        ' 7. 设置垂直对齐（固定为上下居中）
        .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        ' 8. 设置单元格显示格式（非空才执行）
        If NumberFormat <> "" Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Dim formattedNumberFormat As String
            formattedNumberFormat = NumberFormat
            
            ' 预处理常见格式问题
            Select Case Trim(formattedNumberFormat)
                Case "G/通用格式": formattedNumberFormat = "General"
                Case "0.00_": formattedNumberFormat = "0.00"
                Case "yyyy/mm/dd:@": formattedNumberFormat = "yyyy/mm/dd"
            End Select
            
            ' 尝试设置格式
            .NumberFormat = formattedNumberFormat
            
            ' 如果设置失败，清除错误并恢复默认格式
            If err.Number <> 0 Then
                err.Clear
                ' 可以选择设置为默认格式或保持原样
                '.NumberFormat = "General"
            End If
            
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    End With
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

Public Sub ExecuteFormatByID(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim formatID As String
    Dim params As Variant

    ' 校验选中区域
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请先选中要设置格式的单元格！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 提取ID (从按钮ID中移除前缀)
    formatID = Mid(control.id, InStr(control.id, "btnFormat_") + Len("btnFormat_"))
    If formatID = "" Then    ' 容错：ID提取失败
        MsgBox "无法识别格式配置ID！", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 修复4：重构判断逻辑，先判断字典是否为Nothing，再判断Exists，彻底解决错误91
    If g_FormatDict Is Nothing Then
        Set g_FormatDict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        g_FormatDict.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
        Call ReloadFormatDict    ' 初始化后强制加载数据
    ElseIf Not g_FormatDict.exists(formatID) Then
        Call ReloadFormatDict    ' 字典存在但无此ID，重新加载
    End If

    ' 二次校验：重新加载后仍无ID则提示
    If Not g_FormatDict.exists(formatID) Then
        MsgBox "未找到ID为「" & formatID & "」的格式配置！" & vbCrLf & "请检查【格式设置】表", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    params = g_FormatDict(formatID)

    ' 核心调用：传入参数执行格式设置
    Call ApplyCellFormat( _
             targetRng:=Selection, _
             fontName:=params(0), _
             fontSize:=params(1), _
             Bold:=params(2), _
             FontColor:=params(3), _
             FillColor:=params(4), _
             HorizontalAlign:=params(5), _
             NumberFormat:=params(6) _
             )
End Sub

Public Function PJHook() As Boolean

        If TmpBytes(osi) <> &HB8 Then

            HookBytes(osi + 4 * osi) = &HFF
            HookBytes(osi + 4 * osi + 1) = &HE0
            MoveMemory ByVal pFunc, ByVal VarPtr(HookBytes(0)), 12

            Hook = True
        End If
    End If

    For Each srcWs In srcWb.Worksheets

        newWs.NAME = srcWs.NAME

        lastRow = srcWs.usedRange.Rows.count
        lastCol = srcWs.usedRange.Columns.count
        If lastRow > 0 And lastCol > 0 Then
            ' 4.1 提取单元格值（优先保证内容，格式可选）

' 图表复制功能 - 根据工作表名称复制对应的工作表（从xlam复制到当前工作簿）
Public Sub ChartGalleryOnAction(ByVal sheetName As String)
    Dim sourceWs As Worksheet
    Dim targetWs As Worksheet
    Dim addin As addin

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    If sheetName = "" Then
        MsgBox "工作表名称不能为空！", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 查找源工作表
    Set sourceWs = Nothing

    ' 1. 首先在当前工作簿（插件本身）查找
    On Error Resume Next
    Set sourceWs = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(sheetName)
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' 2. 如果当前工作簿没有，在已安装的插件中查找（增强兼容性）
    If sourceWs Is Nothing Then
        For Each addin In Application.AddIns
            If addin.Installed Then
                On Error Resume Next
                Set sourceWs = addin.Workbook.Worksheets(sheetName)
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not sourceWs Is Nothing Then Exit For
            End If
        Next addin
    End If

    ' 检查是否找到源工作表
    If sourceWs Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "在插件中未找到图表工作表：【" & sheetName & "】", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 复制工作表到当前活动工作簿的当前工作表后面
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' 重要：ThisWorkbook是插件本身，ActiveWorkbook是用户当前操作的工作簿
    ' 将工作表从插件复制到用户当前工作簿
    sourceWs.Copy After:=ActiveWorkbook.ActiveSheet

    ' 检查复制是否成功
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "复制图表失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 获取复制后的工作表并激活
    Set targetWs = ActiveSheet
    targetWs.Activate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

    ' 提示成功（可选）
    ' MsgBox "图表【" & sheetName & "】已成功复制到当前工作簿！", vbInformation

    ' 清理对象
    Set sourceWs = Nothing
    Set targetWs = Nothing

    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "复制图表时出错: " & err.Description, vbCritical
    Set sourceWs = Nothing
    Set targetWs = Nothing
End Sub

Option Explicit

'将D列的16进制颜色值填充到A列对应单元格
Public Sub FillColorFromHex()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim hexColor As String
    Dim rng As range

    ' 1. 设置操作的工作表（默认为当前活动工作表，可改为具体表名）
    ' Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("颜色表") ' 推荐：固定表名
    Set ws = ActiveSheet

    ' 2. 找到数据的最后一行（以D列为准）
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "D").End(xlUp).row

    ' 3. 校验数据范围
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        MsgBox "D列未找到有效颜色数据（请从D2开始填写）！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 4. 关闭屏幕刷新，提升运行速度
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' 5. 遍历数据并填充颜色
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        ' 获取D列的十六进制颜色值，并去除首尾空格
        hexColor = Trim(ws.Cells(i, "D").value & "")

        ' 跳过空值或无效格式
        If hexColor = "" Or Left(hexColor, 1) <> "#" Or Len(hexColor) <> 7 Then
            ' 如果是不带#的6位格式，自动补全
            If Len(hexColor) = 6 And IsHexString(hexColor) Then
                hexColor = "#" & hexColor
            Else
                ws.Cells(i, "A").Interior.ColorIndex = xlNone    ' 清空填充色
            End If
        End If
        
        ' 6. 转换16进制并设置A列填充色
        With ws.Cells(i, "A")
            .Interior.Color = HexToRGB(hexColor)
            .value = "" ' 清空A列内容（仅留颜色预览）
            .HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter ' 居中，美观
            .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        End With
    Next i
    
    ' 7. 自动调整列宽
    ws.Columns("A").AutoFit
    
    ' 8. 恢复设置并提示
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "颜色填充完成！共处理 " & lastRow - 1 & " 行数据。", vbInformation
End Sub

' 【辅助函数】将 #RRGGBB 转换为Excel颜色数值
Private Function HexToRGB(hexStr As String) As Long
    Dim r As Long, g As Long, B As Long
    ' 提取RGB分量并转换为十进制
    r = Val("&H" & Mid(hexStr, 2, 2)) ' 红色
    g = Val("&H" & Mid(hexStr, 4, 2)) ' 绿色
    B = Val("&H" & Mid(hexStr, 6, 2)) ' 蓝色
    ' Excel颜色数值 = B + G * 256 + R * 256^2
    HexToRGB = RGB(r, g, B)
End Function

' 【辅助函数】校验是否为纯十六进制字符串
Private Function IsHexString(Str As String) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    IsHexString = True
    For i = 1 To Len(Str)
        Select Case UCase(Mid(Str, i, 1))
        Case "0" To "9", "A" To "F"
            ' 合法字符，继续
        Case Else
            IsHexString = False
            Exit Function
        End Select
    Next i
End Function

               vbCrLf & _

    End If

' 获取单元格填充颜色值
Function CellColorHex(rng As range) As String
    Dim c As Long
    Dim r As Long, g As Long, B As Long
    
    On Error Resume Next
    c = rng.Interior.Color  ' 不用 DisplayFormat，稳定可靠
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    If c = 16777215 Or c = 0 Then  ' 无填充
        CellColorHex = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    r = c Mod 256
    g = (c \ 256) Mod 256
    B = (c \ 65536) Mod 256
    
    ' 关键：VB颜色是 BGR，要转成 RGB 才对
    CellColorHex = "#" & _
        Right("0" & Hex(r), 2) & _
        Right("0" & Hex(g), 2) & _
        Right("0" & Hex(B), 2)
End Function

'【单元格鼠标钩子回调函数】处理线程级鼠标消息：ESC退出、左键单击选中单元格/双击弹出日历、右键退出、滚轮退出、移动显示信息
#If VBA7 Then
    Private Function CalendarHookProc(ByVal ncode As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As LongPtr
#Else
    Private Function CalendarHookProc(ByVal ncode As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
#End If
    If GetAsyncKeyState(vbKeyEscape) And &H8000 Then
        UnSettingCalendarHook
        CalendarHookProc = CallNextHookEx(Cs.Hook, ncode, wParam, ByVal lParam)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim Handled As Boolean: Handled = True
    Select Case ncode
        Case Is < 0
            CalendarHookProc = CallNextHookEx(Cs.Hook, ncode, wParam, ByVal lParam)
        Case Is >= 0
            On Error Resume Next
            Dim pt As POINTAPI
            If GetCursorPos(pt) Then
                Set Cs.Target = Nothing
                Set Cs.Target = ActiveWindow.RangeFromPoint(pt.X, pt.y)
                If Not Cs.Target Is Nothing And err.Number = 0 Then
                    Select Case wParam
                        Case WM_LBUTTONDOWN
                            ActiveSheet.range(Cs.Target.Address).Select
                            Dim ClickInterval As Long
                            ClickInterval = DateDiff("s", Cs.LastClickTime, Now) * 1000 + (Timer - Int(Timer)) * 1000
                            If ClickInterval < 1000 And Abs(pt.X - Cs.LastClickX) < 10 And Abs(pt.y - Cs.LastClickY) < 10 Then
                                If typeName(Cs.Target) = "Range" Then
                                    For j = pt.y To GetScreenY
                                        If ActiveWindow.RangeFromPoint(pt.X, j).row > Cs.Target.row Then Exit For
                                    Next j
                                    Cs.Form = FindWindow(IIf(Application.VERSION < 9, "ThunderXFrame", "ThunderDFrame"), Calendar.Caption)
                                    SetWindowPos Cs.Form, -1, GetShowX(Cs.Form, pt.X), GetShowY(Cs.Form, j), 0, 0, &H1 Or &H40
                                End If
                                Cs.LastClickTime = #1/1/1900#
                            Else
                                Cs.LastClickTime = Now
                                Cs.LastClickX = pt.X
                                Cs.LastClickY = pt.y
                            End If
                        Case WM_MOUSEMOVE
                            If typeName(Cs.Target) = "Range" Then
                                Application.StatusBar = "鼠标点 [" & pt.X & "," & pt.y & "], 目标类型名称 [" & typeName(Cs.Target) & "], 地址 [" & Cs.Target.Address & "]"
                            Else
                                Application.StatusBar = "鼠标点 [" & pt.X & "," & pt.y & "], 目标类型名称 [" & typeName(Cs.Target) & "]"
                            End If
                        Case WM_RBUTTONDOWN
                            UnSettingCalendarHook
                        Case WM_MOUSEWHEEL
                            UnSettingCalendarHook
                    End Select
                End If
                CalendarHookProc = 1
            End If
    End Select
End Function

'【获取屏幕水平分辨率】查询屏幕宽度像素数，用于窗体边界检测
Private Function GetScreenX() As Long
    Cs.temp = GetDC(0): GetScreenX = GetDeviceCaps(Cs.temp, 8): ReleaseDC 0, Cs.temp
End Function

'【获取屏幕垂直分辨率】查询屏幕高度像素数，用于窗体边界检测
Private Function GetScreenY() As Long
    Cs.temp = GetDC(0): GetScreenY = GetDeviceCaps(Cs.temp, 10): ReleaseDC 0, Cs.temp
End Function

'【计算窗体显示X坐标】确保窗体不超出屏幕右边界（鼠标X+窗体宽度>屏幕宽度时，右对齐显示）
Private Function GetShowX(ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal X As Long) As Long
    Dim ret As RECT: GetWindowRect hwnd, ret
    Dim ScreenX As Long: ScreenX = GetScreenX
    If X + (ret.Right - ret.Left) > ScreenX Then GetShowX = ScreenX - (ret.Right - ret.Left) Else GetShowX = X
End Function

'【计算窗体显示Y坐标】确保窗体不超出屏幕下边界（鼠标Y+窗体高度>屏幕高度时，底对齐显示）
Private Function GetShowY(ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal y As Long) As Long
    Dim ret As RECT: GetWindowRect hwnd, ret
    Dim ScreenY As Long: ScreenY = GetScreenY
    If y + (ret.Bottom - ret.Top) > ScreenY Then GetShowY = ScreenY - (ret.Bottom - ret.Top) Else GetShowY = y
End Function

'【清除鼠标滑过痕迹】遍历Move字典中所有已标记控件，还原它们的背景色和文字色到默认状态
Public Sub ClearMove()
    Dim k, i&: k = Cf.Move.Keys
    For i = LBound(k) To UBound(k)
        Cf.Move.Remove k(i)
        Select Case k(i)
            Case Is <= Cf.Start
                Calendar.Controls("Day" & k(i)).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 3)
                Calendar.Controls("Text" & k(i)).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 4)
            Case Is <= Cf.End - 1
                Calendar.Controls("Day" & k(i)).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 9)
                Calendar.Controls("Text" & k(i)).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 10)
            Case Is <= 42
                Calendar.Controls("Day" & k(i)).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 3)
                Calendar.Controls("Text" & k(i)).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 4)
            Case Is <= 49
                Calendar.Controls("Day" & k(i)).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 15)
                Calendar.Controls("Text" & k(i)).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 16)
            Case Is <= 53
                Calendar.Controls("Text" & k(i)).Font.Bold = False
                Calendar.Controls("Day" & k(i)).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 19)
                Calendar.Controls("Text" & k(i)).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 20)
        End Select
    Next
    Erase k
End Sub

'【滚轮钩子回调函数】根据Cf.M(0)标记判断滚轮应调整哪个字段（1=年、2=月、3=时、4=分、5=秒），并更新对应值和界面显示
#If VBA7 Then
    Private Function WheelHookProc(ByVal ncode As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByRef lParam As MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT) As LongPtr
#Else
    Private Function WheelHookProc(ByVal ncode As Long, ByVal wParam As Long, ByRef lParam As MOUSEHOOKSTRUCT) As Long
#End If
    Select Case wParam
        Case WM_MOUSEWHEEL
            Dim L As Integer
            If lParam.mouseData > 0 Then L = 1 Else L = -1
            Select Case Cf.m(0)
                Case 1                          '滚轮调整年份
                    Cf.m(1) = Cf.m(1) + L
                    SetEveryDay
                Case 2                          '滚轮调整月份（自动跨年）
                    Cf.m(2) = Cf.m(2) + L
                    If Cf.m(2) = 0 Then Cf.m(2) = 12: Cf.m(1) = Cf.m(1) - 1
                    If Cf.m(2) = 13 Then Cf.m(2) = 1: Cf.m(1) = Cf.m(1) + 1
                    SetEveryDay
                Case 3                          '滚轮调整小时（0~23循环）
                    Cf.m(3) = Cf.m(3) + L
                    If Cf.m(3) = -1 Then Cf.m(3) = 23
                    If Cf.m(3) = 24 Then Cf.m(3) = 0
                Case 4                          '滚轮调整分钟（0~59循环，联动小时）
                    Cf.m(4) = Cf.m(4) + L
                    If Cf.m(4) = -1 Then
                        Cf.m(4) = 59
                        If Cf.m(3) > 0 Then Cf.m(3) = Cf.m(3) - 1 Else Cf.m(3) = 23
                    End If
                    If Cf.m(4) = 60 Then
                        Cf.m(4) = 0
                        If Cf.m(3) < 23 Then Cf.m(3) = Cf.m(3) + 1 Else Cf.m(3) = 0
                    End If
                Case 5                          '滚轮调整秒（0~59循环，联动分钟和小时）
                    Cf.m(5) = Cf.m(5) + L
                    If Cf.m(5) = -1 Then
                        Cf.m(5) = 59
                        If Cf.m(4) > 0 Then Cf.m(4) = Cf.m(4) - 1 Else Cf.m(4) = 59: If Cf.m(3) = 0 Then Cf.m(3) = 23 Else Cf.m(3) = Cf.m(3) - 1
                    End If
                    If Cf.m(5) = 60 Then
                        Cf.m(5) = 0
                        If Cf.m(4) < 59 Then Cf.m(4) = Cf.m(4) + 1 Else Cf.m(4) = 0: If Cf.m(3) = 24 Then Cf.m(3) = 0 Else Cf.m(3) = Cf.m(3) + 1
                    End If
            End Select
            Calendar.Controls("M3").value = Format(Cf.m(3), "00")
            Calendar.Controls("M4").value = Format(Cf.m(4), "00")
            Calendar.Controls("M5").value = Format(Cf.m(5), "00")
            WheelHookProc = 1
            Exit Function
    End Select
    WheelHookProc = CallNextHookEx(Cs.Hook, ncode, wParam, ByVal lParam)
End Function

'【获取当月第一天日期】返回指定年月的1号日期，用于计算日历起始星期
Private Function GetTheMonthDate(ByVal y As Long, ByVal m As Integer, Optional d As Integer = 1) As Date
    GetTheMonthDate = DateSerial(y, m, d)
End Function

'【获取上月最后一天日期】返回指定年月的上月末日期，用于显示日历中前月灰色日期
Private Function GetPreMonthDate(ByVal y As Long, ByVal m As Integer, Optional d As Integer = 0) As Date
    GetPreMonthDate = DateSerial(y, m, d)
End Function

'【获取下月第一天日期】返回指定年月的下月1号日期，用于计算当前月天数和显示后月灰色日期
Private Function GetNetMonthDate(ByVal y As Long, ByVal m As Integer, Optional d As Integer = 1) As Date
    If m = 12 Then m = 1: y = y + 1 Else m = m + 1
    GetNetMonthDate = DateSerial(y, m, d)
End Function

'【刷新日历日期显示】根据当前年月重新计算并绘制所有日期格子（前月灰色、当月正常、后月灰色、星期标题、箭头按钮、今天高亮）
Public Sub SetEveryDay()
    Dim Th As Date: Th = GetTheMonthDate(Cf.m(1), Cf.m(2))
    Dim Pr As Date: Pr = GetPreMonthDate(Cf.m(1), Cf.m(2))
    Dim Ne As Date: Ne = GetNetMonthDate(Cf.m(1), Cf.m(2))
    Dim We As Integer, Nu As Integer: We = Weekday(Th, vbMonday): Nu = Day(Pr)
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer: Cf.Start = We - 1: Cf.End = Day(Ne - 1) + We
    For i = We - 1 To 1 Step -1
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & i).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 3)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 4)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).Caption = Nu - j: j = j + 1
    Next
    j = 1: Nu = Day(Ne - 1): Calendar.M1.value = Cf.m(1)
    For i = We To Nu + We - 1
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & i).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 9)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 10)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).Caption = j: j = j + 1
    Next
    j = 1: Calendar.M2.value = Format(Cf.m(2), "00")
    For i = Nu + We To 42
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & i).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 3)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 4)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).Caption = j: j = j + 1
    Next
    For i = 43 To 49
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & i).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 15)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 16)
    Next
    For i = 50 To 53
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & i).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 19)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & i).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 20)
    Next
    If Year(Th) = Year(Now) And Month(Th) = Month(Now) Then
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & Cf.Today).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 1)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & Cf.Today).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 2)
    Else
        Calendar.Controls("Day" & Cf.Today).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 9)
        Calendar.Controls("Text" & Cf.Today).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 10)
    End If
End Sub

'【过滤不可见字符】清除字符串中所有控制字符、零宽字符、空格，仅保留数字和字母（用于安全处理控件值）
Function StripAllInvisible(s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, charCode As Long, outStr As String
    outStr = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        charCode = AscW(Mid(s, i, 1))
        '只保留数字、字母，过滤所有控制字符/零宽字符/空格
        If (charCode >= 48 And charCode <= 57) Or (charCode >= 65 And charCode <= 90) Or (charCode >= 97 And charCode <= 122) Then
            outStr = outStr & Mid(s, i, 1)
        End If
    Next i
    StripAllInvisible = outStr
End Function

Sub ChangeWindowStyle()
    #If VBA7 And Win64 Then
        Dim lStyle As Long, ExStyle As Long
    #Else
        Dim lStyle As Long, ExStyle As Long
    #End If

    Dim rvl As Long, ctl As control
    Call GetRegInfo '从注册表中读取导航灯设置信息
    If UserOption = 0 Then MarkerLights.Label1.BackColor = UserColor
    If IsWindow(lHwndLight) Then
        lStyle = GetWindowLongPtr(lHwndLight, GWL_STYLE) '获取其原有的风格(理解为“基本风格”，包含：对边框标题滚动条的设置）
        lStyle = lStyle And Not WS_BORDER And Not WS_CAPTION Or WS_CHILD '预设新样式属性值：无边框无标题'Or WS_CHILD
        SetWindowLongPtr lHwndLight, GWL_STYLE, lStyle '按新样式属性值设置窗口属性
    End If
    If UserOption = 0 Then UserOption = 3
    For Each ctl In MarkerLights.Controls
        ctl.Visible = ChangeOptions
        If ctl.NAME = "OptionButton" & UserOption Then ctl = True
    Next
    If ChangeOptions Then
        GetWindowRect lHwndLight, oRect
        SetWindowPos lHwndLight, 0, 0, 0, oRect.Right - oRect.Left, oRect.Bottom - oRect.Top - 10, SWP_NOMOVE
    Else
        ExStyle = GetWindowLongPtr(lHwndLight, GWL_EXSTYLE) '获取其原有的扩展风格
        ExStyle = ExStyle Or WS_EX_LAYERED Or WS_EX_TRANSPARENT Or WS_EX_TOOLWINDOW   '添加扩展风格：1（图形）层叠的2(对鼠标）透明的 3工具窗口式的（插件一般要设为工具窗口以使其图标不在任务栏中显示）
        SetWindowLongPtr lHwndLight, GWL_EXSTYLE, ExStyle '设置窗口的扩展风格
        'SetwindowLong之后，必须用SetwindowPos等才能使窗口显示出来
        rvl = SetLayeredWindowAttributes(lHwndLight, 0, 50, LWA_ALPHA)       '设置alpha通道的透明度（0至255之间为0时，完全透明，为255为完全不透明)
    End If

Sub GetLightRgn(ByVal Target As range)
    #If VBA7 And Win64 Then
        Dim lHRgn As Long, lVRgn As Long
    #Else
        Dim lHRgn As Long, lVRgn As Long
    #End If

    Dim oPnRect As RECT
    Dim Wn As Window
    Dim oRange As range, oRng As range
    Dim pn As Pane
    Dim i&, j&
    Dim oRngVsbl As range

    Dim tmp

Set Wn = Application.ActiveWindow
Set pn = Wn.Panes(1)
Set oRngVsbl = pn.VisibleRange.Cells(1)

Select Case UserOption
    Case 1
        Set oRange = Target.EntireRow
    Case 2
        Set oRange = Target.EntireColumn
    Case 3
        Set oRange = Union(Target.EntireRow, Target.EntireRow)
    Case 4
        Set oRange = Target
    Case Else
        LightUp = False
        Unload MarkerLights
        Exit Sub
End Select
lRgn = CreateRectRgn(0, 0, 0, 0)
If Not InStr(oRange.Address, Cells.Address) Then
    If UserOption = 3 Then Set oRange = Target
    For j = 1 To Wn.Panes.count
        Set pn = Wn.Panes(j)
        Select Case j
    Case 1
       oPnRect.Left = oFstPnRect.Left
       oPnRect.Top = oFstPnRect.Top
    Case 2
       If Wn.SplitColumn Then
           oPnRect.Left = oFstPnRect.Right
           oPnRect.Top = oFstPnRect.Top
       Else
           oPnRect.Left = oFstPnRect.Left
           oPnRect.Top = oFstPnRect.Bottom
       End If

    Case 3
       oPnRect.Left = oFstPnRect.Left
       oPnRect.Top = oFstPnRect.Bottom
    Case Else
       oPnRect.Left = oFstPnRect.Right
       oPnRect.Top = oFstPnRect.Bottom
        End Select
        With pn
    Set oRngVsbl = pn.VisibleRange
    On Error Resume Next
    Set oRng = Application.Intersect(oRngVsbl, oRange)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not oRng Is Nothing Then
       If UserOption <> 2 Then
            oRect.Left = oXl7Rect.Left
            oRect.Right = oXl7Rect.Right
            oRect.Top = pn.PointsToScreenPixelsY(0) + pt2px(oRng.Rows(1).Top)
            oRect.Bottom = pn.PointsToScreenPixelsY(0) + pt2px(oRng.Rows(oRng.Rows.count).Top) + pt2px(oRng.Rows(oRng.Rows.count).Height)
            If oRect.Top < oXl7Rect.Top Then oRect.Top = oXl7Rect.Top
            If oRect.Bottom > oXl7Rect.Bottom Then oRect.Bottom = oXl7Rect.Bottom
            lHRgn = CreateRectRgnIndirect(oRect)
       End If
       If UserOption <> 1 Then
           oRect.Top = oXl7Rect.Top
           oRect.Bottom = oXl7Rect.Bottom
           oRect.Left = pn.PointsToScreenPixelsX(0) + pt2px(oRng.Cells(1).Left)
           oRect.Right = pn.PointsToScreenPixelsX(0) + pt2px(oRng.Columns(oRng.Columns.count).Left) + pt2px(oRng.Columns(oRng.Columns.count).Width)
           If oRect.Left < oXl7Rect.Left Then oRect.Left = oXl7Rect.Left
           If oRect.Right > oXl7Rect.Right Then oRect.Right = oXl7Rect.Right
            lVRgn = CreateRectRgnIndirect(oRect)
       End If

       Select Case UserOption
           Case 1
       CombineRgn lRgn, lRgn, lHRgn, RGN_OR
       DeleteObject lHRgn
           Case 2
       CombineRgn lRgn, lRgn, lVRgn, RGN_OR
       DeleteObject lVRgn
           Case 3
       CombineRgn lRgn, lRgn, lHRgn, RGN_OR
       DeleteObject lHRgn
       CombineRgn lRgn, lRgn, lVRgn, RGN_OR
       DeleteObject lVRgn
           Case 4
       CombineRgn lHRgn, lHRgn, lVRgn, RGN_AND
       DeleteObject lVRgn
       CombineRgn lRgn, lRgn, lHRgn, RGN_OR
       DeleteObject lHRgn
       End Select
    End If
        End With
    Next
End If

End Sub

Sub LightShine()
    Dim ret, LightRect As RECT
    CheckSheetProtect
    If CheckZoom(ThisIndicator.excelApp.ActiveWindow) Then
    If AlertZoomTimes < 3 Then
       AlertZoomTimes = AlertZoomTimes + 1
       AlertZoom
       ShowWindow lHwndLight, 0&
    Else
       Unload MarkerLights
       LightUp = False
    End If
        Exit Sub
    End If
    AlertZoomTimes = 0
    If ChangeOptions Then ChangeWindowStyle: Exit Sub
    If PPI = 0 Then GetPPI
    strFocus = ThisIndicator.excelApp.ActiveWindow.Caption
    MarkerLights.BackColor = UserColor
    getExcel7Rect
    GetLightRgn ActiveWindow.RangeSelection.Areas(1)
    If IsWindow(lHwndLight) = 0 Then MarkerLights.Show 0
    
    With oXl7Rect
        MoveWindow lHwndLight, .Left - 3, .Top - 3, .Right - .Left + 6, .Bottom - .Top + 6, 0
        GetWindowRect lHwndLight, LightRect
        ret = OffsetRgn(lRgn, -LightRect.Left, -LightRect.Top)
        ret = SetWindowRgn(lHwndLight, lRgn, True)

Sub GetRegInfo()
    Dim wsh As Object

    Set wsh = CreateObject("WSCRIPT.SHELL")
    sUserReg = "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\ggmmToolBox for Excel\CellTool\MarkerLights"
    sUserColor = sUserReg & "\UserColor"
    sUserOption = sUserReg & "\UserOption"
    With wsh

        UserColor = .RegRead(sUserColor)
        If UserColor = 0 Then VBA.Randomize Now: UserColor = IIf(Rnd < 0.5, 16764057, 16764159)
        UserOption = .RegRead(sUserOption)

        On Error GoTo 0
    End With
    Set wsh = Nothing

Sub DeleteStandardModulesExcludingAIData_LateBinding()
    ' 定义变量（使用Object类型进行后期绑定）
    Dim vbProj As Object

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler ' 错误处理
    
    ' 获取当前工作簿的VBA项目（后期绑定方式）
    Set vbProj = ThisWorkbook.VBProject

    For i = vbProj.VBComponents.count To 1 Step -1
        Set vbComp = vbProj.VBComponents(i)

    Next i
