Function ConvertVbaCodeToJsonString(vbaCode) As String
    ' 将VBA代码字符串转换为JSON兼容格式

    Dim result As String
    result = vbaCode  ' 初始化结果字符串
    
    ' 首先替换CRLF（Windows换行符）为\n
    ' 注意：vbCrLf是VBA常量，代表Chr(13) & Chr(10)（即CR+LF）
    result = Replace(result, vbCrLf, "\n")
    
    ' 然后替换剩余的单独回车符（CR, Chr(13)）为\n
    ' 健壮性考虑：处理Mac旧版本或个别情况下的单独CR
    result = Replace(result, vbCr, "\n")  ' vbCr等效于Chr(13)
    
    ' 最后替换剩余的单独换行符（LF, Chr(10)）为\n
    ' 健壮性考虑：处理Unix/Linux或新Mac系统中的单独LF
    result = Replace(result, vbLf, "\n")  ' vbLf等效于Chr(10)
    
    ' 替换所有双引号为转义序列\"
    ' 在VBA中，双引号在字符串内需用两个双引号表示（""），但这里替换为字面值\"
    ' 使用Chr(34)表示双引号字符，替换为"\"", 其中反斜杠是普通字符
    result = Replace(result, Chr(34), "\""")
    
    ' 返回处理后的字符串
    ConvertVbaCodeToJsonString = result
End Function

        ' 一次性写入整个数组到工作表
        .range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(2, 32)).Value2 = configArray
    End With

    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "初始化配置工作表时发生错误: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "错误"
End Sub

' 格式应用回调函数
' 功能：应用格式到选中的表格区域
Public Sub ApplyTableFormat(control As IRibbonControl)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim selectedRange As range
    Dim configDict As Object
    Dim configData As Variant
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim j As Long
    
    ' 获取当前活动工作表和选中区域
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    Set selectedRange = Selection
    
    ' 检查是否有选中区域
    If selectedRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选择要应用格式的表格区域", vbExclamation, "错误"
        GoTo line
    End If
    
    ' 获取配置数据
    Set configDict = GetConfigDictionary()
    
    ' 检查是否有配置数据
    If configDict Is Nothing Or configDict.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "没有可用的格式配置", vbExclamation, "错误"
        GoTo line
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False  ' 关闭屏幕刷新
    ' 获取当前选中的配置名称
    ' 这里假设当前配置是标记为"是"的配置
    Dim currentConfigName As String
    Dim configKey As Variant
    Dim configArray As Variant
    currentConfigName = "默认配置"
    
    For Each configKey In configDict.Keys
        configArray = configDict(configKey)
        If UBound(configArray) >= 31 Then ' 确保有32个元素
            If LCase(Trim(configArray(31))) = "是" Then ' AF列是第32个元素(索引31)
                currentConfigName = configKey
                Exit For
            End If
        End If
    Next configKey
    
    ' 获取选中配置的数据
    If configDict.exists(currentConfigName) Then
        configArray = configDict(currentConfigName)
    Else
        MsgBox "找不到配置: " & currentConfigName, vbExclamation, "错误"
        GoTo line
    End If
    
    ' 记录选中区域的行列信息
    Dim startRow As Long
    Dim endRow As Long
    Dim startCol As Integer
    Dim endCol As Integer
    
    startRow = selectedRange.row
    endRow = selectedRange.row + selectedRange.Rows.count - 1
    startCol = selectedRange.column
    endCol = selectedRange.column + selectedRange.Columns.count - 1
    
    ' 获取数据区域（排除表头）
    Dim dataRange As range
    Set dataRange = ws.range(ws.Cells(startRow + 1, startCol), ws.Cells(endRow, endCol))
    
    ' 第一步：对每列进行格式推测
    Call DetectColumnFormats(ws, dataRange, configArray)
    
    ' 第二步：应用表头格式
    Call ApplyHeaderFormat(ws, ws.range(ws.Cells(startRow, startCol), ws.Cells(startRow, endCol)), configArray)
    
    ' 第三步：应用内容格式
    Call ApplyContentFormat(ws, dataRange, configArray)
    
    ' 第四步：应用边框样式
    Call ApplyBorderFormat(ws, selectedRange, configArray)
    
    ' 第五步：应用行列宽
    Call ApplyRowColumnFormat(ws, selectedRange, configArray)
    
    MsgBox "格式应用完成", vbInformation, "成功"
    
    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "应用格式时发生错误: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "错误"
line:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True ' 重新打开屏幕刷新
End Sub

' 辅助函数：获取配置字典
' 功能：从格式配置工作表获取配置数据
' 参数：无
' 返回：配置字典
Function GetConfigDictionary() As Object
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Dim ws As Variant
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim configData As Variant
    Dim configName As String
    
    ' 创建字典对象
    Set GetConfigDictionary = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 获取格式配置工作表
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("格式配置")
    
    ' 获取最后一行数据，第一列可能是空的，要从第二列b列向上查找最大行。
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "B").End(xlUp).row
    
    ' 一次性读取所有数据到数组
    configData = ws.range("A2:AF" & lastRow).value
    
    ' 遍历数据，填充字典
    For i = LBound(configData, 1) To UBound(configData, 1)
        configName = Trim(configData(i, 2)) ' B列：配置名称
        If configName <> "" Then
            ' 将整行数据作为值存储
            GetConfigDictionary.Add configName, Array( _
                configData(i, 1), configData(i, 2), configData(i, 3), configData(i, 4), configData(i, 5), _
                configData(i, 6), configData(i, 7), configData(i, 8), configData(i, 9), configData(i, 10), _
                configData(i, 11), configData(i, 12), configData(i, 13), configData(i, 14), configData(i, 15), _
                configData(i, 16), configData(i, 17), configData(i, 18), configData(i, 19), configData(i, 20), _
                configData(i, 21), configData(i, 22), configData(i, 23), configData(i, 24), configData(i, 25), _
                configData(i, 26), configData(i, 27), configData(i, 28), configData(i, 29), configData(i, 30), _
                configData(i, 31), configData(i, 32))
        End If
    Next i
    
    Exit Function
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "读取配置数据失败: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "错误"
    Set GetConfigDictionary = Nothing
End Function

' 辅助函数：列格式推测
' 功能：推测每列的数据格式
' 参数：ws - 工作表，range - 数据区域，configArray - 配置数组
' 返回：无
Private Sub DetectColumnFormats(ws As Worksheet, range As range, configArray As Variant)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim j As Long
    
    lastRow = range.row + range.Rows.count - 1
    lastCol = range.column + range.Columns.count - 1
    
    ' 获取配置选项 - 修复配置索引不匹配问题
    Dim detectThousands As Boolean
    Dim detectPercent As Boolean
    Dim textToNum As Boolean
    Dim detectDate As Boolean
    Dim decimalPlaces As Integer
    Dim noDecimalForLarge As Boolean
    
    detectThousands = CBool(configArray(25)) ' 检测千位分隔符 - 第26列配置
    detectPercent = CBool(configArray(26)) ' 检测百分数 - 第27列配置
    textToNum = CBool(configArray(27)) ' 文本转数值 - 第28列配置
    detectDate = CBool(configArray(28)) ' 检测日期 - 第29列配置
    decimalPlaces = CInt(configArray(29)) ' 数值小数位数 - 第30列配置
    noDecimalForLarge = CBool(configArray(30)) ' 大数不显示小数 - 第31列配置
    
    ' 一次性将包含表头的选择区域全载入数组
    Dim fullArray As Variant
    fullArray = range.value
    
    ' 获取数组维度
    Dim arrayRows As Long
    Dim arrayCols As Integer
    arrayRows = UBound(fullArray, 1)
    arrayCols = UBound(fullArray, 2)
    
    ' 遍历每一列（从第1列到最后一列）
    For i = 1 To arrayCols
        ' 获取对应的工作表列号
        Dim currentCol As Integer
        currentCol = range.column + i - 1
        
        ' 定义内容区域的range
        Dim contentRange As range
        Dim hasContent As Boolean
        hasContent = (arrayRows >= 1) ' 当数组行数大于等于1时，表示有内容区域

        If hasContent Then
            ' 内容区域从第一行开始（range的第一行就是内容的第一行）
            Set contentRange = ws.range(ws.Cells(range.row, currentCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, currentCol))
        End If
        
        ' 定义临时数组用于存储当前列的数据（用于文本转数值处理）
        Dim currentColumnData As Variant
        ReDim currentColumnData(1 To arrayRows, 1 To 1)
        
        ' 第一步：文本转数值处理（如果需要） - 在数组中进行转换
        If textToNum Then
            Dim hasValidConversion As Boolean
            hasValidConversion = False

            ' 构建转换后的数组
            For j = 1 To arrayRows
                Dim originalValue As Variant
                originalValue = fullArray(j, i)

                If Not IsEmpty(originalValue) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    Dim convertedValue As Variant
                    convertedValue = CDbl(originalValue)
                    If err.Number = 0 Then
                        currentColumnData(j, 1) = convertedValue
                        hasValidConversion = True
                    Else
                        currentColumnData(j, 1) = originalValue ' 转换失败，保留原值
                    End If
                    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
                Else
                    currentColumnData(j, 1) = originalValue
                End If
            Next j

            ' 只有在有有效转换时才写入，避免数据丢失
            If hasValidConversion Then
                ' 只将转换后的内容区域写回
                If hasContent Then
                    ' 将转换后的数组从第一行开始写回内容区域
                    Dim contentArray As Variant
                    ReDim contentArray(1 To arrayRows, 1 To 1)
                    For j = 1 To arrayRows
                        contentArray(j, 1) = currentColumnData(j, 1)
                    Next j
                    ws.range(ws.Cells(range.row, currentCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, currentCol)).value = contentArray
                End If
                ' 更新fullArray中的数据
                For j = 1 To arrayRows
                    fullArray(j, i) = currentColumnData(j, 1)
                Next j
            End If
        End If
        
        ' 格式检测相关变量
        Dim isDateColumn As Boolean
        Dim isPercentColumn As Boolean
        Dim isNumberColumn As Boolean
        Dim sampleCount As Integer
        Dim dateCount As Integer
        Dim percentCount As Integer
        Dim numberCount As Integer
        Dim over100Count As Integer
        
        isDateColumn = False
        isPercentColumn = False
        isNumberColumn = False
        sampleCount = 0
        dateCount = 0
        percentCount = 0
        numberCount = 0
        over100Count = 0
        
        ' 第二步：检测列格式 - 从第一行开始，处理所有内容区域
        Dim maxSampleRows As Long
        maxSampleRows = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(arrayRows, 10) ' 采样前10行内容
        For j = 1 To maxSampleRows ' 从第一行开始采样
            If j <= arrayRows Then
                Dim cellValue As Variant
                cellValue = fullArray(j, i)
                
                If Not IsEmpty(cellValue) Then
                    sampleCount = sampleCount + 1
                    
                    ' 检测日期：100%符合特征
                    If detectDate Then
                        If IsDate(cellValue) Then
                            dateCount = dateCount + 1
                        End If
                    End If
                    
                    ' 检测数值和百分比
                    Dim NumericValue As Double
                    Dim isNumericCell As Boolean
                    
                    If IsNumeric(cellValue) Then
                        isNumericCell = True
                        NumericValue = CDbl(cellValue)
                        numberCount = numberCount + 1
                        
                        ' 检测百分比：放宽条件，100%以上分布在0-1
                        If detectPercent Then
                            If NumericValue > 0 And NumericValue < 1 Then
                                percentCount = percentCount + 1
                            End If
                        End If
                        
                        ' 统计超过100的数值数量
                        If NumericValue > 100 Then
                            over100Count = over100Count + 1
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            End If
        Next j
        
        ' 第三步：判断列格式
        If sampleCount > 0 Then
            ' 日期：100%以上符合特征
            If detectDate And dateCount / sampleCount = 1 Then
                isDateColumn = True
            ' 百分比：100%以上分布在0-1
            ElseIf detectPercent And percentCount / sampleCount = 1 Then
                isPercentColumn = True
            ' 数值：至少有一个数值
            ElseIf numberCount > 0 Then
                isNumberColumn = True
            End If
        End If
        
        ' 第四步：应用格式 - 只应用到内容区域（第二行及以后）
        Dim formatString As String
        
        ' 获取对齐方式配置 - 修复配置索引
        Dim textAlign As String
        Dim numAlign As String
        Dim dateAlign As String
        
        textAlign = CStr(configArray(21)) ' 文本对齐方式 - 第22列配置
        numAlign = CStr(configArray(22)) ' 数值对齐方式 - 第23列配置
        dateAlign = CStr(configArray(23)) ' 日期对齐方式 - 第24列配置
        
        ' 只有当存在内容区域时才应用格式
        If hasContent Then
            If isDateColumn Then
                ' 在数组中完成日期转换，提高性能
                
                Dim dateArray As Variant
                dateArray = contentRange.value
                
                ' 检查dateArray是否为数组，处理单行/单个单元格的情况
                If IsArray(dateArray) Then
                    ' 遍历数组转换日期
                    Dim rowIndex As Long
                    For rowIndex = LBound(dateArray, 1) To UBound(dateArray, 1)
                        If Not IsEmpty(dateArray(rowIndex, 1)) Then
                            ' 确保将文本转换为真正的日期类型
                            If IsDate(dateArray(rowIndex, 1)) Then
                                ' 先转换为日期类型
                                dateArray(rowIndex, 1) = CDate(dateArray(rowIndex, 1))
                            End If
                        End If
                    Next rowIndex
                    contentRange.NumberFormat = "yyyy/m/d"
                    ' 一次性写回单元格
                    contentRange.value = dateArray
                Else
                    ' 单个单元格的情况
                    If Not IsEmpty(dateArray) Then
                        If IsDate(dateArray) Then
                            contentRange.NumberFormat = "yyyy/m/d"
'                            Debug.Print CDate(dateArray)
                        ' 应用日期格式，使用反斜杠转义斜杠，确保格式正确显示
                            contentRange.value = CDate(dateArray)
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
                
                
                
                ' 设置对齐方式
                Select Case LCase(Trim(dateAlign))
                    Case "左对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
                    Case "居中对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    Case "右对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                    Case Else: contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                End Select
            ElseIf isPercentColumn Then
                ' 应用百分数格式
                If decimalPlaces >= 0 Then ' 当小数位数为负数时，不调整小数位格式
                    If decimalPlaces = 0 Then
                        ' 小数位数为0时，不显示小数点
                        formatString = "0%"
                    Else
                        ' 显示指定小数位
                        formatString = "0." & String(decimalPlaces, "0") & "%"
                    End If
                    contentRange.NumberFormat = formatString
                End If
                
                ' 设置对齐方式（跟数值对齐方式一致）
                Select Case LCase(Trim(numAlign))
                    Case "左对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
                    Case "居中对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    Case "右对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                    Case Else: contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                End Select
            ElseIf isNumberColumn Then
                ' 计算超过100的数值比例
                Dim over100Ratio As Double
                If numberCount > 0 Then
                    over100Ratio = over100Count / numberCount
                Else
                    over100Ratio = 0
                End If
                
                ' 构建数值格式字符串
                If decimalPlaces >= 0 Then ' 当小数位数为负数时，不调整小数位格式
                    If decimalPlaces = 0 Then
                        formatString = "0"
                    Else
                        formatString = "0." & String(decimalPlaces, "0")
                    End If
                    
                    ' 只有当样本数量足够多（至少3行）且超过50%的数值大于100时，才应用大数不显示小数
                    If noDecimalForLarge And over100Ratio > 0.5 And numberCount >= 3 Then
                        ' 超过50%的数值大于100且配置了大数不显示小数
                        formatString = "0"
                    End If
                    
                    ' 添加千位分隔符
                    If detectThousands Then
                        If InStr(formatString, ".") > 0 Then
                            ' 包含小数位，在整数部分添加千位分隔符
                            formatString = Replace(formatString, "0.", "#,##0.")
                        Else
                            ' 整数格式，直接添加千位分隔符
                            formatString = "#,##0"
                        End If
                    End If
                    
                    contentRange.NumberFormat = formatString
                End If
                
                ' 设置对齐方式
                Select Case LCase(Trim(numAlign))
                    Case "左对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
                    Case "居中对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    Case "右对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                    Case Else: contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                End Select
            Else
                ' 文本格式，仅设置对齐方式
                contentRange.NumberFormat = "@" ' 文本格式
                
                Select Case LCase(Trim(textAlign))
                    Case "左对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
                    Case "居中对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    Case "右对齐": contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
                    Case Else: contentRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
                End Select
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "在检测列格式时发生错误: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "错误"
    Resume Next
End Sub

' 辅助函数：应用表头格式
' 功能：应用表头格式
' 参数：ws - 工作表，range - 表头区域，configArray - 配置数组
' 返回：无
Private Sub ApplyHeaderFormat(ws As Worksheet, range As range, configArray As Variant)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' 设置字体
    range.Font.NAME = CStr(configArray(2)) ' 表头字体
    range.Font.size = CInt(configArray(3)) ' 表头字体大小
    range.Font.Bold = CBool(configArray(4)) ' 表头加粗
    range.Font.Color = CLng(configArray(5)) ' 表头字体颜色
    range.Interior.Color = CLng(configArray(6)) ' 表头背景色
    
    ' 设置对齐方式
    Dim HorizontalAlign As String
    HorizontalAlign = CStr(configArray(24)) ' 水平对齐方式
    
    Select Case LCase(Trim(HorizontalAlign))
        Case "左对齐": range.HorizontalAlignment = xlLeft
        Case "居中对齐": range.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
        Case "右对齐": range.HorizontalAlignment = xlRight
        Case Else: range.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    End Select
    
    range.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
    range.WrapText = True
    
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 辅助函数：应用内容格式
' 功能：应用内容格式
' 参数：ws - 工作表，range - 内容区域，configArray - 配置数组
' 返回：无
Private Sub ApplyContentFormat(ws As Worksheet, range As range, configArray As Variant)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' 设置字体
    range.Font.NAME = CStr(configArray(7)) ' 内容字体
    range.Font.size = CInt(configArray(8)) ' 内容字体大小
    range.Font.Bold = CBool(configArray(9)) ' 内容加粗
    range.Font.Color = CLng(configArray(10)) ' 内容字体颜色

    ' 设置背景色
    Dim contentBgColor As Variant
    Dim alternateBgColor As Variant

    ' 获取背景色配置
    contentBgColor = configArray(11) ' 内容背景色
    alternateBgColor = configArray(12) ' 内容间隔背景色
    
    ' 检查间隔背景色是否设置，16777215(RGB(255,255,255))映射为xlNone
    If IsEmpty(alternateBgColor) Or alternateBgColor = 16777215 Then
        ' 间隔背景色未设置，统一设置所有行的背景色
        If IsEmpty(contentBgColor) Or contentBgColor = 16777215 Then
            ' 内容背景色为RGB(255,255,255)，设置为无背景色
            range.Interior.pattern = xlNone
        Else
            ' 设置内容背景色
            range.Interior.Color = CLng(contentBgColor)
            range.Interior.pattern = xlSolid
        End If
    Else
        ' 间隔背景色已设置，不使用条件格式，直接设置奇偶行背景色
        ' 清除所有背景色相关的条件格式
        On Error Resume Next
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = range.FormatConditions.count To 1 Step -1
            If range.FormatConditions(i).Interior.pattern <> xlNone Then
                range.FormatConditions(i).Delete
            End If
        Next i
        On Error GoTo 0

        ' 直接设置奇偶行背景色，确保用户可以手动调整
        ' 清除所有背景色相关的条件格式
        Call ClearAllBackgroundConditions(range)

        Dim row As range
        For Each row In range.Rows
            If row.row Mod 2 = 1 Then
                ' 奇数行：使用间隔背景色
                If IsEmpty(alternateBgColor) Or alternateBgColor = 16777215 Then
                    row.Interior.pattern = xlNone
                Else
                    row.Interior.Color = CLng(alternateBgColor)
                    row.Interior.pattern = xlSolid
                End If
            Else
                ' 偶数行：使用内容背景色
                If IsEmpty(contentBgColor) Or contentBgColor = 16777215 Then
                    row.Interior.pattern = xlNone
                Else
                    row.Interior.Color = CLng(contentBgColor)
                    row.Interior.pattern = xlSolid
                End If
            End If
        Next row
    End If
    
    ' 设置垂直对齐
    range.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
    
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 辅助函数：清除背景色条件格式
Private Sub ClearAllBackgroundConditions(range As range)
    On Error Resume Next

    ' 彻底清除所有条件格式
    range.FormatConditions.Delete

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 辅助函数：应用边框样式
' 功能：应用边框样式
' 参数：ws - 工作表，range - 区域，configArray - 配置数组
' 返回：无
Private Sub ApplyBorderFormat(ws As Worksheet, range As range, configArray As Variant)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' 获取边框配置
    Dim innerBorderStyle As Integer
    Dim innerBorderColor As Long
    Dim outerBorderStyle As Integer
    Dim outerBorderColor As Long
    
    innerBorderStyle = GetBorderStyleValueFromDescription(CStr(configArray(13))) ' 内边框样式
    innerBorderColor = CLng(configArray(14)) ' 内边框颜色
    outerBorderStyle = GetBorderStyleValueFromDescription(CStr(configArray(15))) ' 外边框样式
    outerBorderColor = CLng(configArray(16)) ' 外边框颜色
    
    ' 应用内边框
    range.Borders(xlInsideHorizontal).LineStyle = innerBorderStyle
    range.Borders(xlInsideHorizontal).Color = innerBorderColor
    range.Borders(xlInsideVertical).LineStyle = innerBorderStyle
    range.Borders(xlInsideVertical).Color = innerBorderColor
    
    ' 应用外边框
    range.Borders(xlEdgeTop).LineStyle = outerBorderStyle
    range.Borders(xlEdgeTop).Color = outerBorderColor
    range.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).LineStyle = outerBorderStyle
    range.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).Color = outerBorderColor
    range.Borders(xlEdgeLeft).LineStyle = outerBorderStyle
    range.Borders(xlEdgeLeft).Color = outerBorderColor
    range.Borders(xlEdgeRight).LineStyle = outerBorderStyle
    range.Borders(xlEdgeRight).Color = outerBorderColor
    
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 辅助函数：应用行列宽
' 功能：应用行列宽
' 参数：ws - 工作表，range - 区域，configArray - 配置数组
' 返回：无
Private Sub ApplyRowColumnFormat(ws As Worksheet, range As range, configArray As Variant)
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' 设置行高
    Dim rowHeight As Double
    rowHeight = CDbl(configArray(17)) ' 行高
    range.rowHeight = rowHeight
    
    ' 设置列宽
    Dim autoWidth As Boolean
    Dim autoWidthAdd As Double
    Dim fixedWidth As Double
    
    autoWidth = CBool(configArray(18)) ' 自动列宽
    autoWidthAdd = CDbl(configArray(19)) ' 自动列宽额外宽度
    fixedWidth = CDbl(configArray(20)) ' 固定列宽
    
    If autoWidth Then
        ' 自动列宽，最宽不超过40
        range.Columns.AutoFit
        
        Dim column As range
        For Each column In range.Columns
            If column.ColumnWidth > 40 Then
                column.ColumnWidth = 40
            Else
                ' 增加额外宽度
                column.ColumnWidth = column.ColumnWidth + autoWidthAdd
            End If
        Next column
    Else
        ' 固定列宽
        range.ColumnWidth = fixedWidth
    End If
    
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 1. 字符串分割并返回指定部分
Function UDF_SplitPart(ByVal txt As String, Optional ByVal Delim As String = ",", Optional ByVal Index As Long = 1) As String
    ' 功能：按分隔符拆分字符串并返回第Index部分（从1开始）
    Dim arr() As String
    If Len(txt) = 0 Then Exit Function
    arr = Split(txt, Delim)
    If Index >= 1 And Index <= UBound(arr) + 1 Then
        UDF_SplitPart = arr(Index - 1)
    End If
End Function

' 2. 正则提取函数
Function UDF_RegexExtract(ByVal txt As String, ByVal pattern As String, _
                          Optional ByVal GroupIndex As Long = 0, _
                          Optional ByVal MatchIndex As Long = 1) As String
    ' 功能：用正则表达式提取指定匹配和分组内容
    ' 参数：
    '   Txt：要匹配的文本
    '   Pattern：正则表达式
    '   GroupIndex：分组序号（0=完整匹配，1=第一个分组，依次类推）
    '   MatchIndex：第几个匹配（默认1，第一个）
    ' 返回：匹配到的字符串；若未匹配到则返回空字符串
    
    Dim re As Object, MC As Object, m As Object
    
    If Len(txt) = 0 Or Len(pattern) = 0 Then Exit Function
    
    Set re = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
    re.pattern = pattern
    re.Global = True
    re.IgnoreCase = True
    
    If re.test(txt) Then
        Set MC = re.Execute(txt)
        If MatchIndex >= 1 And MatchIndex <= MC.count Then
            Set m = MC(MatchIndex - 1)
            ' 判断分组是否存在
            If GroupIndex >= 0 And GroupIndex <= m.SubMatches.count Then
                If GroupIndex = 0 Then
                    UDF_RegexExtract = m.value
                Else
                    UDF_RegexExtract = m.SubMatches(GroupIndex - 1)
                End If
            Else
                UDF_RegexExtract = m.value
            End If
        End If
    End If
End Function


' 3. 正则替换
Function UDF_RegexReplace(ByVal txt As String, ByVal pattern As String, ByVal ReplaceTxt As String) As String
    ' 功能：用正则表达式替换匹配内容
    Dim re As Object
    If Len(txt) = 0 Then Exit Function
    Set re = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
    re.pattern = pattern
    re.Global = True
    re.IgnoreCase = True
    UDF_RegexReplace = re.Replace(txt, ReplaceTxt)
End Function

' 4. 统计某字符出现次数
Function UDF_CountChar(ByVal txt As String, ByVal char As String) As Long
    ' 功能：统计某个字符在字符串中出现的次数
    If Len(char) = 0 Then Exit Function
    UDF_CountChar = Len(txt) - Len(Replace(txt, char, ""))
End Function

' 5. 反转字符串
Function UDF_ReverseText(ByVal txt As String) As String
    ' 功能：将字符串反转
    Dim i As Long
    For i = Len(txt) To 1 Step -1
        UDF_ReverseText = UDF_ReverseText & Mid(txt, i, 1)
    Next
End Function

' 6. 提取数字
Function UDF_ExtractNumbers(ByVal txt As String) As String
    ' 功能：提取字符串中的所有数字
    Dim i As Long, ch As String
    For i = 1 To Len(txt)
        ch = Mid(txt, i, 1)
        If ch >= "0" And ch <= "9" Then UDF_ExtractNumbers = UDF_ExtractNumbers & ch
    Next
End Function

' 7. 提取字母
Function UDF_ExtractLetters(ByVal txt As String) As String
    ' 功能：提取字符串中的所有字母
    Dim i As Long, ch As String
    For i = 1 To Len(txt)
        ch = Mid(txt, i, 1)
        If (ch >= "A" And ch <= "Z") Or (ch >= "a" And ch <= "z") Then
            UDF_ExtractLetters = UDF_ExtractLetters & ch
        End If
    Next
End Function

' 8. 单元格区域拼接
Function UDF_JoinRange(ByVal rng As range, Optional ByVal Delim As String = ",") As String
    ' 功能：将区域内所有单元格内容拼接成一个字符串
    Dim cell As range
    For Each cell In rng
        If Len(cell.value) > 0 Then
            UDF_JoinRange = UDF_JoinRange & cell.value & Delim
        End If
    Next
    If Len(UDF_JoinRange) > 0 Then UDF_JoinRange = Left(UDF_JoinRange, Len(UDF_JoinRange) - Len(Delim))
End Function

' 9. 判断是否为质数
Function UDF_IsPrime(ByVal Num As Long) As Boolean
    ' 功能：判断一个数是否为质数
    Dim i As Long
    If Num < 2 Then Exit Function
    For i = 2 To Sqr(Num)
        If Num Mod i = 0 Then Exit Function
    Next
    UDF_IsPrime = True
End Function

' 10. 返回季度
Function UDF_GetQuarter(dateValue As Date, style As Integer) As Variant
    ' 功能：根据日期返回季度信息，支持三种不同的显示样式
    ' 参数：
    '   - DateValue: 输入的日期，应为有效的日期格式
    '   - Style: 返回样式代码（1=返回数值，2=返回"Q1"格式，3=返回中文如"一季度"）
    ' 返回值：根据Style参数返回对应的季度信息，错误时返回#VALUE!
    ' 作者：基于VBA最佳实践及搜索结果优化
    ' 参考：[1,2,4](@ref)
    ' 日期：2025-10-02
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler ' 启用错误处理，增强健壮性
    
    ' 参数验证：检查Style参数是否在有效范围内（1-3）
    If style < 1 Or style > 3 Then
        UDF_GetQuarter = CVErr(xlErrValue)
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim monthValue As Integer
    Dim QuarterNum As Integer
    
    monthValue = Month(dateValue) ' 使用Month函数提取月份[1,5](@ref)
    
    ' 核心逻辑：根据月份确定季度（1-4月为Q1，5-8月为Q2，9-12月为Q3和Q4）
    Select Case monthValue
        Case 1 To 3
            QuarterNum = 1
        Case 4 To 6
            QuarterNum = 2
        Case 7 To 9
            QuarterNum = 3
        Case 10 To 12
            QuarterNum = 4
        Case Else
            ' 月份值应在1-12之间，此分支为防御性编程
            UDF_GetQuarter = CVErr(xlErrValue)
            Exit Function
    End Select
    
    ' 根据Style参数返回对应格式的季度信息
    Select Case style
        Case 1
            ' 样式1：返回数值（如 1, 2, 3, 4）
            UDF_GetQuarter = QuarterNum
        Case 2
            ' 样式2：返回"Q1"格式（如 Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4）
            UDF_GetQuarter = "Q" & QuarterNum
        Case 3
            ' 样式3：返回中文季度名称（如 一季度, 二季度）[6](@ref)
            Select Case QuarterNum
                Case 1
                    UDF_GetQuarter = "一季度"
                Case 2
                    UDF_GetQuarter = "二季度"
                Case 3
                    UDF_GetQuarter = "三季度"
                Case 4
                    UDF_GetQuarter = "四季度"
            End Select
    End Select
    
    Exit Function ' 正常退出，避免进入错误处理流程

ErrorHandler:
    ' 错误处理：返回Excel错误值#VALUE!
    UDF_GetQuarter = CVErr(xlErrValue)
End Function

' 11. 获取星期几（中文）
Function UDF_WeekDayCN(ByVal Dt As Date) As String
    ' 功能：返回日期对应的中文星期
    Dim arr
    arr = Array("日", "一", "二", "三", "四", "五", "六")
    UDF_WeekDayCN = "星期" & arr(Weekday(Dt, vbSunday) - 1)
End Function

' 12. 获取工作日天数
Function UDF_WorkDays(ByVal startDate As Date, ByVal endDate As Date) As Long
    ' 功能：计算两个日期之间的工作日天数（不含周六日）
    Dim d As Date
    If endDate < startDate Then Exit Function
    For d = startDate To endDate
        If Weekday(d, vbMonday) <= 5 Then UDF_WorkDays = UDF_WorkDays + 1
    Next
End Function

' 13. 获取唯一值数量
Function UDF_UniqueCount(ByVal rng As range) As Long
    ' 功能：统计区域内唯一值的数量
    Dim dict As Object, cell As range
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For Each cell In rng
        If Len(cell.value) > 0 Then
            If Not dict.exists(CStr(cell.value)) Then dict.Add CStr(cell.value), 1
        End If
    Next
    UDF_UniqueCount = dict.count
End Function

' 14. 判断是否为回文
Function UDF_IsPalindrome(ByVal txt As String) As Boolean
    ' 功能：判断字符串是否为回文
    UDF_IsPalindrome = (StrComp(txt, UDF_ReverseText(txt), vbTextCompare) = 0)
End Function

' 15. 获取最大公约数
Function UDF_GCD(ByVal A As Long, ByVal B As Long) As Long
    ' 功能：计算两个数的最大公约数
    Do While B <> 0
        Dim t As Long
        t = B
        B = A Mod B
        A = t
    Loop
    UDF_GCD = A
End Function

' 16. 获取最小公倍数
Function UDF_LCM(ByVal A As Long, ByVal B As Long) As Long
    ' 功能：计算两个数的最小公倍数
    If A = 0 Or B = 0 Then Exit Function
    UDF_LCM = A * B / UDF_GCD(A, B)
End Function

' 17. 生成随机字符串
Function UDF_RandomString(ByVal Length As Long) As String
    ' 功能：生成指定长度的随机字母数字字符串
    Dim i As Long, chars As String
    Randomize
    chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
    For i = 1 To Length
        UDF_RandomString = UDF_RandomString & Mid(chars, Int(Rnd() * Len(chars)) + 1, 1)
    Next
End Function

' 18. 获取文本字节长度
Function UDF_ByteLen(ByVal txt As String) As Long
    ' 功能：返回字符串的字节长度（区分中英文）
    UDF_ByteLen = LenB(StrConv(txt, vbFromUnicode))
End Function

Function UDF_EmailDomain(ByVal Email As String) As String
    ' 功能：提取邮箱地址的域名部分
    If InStr(Email, "@") > 0 Then
        UDF_EmailDomain = Mid(Email, InStr(Email, "@") + 1)
    End If

' 20. 判断是否为数字（严格）
Function UDF_IsNumberStrict(ByVal txt As String) As Boolean
    ' 功能：严格判断字符串是否为纯数字
    If txt Like "*[!0-9]*" Or txt = "" Then
        UDF_IsNumberStrict = False
    Else
        UDF_IsNumberStrict = True
    End If
End Function

' 21. 获取单元格文本的最后一个单词
Function UDF_LastWord(ByVal txt As String, Optional ByVal Delim As String = " ") As String
    ' 功能：返回字符串中最后一个分隔符后的内容
    Dim arr() As String
    If Len(txt) = 0 Then Exit Function
    arr = Split(txt, Delim)
    UDF_LastWord = arr(UBound(arr))

' 22. 获取文本中第一个数字串
Function UDF_FirstNumber(ByVal txt As String) As String
    ' 功能：提取字符串中第一个连续数字
    Dim i As Long, tmp As String, ch As String
    For i = 1 To Len(txt)
        ch = Mid(txt, i, 1)
        If ch >= "0" And ch <= "9" Then
            tmp = tmp & ch
        ElseIf Len(tmp) > 0 Then
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
    UDF_FirstNumber = tmp
End Function

' 23. 判断单元格是否为空或仅包含空格
Function UDF_IsBlankStrict(ByVal txt As String) As Boolean
    ' 功能：判断字符串是否为空或仅包含空格
    UDF_IsBlankStrict = (Len(Trim(txt)) = 0)
End Function

' 24. 计算文本中单词数量
Function UDF_WordCount(ByVal txt As String) As Long
    ' 功能：统计字符串中的单词数量（以空格分隔）
    Dim arr() As String
    txt = Trim(txt)
    If Len(txt) = 0 Then Exit Function
    arr = Split(txt, " ")
    UDF_WordCount = UBound(arr) - LBound(arr) + 1
End Function

' 25. 获取日期所在季度
Function UDF_Quarter(ByVal Dt As Date) As Long
    ' 功能：返回日期所在季度（1-4）
    UDF_Quarter = Int((Month(Dt) - 1) / 3) + 1

' 26. 计算两个日期之间的月数差
Function UDF_MonthDiff(ByVal startDate As Date, ByVal endDate As Date) As Long
    ' 功能：返回两个日期之间的完整月数差
    UDF_MonthDiff = DateDiff("m", startDate, endDate)

' 27. 获取区域内最大文本长度
Function UDF_MaxTextLen(ByVal rng As range) As Long
    ' 功能：返回区域内最长字符串的长度
    Dim cell As range
    For Each cell In rng
        If Len(cell.value) > UDF_MaxTextLen Then UDF_MaxTextLen = Len(cell.value)
    Next

' 28. 判断文本是否包含子串（忽略大小写）
Function UDF_Contains(ByVal txt As String, ByVal SubTxt As String) As Boolean
    ' 功能：判断字符串是否包含指定子串（不区分大小写）
    If InStr(1, txt, SubTxt, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then UDF_Contains = True
End Function

' 29. 获取区域内数值的中位数
Function UDF_Median(ByVal rng As range) As Double
    ' 功能：计算区域内数值的中位数
    Dim arr() As Double, cell As range, i As Long, j As Long, tmp As Double
    Dim cnt As Long
    For Each cell In rng
        If IsNumeric(cell.value) Then
            ReDim Preserve arr(cnt)
            arr(cnt) = cell.value
            cnt = cnt + 1
        End If
    Next
    If cnt = 0 Then Exit Function
    ' 排序（简单冒泡）
    For i = 0 To cnt - 2
        For j = i + 1 To cnt - 1
            If arr(i) > arr(j) Then
                tmp = arr(i): arr(i) = arr(j): arr(j) = tmp
            End If
        Next
    Next
    ' 取中位数
    If cnt Mod 2 = 1 Then
        UDF_Median = arr(cnt \ 2)
    Else
        UDF_Median = (arr(cnt \ 2 - 1) + arr(cnt \ 2)) / 2
    End If
End Function

' 30. 将文本首字母大写（类似PROPER，但更简洁）
Function UDF_Capitalize(ByVal txt As String) As String
    ' 功能：将字符串首字母大写，其余保持不变
    If Len(txt) > 0 Then
        UDF_Capitalize = UCase(Left(txt, 1)) & Mid(txt, 2)
    End If
End Function

' 选择单个单元格或者单列（图片url），转化展示图片
Sub UrlToImage(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim Sel As range
    Dim inputStr As String
    Dim parts() As String
    Dim rowHeight As Double, colWidth As Double
    Dim cell As range
    Dim targetRange As range
    Dim pic As Picture
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim processedCount As Integer

    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请选择单元格或单列范围。", vbExclamation
        GoTo CleanExit
    End If
    
    Set Sel = Selection
    
    ' 检查选择范围：单个单元格或单列
    If Sel.Cells.count = 1 Then
        ' 单个单元格
        Set targetRange = Sel
    ElseIf Sel.Columns.count = 1 And Sel.Areas.count = 1 Then
        ' 单列选择，只处理已使用区域内的单元格
        Set targetRange = Intersect(Sel, ActiveSheet.usedRange)
        If targetRange Is Nothing Then
            MsgBox "选择范围内没有已使用的单元格。", vbInformation
            GoTo CleanExit
        End If
    Else
        MsgBox "请选择单个单元格或单列区域（不能选择多列）。", vbExclamation
        GoTo CleanExit
    End If
    
    ' 获取用户输入的行高和列宽
    inputStr = InputBox("请输入行高和列宽，格式为: 行高,列宽" & vbCrLf & _

                        "备注: 如果不知道如何设置，可以先转化单个图看效果再调整。" & vbCrLf & _
                        "输入行高和列宽", "图片所在单元格行高与列宽设置", "200,40")
    
    If inputStr = "" Then
        MsgBox "操作已取消。", vbInformation
        GoTo CleanExit
    End If
    
    ' 验证输入格式
    parts = Split(inputStr, ",")
    If UBound(parts) <> 1 Then
        MsgBox "输入格式错误，请使用'行高,列宽'的格式（用逗号分隔）。", vbExclamation
        GoTo CleanExit
    End If
    
    ' 转换为数值
    On Error Resume Next
    rowHeight = CDbl(Trim(parts(0)))
    colWidth = CDbl(Trim(parts(1)))
    If err.Number <> 0 Or rowHeight <= 0 Or colWidth <= 0 Then
        MsgBox "行高和列宽必须是大于0的数字。", vbExclamation
        GoTo CleanExit
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 设置行高和列宽
    If Sel.Cells.count = 1 Then
        ' 单个单元格：设置所在行和列
        Sel.EntireRow.rowHeight = rowHeight
        Sel.EntireColumn.ColumnWidth = colWidth
    Else
        ' 单列：设置整列宽度，并设置每个已使用行的行高
        Sel.EntireColumn.ColumnWidth = colWidth
        For Each cell In targetRange.Cells
            cell.EntireRow.rowHeight = rowHeight
        Next cell
    End If
    processedCount = 0
    
    ' 处理每个单元格
    For Each cell In targetRange.Cells
        ' 跳过空单元格或错误值单元格
        If IsEmpty(cell) Or IsError(cell) Then GoTo NextCell
        
        ' 检查是否为有效URL（简单验证）
        validURL = False
        If InStr(1, cell.value, "http", vbTextCompare) = 1 Then
            validURL = True
        ElseIf InStr(1, cell.value, ".jpg") > 0 Or _
               InStr(1, cell.value, ".jpeg") > 0 Or _
               InStr(1, cell.value, ".png") > 0 Or _
               InStr(1, cell.value, ".gif") > 0 Then
            validURL = True
        End If
        
        If validURL Then
            ' 尝试插入图片
            On Error Resume Next
            Set pic = ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(cell.value)
            If err.Number <> 0 Then
                ' 插入失败，跳过此单元格
                On Error GoTo 0
            Else
                On Error GoTo 0
                ' 调整图片大小和位置以适应单元格[2](@ref)
                With pic
                    .Top = cell.Top
                    .Left = cell.Left
                    .Height = cell.Height
                End With
                processedCount = processedCount + 1
            End If
        End If
NextCell:
    Next cell
    ' 恢复选择
    Sel.Select
    MsgBox "图片转换完成！成功处理 " & processedCount & " 个图片。", vbInformation
    
CleanExit:
    ' 恢复设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
End Sub

Option Explicit
Public Sub ShiftNode(TargetTV As TreeView, TargetNode As Node, MoveMode As TreeRelationshipConstants)
    Dim newNode As Node
    '首先，我们在MoveMode参数中指定的位置添加一个新节点
    Select Case MoveMode
        Case tvwFirst
            If TargetNode.Previous Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            Set newNode = TargetTV.Nodes.Add(TargetNode.FirstSibling, tvwFirst)
        Case tvwPrevious
            If TargetNode.Previous Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            Set newNode = TargetTV.Nodes.Add(TargetNode.Previous, tvwPrevious)
        Case tvwNext
            If TargetNode.Next Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            Set newNode = TargetTV.Nodes.Add(TargetNode.Next, tvwNext)
        Case tvwLast
            If TargetNode.Next Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
            Set newNode = TargetTV.Nodes.Add(TargetNode.LastSibling, tvwLast)
        Case Else
            Exit Sub
    End Select
    '将所有属性复制到新节点
    CopyNodeAttrributes TargetNode, newNode
    If newNode.Children <> 0 Then newNode.Tag = "节点"
    '如果节点有任何子节点被移动，我们也需要复制这些子节点
    If TargetNode.Children <> 0 Then IterateChildren TargetTV, TargetNode, newNode
    '最后我们删除原始节点
    TargetTV.Nodes.Remove TargetNode.Index
    Set TargetTV.DropHighlight = newNode '高亮显示移动后项目
    Set TargetNode = Nothing
End Sub
Public Sub IterateChildren(tv As TreeView, TargetNode As Node, ParentNode As Node)
'复制所有子节点
    Dim z As Long
    Dim newNode As Node
    Dim TargetChild As Node
    '循环遍历每个子节点
    Set TargetChild = TargetNode.Child
    For z = 1 To TargetNode.Children
        '将子节点添加到我们的新节点
        Set newNode = tv.Nodes.Add(ParentNode, tvwChild)
        '将它的所有属性复制到新的孩子
        CopyNodeAttrributes TargetChild, newNode
        '如果孩子自己有孩子，那么也要孩子
        If TargetChild.Children <> 0 Then IterateChildren tv, TargetChild, newNode
        '把我们的目标换成下一个孩子
        Set TargetChild = TargetChild.Next
    Next
End Sub
Public Sub CopyNodeAttrributes(TargetNode As Node, newNode As Node)
    'Copies the attributes of one node to another node
    '为了兼容性这里使用了低版本treeview,注释掉部分属性在sp6以上版本才存在
    With TargetNode
        'We need to change it's key before we use it again
        .key = "TemporaryNodeKey" & .key
        newNode.key = Right(.key, Len(.key) - 16) ' NewNode.FullPath ' '后面是保留原key,这里使用全路径作为key
        'newNode.BackColor = .BackColor
        'newNode.Bold = .Bold
        'newNode.Checked = .Checked
        newNode.Expanded = .Expanded
        'newNode.ExpandedImage = .ExpandedImage
        'newNode.ForeColor = .ForeColor
        'newNode.Image = .Image
        'newNode.Selected = .Selected
        'newNode.SelectedImage = .SelectedImage
        newNode.Tag = .Tag
        newNode.Text = .Text
    End With
End Sub
Public Sub MoveNode(TargetTV As TreeView, TargetNode As Node, PositionNode As Node)
'同级或者降级移动节点
    Dim newNode As Node
    'Firstly we add a new node in the position specified in the MoveMode parameter
    If TargetNode Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If TargetNode.Index = PositionNode.Index Then Exit Sub '位置没动则直接退出
    If TargetNode.key = PositionNode.Parent.key Then
        MsgBox "不要移动自己下级", vbOKOnly: Exit Sub  '目标位置是选定项的下级无法移动,父亲不能比儿子地位低啊！
    Else
    If NodeException(TargetNode) Then Exit Sub
    If NodeException(PositionNode) Then Exit Sub
    End If
    'If PositionNode.Children = 0 Then MsgBox "不要移动到非节点下", vbOKOnly: Exit Sub
        '限制只能在移动到同级或者上级节点,如果移动到非节点的下级则会将原来有代码的命令变为无代码的节点
    Set newNode = TargetTV.Nodes.Add(PositionNode.key, tvwNext)
    'Copy all of it's attributes to the new node
    CopyNodeAttrributes TargetNode, newNode
    'If there are any children of the node being moved we need to copy those as well
    If TargetNode.Children <> 0 Then IterateChildren TargetTV, TargetNode, newNode
    'Finally we remove the original node
    TargetTV.Nodes.Remove TargetNode.Index
    Set TargetTV.DropHighlight = newNode '高亮显示移动后项目
    Set TargetNode = Nothing
End Sub
Public Sub TvSerialNumber(tv As TreeView, TargetNode As Node)
'依次遍历所有节点,每个节点子项从1开始顺序编号
    Dim i As Long, arr
    Dim newNode As Node
    Dim TargetChild As Node
    'On Error Resume Next
    'Cycle through each of the child nodes
    If TargetNode.Children = 0 Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set TargetChild = TargetNode.Child
    For i = 1 To TargetNode.Children
        'If the child has children itself then get those too
        If NodeLevel(TargetChild) > 2 Then '一二级分类不编号
            arr = Split(TargetChild.Text, " ")
            TargetChild.Text = i & " " & arr(UBound(arr))
            TargetChild.key = TargetChild.fullPath
        End If
        If TargetChild.Children <> 0 Then
            TargetChild.Tag = "节点"
            TvSerialNumber tv, TargetChild
        End If
        'Change our target to the next child
        Set TargetChild = TargetChild.Next
    Next
End Sub
Public Sub NodeOutPut(TargetNode As Node, rng As range, iR As Long)
'依次遍历所有节点,输出到rng
    Dim i As Long, arr
    Dim newNode As Node
    Dim TargetChild As Node
    'Cycle through each of the child nodes
    Set TargetChild = TargetNode.Child
    For i = 1 To TargetNode.Children
        'If the child has children itself then get those too
        rng.Cells(iR, 1) = TargetChild.fullPath
        rng.Cells(iR, 2) = TargetChild.Tag
        iR = iR + 1
        If TargetChild.Children <> 0 Then
            rng.Cells(iR - 1, 2) = "节点" '节点处不存储代码
            NodeOutPut TargetChild, rng, iR
        End If
        'Change our target to the next child
        Set TargetChild = TargetChild.Next
    Next
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "Z关键词提取"
Option Explicit
'=
' 模块：通用关键词提取（XLAM 插件通用版）
' 功能：从单元格文本中提取用户自定义的关键词
'       关键词完全由用户维护，不限于颜色
'       支持通配符 *（代表任意字符）
' 使用：
'   步骤1 → 选择关键词字典区域（每个单元格一个词，如 A1:A50）
'   步骤2 → 点击要处理的数据列的任意单元格
'   结果自动写入该列右侧一列
' 通配符说明：
'   "*底*字"  →  匹配"黑底白字"、"灰底黑字"等
'   "PET*"     →  匹配以"PET"开头的文本片段
'   "*哑油"    →  匹配以"哑油"结尾的文本片段
' 主过程：通用关键词提取
Sub ExtractKeywords_General()

    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set wb = Application.ActiveWorkbook
    If wb Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "没有打开的工作簿！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set ws = wb.ActiveSheet

    ' ----- 步骤1：选择关键词字典区域 -----
    Dim dictRng As range
    On Error Resume Next
    Set dictRng = Application.InputBox( _
        "步骤 1/2：选择【关键词字典】区域" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "请框选存放关键词的单元格区域，" & vbCrLf & _
        "每个单元格写一个关键词，" & vbCrLf & _
        "如：A1=黑底白字  A2=哑黑色  A3=PET" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "支持通配符：用 * 代表任意字符（如 ""*底*字""）", _
        "通用关键词提取", _
        Selection.Address, Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If dictRng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未选择关键词区域，操作取消。", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ----- 读取关键词到数组 -----
    Dim dictArr As Variant
    dictArr = dictRng.value

    Dim kwRaw() As String
    Dim kwCount As Long
    kwCount = 0

    Dim r As Long, c As Long
    For r = 1 To UBound(dictArr, 1)
        For c = 1 To UBound(dictArr, 2)
            If Trim(CStr(dictArr(r, c))) <> "" Then
                ReDim Preserve kwRaw(0 To kwCount)
                kwRaw(kwCount) = Trim(CStr(dictArr(r, c)))
                kwCount = kwCount + 1
            End If
        Next c
    Next r

    If kwCount = 0 Then
        MsgBox "关键词区域为空！请填入关键词后重试。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' ----- 按长度降序排序（长词优先匹配）-----
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, temp As String
    For i = 0 To kwCount - 2
        For j = i + 1 To kwCount - 1
            If Len(kwRaw(j)) > Len(kwRaw(i)) Then
                temp = kwRaw(i)
                kwRaw(i) = kwRaw(j)
                kwRaw(j) = temp
            End If
        Next j
    Next i

    ' ----- 构建正则模式 -----
    Dim pattern As String
    pattern = BuildRegexPattern(kwRaw, kwCount)

    Dim regEx As Object
    Set regEx = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
    regEx.Global = True
    regEx.IgnoreCase = True
    regEx.pattern = pattern

    ' ----- 步骤2：选择要处理的数据列 -----
    Dim srcCol As range
    On Error Resume Next
    Set srcCol = Application.InputBox( _
        "步骤 2/2：选择【要处理的数据列】" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "点击该列的任意单元格即可，" & vbCrLf & _
        "提取结果将写入该列右侧一列", _
        "通用关键词提取", _
        "A1", Type:=8)
    On Error GoTo 0
    If srcCol Is Nothing Then
'        MsgBox "未选择数据列，操作取消。", vbInformation
        Set regEx = Nothing
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim srcColNum As Long
    srcColNum = srcCol.column
    Dim destColNum As Long
    destColNum = srcColNum + 1

    ' ----- 输入结果列标题 -----
    Dim colTitle As String
    colTitle = InputBox( _
        "请输入结果列的标题名称：" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "（如：颜色、材料、型号等）", _
        "通用关键词提取", _
        "关键词")
    If colTitle = "" Then colTitle = "关键词"

    ' ----- 确定数据范围 -----
    Dim dataStartRow As Long
    dataStartRow = srcCol.row

    Dim dataEndRow As Long
    dataEndRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, srcColNum).End(xlUp).row

    If dataEndRow < dataStartRow Then
        MsgBox "数据列为空！", vbExclamation
        Set regEx = Nothing
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim rowCount As Long
    rowCount = dataEndRow - dataStartRow + 1

    ' ----- 批量读取数据到数组 -----
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.EnableEvents = False

    Dim dataArr As Variant
    dataArr = ws.range(ws.Cells(dataStartRow, srcColNum), _
                        ws.Cells(dataEndRow, srcColNum)).value

    ' ----- 批量处理 -----
    Dim resultArr() As Variant
    ReDim resultArr(1 To rowCount, 1 To 1)

    Dim k As Long
    Dim cellText As String
    Dim extracted As String
    Dim kwTracker As String
    Dim hasMatch As Boolean
    Dim matches As Object
    Dim m As Long

    For k = 1 To rowCount
        cellText = Trim(CStr(dataArr(k, 1)))
        If cellText = "" Then
            resultArr(k, 1) = ""
            GoTo SkipRow
        End If

        kwTracker = "、"
        extracted = ""
        hasMatch = False

        If regEx.test(cellText) Then
            Set matches = regEx.Execute(cellText)
            For m = 0 To matches.count - 1
                Dim hit As String
                hit = RestoreAsterisk(matches(m).value, kwRaw, kwCount)
                ' 去重
                If InStr(1, kwTracker, "、" & hit & "、") = 0 Then
                    kwTracker = kwTracker & hit & "、"
                    If hasMatch Then extracted = extracted & "、"
                    extracted = extracted & hit
                    hasMatch = True
                End If
            Next m
        End If

        resultArr(k, 1) = extracted
SkipRow:
    Next k

    ' ----- 写入结果 -----
    ws.range(ws.Cells(dataStartRow, destColNum), _
              ws.Cells(dataEndRow, destColNum)).ClearContents

    ws.range(ws.Cells(dataStartRow, destColNum), _
              ws.Cells(dataEndRow, destColNum)).value = resultArr

    ' 写入列标题
    ws.Cells(dataStartRow, destColNum).value = colTitle

    ' 自适应列宽
    ws.Columns(destColNum).AutoFit

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.EnableEvents = True

    ' ----- 完成提示 -----
    Dim srcLetter As String
    srcLetter = Split(ws.Cells(1, srcColNum).Address(True, False), "$")(0)
    Dim destLetter As String
    destLetter = Split(ws.Cells(1, destColNum).Address(True, False), "$")(0)

    MsgBox "关键词提取完成！" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
           "关键词字典：" & dictRng.Address(False, False) & "（" & kwCount & " 个词）" & vbCrLf & _
           "源数据列：" & srcLetter & " 列" & vbCrLf & _
           "结果列：" & destLetter & " 列（标题：""" & colTitle & """）" & vbCrLf & _
           "共处理 " & rowCount & " 行", vbInformation

    Set regEx = Nothing
End Sub


' 辅助函数1：构建正则模式
' 将关键词数组转换为正则模式字符串
' 支持 * 作为通配符（转换为 .*）
' 对其他正则特殊字符进行转义
Private Function BuildRegexPattern(kw() As String, count As Long) As String

    Dim patterns() As String
    ReDim patterns(0 To count - 1)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 0 To count - 1
        Dim raw As String
        raw = kw(i)

        ' 检查是否包含通配符 *
        If InStr(1, raw, "*") > 0 Then
            Dim converted As String
            converted = ConvertWildcard(raw)
            patterns(i) = "(" & converted & ")"
        Else
            ' 无通配符：转义正则特殊字符后作为字面量匹配
            patterns(i) = "(" & EscapeRegex(raw) & ")"
        End If
    Next i

    BuildRegexPattern = Join(patterns, "|")
End Function


' 辅助函数2：将用户通配符表达式转换为正则
' 用户 * → 正则 .*
' 同时转义其他正则特殊字符
Private Function ConvertWildcard(raw As String) As String

    Dim result As String
    result = ""

    Dim i As Long
    Dim ch As String
    For i = 1 To Len(raw)
        ch = Mid(raw, i, 1)
        If ch = "*" Then
            result = result & ".*"
        ElseIf ch = "." Or ch = "^" Or ch = "$" Or ch = "+" Or _
               ch = "?" Or ch = "[" Or ch = "]" Or ch = "(" Or _
               ch = ")" Or ch = "{" Or ch = "}" Or ch = "|" Or _
               ch = "\" Then
            result = result & "\" & ch
        Else
            result = result & ch
        End If
    Next i

    ConvertWildcard = result
End Function

' 辅助函数3：转义正则特殊字符（无通配符时使用）
Private Function EscapeRegex(raw As String) As String

    Dim result As String
    result = ""

    Dim i As Long
    Dim ch As String
    For i = 1 To Len(raw)
        ch = Mid(raw, i, 1)
        If ch = "." Or ch = "^" Or ch = "$" Or ch = "*" Or _
           ch = "+" Or ch = "?" Or ch = "[" Or ch = "]" Or _
           ch = "(" Or ch = ")" Or ch = "{" Or ch = "}" Or _
           ch = "|" Or ch = "\" Then
            result = result & "\" & ch
        Else
            result = result & ch
        End If
    Next i

    EscapeRegex = result
End Function


' 辅助函数4：将正则匹配结果还原为用户原始关键词
'（因为 * 被转换成了 .*，匹配结果需要映射回原词）
' 优先返回最长匹配的原词
Private Function RestoreAsterisk(matchedText As String, kw() As String, count As Long) As String
    ' 先尝试直接在原词列表中查找完全匹配的
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 0 To count - 1
        If InStr(1, kw(i), "*") = 0 Then
            If StrComp(kw(i), matchedText, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                RestoreAsterisk = kw(i)
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' 含通配符的原词：尝试匹配
    For i = 0 To count - 1
        If InStr(1, kw(i), "*") > 0 Then
            Dim patt As String
            patt = "^" & ConvertWildcard(kw(i)) & "$"
            Dim regTest As Object
            Set regTest = CreateObject("VBScript.RegExp")
            regTest.IgnoreCase = True
            regTest.pattern = patt
            If regTest.test(matchedText) Then
                RestoreAsterisk = kw(i)
                Set regTest = Nothing
                Exit Function
            End If
            Set regTest = Nothing
        End If
    Next i

    ' 都匹配不上就返回原匹配文本
    RestoreAsterisk = matchedText
End Function

    ColumnLetter = Split(ws.Cells(1, colNum).Address(True, False), "$")(0)

Attribute VB_Name = "Z工作表操作"
Sub OPEN_创建工作表目录()
    Dim sht As Worksheet
    Dim xrow As Integer
    Dim targetWB As Workbook
    Dim newSheet As Worksheet
    Dim dirSheetName As String

    ' 获取目标工作簿（用户当前操作的工作簿，而非插件）
    Set targetWB = GetTargetWorkbook()
    If targetWB Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "未检测到可操作的工作簿", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' 在目标工作簿中创建目录工作表
    Set newSheet = targetWB.Worksheets.Add(Before:=targetWB.Worksheets(1))

    On Error Resume Next
    newSheet.NAME = "目录"
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        newSheet.NAME = "目录_总页"
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    dirSheetName = newSheet.NAME
    newSheet.usedRange.ClearContents

    xrow = 2
    newSheet.Cells(xrow - 1, "A").value = "序号"
    newSheet.Cells(xrow - 1, "B").value = "子表名称"

    For Each sht In targetWB.Worksheets
        If sht.NAME <> dirSheetName And sht.Visible = xlSheetVisible Then
            newSheet.Cells(xrow, "A").value = xrow - 1
            newSheet.Hyperlinks.Add Anchor:=newSheet.Cells(xrow, "B"), _
                Address:="", SubAddress:="'" & sht.NAME & "'!A1", _
                TextToDisplay:=sht.NAME
            xrow = xrow + 1
        End If
    Next

    ' 格式化
    With newSheet.range("A1:B5000")
        .NumberFormatLocal = "G/通用格式"
        .Font.NAME = "等线"
    End With
    newSheet.range("A1:A5000").HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    newSheet.range("B:B").Columns.AutoFit
    newSheet.Activate
    ActiveWindow.DisplayGridlines = False
    newSheet.range("A1").Select

    ' 向目标工作簿添加返回目录过程
    Call AddReturnToDirectoryProcedure(targetWB)

    ' 创建返回按钮（传递目标工作簿和目录表名称）
    Call 创建表格目录返回链接(targetWB, dirSheetName)

'    MsgBox "子表的目录已生成！", , "操作提示！"
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

' 辅助函数：获取目标工作簿
Private Function GetTargetWorkbook() As Workbook
    Dim wb As Workbook

    ' 方法1：如果选中了单元格，使用该单元格所在的工作簿
    On Error Resume Next
    If typeName(Selection) = "Range" Then
        Set wb = Selection.Parent.Parent
        If Not wb Is Nothing Then
            If wb.NAME <> ThisWorkbook.NAME Then
                Set GetTargetWorkbook = wb
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' 方法2：遍历所有打开的工作簿，找到第一个不是插件的工作簿
    For Each wb In Application.Workbooks
        If wb.NAME <> ThisWorkbook.NAME Then
            Set GetTargetWorkbook = wb
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next

    ' 方法3：使用 ActiveWorkbook（但排除插件自身）
    If ActiveWorkbook.NAME <> ThisWorkbook.NAME Then
        Set GetTargetWorkbook = ActiveWorkbook
    End If
End Function

' 检查指定工作簿中是否存在某个公共过程
Private Function ProcedureExists(wb As Workbook, procName As String) As Boolean
    Dim moduleName As String
    Dim lineNum As Long
    Dim lineText As String
    Dim comp As Object

    On Error Resume Next
    For Each comp In wb.VBProject.VBComponents
        If comp.Type = 1 Or comp.Type = 2 Then  ' 标准模块或类模块
            With comp.codeModule
                lineNum = .CountOfDeclarationLines + 1
                Do While lineNum < .CountOfLines
                    lineText = .lines(lineNum, 1)
                    If InStr(1, lineText, "Sub " & procName & "(", vbTextCompare) > 0 Or _
                       InStr(1, lineText, "Public Sub " & procName & "(", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                        ProcedureExists = True
                        Exit Function
                    End If
                    lineNum = lineNum + 1
                Loop
            End With
        End If
    Next comp
End Function

' 向目标工作簿中添加返回目录过程
Private Sub AddReturnToDirectoryProcedure(wb As Workbook)
    Dim newModule As Object
    Dim moduleName As String
    Dim code As String

    ' 要写入的代码
    code = ""
    code = code & "Public Sub 返回目录()" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    Dim sht As Worksheet" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    On Error Resume Next" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    Set sht = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(""目录"")" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    If sht Is Nothing Then Set sht = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(""目录_总页"")" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    On Error GoTo 0" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    If Not sht Is Nothing Then" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "        Application.Goto sht.Range(""A1""), Scroll:=True" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "        sht.Activate" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    Else" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "        MsgBox ""当前工作簿中没有找到「目录」或「目录_总页」工作表"", vbInformation" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "    End If" & vbCrLf
    code = code & "End Sub" & vbCrLf

    ' 检查是否已存在该过程
    If ProcedureExists(wb, "返回目录") Then
        ' 已存在，不需要添加
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 添加模块
    On Error Resume Next
    Set newModule = wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(1)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "无法添加模块，请检查宏安全设置：需要勾选「信任对VBA工程对象模型的访问」", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    moduleName = "mod目录工具"
    newModule.NAME = moduleName
    newModule.codeModule.AddFromString code

    ' 强制编译，使宏立即生效
    On Error Resume Next
    wb.VBProject.VBE.CommandBars.ExecuteMso "Compile"
    Application.VBE.CommandBars.ExecuteMso "Compile"
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' 或者使用更简单的方法：触发一次保存
    wb.Save

'    MsgBox "已在当前工作簿中添加「返回目录」代码模块", vbInformation
End Sub

'删除非第一行外的所有行
Sub DeleteNonSelected_Rows()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim selectedRange As range
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim rowsToDelete As range
    Dim selectedRows As Collection
    Dim cell As range
    Dim j As Long

    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    Set selectedRange = Selection
    Set selectedRows = New Collection

    '获取所有选中的行号
    For Each cell In selectedRange
        On Error Resume Next
        selectedRows.Add cell.row, CStr(cell.row)
        On Error GoTo 0
    Next cell

    '从最后一行开始向上遍历（避免删除时行号变化）
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).row

    For i = lastRow To 2 Step -1    '从最后一行到第2行
        Dim rowIsSelected As Boolean
        rowIsSelected = False

        '检查当前行是否在选中行集合中
        For j = 1 To selectedRows.count
            If i = selectedRows(j) Then
                rowIsSelected = True
                Exit For
            End If
        Next j

        '如果行未被选中且不是第一行，则标记为删除
        If Not rowIsSelected Then
            If rowsToDelete Is Nothing Then
                Set rowsToDelete = ws.Rows(i)
            Else
                Set rowsToDelete = Union(rowsToDelete, ws.Rows(i))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    '删除标记的行
    If Not rowsToDelete Is Nothing Then
        rowsToDelete.Delete
    End If

    '修复：使用更可靠的方法定位到A1单元格
    ws.Activate
    Application.GoTo Reference:=ws.range("A1"), Scroll:=True

ErrorHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.EnableEvents = True

    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "发生错误: " & err.Description, vbCritical
    End If
End Sub

' 功能：将当前工作簿的每个工作表拆分为一个独立的工作簿
' 按钮：拆分为多个工作簿
' 优化点：
' 1. 关闭屏幕更新、自动计算和事件处理，提高性能
' 2. 简化工作表复制逻辑，直接复制工作表到新工作簿
' 3. 优化错误处理，避免掩盖问题
' 4. 减少对象创建和销毁，提高内存使用效率
' 5. 在活动工作簿目录下创建以工作簿名称命名的文件夹，用于保存拆分后的文件
Public Sub SplitEachSheetToWorkbook(control As IRibbonControl)
    ' 保存当前应用程序设置
    Dim originalScreenUpdating As Boolean
    Dim originalCalculation As XlCalculation
    Dim originalEnableEvents As Boolean
    Dim originalDisplayAlerts As Boolean

    ' 记录原始设置
    originalScreenUpdating = Application.ScreenUpdating
    originalCalculation = Application.Calculation
    originalEnableEvents = Application.EnableEvents
    originalDisplayAlerts = Application.DisplayAlerts

    ' 关闭不必要的功能以提高性能
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim srcWorkbook As Workbook
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim savePath As String
    Dim folderName As String
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim fileName As String

    ' 获取当前工作簿
    Set srcWorkbook = ActiveWorkbook

    ' 获取当前工作簿的保存路径
    savePath = srcWorkbook.path
    If savePath = "" Then
        ' 如果工作簿未保存，提示用户先保存
        MsgBox "请先保存当前工作簿，然后再执行拆分操作。", vbInformation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If

    ' 获取当前工作簿名称（不带扩展名）
    folderName = Left(srcWorkbook.NAME, InStrRev(srcWorkbook.NAME, ".") - 1)

    ' 创建文件夹路径
    folderPath = savePath & "\" & folderName

    ' 检查文件夹是否存在，如果不存在则创建
    If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        MkDir folderPath
    End If

    ' 遍历每个工作表
    For Each ws In srcWorkbook.Worksheets
        ' 直接复制工作表到新工作簿（这会自动创建一个新工作簿）
        ws.Copy

        ' 设置新工作簿的文件名，保存到新建的文件夹中
        fileName = folderPath & "\" & ws.NAME & ".xlsx"

        ' 保存并关闭新工作簿
        With ActiveWorkbook
            .SaveAs fileName:=fileName, fileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook
            .Close SaveChanges:=False
        End With
    Next ws

    ' 提示用户操作完成
    MsgBox "工作表拆分完成！所有工作表已保存到 " & folderPath & " 文件夹中。", vbInformation + vbOKOnly, "提示"

Cleanup:
    ' 恢复原始设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = originalScreenUpdating
    Application.Calculation = originalCalculation
    Application.EnableEvents = originalEnableEvents
    Application.DisplayAlerts = originalDisplayAlerts

    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    ' 处理错误
    MsgBox "执行过程中发生错误：" & err.Description, vbCritical + vbOKOnly, "错误"
    Resume Cleanup
End Sub

Sub ImportAllAllWorksheets()

    With Application.FileDialog(1)

    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    For i = 1 To sourceWB.sheets.count

' 统一的 GenerateUniqueSheetName 函数
Private Function GenerateUniqueSheetName(baseName As String) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    Dim newName As String
    Dim counter As Integer
    newName = baseName
    counter = 1
    ' 如果名称已存在，添加数字后缀
    Do While WorksheetExists(newName)
        newName = baseName & "(" & counter & ")"
        counter = counter + 1
        If counter > 100 Then
            ' 如果尝试100次都失败，使用时间戳
            newName = baseName & Format(Now, "_mmddHHMMSS")
            Exit Do
        End If
    Loop
    GenerateUniqueSheetName = newName
End Function

    If Not fso.FileExists(path) Then
        MsgBox "找不到文件：" & path, vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim wb As Object
    Set wb = ThisWorkbook
    Dim ws As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets("EChartsLib")
    On Error GoTo 0

        Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add
        ws.NAME = "EChartsLib"
    End If
    ws.Cells.Clear

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim ts As Object
    Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile(path, 1, False)
    Dim chunk As String
    Dim chunkSize As Long
    chunkSize = 30000
    Dim rowIdx As Long
    rowIdx = 1
    Dim first As Boolean
    first = True
    Do While Not ts.AtEndOfStream
        chunk = ts.Read(chunkSize)
        If first Then
            If Len(chunk) >= 3 Then
                If Asc(Mid$(chunk, 1, 1)) = 239 And Asc(Mid$(chunk, 2, 1)) = 187 And Asc(Mid$(chunk, 3, 1)) = 191 Then
                    chunk = Mid$(chunk, 4)
                End If
            End If
            first = False
        End If
        If Len(chunk) > 32767 Then chunk = Left$(chunk, 32767)
        ws.Cells(rowIdx, 1).value = chunk
        rowIdx = rowIdx + 1
    Loop
    ts.Close
    Set ts = Nothing

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    ws.Visible = 2

Public Sub BubbleSortLen(ByRef vArray As Variant)
    Dim i As Long
    Dim j As Long
    Dim sTemp As String
    For i = LBound(vArray) To UBound(vArray) - 1
        For j = i To UBound(vArray)
            If Len(vArray(j)) > Len(vArray(i)) Then
                sTemp = vArray(i)
                vArray(i) = vArray(j)
                vArray(j) = sTemp
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
End Sub

Public Sub 智能自动分列(Optional isDirectFill As Variant = False)
    Dim rng As range
    Dim arr() As String
    Dim cell As range
    Dim maxSplit As Integer
    Dim delimiter As String
    Dim fillMode As Boolean
    fillMode = CBool(isDirectFill)
    If fillMode Then
        If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
            MsgBox "当前选中的不是单元格区域！", vbExclamation, "操作提示"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        Set rng = Selection
    Else
        On Error Resume Next
        Set rng = Application.InputBox( _
                      Prompt:="请选择需要分列的数据单元格区域：" & vbCrLf & "注意：请保持数据右侧有足够空白单元格！", _
                      Title:="智能自动分列", _
                      Default:=Selection.Address, _
                      Type:=8)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If rng Is Nothing Then
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
    delimiter = InputBox("请输入分隔符（如逗号、顿号、空格等）：", "自定义分隔符", ",")
    If delimiter = "" Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    maxSplit = 0
    For Each cell In rng
        If cell.value <> "" Then
            arr = Split(cell.value, delimiter)
            If UBound(arr) > maxSplit Then
                maxSplit = UBound(arr)
            End If
        End If
    Next
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    For Each cell In rng
        If cell.value <> "" Then
            arr = Split(cell.value, delimiter)
            If cell.column + maxSplit <= Columns.count Then
                cell.Resize(1, maxSplit + 1).value = arr
            Else
                MsgBox "单元格 " & cell.Address & " 右侧列数不足，无法完成分列！", vbCritical, "错误"
                Application.ScreenUpdating = True
                Exit Sub
            End If
        End If
    Next
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Set rng = Nothing
End Sub

        ' 月销售总额

    Dim oldCho As ChartObject

        oldCho.Delete
    Next oldCho

    Dim successCount As Long

    Next i
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "图表已生成完毕，成功创建 " & successCount & " 张，排列在当前工作表中。", vbInformation
End Sub

'遍历工作簿中哪些工作表中有切片器控件
Sub CountAllSlicersSafe_NoErr13()
    Dim sc As Object
    Dim slc As Object
    Dim sht As Worksheet
    Dim dict As Object
    Dim total As Long
    Dim msg As String
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    dict.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    total = 0
    '容错：无切片器缓存直接退出
    On Error GoTo NoSlicerCache
    For Each sc In ActiveWorkbook.SlicerCaches
        On Error Resume Next
        For Each slc In sc.Slicers
            '稳定获取切片器所在工作表：slc → Shape → Worksheet
            Set sht = slc.Shape.Parent
            If err.Number = 0 Then
                total = total + 1
                If dict.exists(sht.NAME) Then
                    dict(sht.NAME) = dict(sht.NAME) + 1
                Else
                    dict(sht.NAME) = 1
                End If
            End If
            err.Clear
        Next slc
        On Error GoTo NoSlicerCache
    Next sc
    '拼接输出文本
    msg = "【切片器统计】工作簿：" & ActiveWorkbook.NAME & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    If dict.count = 0 Then
        msg = msg & "未检测到任何切片器、时间线、日程表"
    Else
        Dim k As Variant
        For Each k In dict.Keys
            msg = msg & "工作表「" & k & "」：" & dict(k) & " 个" & vbCrLf
        Next k
        msg = msg & vbCrLf & "切片器合计总数：" & total & " 个"
    End If
    MsgBox msg, vbInformation
    Debug.Print msg
    Exit Sub
NoSlicerCache:

'单元格合并
Sub MergeCells(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim rng As range
    Dim workRange As range
    Dim firstCell As range, lastCell As range
    Dim cell As range, startCell As range
    Dim sameValue As String
    ' 如果没有选择区域，直接退出
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then Exit Sub
    Set rng = Selection
    ' 限制：只能处理单行或单列
    If rng.Rows.count > 1 And rng.Columns.count > 1 Then
        MsgBox "此功能仅支持单行或单列的区域，请重新选择。", vbExclamation, "单元格合并"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' 找到第一个非空和最后一个非空单元格，缩小处理范围
    For Each cell In rng
        If Trim(cell.value) <> "" Then
            If firstCell Is Nothing Then Set firstCell = cell
            Set lastCell = cell
        End If
    Next cell
    ' 如果全是空白，直接退出
    If firstCell Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "选区内没有可合并的内容。", vbInformation, "单元格合并"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set workRange = range(firstCell, lastCell)
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    ' 如果是单列
    If workRange.Columns.count = 1 Then
        Set startCell = workRange.Cells(1, 1)
        sameValue = startCell.value
        For Each cell In workRange.Cells
            If cell.row = startCell.row Then GoTo ContinueLoop
            If cell.value <> sameValue Or cell.value = "" Then
                If cell.row - startCell.row > 1 Then
                    range(startCell, cell.Offset(-1, 0)).Merge
                    range(startCell, cell.Offset(-1, 0)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    range(startCell, cell.Offset(-1, 0)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
                End If
                Set startCell = cell
                sameValue = cell.value
            End If
ContinueLoop:
        Next cell
        ' 处理最后一段
        If workRange.Cells(workRange.Rows.count, 1).row > startCell.row Then
            range(startCell, workRange.Cells(workRange.Rows.count, 1)).Merge
            range(startCell, workRange.Cells(workRange.Rows.count, 1)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            range(startCell, workRange.Cells(workRange.Rows.count, 1)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        End If
    End If
    ' 如果是单行
    If workRange.Rows.count = 1 Then
        Set startCell = workRange.Cells(1, 1)
        sameValue = startCell.value
        For Each cell In workRange.Cells
            If cell.column = startCell.column Then GoTo ContinueLoop2
            If cell.value <> sameValue Or cell.value = "" Then
                If cell.column - startCell.column > 1 Then
                    range(startCell, cell.Offset(0, -1)).Merge
                    range(startCell, cell.Offset(0, -1)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                    range(startCell, cell.Offset(0, -1)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
                End If
                Set startCell = cell
                sameValue = cell.value
            End If
ContinueLoop2:
        Next cell
        ' 处理最后一段
        If workRange.Cells(1, workRange.Columns.count).column > startCell.column Then
            range(startCell, workRange.Cells(1, workRange.Columns.count)).Merge
            range(startCell, workRange.Cells(1, workRange.Columns.count)).HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            range(startCell, workRange.Cells(1, workRange.Columns.count)).VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        End If
    End If
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
'    MsgBox "合并完成！", vbInformation, "单元格合并"
End Sub
'取消单元格合并并填充值

'值合并
Sub MergeValues(control As IRibbonControl)
    Dim rng As range, cell As range, workRange As range
    Dim arrValues As Collection
    Dim result As String
    Dim userInput As String
    Dim sep As String, quoteChar As String
    Dim DataObj As Object
    ' 如果没有选择区域，退出
    If typeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then Exit Sub
    ' 与 UsedRange 交叉，避免处理整行整列空白
    Set workRange = Intersect(Selection, ActiveSheet.usedRange)
    If workRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "选区没有有效数据。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' 收集非空、非错误的值
    Set arrValues = New Collection
    For Each cell In workRange
        If Not IsError(cell.value) Then
            If Trim(cell.value) <> "" Then
                arrValues.Add cell.value
            End If
        End If
    Next cell
    If arrValues.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "选区没有可合并的值。", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    ' 默认规则：英文逗号 + 单引号
    sep = ","
    quoteChar = "'"
RetryRule:
    ' 拼接结果
    result = ""
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To arrValues.count
        If result = "" Then
            result = quoteChar & arrValues(i) & quoteChar
        Else
            result = result & sep & quoteChar & arrValues(i) & quoteChar
        End If
    Next i
    ' 将返回的内容添加到剪切板
    CopyToClipboard (result)
    ' 弹出输入框，默认值为合并结果
    userInput = InputBox( _
        "合并结果如下（可修改）：" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "请输入编号选择规则：" & vbCrLf & _
        "1: 英文逗号 (,)" & vbCrLf & _
        "2: 英文逗号 + 单引号 (,'')" & vbCrLf & _
        "3: 竖线 (|)" & vbCrLf & _
        "4: 竖线 + 单引号 (|'' )" & vbCrLf & _
        "5: 分号 (;)" & vbCrLf & _
        "6: 分号 + 单引号 (;'' )" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & _
        "将按照规则重新生成合并文本", _
        "值合并", result)   ' ← 默认值为 result
    ' 如果用户取消
    If userInput = "" Then Exit Sub
    ' 判断用户输入
    Select Case userInput
            Case "1": sep = ",": quoteChar = ""
            Case "2": sep = ",": quoteChar = "'"
            Case "3": sep = "|": quoteChar = ""
            Case "4": sep = "|": quoteChar = "'"
            Case "5": sep = ";": quoteChar = ""
            Case "6": sep = ";": quoteChar = "'"
            Case Else
                Debug.Print userInput     ' 加入剪切板里
                ' MsgBox "已复制到剪贴板：" & vbCrLf & userInput, vbInformation
                Exit Sub
    End Select
    ' 如果选择了编号规则 → 重新生成并再次弹窗
    GoTo RetryRule
End Sub

'调整选中合并单元格自适应行高列宽
Sub AdaptiveRowHeightAndColumnWidth()
    Dim selRng As range, cell As range
    Dim mergeArea As range
    Dim processedAreas As Object
    Dim mergeWidth As Double, mergeHeight As Double
    Dim newHeight As Double, newWidth As Double
    Dim celWidth As Double, celHeight As Double
    Dim n As Long, i As Long
    
    '创建集合 用于去重：同一个合并区域只处理一次
    Set processedAreas = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    '获取用户选中区域
    On Error Resume Next
    Set selRng = Selection
    On Error GoTo 0
    If selRng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选中包含合并单元格的区域！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    '第一层循环：遍历选区所有单元格，收集所有独立合并区域
    For Each cell In selRng
        If cell.MergeCells Then
            Set mergeArea = cell.mergeArea
            '用区域地址作为key去重
            If Not processedAreas.exists(mergeArea.Address) Then
                processedAreas(mergeArea.Address) = True
                '执行自适应行高逻辑
                Call AutoFitMergeRow(mergeArea)
                '执行自适应列宽逻辑
                Call AutoFitMergeCol(mergeArea)
            End If
        End If
    Next cell
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
'    MsgBox "选中区域内所有合并单元格自适应完成！", vbInformation
    
    Set processedAreas = Nothing
    Set selRng = Nothing
End Sub

'【子过程1】合并区域自适应行高（原第一段逻辑封装）
Private Sub AutoFitMergeRow(mergeArea As range)
    Dim r As range, c As range
    Dim mergeWidth As Double, newHeight As Double, celWidth As Double
    Dim rowCount As Long
    
    '1. 计算合并区域总列宽
    mergeWidth = 0
    For Each c In mergeArea.Columns
        mergeWidth = mergeWidth + c.ColumnWidth
    Next c
    
    '2. 取消合并
    mergeArea.MergeCells = False
    
    With mergeArea.Cells(1)
        .WrapText = True
        celWidth = .ColumnWidth
        .ColumnWidth = mergeWidth
        .EntireRow.AutoFit
        newHeight = .rowHeight
        .ColumnWidth = celWidth
    End With
    
    '3. 重新合并，均分行高并放大1.1倍
    mergeArea.MergeCells = True
    rowCount = mergeArea.Rows.count
    For Each r In mergeArea.Rows
        r.rowHeight = newHeight / rowCount * 1.1
    Next r
    
    '居中对齐
    mergeArea.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    mergeArea.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
End Sub

'【子过程2】合并区域自适应列宽（原第二段逻辑封装）
Private Sub AutoFitMergeCol(mergeArea As range)
    Dim r As range, c As range
    Dim mergeHeight As Double, newWidth As Double, celHeight As Double
    Dim colCount As Long
    
    '1. 计算合并区域总行高
    mergeHeight = 0
    For Each r In mergeArea.Rows
        mergeHeight = mergeHeight + r.rowHeight
    Next r
    
    '2. 取消合并
    mergeArea.MergeCells = False
    
    With mergeArea.Cells(1)
        .WrapText = True
        celHeight = .rowHeight
        .rowHeight = mergeHeight
        .EntireColumn.AutoFit
        newWidth = .ColumnWidth
        .rowHeight = celHeight
    End With
    
    '3. 重新合并，均分列宽并放大1.1倍
    mergeArea.MergeCells = True
    colCount = mergeArea.Columns.count
    For Each c In mergeArea.Columns
        c.ColumnWidth = newWidth / colCount * 1.1
    Next c
    
    '居中对齐
    mergeArea.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
    mergeArea.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
End Sub

'替代CONCAT 函数对单元格区域的内容进行串联
Function BCONCAT(ParamArray 单元格或区域地址() As Variant) As String
Attribute BCONCAT.VB_Description = "说明：替代CONCAT函数对单元格区域的内容进行串联。\r\n相当于多个单元格之间使用 & 连接符串联各自的内容\r\n参数1：需要合并的单元格或单元格区域地址（多选）\r\n参数2：可选，分隔符，用于在分隔每个单元格内容的字符"
Attribute BCONCAT.VB_ProcData.VB_Invoke_Func = " \n21"
' 自定义CONCAT函数，支持分隔符
' 用法1：=BCONCAT(A1, B1, C1)  ' 无分隔符
' 用法2：=BCONCAT(A1:A10, "-")  ' 区域+分隔符
' 用法3：=BCONCAT("-", A1, B1, C1)  ' 分隔符在前

    Dim result As String
    Dim delimiter As String
    Dim arg As Variant
    Dim cell As range
    Dim firstItem As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    Dim hasExplicitDelimiter As Boolean

    result = ""
    delimiter = ""
    firstItem = True
    hasExplicitDelimiter = False

    If UBound(单元格或区域地址) >= 0 Then
        If VarType(单元格或区域地址(0)) = vbString Then
            If UBound(单元格或区域地址) >= 1 Then
                delimiter = 单元格或区域地址(0)
                hasExplicitDelimiter = True
            End If
        ElseIf VarType(单元格或区域地址(UBound(单元格或区域地址))) = vbString Then
            If UBound(单元格或区域地址) >= 1 Then
                delimiter = 单元格或区域地址(UBound(单元格或区域地址))
                hasExplicitDelimiter = True
            End If
        End If
    End If

    For i = LBound(单元格或区域地址) To UBound(单元格或区域地址)
        If hasExplicitDelimiter And _
           ((i = 0 And VarType(单元格或区域地址(0)) = vbString) Or _
            (i = UBound(单元格或区域地址) And VarType(单元格或区域地址(UBound(单元格或区域地址))) = vbString)) Then
        Else
            ProcessArg 单元格或区域地址(i), result, delimiter, firstItem
        End If
    Next i
    
    BCONCAT = result
End Function

' 辅助函数：处理单个参数
Private Sub ProcessArg(arg As Variant, ByRef result As String, _
                       delimiter As String, ByRef firstItem As Boolean)
    Dim cell As range

    If typeName(arg) = "Range" Then
        For Each cell In arg
            If Not IsError(cell) Then
                AddToResult CStr(cell.value), result, delimiter, firstItem
            End If
        Next cell
    ElseIf IsArray(arg) Then
        Dim i As Long
        For i = LBound(arg) To UBound(arg)
            If Not IsError(arg(i)) Then
                AddToResult CStr(arg(i)), result, delimiter, firstItem
            End If
        Next i
    Else
        If Not IsError(arg) Then
            AddToResult CStr(arg), result, delimiter, firstItem
        End If
    End If
End Sub

' 辅助函数：添加到结果字符串
Private Sub AddToResult(value As String, ByRef result As String, _
                        delimiter As String, ByRef firstItem As Boolean)
    If Len(Trim(value)) > 0 Then
        If firstItem Then
            result = result & value
            firstItem = False
        Else
            result = result & delimiter & value
        End If
    End If
End Sub

        Title:="选择源文本单元格", _
        Default:=ActiveCell.Address, _
        Type:=8)
    
    If sourceCell Is Nothing Then
'        MsgBox "已取消操作", vbInformation

    ' 初始化数组
    ReDim resultArray(0)
    count = 0
    
    ' 提取所有双引号内的文本
    quoteStart = InStr(1, sourceText, """")
    Do While quoteStart > 0

            ' 将双引号内的文本添加到数组

            ' 继续查找下一个双引号
