        Else
            ' 没有匹配的结束双引号，退出循环
            quoteStart = 0
        End If
    Loop
    
    ' 如果没有找到任何内容

        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 确定目标起始单元格（源单元格下方）
    Set targetCell = sourceCell.Offset(1, 0)
    
    ' 填充结果到右侧单元格

Attribute VB_Name = "批量插入文件"
'Attribute VB_Name = "批量插入文件"

' 模块: 批量插入文件 (增强版)
' 功能: 将PDF/Excel/Word/PPT/TXT/压缩包/图片等文件以对应图标插入工作表
' 日期: 2026-06-30
' 说明: 由原 OPEN_InsertPDFFile 优化而来，支持多格式 + 自动匹配图标

Option Explicit
'--- 布局参数 (可按需修改) ---
Private Const COL_COUNT    As Long = 5    ' 每行图标数
Private Const COL_SPACING  As Double = 120 ' 列间距(磅)
Private Const ROW_SPACING  As Double = 80  ' 行间距(磅)
Private Const START_X      As Double = 50  ' 起始X坐标
Private Const START_Y      As Double = 100 ' 起始Y坐标

' 主过程: 批量插入文件 (从功能区按钮调用)
Public Sub OPEN_InsertFile(control As IRibbonControl)
    InsertFiles_Core
End Sub

' 主过程: 批量插入文件 (无参数版本, 可从宏对话框直接运行)

Public Sub OPEN_InsertFile_Run()
    InsertFiles_Core
End Sub

' 核心逻辑
Private Sub InsertFiles_Core()
    Dim fd As FileDialog
    Dim selectedFile As Variant
    Dim i As Long, fileCount As Long
    Dim X As Double, y As Double
    Dim fileName As String, fileExt As String
    Dim iconFile As String, iconIndex As Long
    Dim colIdx As Long
    Dim failCount As Long
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    '--- 弹出文件选择对话框 ---
    Set fd = Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFilePicker)
    With fd
        .Title = "选择要插入的文件（可多选）"
        .AllowMultiSelect = True
        .Filters.Clear
        .Filters.Add "所有支持的文件", _
            "*.pdf;*.xlsx;*.xls;*.xlsm;*.xlsb;" & _
            "*.docx;*.doc;*.docm;*.rtf;" & _
            "*.pptx;*.ppt;*.pptm;" & _
            "*.txt;*.csv;*.log;*.xml;*.json;*.html;*.htm;" & _
            "*.zip;*.rar;*.7z;" & _
            "*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.png;*.gif;*.bmp;*.tif;*.tiff"
        .Filters.Add "PDF文件", "*.pdf"
        .Filters.Add "Excel文件", "*.xlsx;*.xls;*.xlsm;*.xlsb"
        .Filters.Add "Word文件", "*.docx;*.doc;*.docm;*.rtf"
        .Filters.Add "PowerPoint文件", "*.pptx;*.ppt;*.pptm"
        .Filters.Add "文本文件", "*.txt;*.csv;*.log;*.xml;*.json;*.html;*.htm"
        .Filters.Add "压缩文件", "*.zip;*.rar;*.7z"
        .Filters.Add "图片文件", "*.jpg;*.jpeg;*.png;*.gif;*.bmp;*.tif;*.tiff"
        If .Show <> -1 Then GoTo CleanExit
        fileCount = .SelectedItems.count
        If fileCount = 0 Then GoTo CleanExit
    End With
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    '--- 初始化布局 ---
    X = START_X
    y = START_Y
    colIdx = 0
    '--- 遍历插入 ---
    For Each selectedFile In fd.SelectedItems
        i = i + 1
        fileName = GetFileName(CStr(selectedFile))
        fileExt = LCase$(GetFileExt(CStr(selectedFile)))
        Application.StatusBar = "正在插入 " & i & "/" & fileCount & ": " & fileName
        ' 获取对应图标
        GetFileIcon fileExt, iconFile, iconIndex
        ' 插入OLE对象 (指定Left/Top, 修复原代码位置不生效的问题)
        On Error Resume Next
        If iconFile <> "" And Dir(iconFile) <> "" Then
            ActiveSheet.OLEObjects.Add _
                fileName:=CStr(selectedFile), _
                Link:=False, _
                DisplayAsIcon:=True, _
                IconFileName:=iconFile, _
                iconIndex:=iconIndex, _
                IconLabel:=fileName, _
                Left:=X, Top:=y
        Else
            ' 无图标文件时使用默认图标
            ActiveSheet.OLEObjects.Add _
                fileName:=CStr(selectedFile), _
                Link:=False, _
                DisplayAsIcon:=True, _
                IconLabel:=fileName, _
                Left:=X, Top:=y
        End If
        If err.Number <> 0 Then
            failCount = failCount + 1
            Debug.Print "插入失败: " & fileName & " - " & err.Description
            err.Clear
        End If
        On Error GoTo ErrHandler
        ' 更新布局位置
        colIdx = colIdx + 1
        If colIdx >= COL_COUNT Then
            colIdx = 0
            X = START_X
            y = y + ROW_SPACING
        Else
            X = X + COL_SPACING
        End If
    Next selectedFile
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    ' 完成提示
    If failCount > 0 Then
'        MsgBox "插入完成: 成功 " & (i - failCount) & " 个, 失败 " & failCount & " 个" & vbCrLf & _
'               "失败详情请查看立即窗口(Ctrl+G)", vbExclamation, "完成(部分失败)"
    Else
'        MsgBox "成功插入 " & i & " 个文件", vbInformation, "完成"
    End If
CleanExit:
    Application.StatusBar = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Set fd = Nothing
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "插入文件时出错:" & vbCrLf & _
           "文件: " & fileName & vbCrLf & _
           "错误: " & err.Number & " - " & err.Description, _
           vbExclamation, "错误"
    Resume CleanExit
End Sub

' 图标获取: 优先从注册表读取关联图标, 失败则使用预设路径
Private Sub GetFileIcon(fileExt As String, _
                        ByRef iconFile As String, _
                        ByRef iconIndex As Long)
    Dim sysPath As String
    sysPath = Environ$("SystemRoot") & "\System32"
    iconFile = ""
    iconIndex = 0
    '--- 方法1: 从注册表读取文件关联的DefaultIcon ---
    If GetIconFromRegistry(fileExt, iconFile, iconIndex) Then
        ' 验证图标文件存在
        If LenB(iconFile) > 0 Then
            If Dir(iconFile) <> "" Then Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
    '--- 方法2: 预设已知路径回退 ---
    iconFile = ""
    iconIndex = 0
    Select Case fileExt
        ' --- Excel ---
        Case "xlsx", "xls", "xlsm", "xlsb"
            iconFile = Application.path & "\EXCEL.EXE"
            iconIndex = 0
        ' --- Word ---
        Case "docx", "doc", "docm", "rtf"
            iconFile = GetAppPath("winword.exe")
            iconIndex = 0
        ' --- PowerPoint ---
        Case "pptx", "ppt", "pptm"
            iconFile = GetAppPath("powerpnt.exe")
            iconIndex = 0
        ' --- PDF ---
        Case "pdf"
            iconFile = GetPDFReaderIcon(iconIndex)
        ' --- 文本类 ---
        Case "txt", "log"
            iconFile = sysPath & "\notepad.exe"
            iconIndex = 0
        Case "csv"
            iconFile = Application.path & "\EXCEL.EXE"
            iconIndex = 0
        Case "xml", "json", "html", "htm"
            iconFile = sysPath & "\notepad.exe"
            iconIndex = 0
        ' --- 压缩文件 ---
        Case "zip"
            ' Windows内置zip图标
            iconFile = sysPath & "\shell32.dll"
            iconIndex = 165
        Case "rar"
            iconFile = GetAppPath("winrar.exe")
            iconIndex = 0
        Case "7z"
            iconFile = Get7ZipPath()
            iconIndex = 0
        ' --- 图片 ---
        Case "jpg", "jpeg"
            iconFile = sysPath & "\shell32.dll"
            iconIndex = 130
        Case "png", "gif", "bmp", "tif", "tiff"
            iconFile = sysPath & "\shell32.dll"
            iconIndex = 131
        ' --- 默认 ---
        Case Else
            iconFile = sysPath & "\shell32.dll"
            iconIndex = 0
    End Select
    '--- 最终验证: 确保图标文件存在 ---
    If LenB(iconFile) = 0 Or Dir(iconFile) = "" Then
        iconFile = sysPath & "\shell32.dll"
        iconIndex = 0
    End If
End Sub

' 从注册表读取文件类型的关联图标
'   查找路径: HKCR\.ext\DefaultIcon  或  HKCR\.ext\(默认值)->ProgID->DefaultIcon
' 返回: True = 成功解析,  False = 未找到或无效
Private Function GetIconFromRegistry(fileExt As String, _
                                     ByRef iconFile As String, _
                                     ByRef iconIndex As Long) As Boolean
    Dim wsh As Object
    Dim progID As String
    Dim iconSpec As String
    On Error GoTo FailExit
    Set wsh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    ' 尝试1: 直接读取 HKCR\.ext\DefaultIcon
    iconSpec = ""
    On Error Resume Next
    iconSpec = wsh.RegRead("HKCR\." & fileExt & "\DefaultIcon\")
    On Error GoTo FailExit
    ' 尝试2: 通过 ProgID 间接读取
    If LenB(iconSpec) = 0 Or iconSpec = "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        progID = wsh.RegRead("HKCR\." & fileExt & "\")
        On Error GoTo FailExit
        If LenB(progID) > 0 And progID <> "" Then
            On Error Resume Next
            iconSpec = wsh.RegRead("HKCR\" & progID & "\DefaultIcon\")
            On Error GoTo FailExit
        End If
    End If
    Set wsh = Nothing
    If LenB(iconSpec) = 0 Or iconSpec = "" Then
        GetIconFromRegistry = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    ' 解析 "path,index" 格式
    GetIconFromRegistry = ParseIconSpec(iconSpec, iconFile, iconIndex)
    Exit Function
FailExit:
    On Error Resume Next
    Set wsh = Nothing
    GetIconFromRegistry = False
End Function

' 解析图标规格字符串
'   输入格式: "C:\path\file.exe,0"
'             "%SystemRoot%\system32\shell32.dll,-152"
'             "C:\path\file.exe"  (无逗号, 默认index=0)
'             "%1"  (表示图标内嵌于文件本身, 不可用, 返回False)
Private Function ParseIconSpec(ByVal spec As String, _
                               ByRef iconFile As String, _
                               ByRef iconIndex As Long) As Boolean
    Dim pos As Long
    Dim idxStr As String
    spec = Trim$(spec)
    If Len(spec) = 0 Then
        ParseIconSpec = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    ' %1 表示图标内嵌在文件本身中, OLE方式无法使用
    If spec = "%1" Or spec = """%1""" Then
        ParseIconSpec = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    ' 查找最后一个逗号分隔符
    pos = InStrRev(spec, ",")
    If pos > 0 Then
        idxStr = Trim$(Mid$(spec, pos + 1))
        If IsNumeric(idxStr) Then
            iconFile = Trim$(Left$(spec, pos - 1))
            ' 负数索引取绝对值
            iconIndex = Abs(CLng(idxStr))
        Else
            ' 逗号后不是数字 -> 整个字符串是路径
            iconFile = spec
            iconIndex = 0
        End If
    Else
        iconFile = spec
        iconIndex = 0
    End If
    ' 去除首尾引号
    iconFile = Unquote(iconFile)
    ' 展开环境变量 (%SystemRoot% 等)
    iconFile = ExpandEnv(iconFile)
    ParseIconSpec = (LenB(iconFile) > 0 And iconFile <> "")
End Function

' 从注册表 App Paths 获取应用程序完整路径
Private Function GetAppPath(exeName As String) As String
    Dim wsh As Object
    Dim p As String
    On Error GoTo Fallback
    Set wsh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    On Error Resume Next
    p = wsh.RegRead("HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\" & _
                     "App Paths\" & exeName & "\")
    On Error GoTo Fallback
    Set wsh = Nothing
    p = Unquote(p)
    If LenB(p) > 0 And p <> "" Then
        If Dir(p) <> "" Then
            GetAppPath = p
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If
Fallback:
    ' 常见安装路径回退
    Select Case LCase$(exeName)
        Case "winword.exe"
            p = Application.path & "\WINWORD.EXE"
        Case "powerpnt.exe"
            p = Application.path & "\POWERPNT.EXE"
        Case "winrar.exe"
            p = "C:\Program Files\WinRAR\WinRAR.exe"
            If Dir(p) = "" Then p = "C:\Program Files (x86)\WinRAR\WinRAR.exe"
        Case "acrored32.exe", "acrobat.exe"
            p = ""
        Case Else
            p = ""
    End Select
    If Dir(p) <> "" Then
        GetAppPath = p
    Else
        GetAppPath = ""
    End If
End Function

' 获取PDF阅读器图标路径
Private Function GetPDFReaderIcon(ByRef iconIndex As Long) As String
    Dim wsh As Object
    Dim iconSpec As String
    Dim progID As String
    Dim iFile As String
    On Error GoTo Fallback
    Set wsh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    ' 从注册表读取PDF关联图标
    iconSpec = ""
    On Error Resume Next
    iconSpec = wsh.RegRead("HKCR\.pdf\DefaultIcon\")
    On Error GoTo Fallback
    If LenB(iconSpec) = 0 Or iconSpec = "" Then
        On Error Resume Next
        progID = wsh.RegRead("HKCR\.pdf\")
        On Error GoTo Fallback
        If LenB(progID) > 0 And progID <> "" Then
            On Error Resume Next
            iconSpec = wsh.RegRead("HKCR\" & progID & "\DefaultIcon\")
            On Error GoTo Fallback
        End If
    End If
    Set wsh = Nothing
    ' 尝试解析注册表图标
    If LenB(iconSpec) > 0 And iconSpec <> "" And iconSpec <> "%1" Then
        If ParseIconSpec(iconSpec, iFile, iconIndex) Then
            If LenB(iFile) > 0 And iFile <> "" Then

' 数字列号转字母
Private Function ColLetter(ByVal colNum As Long) As String
    Dim n As Long, s As String, m As Long
    n = colNum
    Do While n > 0
        m = (n - 1) Mod 26
        s = Chr(65 + m) & s
        n = (n - m - 1) \ 26
    Loop
    ColLetter = s
End Function

'提取文件中的数据
Sub ExtractXLSMData_Safe()
    Call SelectDataRegion
    ' 初始化
    fileCounter = 0
    saveCounter = 0
    memoryWarningLevel = 819200 ' 内存警告阈值

    ' 先让用户选择数据区域（必须在 Excel 可见、静默模式之前）
    If Not EnsureDataRegion() Then Exit Sub

    ' 保存原始状态
    originalVisible = Application.Visible
    originalScreenUpdating = Application.ScreenUpdating

    ' 进入静默模式
    Call EnterSilentMode

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim i As Long
    Dim startTime As Double
    Dim lastSaveTime As Double

    Set ws = mDataWs
    startTime = Timer
    lastSaveTime = Timer

    ' 添加进度显示
    ws.Cells(1, "W").value = "处理进度"
    ws.Cells(1, "X").value = "开始时间: " & Format(Now, "hh:mm:ss")

    ' 主处理循环
    For i = mStartRow To mEndRow
        fileCounter = fileCounter + 1

        ' 更新进度显示
        ws.Cells(1, "Z").value = "正在处理: " & (i - 1) & "/" & (mEndRow - 1)
        ws.Cells(1, "AA").value = "已处理: " & fileCounter

        ' 处理单个文件
        Dim result As String
        result = ProcessSingleFileSafe(ws, i)

        ' 显示处理结果
        ws.Cells(i, "X").value = result

        ' 立即保存当前行的数据
        mDataWb.Save

        ' 每处理一个文件保存一次（强制保存）
        saveCounter = saveCounter + 1
        ws.Cells(1, "AB").value = "保存次数: " & saveCounter

        ' 检查内存使用
        If CheckMemoryUsage() Then
            Call ForceMemoryCleanupFull
            ws.Cells(1, "AC").value = "内存清理: " & Format(Now, "hh:mm:ss")
        End If

        ' 每处理10个文件强制保存并清理
        If fileCounter Mod 10 = 0 Then
            mDataWb.Save
            ws.Cells(1, "AD").value = "进度检查点: " & fileCounter & " @ " & Format(Now, "hh:mm:ss")
            Call MediumMemoryCleanup
            Sleep 100
        End If

        ' 每处理30个文件深度清理
        If fileCounter Mod 30 = 0 Then
            Call DeepMemoryCleanup
            ws.Cells(1, "AE").value = "深度清理: " & fileCounter & " @ " & Format(Now, "hh:mm:ss")
        End If

        ' 每处理50个文件重新启动处理循环
        If fileCounter Mod 50 = 0 Then
            ws.Cells(1, "AF").value = "重启点: " & fileCounter & " @ " & Format(Now, "hh:mm:ss")
            mDataWb.Save
            Dim elapsed As Double
            elapsed = Timer - startTime
            ws.Cells(1, "AG").value = "已耗时: " & Format(elapsed / 60, "0.00") & "分钟"
            Application.Visible = True
            DoEvents
            Sleep 1000
            Application.Visible = False
            Call DeepMemoryCleanup
        End If

        DoEvents
    Next i

    ' 最终保存
    mDataWb.Save

    ' 显示完成信息
    Dim totalTime As Double
    totalTime = Timer - startTime

    Call RestoreExcelDisplay

    Application.Visible = True
    MsgBox "处理完成！" & vbCrLf & _
           "总文件数: " & (mEndRow - 1) & vbCrLf & _
           "已处理: " & fileCounter & vbCrLf & _
           "保存次数: " & saveCounter & vbCrLf & _
           "总耗时: " & Format(totalTime / 60, "0.00") & "分钟", vbInformation

    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    Call EmergencySave(ws, i)
    Call RestoreExcelDisplay
    Application.Visible = True
    MsgBox "处理在第 " & i & " 行中断！" & vbCrLf & _
           "错误: " & err.Description & vbCrLf & _
           "已保存处理结果。", vbCritical
End Sub

' ========== 安全处理单个文件 ==========
Function ProcessSingleFileSafe(ws As Worksheet, rowNum As Long) As String
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim folderPath As String, xlsmFile As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim sourceWs As Worksheet
    Dim j As Long
    Dim fullPath As String

    folderPath = Trim(ws.Cells(rowNum, mPathCol).value)

    If folderPath = "" Then
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "路径为空"
        Exit Function
    End If

    If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "路径不存在"
        Exit Function
    End If

    xlsmFile = Dir(folderPath & "\*.xlsm")
    If xlsmFile = "" Then
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "无XLSM文件"
        Exit Function
    End If

    fullPath = folderPath & "\" & xlsmFile

    Set wb = Nothing
    On Error Resume Next
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open( _
        fileName:=fullPath, _
        ReadOnly:=True, _
        UpdateLinks:=xlUpdateLinksNever, _
        IgnoreReadOnlyRecommended:=True, _
        CorruptLoad:=xlRepairFile, _
        Notify:=False)

    If err.Number <> 0 Or wb Is Nothing Then
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "无法打开文件"
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    On Error Resume Next
    Set sourceWs = wb.Worksheets(1)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "无有效工作表"
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' 预先获取目标地址
    Dim targetAddresses() As String
    ReDim targetAddresses(mAddrStartCol To mAddrEndCol)
    For j = mAddrStartCol To mAddrEndCol
        targetAddresses(j) = ws.Cells(mAddrRow, j).value
    Next j

    Dim successCount As Long
    successCount = 0

    For j = mAddrStartCol To mAddrEndCol
        If targetAddresses(j) <> "" Then
            On Error Resume Next
            Dim cellValue As Variant
            cellValue = sourceWs.range(targetAddresses(j)).value
            If err.Number = 0 Then
                ws.Cells(rowNum, j).value = cellValue
                successCount = successCount + 1
            End If
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next j

    On Error Resume Next
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "Y").value = sourceWs.NAME
    On Error GoTo 0

    mDataWb.Save

    On Error Resume Next
    wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
    Set wb = Nothing
    Set sourceWs = Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0

    Call LightMemoryCleanup

    If successCount > 0 Then
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "成功(" & successCount & ")"
    Else
        ProcessSingleFileSafe = "无数据"
    End If

    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not wb Is Nothing Then
        wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
    End If
    Set wb = Nothing
    Set sourceWs = Nothing

    ProcessSingleFileSafe = "错误: " & err.Description
End Function

Sub LightMemoryCleanup()

    Application.CutCopyMode = False

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In mDataWb.Worksheets
        ws.range("A1").Select
    Next ws

    DoEvents
    Sleep 50
    DoEvents

    On Error GoTo 0

Sub MediumMemoryCleanup()
    On Error Resume Next

    Application.CutCopyMode = False

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In mDataWb.Worksheets
        ws.range("A1").Select
        Set ws = Nothing
    Next ws

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To 5
        DoEvents
        Sleep 100
    Next i

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Sub DeepMemoryCleanup()
    On Error Resume Next

    Application.CutCopyMode = False

    Dim wb As Workbook
    For Each wb In Workbooks
        If wb.NAME <> mDataWb.NAME And wb.NAME <> ThisWorkbook.NAME Then
            wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
        End If
    Next wb

    Dim obj As Object
    Set obj = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set obj = Nothing

    SetProcessWorkingSetSize -1, -1, -1

    For i = 1 To 3
        DoEvents
        Sleep 500
    Next i

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Sub ForceMemoryCleanupFull()
    On Error Resume Next

    mDataWb.Save

    Call DeepMemoryCleanup

    Sleep 1000

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "数据分析"
Option Explicit

' 描述性统计功能实现
Sub RunDescriptiveStats(control As IRibbonControl)
    ' 错误处理
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 检查是否选中了数据区域
    If Selection.Cells.count = 1 Then
        MsgBox "请先选择包含数值数据的数据区域", vbExclamation, "选择数据区域"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取选中的数据区域和对应的工作表
    Dim selectedRange As range
    Set selectedRange = Selection
    
    Dim sourceSheet As Worksheet
    Set sourceSheet = selectedRange.Worksheet
    
    ' 获取工作表的实际使用范围
    Dim usedRange As range
    Set usedRange = sourceSheet.usedRange
    
    ' 获取选中区域与使用区域的交集，避免处理整列时的空单元格
    Dim actualRange As range
    Set actualRange = Intersect(selectedRange, usedRange)
    
    ' 检查交集是否存在
    If actualRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "选中区域中没有有效数据", vbExclamation, "无有效数据"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取列数
    Dim numColumns As Long
    numColumns = actualRange.Columns.count
    
    ' 定义统计指标数组
    Dim statsNames() As Variant
    statsNames = Array("最小值", "最大值", "平均值", "下四分位", "中位数", "上四分位", "平均差", "极差", "标准差")
    
    ' 定义存储每列统计结果的字典
    Dim allStats As Object
    Set allStats = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 存储每列的表头
    Dim columnHeaders() As Variant
    ReDim columnHeaders(1 To numColumns)
    
    ' 遍历每一列
    Dim col As range
    Dim colIndex As Long: colIndex = 1
    
    For Each col In actualRange.Columns
        ' 获取当前列的实际数据范围
        Dim colRange As range
        Set colRange = Intersect(col, usedRange)
        
        ' 获取列的表头（假设第一行为表头）
        columnHeaders(colIndex) = sourceSheet.Cells(selectedRange.row, col.column).value
        If columnHeaders(colIndex) = "" Then
            columnHeaders(colIndex) = "列 " & Split(sourceSheet.Cells(1, col.column).Address, "$")(1)
        End If
        
        ' 读取列数据到数组
        Dim colData As Variant
        colData = colRange.value
        
        ' 获取数据行数
        Dim numRows As Long
        numRows = UBound(colData, 1)
        
        ' 过滤掉非数值数据和空值
        Dim filteredData() As Double
        Dim validCount As Long: validCount = 0
        
        Dim i As Long
        For i = 1 To numRows
            If IsNumeric(colData(i, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(colData(i, 1)) Then
                validCount = validCount + 1
                ReDim Preserve filteredData(1 To validCount)
                filteredData(validCount) = CDbl(colData(i, 1))
            End If
        Next i
        
        ' 如果没有有效数值，跳过该列
        If validCount > 0 Then
            ' 排序数据用于计算四分位数
            Dim sortedData() As Double
            sortedData = filteredData
            BubbleSort sortedData
            
            ' 计算统计指标
            Dim colStats As Object
            Set colStats = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            
            ' 最小值
            colStats("最小值") = WorksheetFunction.Min(sortedData)
            
            ' 最大值
            colStats("最大值") = WorksheetFunction.max(sortedData)
            
            ' 平均值
            colStats("平均值") = WorksheetFunction.Average(sortedData)
            
            ' 下四分位（25%分位）
            colStats("下四分位") = WorksheetFunction.Quartile_Inc(sortedData, 1)
            
            ' 中位数（50%分位）
            colStats("中位数") = WorksheetFunction.Median(sortedData)
            
            ' 上四分位（75%分位）
            colStats("上四分位") = WorksheetFunction.Quartile_Inc(sortedData, 3)
            
            ' 平均差
            colStats("平均差") = CalculateMeanDeviation(sortedData, colStats("平均值"))
            
            ' 极差（最大值-最小值）
            colStats("极差") = colStats("最大值") - colStats("最小值")
            
            ' 标准差（样本标准差）
            colStats("标准差") = WorksheetFunction.StDev_S(sortedData)
            
            ' 保存当前列的统计结果
            Dim currentHeader As String
            currentHeader = columnHeaders(colIndex)
            
            ' 确保表头不为空
            If currentHeader = "" Then
                currentHeader = "列 " & Split(sourceSheet.Cells(1, col.column).Address, "$")(1)
            End If
            
            ' 如果键已存在，先删除
            If allStats.exists(currentHeader) Then
                allStats.Remove currentHeader
            End If
            
            ' 添加新的统计结果
            allStats.Add currentHeader, colStats
        End If
        
        colIndex = colIndex + 1
    Next col
    
    ' 检查是否有有效数据列
    If allStats.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "选中区域中没有有效数值列", vbExclamation, "无有效数据"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 创建新工作表用于输出结果
    Dim newSheet As Worksheet
    Set newSheet = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    newSheet.NAME = "描述性统计结果_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhmmss")
    
    ' 写入结果标题
    newSheet.Cells(1, 1).value = "统计指标"
    
    ' 写入每列的表头
    Dim resultCol As Long: resultCol = 2
    Dim colName As Variant
    For Each colName In allStats.Keys
        newSheet.Cells(1, resultCol).value = colName
        resultCol = resultCol + 1
    Next colName
    
    ' 写入数据来源
    newSheet.Cells(2, 1).value = "数据来源"
    newSheet.Cells(2, 2).value = sourceSheet.NAME & "!" & actualRange.Address
    newSheet.range(newSheet.Cells(2, 2), newSheet.Cells(2, resultCol - 1)).Merge
    
    ' 设置标题格式

' 冒泡排序函数
Sub BubbleSort(ByRef arr() As Double)
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim temp As Double
    
    For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr) - 1
        For j = i + 1 To UBound(arr)
            If arr(i) > arr(j) Then
                temp = arr(i)
                arr(i) = arr(j)
                arr(j) = temp
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
End Sub

' 计算平均差
Function CalculateMeanDeviation(ByRef arr() As Double, ByVal mean As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Long
    Dim sumDeviation As Double: sumDeviation = 0
    
    For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
        sumDeviation = sumDeviation + Abs(arr(i) - mean)
    Next i
    
    CalculateMeanDeviation = sumDeviation / UBound(arr)
End Function

' 功能：基于选中的单元格范围，推测数值列并输出相关性矩阵
' 说明：
' 1. 基于选中区域的前5行推测数值列
' 2. 支持多种相关性计算方法
' 3. 在活动工作簿中新建工作表输出相关性矩阵

Public Sub RunCorrelationAnalysis(control As IRibbonControl)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 保存当前应用程序设置
    Dim originalScreenUpdating As Boolean
    Dim originalCalculation As XlCalculation
    Dim originalEnableEvents As Boolean
    
    ' 记录原始设置
    originalScreenUpdating = Application.ScreenUpdating
    originalCalculation = Application.Calculation
    originalEnableEvents = Application.EnableEvents
    
    ' 关闭不必要的功能以提高性能
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    
    Dim selectedRange As range
    Dim dataRange As range
    Dim headers As range
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim newWs As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim lastCol As Long
    Dim numCols As Long
    Dim numRows As Long
    Dim numericCols() As Integer
    Dim numericHeaders() As String
    Dim colCount As Integer
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer, k As Integer
    Dim corrMethod As String
    Dim userInput As String
    
    ' 检查是否有选中区域
    On Error Resume Next
    Set selectedRange = Selection
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    If selectedRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选择要分析的数据区域（包含表头）！", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If
    
    ' 获取活动工作表
    Set ws = selectedRange.Parent
    
    ' 获取工作表的UsedRange，处理整列选择的情况
    Dim usedRange As range
    Set usedRange = ws.usedRange
    
    ' 计算实际需要处理的数据范围（取选中区域和UsedRange的交集）
    Dim actualRange As range
    Set actualRange = Intersect(selectedRange, usedRange)
    
    ' 检查交集是否存在
    If actualRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "选中区域不在UsedRange范围内，请选择包含数据的区域！", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If
    
    ' 获取实际数据范围的边界
    lastRow = actualRange.Rows.count
    lastCol = actualRange.Columns.count
    
    ' 检查是否有足够的列
    If lastCol < 2 Then
        MsgBox "选择的数据区域至少需要包含两列数据！", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If
    
    ' 检查是否有足够的行数（至少包含表头和一行数据）
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        MsgBox "选择的数据区域至少需要包含表头和一行数据！", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If
    
    ' 分离表头和数据
    Set headers = actualRange.Rows(1)
    Set dataRange = actualRange.Offset(1, 0).Resize(actualRange.Rows.count - 1, actualRange.Columns.count)
    
    ' 将数据载入数组，提高处理速度
    Dim dataArray As Variant
    dataArray = actualRange.value
    
    ' 推测数值列（前5行全为数值则认为是数值列）
    colCount = 0
    ReDim numericCols(1 To lastCol)
    ReDim numericHeaders(1 To lastCol)
    
    For i = 1 To lastCol
        Dim isNumericCol As Boolean
        isNumericCol = True
        
        ' 检查该列前5行数据是否全为数值（使用数组操作提高速度）
        Dim checkRows As Integer
        checkRows = WorksheetFunction.Min(5, UBound(dataArray, 1) - 1) ' 减去1是因为第1行是表头
        
        ' 确保至少有一行数据可以检查
        If checkRows > 0 Then
            For j = 2 To 2 + checkRows - 1 ' 从第2行（数据行）开始检查
                ' 处理可能的空值或错误值
                If IsError(dataArray(j, i)) Or IsEmpty(dataArray(j, i)) Then
                    isNumericCol = False
                    Exit For
                End If
                
                If Not IsNumeric(dataArray(j, i)) Then
                    isNumericCol = False
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next j
        Else
            ' 没有数据行，无法判断是否为数值列
            isNumericCol = False
        End If
        
        ' 如果是数值列，记录下来
        If isNumericCol Then
            colCount = colCount + 1
            numericCols(colCount) = i
            ' 确保表头是字符串类型
            numericHeaders(colCount) = CStr(dataArray(1, i)) ' 从数组中获取表头并转换为字符串
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 调整数组大小
    ReDim Preserve numericCols(1 To colCount)
    ReDim Preserve numericHeaders(1 To colCount)
    
    ' 检查是否有足够的数值列
    If colCount < 2 Then
        MsgBox "选择的数据中只有" & colCount & "列数值列，至少需要2列数值列才能进行相关性分析！", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
        GoTo Cleanup
    End If
    
    ' 弹出InputBox让用户选择相关性计算方法
    userInput = InputBox("请选择相关性计算方法：" & vbCrLf & _
                        "1. 皮尔逊系数（Pearson）" & vbCrLf & _
                        "2. 斯皮尔曼等级相关（Spearman）" & vbCrLf & _
                        "3. 肯德尔等级相关（Kendall）" & vbCrLf & _
                        "请输入对应的数字（1-3）：", _
                        "选择相关性计算方法", "1")
    
    ' 验证用户输入
    Select Case userInput
        Case "1"
            corrMethod = "Pearson"
        Case "2"
            corrMethod = "Spearman"
        Case "3"
            corrMethod = "Kendall"
        Case ""
            ' 用户取消输入
            GoTo Cleanup
        Case Else
            MsgBox "无效的输入！请输入1-3之间的数字。", vbExclamation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
            GoTo Cleanup
    End Select
    
    ' 新建工作表用于输出相关性矩阵
    Dim sheetName As String
    sheetName = "相关性分析结果"
    
    ' 检查是否已存在同名工作表，如果存在则删除
    For Each newWs In ActiveWorkbook.sheets
        If newWs.NAME = sheetName Then
            Application.DisplayAlerts = False
            newWs.Delete
            Application.DisplayAlerts = True
            Exit For
        End If
    Next newWs
    
    ' 在活动工作簿中新建工作表
    Set newWs = ActiveWorkbook.sheets.Add(After:=ActiveWorkbook.sheets(ActiveWorkbook.sheets.count))
    newWs.NAME = sheetName
    
    With newWs
        ' 输出表头
        For i = 1 To colCount
            ' 确保表头是字符串类型
            .Cells(1, i + 1).value = CStr(numericHeaders(i))
            .Cells(i + 1, 1).value = CStr(numericHeaders(i))
        Next i
        
        ' 设置表头格式
        With .range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(1, colCount + 1))
            .Font.Bold = True
            .BorderAround ColorIndex:=xlAutomatic, Weight:=xlThin
        End With
        
        With .range(.Cells(1, 1), .Cells(colCount + 1, 1))
            .Font.Bold = True
            .BorderAround ColorIndex:=xlAutomatic, Weight:=xlThin
        End With
        
        ' 计算并输出相关性矩阵
        For i = 1 To colCount
            For j = 1 To colCount
                Dim range1 As range
                Dim range2 As range
                
                ' 获取要比较的两列数据（只取实际数据行）
                Set range1 = dataRange.Columns(numericCols(i))
                Set range2 = dataRange.Columns(numericCols(j))
                
                ' 根据用户选择的方法计算相关系数
                Dim correlation As Double
                
                Select Case corrMethod
                    Case "Pearson"
                        ' 添加错误处理，避免Correl函数报错
                        On Error Resume Next
                        correlation = WorksheetFunction.Correl(range1, range2)
                        If err.Number <> 0 Then
                            correlation = 0
                            err.Clear
                        End If
                        On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
                    Case "Spearman"
                        ' 使用RANK.AVG函数计算秩，然后计算皮尔逊相关系数
                        correlation = CalculateSpearmanCorrelation(range1, range2)
                    Case "Kendall"
                        ' 简化实现，使用RANK函数后计算皮尔逊相关系数
                        correlation = CalculateKendallCorrelation(range1, range2)
                End Select
                
                ' 输出相关系数，保留2位小数
                .Cells(i + 1, j + 1).value = Round(correlation, 2)
                
                ' 设置单元格格式
                .Cells(i + 1, j + 1).NumberFormat = "0.00"
                .Cells(i + 1, j + 1).BorderAround ColorIndex:=xlAutomatic, Weight:=xlThin
            Next j
        Next i
        
        ' 调整列宽 - 先自动调整，然后限制第一列宽度
        .Columns.AutoFit
        
        ' 调整第一列宽度，确保不会太宽
        .Columns(1).ColumnWidth = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(.Columns(1).ColumnWidth, 15) ' 限制最大宽度为15
        
        ' 尝试设置条件格式，突出显示相关性
        On Error Resume Next ' 临时忽略条件格式设置中的错误
        Dim corrRange As range
        Set corrRange = .range(.Cells(2, 2), .Cells(colCount + 1, colCount + 1))
        
        ' 检查相关性范围是否有效
        If Not corrRange Is Nothing And corrRange.Cells.count > 0 Then
            ' 清除已有条件格式
            corrRange.FormatConditions.Delete
            
            ' 添加颜色刻度条件格式，使用Excel内置默认的红黄绿色阶
            corrRange.FormatConditions.AddColorScale ColorScaleType:=3
        End If
        On Error GoTo ErrorHandler ' 恢复错误处理
        
        ' 将文字描述放在矩阵下方
        Dim descriptionRow As Long
        descriptionRow = colCount + 3 ' 矩阵下方空一行
        
        .Cells(descriptionRow, 1).value = "相关性分析结果"
        .Cells(descriptionRow, 1).Font.Bold = True
        .Cells(descriptionRow, 1).Font.size = 14
        
        .Cells(descriptionRow + 1, 1).value = "计算方法：" & corrMethod
        .Cells(descriptionRow + 2, 1).value = "分析日期：" & Format(Now(), "yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS")
    End With
    
    ' 提示用户分析完成
    MsgBox "相关性分析已完成！结果已输出到""相关性分析结果""工作表。", vbInformation + vbOKOnly, "提示"
    
Cleanup:
    ' 恢复原始设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = originalScreenUpdating
    Application.Calculation = originalCalculation
    Application.EnableEvents = originalEnableEvents
    
    Exit Sub
    
ErrorHandler:
    ' 处理错误
    MsgBox "执行过程中发生错误：" & err.Description, vbCritical + vbOKOnly, "错误"
    Resume Cleanup
End Sub

' 功能：计算斯皮尔曼等级相关系数
' 参数：
'   range1 - 第一个数据范围
'   range2 - 第二个数据范围
' 返回值：斯皮尔曼相关系数
Private Function CalculateSpearmanCorrelation(range1 As range, range2 As range) As Double
    Dim data1() As Variant
    Dim data2() As Variant
    Dim rank1() As Double
    Dim rank2() As Double
    Dim n As Long
    Dim i As Long
    
    ' 将数据加载到数组中
    data1 = range1.value
    data2 = range2.value
    
    n = UBound(data1, 1)
    ReDim rank1(1 To n)
    ReDim rank2(1 To n)
    
    ' 计算秩
    For i = 1 To n
        ' 处理可能的错误值
        If Not IsError(data1(i, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(data1(i, 1)) Then
            rank1(i) = WorksheetFunction.Rank_Avg(data1(i, 1), range1)
        Else
            rank1(i) = 0
        End If
        
        If Not IsError(data2(i, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(data2(i, 1)) Then
            rank2(i) = WorksheetFunction.Rank_Avg(data2(i, 1), range2)
        Else
            rank2(i) = 0
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 计算秩的皮尔逊相关系数
    CalculateSpearmanCorrelation = WorksheetFunction.Correl(rank1, rank2)
End Function

' 功能：计算肯德尔等级相关系数
' 参数：
'   range1 - 第一个数据范围
'   range2 - 第二个数据范围
' 返回值：肯德尔相关系数
Private Function CalculateKendallCorrelation(range1 As range, range2 As range) As Double
    Dim data1() As Variant
    Dim data2() As Variant
    Dim n As Long
    Dim concordant As Long
    Dim discordant As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    
    ' 将数据加载到数组中
    data1 = range1.value
    data2 = range2.value
    
    n = UBound(data1, 1)
    concordant = 0
    discordant = 0
    
    ' 计算一致对和不一致对
    For i = 1 To n - 1
        For j = i + 1 To n
            Dim diff1 As Double
            Dim diff2 As Double
            
            ' 处理可能的错误值或空值
            If Not IsError(data1(i, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(data1(i, 1)) And _
               Not IsError(data1(j, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(data1(j, 1)) And _
               Not IsError(data2(i, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(data2(i, 1)) And _
               Not IsError(data2(j, 1)) And Not IsEmpty(data2(j, 1)) Then
                
                diff1 = CDbl(data1(i, 1)) - CDbl(data1(j, 1))
                diff2 = CDbl(data2(i, 1)) - CDbl(data2(j, 1))
                
                If diff1 * diff2 > 0 Then
                    concordant = concordant + 1
                ElseIf diff1 * diff2 < 0 Then
                    discordant = discordant + 1
                End If
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
    
    ' 计算肯德尔相关系数
    Dim totalPairs As Double
    totalPairs = n * (n - 1) / 2
    
    If totalPairs > 0 Then
        CalculateKendallCorrelation = (concordant - discordant) / totalPairs
    Else
        CalculateKendallCorrelation = 0
    End If
End Function

Sub SplitChartText()
    Dim srcTxt As String
    Dim arrAll As Variant
    Dim arrRow() As Variant
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, idx As Long
    Dim destRow As Long
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    '读取当前选中单元格的文本（全部内容放一个格子里）
    srcTxt = Trim(Selection.value)
    '按空格拆分所有内容
    arrAll = Split(srcTxt, " ")
    '清空A:D列输出区域（可选，避免旧数据干扰）
    range("A:D").ClearContents
    destRow = 1
    idx = 0
    '每4个元素一行循环
    Do While idx <= UBound(arrAll)
        '跳过空字符串（多个连续空格拆分出的空元素）
        Do While idx <= UBound(arrAll) And Trim(arrAll(idx)) = ""
            idx = idx + 1
        Loop
        If idx > UBound(arrAll) Then Exit Do
        '一组4个数据
        ReDim arrRow(1 To 1, 1 To 4)
        For j = 1 To 4
            If idx > UBound(arrAll) Then
                arrRow(1, j) = ""
            Else
                arrRow(1, j) = Trim(arrAll(idx))
                idx = idx + 1
            End If
        Next j
        '写入一行
        Cells(destRow, "A").Resize(1, 4).value = arrRow
        destRow = destRow + 1
    Loop
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "拆分完成！共生成 " & destRow - 1 & " 行数据", vbInformation
End Sub

' 核心功能：单列纵向数据按指定列数转结构化表格
' 适配XLAM插件，可直接放在标准模块中使用
Public Sub ConvertVerticalToTable()
    Dim srcCol As Long, startRow As Long, endRow As Long, totalRows As Long
    Dim colCount As Variant, recordCount As Long, i As Long, j As Long, k As Long
    Dim srcData As Variant, resultData As Variant, shtResult As Worksheet
    Dim oldUpd As Boolean, oldAlert As Boolean
    
    oldUpd = Application.ScreenUpdating
    oldAlert = Application.DisplayAlerts
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    If Selection Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请选中数据单元格", vbExclamation
        GoTo Restore
    End If
    
    srcCol = Selection.column
    startRow = Selection.row
    endRow = Cells(Rows.count, srcCol).End(xlUp).row
    totalRows = endRow - startRow + 1
    
    If totalRows <= 0 Then
        MsgBox "无有效数据", vbExclamation
        GoTo Restore
    End If
    
    colCount = InputBox("输入目标表格列数", "设置列数", 5)
    '点击取消直接退出
    If colCount = False Then GoTo Restore
    '输入空白文本
    If Trim(colCount) = "" Then
        MsgBox "请输入正整数", vbCritical
        GoTo Restore
    End If
    '判断是否数字、正整数
    If Not IsNumeric(colCount) Or Val(colCount) <= 0 Or Val(colCount) <> Int(Val(colCount)) Then
        MsgBox "请输入正整数", vbCritical
        GoTo Restore
    End If
    colCount = CLng(colCount)
    
    If colCount > totalRows Then
        MsgBox "列数不能大于总行数", vbCritical
        GoTo Restore
    End If
    
    recordCount = totalRows \ colCount
    If totalRows Mod colCount <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "行数非整数倍，末尾" & totalRows Mod colCount & "行丢弃", vbInformation
    End If
    
    srcData = Application.Transpose(range(Cells(startRow, srcCol), Cells(endRow, srcCol)).value)
    ReDim resultData(1 To recordCount, 1 To colCount)
    k = 1
    For i = 1 To recordCount
        For j = 1 To colCount
            resultData(i, j) = srcData(k)
            k = k + 1
        Next j
    Next i
    
    On Error Resume Next
    Set shtResult = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("转换结果")
    If Not shtResult Is Nothing Then
        shtResult.Cells.Clear
    Else
        Set shtResult = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ActiveSheet)
        shtResult.NAME = "转换结果"
    End If
    On Error GoTo Restore
    
    shtResult.Cells(1, 1).Resize(recordCount, colCount).value = resultData
    With shtResult
        .Rows(1).Font.Bold = True
'        .Rows(1).Interior.Color = RGB(240, 248, 255)
        .usedRange.EntireColumn.AutoFit
        .usedRange.Borders.LineStyle = xlContinuous
        .Activate
    End With
    MsgBox "转换完成，共" & recordCount & "行", vbInformation
    
Restore:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = oldUpd
    Application.DisplayAlerts = oldAlert
    Set shtResult = Nothing
End Sub

Sub RecursiveFolderSearch(ByVal path As String, ByRef folderArray() As String, ByRef folderCount As Long)
    Dim folderName As String
    If Len(Dir(path, vbDirectory)) = 0 Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    folderName = Dir(path, vbDirectory)
    
    Do While folderName <> ""
        If folderName <> "." And folderName <> ".." Then
            If (GetAttr(path & folderName) And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory Then
                ' 调整数组大小
                If folderCount = UBound(folderArray, 1) + 1 Then
                    ReDim Preserve folderArray(0 To folderCount * 2)
                End If
                folderArray(folderCount) = path & folderName
                folderCount = folderCount + 1
                ' 递归调用，搜索子文件夹
                Call RecursiveFolderSearch(path & folderName & "\", folderArray, folderCount)
            End If
        End If
        folderName = Dir
    Loop
End Sub

    Loop
End Sub

    folderPath = ws.range("A1").value

    If Right(folderPath, 1) <> "\" Then

    End If

    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' 检查文件夹是否存在
    If Not fso.FolderExists(folderPath) Then
        MsgBox "指定的文件夹不存在！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 保存A1单元格的值
    Dim originalValue As Variant
    originalValue = ws.range("A1").value

    End If

    ws.range("A1").value = originalValue
    
    ' 使用文件系统对象遍历文件
    For Each file In folder.files

        Set cell = cell.Offset(1, 0)
    Next file

        Exit Sub
    End If

        Exit Sub

    For i = 2 To lastRow

        If Trim(folderName) <> "" Then
            ' 检查文件夹是否已存在
            If Not fso.FolderExists(folderPath & folderName) Then
                ' 创建新文件夹
                On Error Resume Next
                fso.CreateFolder (folderPath & folderName)
                If err.Number <> 0 Then

                Cells(i, "B").value = "已存在"
            End If
        Else
            ' 空名称
            Cells(i, "B").value = "名称为空"
        End If
    Next i

'根据选择的单元格区域自动创建窗体
Sub CreateUserForm()
' 定义间距和边距参数
    Const CONTROL_H_SPACING As Single = 3    ' 控件水平间距
    Const CONTROL_V_SPACING As Single = 3    ' 控件垂直间距
    Const FORM_MARGIN As Single = 10          ' 窗体边距（四周一致）

    Dim selectedRange As range
    Dim cell As range
    Dim formHeight As Single
    Dim formWidth As Single
    Dim controlTop As Single, controlLeft As Single
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim ctrl As Object
    Dim colWidth As Double

    ' 获取选中区域
    Set selectedRange = Selection
    If selectedRange Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选择单元格区域！"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 计算窗体尺寸
    formWidth = 0
    For j = 1 To selectedRange.Columns.count
        formWidth = formWidth + selectedRange.Columns(j).Width
    Next j
    formWidth = formWidth + (selectedRange.Columns.count - 1) * CONTROL_H_SPACING + 2 * FORM_MARGIN + 5

    ' 修正后的高度计算
    formHeight = selectedRange.Rows.count * selectedRange.Rows(1).Height + _
                 (selectedRange.Rows.count - 1) * CONTROL_V_SPACING + _
                 2 * FORM_MARGIN + 15

    ' 创建新窗体
    Dim vbComp As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents.Remove ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents("DynamicForm")
    On Error GoTo 0

    Set vbComp = ThisWorkbook.VBProject.VBComponents.Add(3)    ' 3 = vbext_ct_MSForm

    ' 配置窗体属性
    With vbComp
        .Properties("Caption") = "动态生成窗体"
        .Properties("Width") = formWidth
        .Properties("Height") = formHeight
        .Properties("StartUpPosition") = 0    ' 手动定位
        .Properties("Left") = Application.Left + 100
        .Properties("Top") = Application.Top + 100
    End With

    ' 添加控件
    controlTop = FORM_MARGIN

    For i = 1 To selectedRange.Rows.count
        controlLeft = FORM_MARGIN

        For j = 1 To selectedRange.Columns.count
            Set cell = selectedRange.Cells(i, j)
            colWidth = cell.Width

            Select Case LCase(Trim(cell.value))
            Case "按钮"
                Set ctrl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1", "Button_" & i & "_" & j)
                With ctrl
                    .Left = controlLeft
                    .Top = controlTop
                    .Width = colWidth
                    .Height = cell.Height
                    .Caption = cell.value

                    ' 字体设置
                    .Font.NAME = cell.Font.NAME
                    .Font.size = cell.Font.size
                    .Font.Bold = cell.Font.Bold
                    .Font.Italic = cell.Font.Italic
                    .Font.Underline = fmUnderlineNone
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .Font.Color = cell.Font.Color
                    On Error GoTo 0

                    ' 填充颜色
                    If cell.Interior.Color <> 16777215 Then
                        .BackColor = cell.Interior.Color
                    Else
                    End If

                    ' 对齐方式
                    Select Case cell.HorizontalAlignment
                    Case xlCenter: .alignment = fmAlignmentCenter
                    Case xlRight: .alignment = fmAlignmentRight
                    End Select
                End With
            Case "标签"
                Set ctrl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1", "Label_" & i & "_" & j)
                With ctrl
                    .Left = controlLeft
                    .Top = controlTop
                    .Width = colWidth
                    .Height = cell.Height
                    .Caption = cell.value

                    ' 字体设置
                    .Font.NAME = cell.Font.NAME
                    .Font.size = cell.Font.size
                    .Font.Bold = cell.Font.Bold
                    .Font.Italic = cell.Font.Italic
                    .Font.Underline = fmUnderlineNone
                    .ForeColor = cell.Font.Color

                    ' 填充颜色
                    If cell.Interior.Color <> 16777215 Then
                        .BackColor = cell.Interior.Color
                    Else
                    End If

                    ' 对齐方式
                    Select Case cell.HorizontalAlignment
                    Case xlCenter: .textAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
                    Case xlRight: .textAlign = fmTextAlignRight
                    End Select
                End With
            Case Else
                ' 文本框
                Set ctrl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1", "TextBox_" & i & "_" & j)
                With ctrl
                    .Left = controlLeft
                    .Top = controlTop
                    .Width = colWidth
                    .Height = cell.Height
                    .Text = cell.value

                    ' 字体设置
                    .Font.NAME = cell.Font.NAME
                    .Font.size = cell.Font.size
                    .Font.Bold = cell.Font.Bold
                    .Font.Italic = cell.Font.Italic
                    .Font.Underline = fmUnderlineNone

                    ' 填充颜色
                    If cell.Interior.Color <> 16777215 Then
                        .BackColor = cell.Interior.Color
                    Else
                    End If

                    ' 对齐方式
                    Select Case cell.HorizontalAlignment
                    Case xlCenter: .textAlign = fmTextAlignCenter
                    Case xlRight: .textAlign = fmTextAlignRight
                    End Select

                    ' 尝试设置文本框字体颜色（通过API）
                    On Error Resume Next
                    SendMessage ctrl.hwnd, WM_SETTEXTCOLOR, 0, ByVal cell.Font.Color
                    On Error GoTo 0
                End With
            End Select

            controlLeft = controlLeft + colWidth + CONTROL_H_SPACING
        Next j

        controlTop = controlTop + selectedRange.Rows(1).Height + CONTROL_V_SPACING
    Next i
    '       UserForm1.Show
End Sub

Public Sub VerticalCcrollCarRefresh()
    Dim lastDataRow As Long
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim tempRng As range
    
    ' 锁定当前激活工作表
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    
    ' 清空滚动限制区域，刷新使用范围
    ws.ScrollArea = ""
    Set tempRng = ws.usedRange
    
    ' 查找最后一行有数据单元格
    On Error Resume Next
    lastDataRow = ws.Cells.Find( _
        What:="*", _
        After:=ws.range("A1"), _
        SearchOrder:=xlByRows, _
        SearchDirection:=xlPrevious).row
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 空白表兜底，默认第1行
    If lastDataRow = 0 Then lastDataRow = 1
    
    ' 窗口滚动至最后一行、A列
    ActiveWindow.ScrollRow = lastDataRow
    ActiveWindow.ScrollColumn = 1
    
    ' 恢复系统设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    
    MsgBox "当前工作表滚动刷新完成！", vbInformation
End Sub

' = 回归分析逻辑 =
Private Sub RunRegression(YRange As range, XRange As range)
    Dim y As Variant, XRaw As Variant
    Dim YName As String, XNames() As String
    Dim n As Long, k As Long, i As Long
    
    ' 保存标题
    YName = YRange.Cells(1, 1).value
    k = XRange.Columns.count
    ReDim XNames(1 To k)
    For i = 1 To k
        XNames(i) = XRange.Cells(1, i).value
    Next i
    
    ' 读取数据（跳过标题行）
    y = YRange.Offset(1, 0).Resize(YRange.Rows.count - 1, 1).value
    XRaw = XRange.Offset(1, 0).Resize(XRange.Rows.count - 1, k).value
    n = UBound(y, 1)
    
    ' 添加截距列
    Dim XWithIntercept As Variant
    XWithIntercept = AddIntercept(XRaw)
    
    ' 计算系数 Beta = (X'X)^(-1) X'Y
    Dim Xt As Variant, XtX As Variant, XtXInv As Variant, XtY As Variant, Beta As Variant
    Xt = WorksheetFunction.Transpose(XWithIntercept)
    XtX = WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, XWithIntercept)
    XtXInv = WorksheetFunction.MInverse(XtX)
    XtY = WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, y)
    Beta = WorksheetFunction.MMult(XtXInv, XtY)
    
    ' 预测值 PredY = X * Beta
    Dim PredY As Variant
    PredY = WorksheetFunction.MMult(XWithIntercept, Beta)
    
    ' 残差
    Dim Residuals() As Double
    ReDim Residuals(1 To n)
    For i = 1 To n
        Residuals(i) = CDbl(y(i, 1)) - CDbl(PredY(i, 1))
    Next i
    
    ' 输出结果
    OutputResults Beta, y, PredY, Residuals, XRaw, XWithIntercept, n, k, YName, XNames
End Sub

' = 添加截距列 =
Private Function AddIntercept(X As Variant) As Variant
    Dim r As Long, c As Long, i As Long, j As Long
    Dim newX() As Double
    r = UBound(X, 1)
    c = UBound(X, 2)
    ReDim newX(1 To r, 1 To c + 1)
    For i = 1 To r
        newX(i, 1) = 1#
        For j = 1 To c
            newX(i, j + 1) = Val(X(i, j))
        Next j
    Next i
    AddIntercept = newX
End Function

' = 输出结果到新建工作表 =
Private Sub OutputResults(Beta As Variant, y As Variant, PredY As Variant, Residuals() As Double, _
                          XRaw As Variant, XWithIntercept As Variant, n As Long, k As Long, _
                          YName As String, XNames() As String)
    Dim wsOut As Worksheet
    Set wsOut = ActiveWorkbook.sheets.Add
    wsOut.NAME = "回归分析结果"
    
    Dim i As Long
    
    ' 计算统计量
    Dim meanY As Double, SSR As Double, SSE As Double, SST As Double
    For i = 1 To n: meanY = meanY + CDbl(y(i, 1)): Next i
    meanY = meanY / n
    For i = 1 To n
        SSR = SSR + (CDbl(PredY(i, 1)) - meanY) ^ 2
        SSE = SSE + Residuals(i) ^ 2
        SST = SST + (CDbl(y(i, 1)) - meanY) ^ 2
    Next i
    
    Dim R2 As Double, AdjR2 As Double
    R2 = IIf(SST = 0, 0, SSR / SST)
    AdjR2 = 1 - (SSE / (n - k - 1)) / (SST / (n - 1))
    
    Dim MSR As Double, MSE As Double, Fstat As Double, pF As Double
    MSR = SSR / k
    MSE = SSE / (n - k - 1)
    Fstat = IIf(MSE = 0, 0, MSR / MSE)
    pF = WorksheetFunction.F_Dist_RT(Fstat, k, n - k - 1)
    
    ' 回归统计
    wsOut.range("A1").value = "回归统计"
    wsOut.range("A2").value = "Multiple R": wsOut.range("B2").value = Sqr(R2)
    wsOut.range("A3").value = "R2": wsOut.range("B3").value = R2
    wsOut.range("A4").value = "调整后的 R2": wsOut.range("B4").value = AdjR2
    wsOut.range("A5").value = "标准误差": wsOut.range("B5").value = Sqr(MSE)
    wsOut.range("A6").value = "样本量": wsOut.range("B6").value = n
    
    ' ANOVA 表
    wsOut.range("A8").value = "ANOVA"
    wsOut.range("A9:F9").value = Array("来源", "平方和", "自由度", "均方", "F", "显著性 F")
    wsOut.range("A10").value = "回归": wsOut.range("B10").value = SSR: wsOut.range("C10").value = k
    wsOut.range("D10").value = MSR: wsOut.range("E10").value = Fstat: wsOut.range("F10").value = pF
    wsOut.range("A11").value = "残差": wsOut.range("B11").value = SSE: wsOut.range("C11").value = n - k - 1
    wsOut.range("D11").value = MSE
    wsOut.range("A12").value = "总和": wsOut.range("B12").value = SST: wsOut.range("C12").value = n - 1
    
    ' 系数表
    wsOut.range("A14").value = "系数表"
    wsOut.range("A15").value = "变量"
    wsOut.range("B15").value = "系数"
    wsOut.range("C15").value = "标准误差"
    wsOut.range("D15").value = "t 值"
    wsOut.range("E15").value = "P 值"
    
    ' 计算标准误差、t 值、P 值
    Dim Xt As Variant, XtX As Variant, XtXInv As Variant
    Xt = WorksheetFunction.Transpose(XWithIntercept)
    XtX = WorksheetFunction.MMult(Xt, XWithIntercept)
    XtXInv = WorksheetFunction.MInverse(XtX)
    
    Dim df As Long: df = n - k - 1
    Dim SE() As Double
    ReDim SE(1 To UBound(Beta, 1))
    
    ' 截距
    SE(1) = Sqr(MSE * XtXInv(1, 1))
    wsOut.Cells(16, 1).value = "截距"
    wsOut.Cells(16, 2).value = Beta(1, 1)
    wsOut.Cells(16, 3).value = SE(1)
    Dim t0 As Double: t0 = IIf(SE(1) = 0, 0, Beta(1, 1) / SE(1))
    wsOut.Cells(16, 4).value = t0
    wsOut.Cells(16, 5).value = PValueTTwoTail(t0, df)
    
    ' 各自变量（使用标题）
    Dim rowStart As Long: rowStart = 17
    For i = 2 To UBound(Beta, 1)
        SE(i) = Sqr(MSE * XtXInv(i, i))
        wsOut.Cells(rowStart + (i - 2), 1).value = XNames(i - 1)
        wsOut.Cells(rowStart + (i - 2), 2).value = Beta(i, 1)
        wsOut.Cells(rowStart + (i - 2), 3).value = SE(i)
        Dim tval As Double: tval = IIf(SE(i) = 0, 0, Beta(i, 1) / SE(i))
        wsOut.Cells(rowStart + (i - 2), 4).value = tval
        wsOut.Cells(rowStart + (i - 2), 5).value = PValueTTwoTail(tval, df)
    Next i
    
    ' 残差表（实际值、预测值、残差）
    Dim baseRow As Long
    baseRow = rowStart + (UBound(Beta, 1) - 1) + 2 ' 系数表后留一行空白
    wsOut.Cells(baseRow, 1).value = "残差表"
    wsOut.Cells(baseRow + 1, 1).value = YName
    wsOut.Cells(baseRow + 1, 2).value = "预测值"
    wsOut.Cells(baseRow + 1, 3).value = "残差"
    
    For i = 1 To n
        wsOut.Cells(baseRow + 1 + i, 1).value = y(i, 1)
        wsOut.Cells(baseRow + 1 + i, 2).value = PredY(i, 1)
        wsOut.Cells(baseRow + 1 + i, 3).value = Residuals(i)
    Next i
    
    ' 散点图 + 回归线（基于第一个自变量标题）
    Dim chartStartRow As Long
    chartStartRow = baseRow + n + 3
    wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow, 1).value = XNames(1)
    wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow, 2).value = YName
    wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow, 3).value = "预测值（按X1）"
    
    For i = 1 To n
        wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + i, 1).value = Val(XRaw(i, 1))
        wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + i, 2).value = y(i, 1)
        wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + i, 3).value = PredY(i, 1)
    Next i
    
    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = wsOut.ChartObjects.Add(Left:=350, Top:=20, Width:=520, Height:=340)
    With co.Chart
        .chartType = xlXYScatter
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = "散点图与回归拟合线（" & XNames(1) & "）"
        .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        
        ' 散点：X1 vs 实际Y
        .SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        .SeriesCollection(1).NAME = YName
        .SeriesCollection(1).XValues = wsOut.range(wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + 1, 1), wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + n, 1))
        .SeriesCollection(1).values = wsOut.range(wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + 1, 2), wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + n, 2))
        
        ' 拟合线：X1 vs 预测Y
        .SeriesCollection.NewSeries
        .SeriesCollection(2).NAME = "预测值"
        .SeriesCollection(2).XValues = wsOut.range(wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + 1, 1), wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + n, 1))
        .SeriesCollection(2).values = wsOut.range(wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + 1, 3), wsOut.Cells(chartStartRow + n, 3))
        .SeriesCollection(2).chartType = xlXYScatterLinesNoMarkers
    End With
    
    MsgBox "回归分析完成，结果已输出到活动工作簿的新工作表【" & wsOut.NAME & "】", vbInformation
End Sub

' 两侧 P 值（t 分布）：优先使用新函数，回退旧函数
Private Function PValueTTwoTail(ByVal tval As Double, ByVal df As Long) As Double
    tval = Abs(tval)
    On Error Resume Next
    PValueTTwoTail = WorksheetFunction.T_Dist_2T(tval, df) ' 新函数（Excel 2010+）
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        err.Clear
        PValueTTwoTail = WorksheetFunction.TDist(tval, df, 2) ' 旧函数
    End If
End Function

' 功能：设置默认配置选择
Private Sub SetDefaultConfigSelection()
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    Dim configDict As Object
    Dim configKey As Variant
    Dim configArray As Variant
    Dim foundCurrent As Boolean
    Dim defaultConfig As String

    ' 获取配置字典
    Set configDict = GetConfigDictionary

    foundCurrent = False
    defaultConfig = "默认配置"

    ' 遍历字典，查找AF列标记为"是"的配置
    For Each configKey In configDict.Keys
        configArray = configDict(configKey)
        If UBound(configArray) >= 31 Then ' 确保有32个元素
            If LCase(Trim(configArray(31))) = "是" Then ' AF列是第32个元素(索引31)
                cmbConfigList.value = configKey
                foundCurrent = True
                ' 加载配置到窗体
                Call LoadConfigToForm(CStr(configKey))
                Exit For
            End If
        End If
    Next configKey

    ' 如果没有找到当前配置，则选择默认配置
    If Not foundCurrent Then
        If configDict.exists(defaultConfig) Then
            cmbConfigList.value = defaultConfig
            Call LoadConfigToForm(defaultConfig)
        ElseIf configDict.count > 0 Then
            ' 如果连默认配置都没有，选择第一个配置
            cmbConfigList.listIndex = 0
            Call LoadConfigToForm(cmbConfigList.value)
        End If
    End If

    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "设置默认配置失败: " & err.Description, vbExclamation, "错误"
End Sub

' 功能：安全设置控件值，处理空值情况
Private Sub SafeSetControlValue(control As Variant, value As Variant, defaultValue As Variant, controlType As String)
    On Error Resume Next

    If IsEmpty(value) Or IsNull(value) Then
        ' 处理空值情况
        Select Case controlType
            Case "String"
                If TypeOf control Is MSForms.ComboBox Then
                    control.value = IIf(IsEmpty(defaultValue), "", defaultValue)
                ElseIf TypeOf control Is MSForms.textBox Then
                    control.value = IIf(IsEmpty(defaultValue), "", defaultValue)
                End If
            Case "Boolean"
                If TypeOf control Is MSForms.CheckBox Or TypeOf control Is MSForms.OptionButton Then
                    control.value = IIf(IsEmpty(defaultValue), False, CBool(defaultValue))
                End If
            Case "Numeric"
                If TypeOf control Is MSForms.textBox Then
                    control.value = IIf(IsEmpty(defaultValue), "", defaultValue)
                End If
            Case "Color"
                If TypeOf control Is MSForms.CommandButton Then
                    control.BackColor = IIf(IsEmpty(defaultValue), RGB(255, 255, 255), defaultValue)
                End If
        End Select
    Else
        ' 正常设置值
        Select Case controlType
            Case "String"
                control.value = CStr(value)
            Case "Boolean"
                control.value = CBool(value)
            Case "Numeric"
                If IsNumeric(value) Then
                    If TypeOf control Is MSForms.textBox Then
                        control.value = CDbl(value)
                    End If
                End If
            Case "Color"
                control.BackColor = CLng(value)
        End Select
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 功能：设置文本对齐方式
Private Sub SetTextAlignment(alignmentType As String, alignment As String)
    On Error Resume Next

    Dim leftControl As MSForms.OptionButton
    Dim centerControl As MSForms.OptionButton
    Dim rightControl As MSForms.OptionButton

    Select Case alignmentType
        Case "text"
            Set leftControl = Me.textLeft
            Set centerControl = Me.textCenter
            Set rightControl = Me.textRight
        Case "num"
            Set leftControl = Me.numLeft
            Set centerControl = Me.numCenter
            Set rightControl = Me.numRight
        Case "date"
            Set leftControl = Me.dateLeft
            Set centerControl = Me.dateCenter
            Set rightControl = Me.dateRight
    End Select

    If Not leftControl Is Nothing And Not centerControl Is Nothing And Not rightControl Is Nothing Then
        ' 重置所有选项
        leftControl.value = False
        centerControl.value = False
        rightControl.value = False

        ' 设置选中项
        Select Case LCase(Trim(alignment))
            Case "左对齐"
                leftControl.value = True
            Case "居中对齐"
                centerControl.value = True
            Case "右对齐"
                rightControl.value = True
            Case Else
                centerControl.value = True ' 默认居中
        End Select
    End If

    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

' 配置选择改变事件
Private Sub cmbConfigList_Change()
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler

    ' 当用户选择不同配置时，加载对应配置

        Call LoadConfigToForm(cmbConfigList.value)
        
        ' 更新格式配置中32列标记，将当前选中配置标记为"是"，其他标记为"否"
        Dim ws As Worksheet
        Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("格式配置")
        
        Dim lastRow As Long
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "B").End(xlUp).row
        
        Dim i As Long
        Dim configName As String
        configName = cmbConfigList.value
        
        ' 遍历所有配置行，更新当前配置标记
        For i = 2 To lastRow
            If Trim(ws.Cells(i, "B").value) = configName Then

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, "B").End(xlUp).row
    
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    ' 获取新行号（基于B列，因为配置名称保存在B列）
    Dim lastRow As Long

    ws.Cells(lastRow, "A").value = lastRow - 1 ' A列：配置序号
    ws.Cells(lastRow, "B").value = newConfigName

' 辅助函数：将配置保存到工作表
Private Sub SaveConfigToSheet(ws As Worksheet, rowNum As Long)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 保存配置到工作表，根据LoadConfigToForm函数的映射关系
    
    ' 表头格式配置列 (C-G列)
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "C").value = cmbHeaderFont.value           ' 表头字体
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "D").value = cmbHeaderSize.value           ' 表头字体大小
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "E").value = chkHeaderBold.value           ' 表头加粗

    ws.Cells(rowNum, "G").value = btnHeaderBackColor.BackColor  ' 表头背景色
    
    ' 内容格式配置列 (H-M列)
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "H").value = cmbContentFont.value          ' 内容字体
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "I").value = cmbContentSize.value          ' 内容字体大小
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "J").value = chkContentBold.value          ' 内容加粗
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "K").value = btnContentFontColor.BackColor ' 内容字体颜色
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "L").value = btnContentBackColor.BackColor ' 内容背景色
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "M").value = btnContentBackColor2.BackColor ' 内容间隔背景色

    ws.Cells(rowNum, "N").value = cmbInnerBorder.value          ' 内边框样式
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "O").value = btnInnerBorderColor.BackColor ' 内边框颜色
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "P").value = cmbOuterBorder.value          ' 外边框样式
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "Q").value = btnOuterBorderColor.BackColor ' 外边框颜色

    ws.Cells(rowNum, "R").value = txtRowHeight.value            ' 行高
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "S").value = autoWith.value               ' 自动列宽
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "T").value = autoWithAdd.value            ' 自动列宽额外宽度
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "U").value = txtColumnWidth.value         ' 固定列宽
    
    ' 对齐模式配置列 (V-Y列)
    ' 获取文本、数值、日期对齐方式
    Dim textAlign As String, numAlign As String, dateAlign As String
    textAlign = GetSelectedAlignment("text")
    numAlign = GetSelectedAlignment("num")
    dateAlign = GetSelectedAlignment("date")
    
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "V").value = textAlign                     ' 文本对齐方式

    ws.Cells(rowNum, "X").value = dateAlign                     ' 日期对齐方式

    ws.Cells(rowNum, "AD").value = txtNumDecimal.value          ' 数值小数位数
    ws.Cells(rowNum, "AE").value = chkNumNoDecimal.value        ' 大数不显示小数

    If ws.Cells(rowNum, "AF").value = "" Then
        ws.Cells(rowNum, "AF").value = "否"
    End If
    
    Exit Sub
ErrorHandler:
    err.Raise err.Number, "SaveConfigToSheet", err.Description
End Sub

' 辅助函数：获取文本、数值或日期的对齐方式
' 参数：alignType - "text"、"num"或"date"
' 返回：选中的对齐方式
Private Function GetSelectedAlignment(alignType As String) As String
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Dim leftCtrl As control, centerCtrl As control, rightCtrl As control
    
    ' 根据对齐类型获取对应的控件组
    Select Case alignType
        Case "text"
            Set leftCtrl = textLeft
            Set centerCtrl = textCenter
            Set rightCtrl = textRight
        Case "num"
            Set leftCtrl = numLeft
            Set centerCtrl = numCenter
            Set rightCtrl = numRight
        Case "date"
            Set leftCtrl = dateLeft
            Set centerCtrl = dateCenter
            Set rightCtrl = dateRight
        Case Else
            GetSelectedAlignment = "居中对齐"
            Exit Function
    End Select
    
    ' 确定选中的对齐方式
    If leftCtrl.value Then
        GetSelectedAlignment = "左对齐"
    ElseIf centerCtrl.value Then
        GetSelectedAlignment = "居中对齐"
    ElseIf rightCtrl.value Then
        GetSelectedAlignment = "右对齐"
    Else
        GetSelectedAlignment = "居中对齐"
    End If
    
    Exit Function
ErrorHandler:
    GetSelectedAlignment = "居中对齐"
End Function

Private Sub DoSplit(srcWs As Worksheet, fields() As String, toNewBook As Boolean)
    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    Dim dict As Object, key As String
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim arr, headers, colIndex()
    Dim savePath As String
    
    lastRow = srcWs.Cells(srcWs.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).row
    lastCol = srcWs.Cells(1, srcWs.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).column
    
    arr = srcWs.range("A1").Resize(lastRow, lastCol).value
    ' 获取表头为一维数组
    headers = Application.Index(arr, 1, 0)
    
    ' 遍历选中的字段
    ReDim colIndex(LBound(fields) To UBound(fields))
    For i = LBound(fields) To UBound(fields)
        colIndex(i) = 0
        For j = LBound(headers) To UBound(headers)
            If Trim(CStr(headers(j))) = Trim(CStr(fields(i))) Then
                colIndex(i) = j
                Exit For
            End If
        Next j
        If colIndex(i) = 0 Then
            MsgBox "未找到字段：" & fields(i), vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 用字典收集唯一组合
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        key = ""
        For j = LBound(colIndex) To UBound(colIndex)
            key = key & "|" & arr(i, colIndex(j))
        Next j
        If Not dict.exists(key) Then dict.Add key, Nothing
    Next i
    
    ' 如果选择“新建工作簿”，先在当前工作簿目录下建文件夹
    If toNewBook Then
        savePath = srcWs.Parent.path & "\" & Replace(srcWs.NAME, ":", "_") & "_拆分结果"
        If Dir(savePath, vbDirectory) = "" Then MkDir savePath
    End If
    
    ' 按组合拆分
    Dim k As Variant, newWs As Worksheet, newWB As Workbook
    For Each k In dict.Keys
        If toNewBook Then
            Set newWB = Workbooks.Add
            Set newWs = newWB.sheets(1)
        Else
            Set newWs = srcWs.Parent.sheets.Add(After:=srcWs.Parent.sheets(srcWs.Parent.sheets.count))
        End If
        
        ' 复制表头
        newWs.range("A1").Resize(1, lastCol).value = headers
        
        ' 复制符合条件的行
        Dim r As Long, outRow As Long
        outRow = 2
        For i = 2 To lastRow
            key = ""
            For j = LBound(colIndex) To UBound(colIndex)
                key = key & "|" & arr(i, colIndex(j))
            Next j
            If key = k Then
                newWs.range("A" & outRow).Resize(1, lastCol).value = Application.Index(arr, i, 0)
                outRow = outRow + 1
            End If
        Next i
        
        ' 命名工作表或保存文件
        Dim namePart As String
        namePart = Replace(Mid(k, 2), "|", "_")
        
        If toNewBook Then
            On Error Resume Next
            newWB.SaveAs savePath & "\" & namePart & ".xlsx", fileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook
            newWB.Close False
            On Error GoTo 0
        Else
            On Error Resume Next
            newWs.NAME = Left(namePart, 31)
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next k
    MsgBox "拆分完成！", vbInformation
End Sub

    ReadFirstLineCSV = textLine

' 自定义转置函数
' 自定义转置函数：把 arr(列, 行) 转成 arrT(行, 列)
Private Function MyTranspose(arr As Variant) As Variant
    Dim r As Long, c As Long
    Dim arrT As Variant
    ReDim arrT(1 To UBound(arr, 2), 1 To UBound(arr, 1))
    
    For c = 1 To UBound(arr, 1)
        For r = 1 To UBound(arr, 2)
            arrT(r, c) = arr(c, r)
        Next r
    Next c
    
    MyTranspose = arrT
End Function

' 工作表合并：合并逻辑（修复版）
Private Sub DoMerge(lstSheets2 As MSForms.ListBox, fields() As String, toNewBook As Boolean)
    Dim resultWB As Workbook, resultWs As Worksheet
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, r As Long
    Dim filePath As String, fileName As String, sheetName As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, wbTest As Workbook
    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    Dim arr, headers, colIndex() As Long
    Dim fso As Object, ts As Object, line As String, parts() As String
    Dim openedHere As Boolean
    Dim resultArr() As Variant
    Dim outRows As Long, capacity As Long, numCols As Long
    Dim savePath As String, folderPath As String, timeStamp As String
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
    Application.EnableEvents = False
    
    ' 创建结果工作簿/工作表
    If toNewBook Then
        Set resultWB = Workbooks.Add
    Else
        Set resultWB = ActiveWorkbook
    End If
    
    ' 如果已有“合并结果”，清空重用
    On Error Resume Next
    Set resultWs = resultWB.sheets("合并结果")
    On Error GoTo 0
    If resultWs Is Nothing Then
        Set resultWs = resultWB.sheets.Add
        resultWs.NAME = "合并结果"
    Else
        resultWs.Cells.Clear
    End If
    
    ' 初始化数组（列, 行）
    numCols = UBound(fields) - LBound(fields) + 1 + 2 ' 字段数 + 来源文件/工作表
    capacity = 5000
    ReDim resultArr(1 To numCols, 1 To capacity)
    
    ' 表头
    For j = LBound(fields) To UBound(fields)
        resultArr(j - LBound(fields) + 1, 1) = fields(j)
    Next j
    resultArr(numCols - 1, 1) = "来源文件"
    resultArr(numCols, 1) = "来源工作表"
    
    outRows = 1
    
    ' 遍历用户选择的工作表/文件
    For i = 0 To lstSheets2.ListCount - 1
        If lstSheets2.Selected(i) Then
            fileName = lstSheets2.List(i, 0)
            sheetName = lstSheets2.List(i, 1)
            filePath = lstSheets2.List(i, 2)
            
            If LCase(Right(filePath, 4)) = ".csv" Then
                ' = CSV 文件处理 =
                Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
                Set ts = fso.OpenTextFile(filePath, 1, False, -1)
                
                ' 读取表头
                If Not ts.AtEndOfStream Then
                    line = ts.ReadLine
                    parts = Split(line, ",")
                End If
                
                ' 建立字段索引
                ReDim colIndex(LBound(fields) To UBound(fields))
                For j = LBound(fields) To UBound(fields)
                    colIndex(j) = GetFieldIndex(parts, fields(j))
                Next j
                
                ' 逐行读取数据
                Do While Not ts.AtEndOfStream
                    line = ts.ReadLine
                    parts = Split(line, ",")
                    outRows = outRows + 1
                    If outRows > capacity Then
                        capacity = capacity * 2
                        ReDim Preserve resultArr(1 To numCols, 1 To capacity)
                    End If
                    For j = LBound(fields) To UBound(fields)
                        If colIndex(j) > -1 And colIndex(j) <= UBound(parts) Then
                            resultArr(j - LBound(fields) + 1, outRows) = parts(colIndex(j))
                        End If
                    Next j
                    resultArr(numCols - 1, outRows) = fileName
                    resultArr(numCols, outRows) = "(CSV)"
                Loop
                ts.Close
                
            Else
                ' = Excel 工作表处理 =
                Set wb = Nothing
                openedHere = False
                
                ' 判断是否已打开
                For Each wbTest In Application.Workbooks
                    If StrComp(wbTest.FullName, filePath, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                        Set wb = wbTest
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next wbTest
                
                ' 如果没打开 → 临时打开
                If wb Is Nothing Then
                    Set wb = GetObject(filePath)
                    openedHere = True
                End If
                
                If Not wb Is Nothing Then
                    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(sheetName)
                    
                    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, 1).End(xlUp).row
                    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).column
                    arr = ws.range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).value
                    
                    headers = Application.Index(arr, 1, 0)
                    
                    ' 建立字段索引
                    ReDim colIndex(LBound(fields) To UBound(fields))
                    For j = LBound(fields) To UBound(fields)
                        colIndex(j) = GetFieldIndex(headers, fields(j))
                    Next j
                    
                    ' 写入数据
                    For r = 2 To lastRow
                        outRows = outRows + 1
                        If outRows > capacity Then
                            capacity = capacity * 2
                            ReDim Preserve resultArr(1 To numCols, 1 To capacity)
                        End If
                        For j = LBound(fields) To UBound(fields)
                            If colIndex(j) > -1 Then
                                resultArr(j - LBound(fields) + 1, outRows) = arr(r, colIndex(j))
                            End If
                        Next j
                        resultArr(numCols - 1, outRows) = fileName
                        resultArr(numCols, outRows) = sheetName
                    Next r
                    
                    ' 只关闭临时打开的
                    If openedHere Then wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 裁剪数组到实际行数
    ReDim Preserve resultArr(1 To numCols, 1 To outRows)
    
    ' 转置并一次性写入工作表
    resultWs.range("A1").Resize(outRows, numCols).value = MyTranspose(resultArr)
    
    ' 如果选择新建工作簿 → 保存到当前工作簿目录下的“合并结果”文件夹
    If toNewBook Then
        folderPath = ActiveWorkbook.path & "\合并结果"
        If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then MkDir folderPath
        timeStamp = Format(Now, "yyyymmddHHMMSS")
        savePath = folderPath & "\合并结果_" & timeStamp & ".xlsx"
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        resultWB.SaveAs savePath, fileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        MsgBox "合并完成，共输出 " & outRows - 1 & " 行数据。" & vbCrLf & _
               "文件已保存到：" & savePath, vbInformation
    Else
        MsgBox "合并完成，共输出 " & outRows - 1 & " 行数据。", vbInformation
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.EnableEvents = True
End Sub

' 工作表合并：字段索引查找函数
Private Function GetFieldIndex(headers, fieldName As String) As Long
    Dim j As Long
    GetFieldIndex = -1
    On Error Resume Next
    For j = LBound(headers) To UBound(headers)
        If LCase(Trim(CStr(headers(j)))) = LCase(Trim(fieldName)) Then
            GetFieldIndex = j
            Exit For
        End If
    Next j
End Function

Private Sub RefreshFields2()
    Dim dict As Object, wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet
    Dim selWB As String, selWS As String, filePath As String
    Dim lastCol As Long, i As Long, j As Variant, arr, fld As String
    Dim openedHere As Boolean, wbTest As Workbook
    
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    lstFields2.Clear
    
    ' 遍历所有选中的表
    For i = 0 To lstSheets2.ListCount - 1
        If lstSheets2.Selected(i) Then
            filePath = lstSheets2.List(i, 2)
            selWB = lstSheets2.List(i, 0)
            selWS = lstSheets2.List(i, 1)
            
            If LCase(Right(filePath, 4)) = ".csv" Then
                arr = Split(ReadFirstLineCSV(filePath), ",")
                For j = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
                    fld = Trim(CStr(arr(j)))
                    If Len(fld) > 0 Then
                        If Not dict.exists(fld) Then dict.Add fld, fld
                    End If
                Next j
            Else
                ' Excel 文件
                Set wb = Nothing
                openedHere = False
                
                ' 判断是否已打开
                For Each wbTest In Application.Workbooks
                    If StrComp(wbTest.FullName, filePath, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
                        Set wb = wbTest
                        Exit For
                    End If
                Next wbTest
                
                ' 如果没打开 → 临时打开
                If wb Is Nothing Then
                    Set wb = GetObject(filePath)
                    openedHere = True
                End If
                
                If Not wb Is Nothing Then
                    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(selWS)
                    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.count).End(xlToLeft).column
                    For j = 1 To lastCol
                        fld = Trim(CStr(ws.Cells(1, j).value))
                        If Len(fld) > 0 Then
                            If Not dict.exists(fld) Then dict.Add fld, fld
                        End If
                    Next j
                    ' 只关闭临时打开的
                    If openedHere Then wb.Close False
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 加载去重后的字段
    For Each j In dict.Keys
        lstFields2.AddItem j
        lstFields2.Selected(lstFields2.ListCount - 1) = True
    Next
End Sub

End Sub

    Option Explicit
Sub getpi(Optional ByVal nums As Long = 10000)
    nums = nums / 5
    Dim max As Long, laptime As Single, result() As String
    Dim i As Long, j As Long, t, d As Long, g, k As Long, f()
    laptime = Timer
    max = 18 * nums

    For i = 0 To max

    Next
    result(0) = "π=" & vbCrLf
    g = 20000
    For j = max To 1 Step -18
        t = 0
        For i = j To 1 Step -1
            t = t + f(i) * 100000
            d = 2 * i + 1
            f(i) = t - Int(t / d) * d
            t = Int(t / d) * i
        Next
        k = k + 1
        result(k) = Format(Int(g + t / 100000) Mod 100000, "00000")
        If k Mod 20 = 0 Then result(k) = result(k) & vbCrLf
        If k Mod 200 = 0 Then result(k) = result(k) & "---[" & k * 5 & "]---" & vbCrLf
        g = t Mod 100000
    Next
    Me.TextBox1.Text = Join(result, " ")
