' 加载指定列数据到列表框
Private Sub FillListBox()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim ColLetter As String
    Dim colNum As Long
    Dim dict As Object
    Dim visCell As range, cell As range
    Dim lastRow As Long
    
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    dict.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    ColLetter = UCase(Trim(Me.CurrentColumn.Text))
    colNum = ws.Columns(ColLetter).column
    
    Me.LoadListBoxData.Clear
    
    If Me.CheckBox1.value Then
        ' ===== 叠加筛选模式：只读取筛选后可见单元格 =====
        On Error Resume Next
        Set visCell = ws.usedRange.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeVisible)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If visCell Is Nothing Then
            MsgBox "当前筛选后无可见数据", vbInformation
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        ' 遍历可见区域，只取当前目标列单元格
        For Each cell In visCell
            If cell.column = colNum And cell.row > 1 Then '跳过表头第1行
                If Not dict.exists(Trim(cell.value)) Then
                    dict(Trim(cell.value)) = ""
                End If
            End If
        Next cell
    Else
        ' ===== 独立筛选模式：读取整列全部原始数据 =====
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, colNum).End(xlUp).row
        If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
        For Each cell In ws.range(ws.Cells(2, colNum), ws.Cells(lastRow, colNum))
            If Not dict.exists(Trim(cell.value)) Then
                dict(Trim(cell.value)) = ""
            End If
        Next cell
    End If
    
    ' 填充列表框
    If dict.count > 0 Then
        Me.LoadListBoxData.List = dict.Keys
    End If
    Set dict = Nothing
End Sub

' 筛选按钮主逻辑 (兼容超级表和普通数据) [需求4, 5]
Private Sub btnOutput_Click()
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    Dim ColLetter As String
    ColLetter = UCase(Trim(Me.CurrentColumn.Text))
    If ColLetter = "" Then ColLetter = "A"
    
    'CheckBox2默认勾选=True：执行原有列表多选正向筛选
    If Me.CheckBox2.value Then
        '===== 正常模式：列表框选中项正向筛选 =====
        Dim ws As Worksheet
        Dim lo As ListObject
        Dim colNum As Long
        Dim fieldNum As Long
        Dim i As Long
        Dim outStr As String
        Dim filterArr() As String
        
        If Not TypeOf ActiveSheet Is Worksheet Then
            MsgBox "当前工作表不支持筛选操作", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
        Set ws = ActiveSheet
        colNum = ws.Columns(ColLetter).column
        
        '收集列表框选中内容
        outStr = ""
        For i = 0 To Me.LoadListBoxData.ListCount - 1
            If Me.LoadListBoxData.Selected(i) Then
                outStr = outStr & Me.LoadListBoxData.List(i) & "|"
            End If
        Next i
        If outStr = "" Then
            MsgBox "请勾选至少一项筛选条件！", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
        outStr = Left(outStr, Len(outStr) - 1)
        filterArr = Split(outStr, "|")
        
        Application.ScreenUpdating = False
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        
        Set lo = GetListObjectByCell(ws.Cells(1, colNum))
        If lo Is Nothing Then
            Dim lastR As Long
            lastR = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, colNum).End(xlUp).row
            If lastR >= 2 Then Set lo = GetListObjectByCell(ws.Cells(lastR, colNum))
        End If
        
        If Not lo Is Nothing Then
            fieldNum = colNum - lo.range.column + 1
            lo.range.AutoFilter _
                Field:=fieldNum, _
                Criteria1:=filterArr, _
                Operator:=xlFilterValues
        Else
            Dim startCol As Long, colCnt As Long
            startCol = ws.usedRange.column
            colCnt = ws.usedRange.Columns.count
            If colNum < startCol Or colNum > startCol + colCnt - 1 Then
                MsgBox "列 " & ColLetter & " 不在数据范围内！", vbExclamation
                GoTo CleanExit
            End If
            fieldNum = colNum - startCol + 1
            Dim headerRng As range
            Set headerRng = ws.range(ws.Cells(1, startCol), ws.Cells(1, startCol + colCnt - 1))
            headerRng.AutoFilter _
                Field:=fieldNum, _
                Criteria1:=filterArr, _
                Operator:=xlFilterValues
        End If
        
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
        Me.Label2.Caption = "筛选完成！条件：" & ColLetter & " 列；共 " & UBound(filterArr) + 1 & " 个记录"
        Call ScrollDownFromA1
    Else
        '===== 复选框取消勾选：启用4种单选框筛选模式 =====
        If Me.OptionButton1.value = True Then
            '开头匹配
            Call FilterByKeyword(ColLetter, 1, Me.TextBox1.Text)
        ElseIf Me.OptionButton2.value = True Then
            '包含匹配
            Call FilterByKeyword(ColLetter, 2, Me.TextBox1.Text)
        ElseIf Me.OptionButton3.value = True Then
            '结尾匹配
            Call FilterByKeyword(ColLetter, 3, Me.TextBox1.Text)
        ElseIf Me.OptionButton4.value = True Then
            '列表选中反向筛选
            Call ReverseFilterFromListBox(ColLetter)
        Else
            MsgBox "请选择一种筛选模式（开头/包含/结尾/反向筛选）", vbExclamation
            Exit Sub
        End If
    End If
    
    Exit Sub
CleanExit:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    MsgBox "筛选失败！" & vbCrLf & _
           "错误号：" & err.Number & vbCrLf & _
           "错误描述：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    Me.Label2.Caption = "筛选操作异常"
End Sub

'===== 新增：文本模糊筛选核心函数 =====
Private Sub FilterByKeyword(ColLetter As String, matchType As Long, keyword As String)
    Dim ws As Worksheet, lo As ListObject
    Dim colNum As Long, fieldNum As Long
    Dim criteriaStr As String
    
    If Trim(keyword) = "" Then
        MsgBox "请在输入框填写筛选关键词！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    colNum = ws.Columns(ColLetter).column
    
    ' 根据单选框类型拼接通配符
    Select Case matchType
        Case 1 ' Option1 开头
            criteriaStr = keyword & "*"
        Case 2 ' Option2 包含
            criteriaStr = "*" & keyword & "*"
        Case 3 ' Option3 结尾
            criteriaStr = "*" & keyword
    End Select
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.ShowAllData '先清空原有筛选
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 判断超级表/普通区域
    Set lo = GetListObjectByCell(ws.Cells(2, colNum))
    If Not lo Is Nothing Then
        fieldNum = colNum - lo.range.column + 1
        lo.range.AutoFilter Field:=fieldNum, Criteria1:=criteriaStr, Operator:=xlFilterValues
    Else
        Dim startCol As Long, colCnt As Long
        startCol = ws.usedRange.column
        colCnt = ws.usedRange.Columns.count
        fieldNum = colNum - startCol + 1
        ws.usedRange.AutoFilter Field:=fieldNum, Criteria1:=criteriaStr
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Me.Label2.Caption = "模糊筛选完成【匹配模式：" & Choose(matchType, "开头", "包含", "结尾") & "】关键词：" & keyword
    Call ScrollDownFromA1
End Sub

'===== 新增：列表框选中项反向筛选（Option4） =====
Private Sub ReverseFilterFromListBox(ColLetter As String)
    Dim ws As Worksheet, lo As ListObject
    Dim colNum As Long, fieldNum As Long
    Dim dictAll As Object, dictSel As Object, dictResult As Object
    Dim i As Long, tempVal As Variant
    Dim outStr As String, filterArr() As String
    
    '1. 收集列表框选中项
    outStr = ""
    For i = 0 To Me.LoadListBoxData.ListCount - 1
        If Me.LoadListBoxData.Selected(i) Then
            outStr = outStr & Me.LoadListBoxData.List(i) & "|"
        End If
    Next i
    If outStr = "" Then
        MsgBox "请先在列表框勾选至少一项作为排除条件！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    outStr = Left(outStr, Len(outStr) - 1)
    filterArr = Split(outStr, "|")
    
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    colNum = ws.Columns(ColLetter).column
    
    '2. 获取当前列全部不重复数据
    Set dictAll = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictSel = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictResult = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    dictAll.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    dictSel.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
    
    Dim lastRow As Long, arrData As Variant
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, ColLetter).End(xlUp).row
    If lastRow < 2 Then
        MsgBox "当前列无数据", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    arrData = ws.range(ColLetter & "2:" & ColLetter & lastRow).value
    
    For i = LBound(arrData) To UBound(arrData)
        tempVal = Trim(arrData(i, 1))
        If tempVal <> "" And Not dictAll.exists(tempVal) Then dictAll(tempVal) = ""
    Next i
    
    '3. 选中项存入字典
    For i = LBound(filterArr) To UBound(filterArr)
        dictSel(filterArr(i)) = ""
    Next i
    
    '4. 全部值 - 选中值 = 反向筛选值
    For Each tempVal In dictAll.Keys
        If Not dictSel.exists(tempVal) Then dictResult(tempVal) = ""
    Next tempVal
    
    If dictResult.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "反向筛选后无剩余数据，所有值均被排除！", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    '5. 执行筛选
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    On Error Resume Next
    ws.ShowAllData
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    Set lo = GetListObjectByCell(ws.Cells(2, colNum))
    If Not lo Is Nothing Then
        fieldNum = colNum - lo.range.column + 1
        lo.range.AutoFilter Field:=fieldNum, Criteria1:=dictResult.Keys, Operator:=xlFilterValues
    Else
        Dim startCol As Long, colCnt As Long
        startCol = ws.usedRange.column
        colCnt = ws.usedRange.Columns.count
        fieldNum = colNum - startCol + 1
        ws.usedRange.AutoFilter Field:=fieldNum, Criteria1:=dictResult.Keys, Operator:=xlFilterValues
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Me.Label2.Caption = "反向筛选完成，排除选中项共" & dictSel.count & "个，剩余" & dictResult.count & "种数据"
    Call ScrollDownFromA1
    
    Set dictAll = Nothing
    Set dictSel = Nothing
    Set dictResult = Nothing
End Sub

Private Sub GetTxtFileUnLockInfo(txtFile As String, isLock As Boolean)
    Dim i&
    BinFileNum = FreeFile
    With m_BinUnLockInfo
        .IsProtected = False
        Open txtFile For Binary As #BinFileNum
        .sCMG = 0

        .sGC = 0

        For i = 1 To LOF(1)

            End Select

        For i = .sCMG + 1 To LOF(1)

        Next i
    End With

Private Sub LockVBA(typFileInfo As FileInfo)
    Dim sss$(4), i&

    For i = 1 To 3

    For i = 1 To LOF(1)
        Get #BinFileNum, i, buf5
        Select Case buf5
            Case cID
                Get #BinFileNum, i + 5, buf1

                    m_BinUnLockInfo.sID = i - 1
                    Put #BinFileNum, m_BinUnLockInfo.sID + 5, IID
                End If
            Case Else
        End Select
    Next i
    Close #BinFileNum

Private Sub ProcessSingleFile(fl As String, isLock As Boolean)
    Dim bakFile As String, CurrentTxtFile As String
    bakFile = fl & ".bak"

    On Error Resume Next

    If err.Number Then ReportErrInfo (fl): Exit Sub
    Dim typFileInfo As FileInfo
    GetFileInfo fl, typFileInfo
    If typFileInfo.IsNewVer Then
        If ExtractVbaBinFromZip(typFileInfo) = False Then Exit Sub
        CurrentTxtFile = typFileInfo.ZipFolder & "\xl\vbaProject.bin"
    Else
        CurrentTxtFile = fl
    End If
    GetTxtFileUnLockInfo CurrentTxtFile, isLock
    If m_BinUnLockInfo.IsProtected Then
        If isLock Then
            LockVBA typFileInfo
        Else
            UnLockVBA typFileInfo
        End If
        If typFileInfo.IsNewVer Then UpdateVbaBinToZip typFileInfo
    Else
        RevertTxtFile typFileInfo, isLock
    End If
End Sub
Private Function RegReadValue(regPath As String, _
            Optional valueName As String = "") As Variant
    Dim wsShell As Object, cmd As String, output As String
    Dim lines() As String, line As String, i As Long
    Dim typePos As Long, valPos As Long, valType As String, valText As String
    Set wsShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    If valueName = "" Then
        cmd = "reg query """ & regPath & """ /ve"
    Else
        cmd = "reg query """ & regPath & """ /v """ & valueName & """"
    End If
    On Error Resume Next
    output = wsShell.exec(cmd).StdOut.ReadAll()
    On Error GoTo 0
    If output = "" Then
        RegReadValue = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    lines = Split(output, vbCrLf)
    For i = 0 To UBound(lines)
        line = Trim(lines(i))
        If line <> "" And InStr(line, "REG_") > 0 Then
            typePos = InStr(1, line, "REG_", vbTextCompare)
            valPos = InStr(typePos + 5, line, " ")
            valType = UCase(Mid(line, typePos, valPos - typePos))
            valText = Trim(Mid(line, valPos))
            Exit For
        End If
    Next
    Select Case valType
        Case ""
            RegReadValue = Empty
        Case "REG_DWORD"
            RegReadValue = CLng(Val(valText))
        Case "REG_QWORD"
            RegReadValue = CDbl(Val(valText))
        Case Else
            RegReadValue = valText
    End Select
End Function

Private Sub UnLockVBA(typFileInfo As FileInfo)
    Dim i&, j&, flag As Boolean
    With m_BinUnLockInfo
        For j = .sGC + 5 To LOF(1)
            Get #BinFileNum, j, buf2
            If buf2 = vbCrLf Then .eCMGB = j - 2: Exit For
        Next j
        For j = .sCMG + 1 To .eCMGB + 1
            Get #BinFileNum, j, buf1
            If buf1 = c00 Or buf1 = cFF Then flag = True: Exit For
        Next j
        If Not flag Then
            If .sID <> 0 Then
                Dim sss$(4)
                sss(0) = "{00000000": sss(4) = "000000000000}"
                For i = 1 To 3
                    sss(i) = "0000"
                Next
                IID = Join(sss, "-")
                For i = 1 To LOF(1)
                    Get #BinFileNum, i, buf5
                    Select Case buf5
                        Case cID
                            Get #BinFileNum, i + 5, buf1
                            If buf1 Like "#" Then
                                .sID = i - 1
                                Put #BinFileNum, .sID + 5, IID
                            End If
                        Case Else
                    End Select
                Next i
            End If
            For i = 1 To .eCMGB - .sCMG Step 2
                Put #BinFileNum, .sCMG + i, vbCrLf
            Next i
            If Not (.eCMGB - .sCMG + 1) / 2 = Int((.eCMGB - .sCMG + 1) / 2) Then
                Put #BinFileNum, .eCMGB + 1, c20
            End If
        Else
            Put #BinFileNum, .sCMG + 1, "DCH"
            Put #BinFileNum, .sDPB + 1, "DCH"
            Put #BinFileNum, .sGC + 1, "AB"
        End If
    End With

Private Sub UpdateVbaBinToZip(typFileInfo As FileInfo)
    Dim pid As Long
    Dim ExitCode As Long
    Dim hProcess As LongPtr
    Dim cmdLine As String
    Dim shellApp As Object, objFolder As Object, objZip As Object
    Dim zipPath As String
    With typFileInfo
        zipPath = .ZipFolder & ".zip"
        If fso.FileExists(zipPath) Then Kill zipPath
        If IsHaveZipApp Then
            cmdLine = ZipAppFullName & " a -r -ep1 -afzip """ & zipPath & """ """ & .ZipFolder & "\*.*"""
            pid = Shell(cmdLine, vbNormalFocus)
            WaitProcess pid
        Else
            Set shellApp = CreateObject("Shell.Application")
            Dim EmptyZipFileNum As Integer
            EmptyZipFileNum = FreeFile
            Open zipPath For Output As #EmptyZipFileNum
            Print #EmptyZipFileNum, Chr(80) & Chr(75) & Chr(5) & Chr(6) & String(18, 0);
            Close #EmptyZipFileNum
            Set objFolder = shellApp.Namespace(CStr(.ZipFolder))
            Set objZip = shellApp.Namespace(CStr(zipPath))
            objZip.CopyHere objFolder.items
            Do Until objZip.items.count = objFolder.items.count
                DoEvents
            Loop
        End If
        fso.DeleteFolder .ZipFolder
        Name zipPath As (.ZipFolder & .extName)
    End With
End Sub
Private Sub WaitProcess(ByVal pid As Long)
    Dim hProcess As LongPtr, ExitCode As Long
    hProcess = OpenProcess(PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION Or SYNCHRONIZE, 0, pid)
    If hProcess <> 0 Then

        CloseHandle hProcess

Private Function NormalizeDecAsString(ByVal NumericValue As String) As String
'将给定编号中的当前分隔符替换为系统分隔符
'礼貌Jan Hornak，2022-05-27
    Dim result As String

    Dim SysSeparator As String
    SysSeparator = Format(0, ".")

    result = VBA.Replace(NumericValue, ".", SysSeparator)
    result = VBA.Replace(result, ",", SysSeparator)

    NormalizeDecAsString = result
End Function

            iNewlines = (pos - Len(Application.Substitute(Left(txt, pos), vbNewLine, ""))) / 2
            pos = pos + iNewlines + 1
            If pos = 0 Then
                pos = 1
            Else
                pos = pos + 2
            End If
            pos = GetPos(txt, cbbFind.value, pos)
            If pos = 0 Then
                pos = 1
                pos = GetPos(txt, cbbFind.value, pos)
            End If
            If pos > 0 Then
                With tbxFoundText
                    iNewlines = (pos - Len(Application.Substitute(Left(txt, pos), vbNewLine, ""))) / 2
                    .SelStart = pos - 1 - iNewlines
                    .SelLength = Len(cbbFind.value)
                    .SetFocus
                End With
                .SetFocus
                Me.Repaint
            End If

Option Explicit

Public WithEvents btn As MSForms.CommandButton
Attribute btn.VB_VarHelpID = -1
Public ButtonType As String
Public ParentForm As Object
Public ws As Object
Public FieldCount As Long
Public FieldLast As Long
Public IsAddMode As Boolean
Public result As Boolean

Private Sub btn_Click()
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    If ButtonType = "OK" Then
        If SaveValues Then
            result = True
            Unload ParentForm
        End If
    Else
        result = False
        Unload ParentForm
    End If
    Exit Sub
    
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "按钮处理失败：" & err.Description, vbCritical
End Sub

Private Function SaveValues() As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        SaveValues = True
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim i As Long
    Dim ctrl As Object
    Dim addr As String
    
    If IsAddMode Then
        ' 新建：追加到现有数据末尾行的下一行（以第 1 列最后非空行为准）
        Dim newRow As Long
        newRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.count, 1).End(-4162).row + 1 ' xlUp = -4162
        For i = FieldCount To FieldLast
            On Error Resume Next
            Set ctrl = ParentForm.Controls("txtRow" & i)
            If err.Number <> 0 Then
                err.Clear
                GoTo NextAdd
            End If
            On Error GoTo ErrHandler
            ws.Cells(newRow, i).value = ctrl.value
NextAdd:
        Next i
    Else
        ' 编辑：写回原单元格（地址保存在控件 Tag 中）
        For i = FieldCount To FieldLast
            On Error Resume Next
            Set ctrl = ParentForm.Controls("txtRow" & i)
            If err.Number <> 0 Then
                err.Clear
                GoTo NextEdit
            End If
            On Error GoTo ErrHandler
            addr = ctrl.Tag & ""
            If addr <> "" Then
                ws.range(addr).value = ctrl.value
            End If
NextEdit:
        Next i
    End If
    
    SaveValues = True
    Exit Function
    
ErrHandler:
    MsgBox "保存失败（字段序号 " & i & "，地址 """ & addr & """）：" & err.Description, vbCritical
    SaveValues = False
End Function

' Description:  Makes a userform resizeable and handles the sizing and positioning
'               of all controls, using resizing information specified in each
'               control's Tag property.
' Authors:      Stephen Bullen, www.oaltd.co.uk
'               Rob Bovey, www.appspro.com

Option Explicit

' Windows API Declarations and Constants Follow
#If Mac Or JKPTest Then
#Else
    #If VBA7 Then
        Dim mhwndForm As LongPtr                                 'The userform's window handle
        'Find the userform's window handle
        Private Declare PtrSafe Function FindWindow Lib "user32" Alias "FindWindowA" (ByVal lpClassName As String, ByVal lpWindowName As String) As LongPtr
        'Get the userform's window style
        Private Declare PtrSafe Function GetWindowLong Lib "user32" Alias "GetWindowLongA" (ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal nIndex As Long) As LongPtr
        'Set the userform's window style
        Private Declare PtrSafe Function SetWindowLong Lib "user32" Alias "SetWindowLongA" (ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal nIndex As Long, ByVal dwNewLong As LongPtr) As LongPtr
    #Else
        Dim mhwndForm As Long                                 'The userform's window handle
        'Find the userform's window handle
        Private Declare Function FindWindow Lib "user32" Alias "FindWindowA" (ByVal lpClassName As String, ByVal lpWindowName As String) As Long
        'Get the userform's window style
        Private Declare Function GetWindowLong Lib "user32" Alias "GetWindowLongA" (ByVal hwnd As Long, ByVal nIndex As Long) As Long
        'Set the userform's window style
        Private Declare Function SetWindowLong Lib "user32" Alias "SetWindowLongA" (ByVal hwnd As Long, ByVal nIndex As Long, ByVal dwNewLong As Long) As Long
    #End If
#End If

'The offset of a window's style
Private Const GWL_STYLE As Long = (-16)

'Style to add a sizable frame
Private Const WS_THICKFRAME As Long = &H40000

''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
' Module-level Declarations Follow
''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''

Dim moform As Object    'The userform we're handling

Dim mdWidth As Single   'The previous width of the form
Dim mdHeight As Single  'The previous height of the form
Dim msRegKey As String  'The registry key for storing the form's size and position



''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
' Comments: Default for the registry key to store the dimensions
' Date          Developer       Action
' 05 Jun 04     Stephen Bullen  Created
Private Sub Class_Initialize()
    msRegKey = "JKP-ADS"
End Sub



''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
' Comments: Properties to identify where in the registry to store
'           the userform position information
' Date          Developer       Action
' 05 Jun 04     Stephen Bullen  Created
Public Property Let RegistryKey(sNew As String)
    msRegKey = sNew
End Property

Public Property Get RegistryKey() As String
    RegistryKey = msRegKey
End Property



''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
' Comments: We're told which form to handle the resizing for,
'           set in the UserForm_Initialize event. Make the form
'           resizable and set its size and position
' Arguments:    oForm       The userform to handle
' Date          Developer       Action
' 05 Jun 04     Stephen Bullen  Created
Public Property Set Form(oNew As Object)

    Dim sSizes As String, vaSizes As Variant
    #If VBA7 Then
        Dim iStyle As LongPtr
    #Else
        Dim iStyle As Long
    #End If

    'Remember the form for later
    Set moform = oNew

#If Mac Or JKPTest Then
'Do nothing here, we're using the draggable box in the bottom-right corner
#Else
    'Get the userform's window handle
    On Error Resume Next
    mhwndForm = FindWindow("ThunderDFrame", moform.Caption)
    If err.Number <> 0 Then
        mhwndForm = moform.hwnd
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    'Make the form resizable
    iStyle = GetWindowLong(mhwndForm, GWL_STYLE)
    iStyle = iStyle Or WS_THICKFRAME
    SetWindowLong mhwndForm, GWL_STYLE, iStyle
#End If
    'Read its dimensions from the registry (if there)
    'The string has the form of "<Top>;<Left>;<Height>;<Width>"
    sSizes = GetSetting(msRegKey, "Forms", moform.NAME, "")

    'Remember the current size for use in the Resize routine
    mdWidth = moform.Width
    mdHeight = moform.Height

    If sSizes <> "" Then
        'If we got a dimension string, split it into its parts
        vaSizes = mySplit(sSizes, ";")

        'Make sure we got 4 elements!
        ReDim Preserve vaSizes(0 To 3)

        'Set the form's size and position
        moform.Top = Val(vaSizes(0))
        moform.Left = Val(vaSizes(1))
        moform.Height = Val(vaSizes(2))
        moform.Width = Val(vaSizes(3))

        'Set to manual startup position
        If FormOutSideOfScreen(moform) Then
            moform.StartUpPosition = 1
        Else
            moform.StartUpPosition = 0
        End If
    End If

End Property


''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
' Comments: Called from the User_Form resize event. Also triggered
'           when we change the size ourself
' Date          Developer       Action
' 05 Jun 04     Stephen Bullen  Created
Public Sub FormResize()
    Dim dHeightAdj As Single
    Dim dWidthAdj As Single
    Dim bSomeWidthChange As Boolean
    Dim bSomeHeightChange As Boolean
    Dim sTag As String
    Dim oCtl As MSForms.control
    Static bResizing As Boolean
    dWidthAdj = 0
    'Resizing can be triggered from within this routine,
    'so use a flag to prevent recursion
    If bResizing Then Exit Sub
    bResizing = True

    'Calculate the change in height and width
    dHeightAdj = moform.Height - mdHeight
    dWidthAdj = moform.Width - mdWidth

    'Check if we can perform the adjustment
    '(i.e. widths and heights can't be negative)
    For Each oCtl In moform.Controls
        If oCtl.Visible Then
            'Read the control's Tag property, which contains the resizing info
            sTag = UCase(oCtl.Tag)

            'If we're changing the Top, check that it won't move off the top
            'of the form
            If InStr(1, sTag, "T", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                If oCtl.Top + dHeightAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "T") <= 0 Then
                    moform.Height = mdHeight
                End If

                bSomeHeightChange = True
            End If

            'If we're changing the Left, check that it won't move off the
            'left of the form
            If InStr(1, sTag, "L", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                If oCtl.Left + dWidthAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "L") <= 0 Then
                    moform.Width = mdWidth
                End If

                bSomeWidthChange = True

            End If

            'If we're changing the Height, check that it won't go negative
            If InStr(1, sTag, "H", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                If oCtl.Height + dHeightAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "H") <= 15 Then
                    moform.Height = mdHeight
                End If

                bSomeHeightChange = True
            End If

            'If we're changing the Width, check that it won't go negative
            If InStr(1, sTag, "W", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                If oCtl.Width + dWidthAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "W") <= 5 Then
                    moform.Width = mdWidth
                End If

                bSomeWidthChange = True
            End If
        End If
    Next        'Control

    'If none of the controls move or size,
    'don't allow the form to resize in that direction
    If Not bSomeHeightChange Then moform.Height = mdHeight
    If Not bSomeWidthChange Then moform.Width = mdWidth

    'Recalculate the height and width changes,
    'in case the previous checks reset them
    dHeightAdj = moform.Height - mdHeight
    dWidthAdj = moform.Width - mdWidth

    'Loop through all the controls on the form,
    'adjusting their position and size
    For Each oCtl In moform.Controls
        With oCtl
            If .Visible Then
                sTag = UCase(.Tag)

                'Changing the Top
                If InStr(1, sTag, "T", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                    .Top = .Top + dHeightAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "T")
                End If

                'Changing the Left
                If InStr(1, sTag, "L", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                    .Left = .Left + dWidthAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "L")
                End If

                'Changing the Height
                If InStr(1, sTag, "H", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                    .Height = .Height + dHeightAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "H")
                End If

                'Changing the Width
                If InStr(1, sTag, "W", vbBinaryCompare) Then
                    .Width = .Width + dWidthAdj * ResizeFactor(sTag, "W")
                End If

            End If
        End With
    Next        'Control

    'Remember the new dimensions of the form for next time
    mdWidth = moform.Width
    mdHeight = moform.Height

    'Store the size and position in the registry
    With moform
        SaveSetting msRegKey, "Forms", .NAME, Str(.Top) & ";" & _
                                              Str(.Left) & ";" & _
                                              Str(.Height) & ";" & Str(.Width)
    End With

    'Reset the recursion flag, now that we're done
    bResizing = False

End Sub



''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''
' Comments: Function to locate a property letter (T, L, H or W)
'           in the Tag string and return the resizing factor for it
' Arguments:    sTag        The full text of the control's Tag string
'               sChange     The resize letter to look for (T, L, H or W)
' Returns:      The percentage change factor
' Date          Developer       Action
' 05 Jun 04     Stephen Bullen  Created
Public Function ResizeFactor(sTag As String, sChange As String)

    Dim iPos As Integer, dfactor As Double

    'Locate the property letter in the tag string
    iPos = InStr(1, sTag, sChange, vbBinaryCompare)

    'If we found it...
    If iPos > 0 Then

        '... read the number following it
        dfactor = Val(Mid$(sTag, iPos + 1))

        'If there was no number, use a factor of 100%
        If dfactor = 0 Then dfactor = 1
    End If

    'Return the factor
    ResizeFactor = dfactor
End Function

Public Sub ResetFormSizes()
    Dim sSizes As String, vaSizes As Variant
    Dim iStyle As Long
    With moform
        SaveSetting msRegKey, "Forms", .NAME, Str(.Top) & ";" & _
                                              Str(.Left) & ";" & _
                                              Str(.Height) & ";" & Str(.Width)
        sSizes = GetSetting(msRegKey, "Forms", .NAME, "")

        'Remember the current size for use in the Resize routine
        mdWidth = .Width
        mdHeight = .Height
    End With
End Sub


Private Function FormOutSideOfScreen(oForm As Object) As Boolean
    Dim bScrUpd As Boolean
    Dim awbRightEdge As Single
    Dim awbBottomEdge As Single
    Dim windowWidth As Single
    Dim winState As XlWindowState
    Dim edgeMarginRight As Single
    Dim edgeMarginBottom As Single
    bScrUpd = Application.ScreenUpdating
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    With ActiveWorkbook.Windows(1)
        If .WindowState = xlMaximized Then
            edgeMarginRight = oForm.Width / 2
            edgeMarginBottom = oForm.Height / 2
        Else
            edgeMarginRight = -30
            edgeMarginBottom = -30
        End If
        awbRightEdge = .Width + .Left
        awbBottomEdge = .Height + .Top
    End With
    FormOutSideOfScreen = oForm.Left + edgeMarginRight > awbRightEdge
    FormOutSideOfScreen = FormOutSideOfScreen Or oForm.Top + edgeMarginBottom > awbBottomEdge
    Application.ScreenUpdating = bScrUpd
End Function

Public Function SheetExists() As Boolean

    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = m_wb.sheets(m_sSheetName)

    On Error GoTo 0

    Else
        Set GetWorksheet = Nothing
    End If

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = GetWorksheet()
    
    If ws Is Nothing Then
        LoadData = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim rng As range
    Set rng = ws.usedRange
    
    If rng Is Nothing Then
        LoadData = Empty
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    LoadData = rng.value
End Function

Public Sub SaveData(ByVal arrData As Variant)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = GetWorksheet()
    
    If ws Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If IsEmpty(arrData) Then Exit Sub
    
    Dim lRows As Long, lCols As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    lRows = UBound(arrData, 1) - LBound(arrData, 1) + 1

Private Sub Class_Initialize()

    ClearAllDataSources
    Set m_dicDataSources = Nothing
End Sub

Public Sub AddDataSource(ByVal sName As String, ByVal sSheetName As String, Optional ByVal wb As Workbook = Nothing)
    Dim ds As DataSource
    
    If m_dicDataSources.exists(sName) Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Set ds = New DataSource
    ds.Initialize sSheetName, wb
    m_dicDataSources.Add sName, ds
    
    If m_sCurrentSource = "" Then
        m_sCurrentSource = sName
    End If
End Sub

Public Function GetDataSource(ByVal sName As String) As DataSource
    If m_dicDataSources.exists(sName) Then
        Set GetDataSource = m_dicDataSources(sName)
    Else
        Set GetDataSource = Nothing
    End If
End Function

Public Function RemoveDataSource(ByVal sName As String) As Boolean
    If m_dicDataSources.exists(sName) Then
        Set m_dicDataSources(sName) = Nothing
        m_dicDataSources.Remove sName
        
        If m_sCurrentSource = sName Then
            If m_dicDataSources.count > 0 Then
                m_sCurrentSource = m_dicDataSources.Keys()(0)
            Else
                m_sCurrentSource = ""
            End If
        End If
        
        RemoveDataSource = True
    Else
        RemoveDataSource = False
    End If
End Function

Public Function DataSourceExists(ByVal sName As String) As Boolean
    DataSourceExists = m_dicDataSources.exists(sName)
End Function

Public Function GetDataSourceNames() As Variant
    If m_dicDataSources.count > 0 Then
        GetDataSourceNames = m_dicDataSources.Keys()
    Else
        GetDataSourceNames = Empty
    End If

    GetDataSourceCount = m_dicDataSources.count

    End If

Public Sub ClearAllDataSources()
    Dim sName As Variant
    For Each sName In m_dicDataSources.Keys()
        Set m_dicDataSources(sName) = Nothing
    Next
    m_dicDataSources.RemoveAll
    m_sCurrentSource = ""
End Sub

    End If

    dsTarget.CopyFromDataSource dsSource
End Sub

'【提取数字】从控件名称字符串中提取所有数字字符，返回纯数字字符串（如"Day23"→"23"）
Private Function GetNum(s As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, c As String
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        c = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If IsNumeric(c) Then GetNum = GetNum & c
    Next i
End Function

'【Label鼠标滑过】鼠标滑过日期格子时，根据格子序号设置高亮色（前月灰色、当月蓝色、后月灰色、星期深色、箭头变色），并记录滑过痕迹
Private Sub Label_MouseMove(ByVal Button As Integer, ByVal Shift As Integer, ByVal X As Single, ByVal y As Single)
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    Dim nm As String, numStr As String
    On Error Resume Next
    nm = Label.NAME
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    If err.Number <> 0 Then Exit Sub
    
    Enm = 0
    numStr = GetNum(nm)
    If numStr <> "" Then Enm = CInt(numStr)
    
    If Cf.Move.exists(CStr(Enm)) Then Exit Sub Else ClearMove
    If Cf.m(1) = Year(Now) And Cf.m(2) = Month(Now) And Enm = Cf.Today Then Exit Sub Else Cf.Move(CStr(Enm)) = ""
    Select Case Enm
        Case Is <= Cf.Start
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 5)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 6)
        Case Is <= Cf.End - 1
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 11)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 12)
        Case Is <= 42
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 5)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 6)
        Case Is <= 49
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 17)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 18)
        Case Is <= 53
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).Font.Bold = True
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 21)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 22)
    End Select
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
End Sub

'【Label单击】单击日期格子时，计算对应日期（前月/当月/后月自动换算年月），设置选中色，并将完整日期时间写入UserCalendar返回值
Private Sub Label_Click()
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    Dim nm As String, numStr As String
    On Error Resume Next
    nm = Label.NAME
    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
    If err.Number <> 0 Then Exit Sub
    
    Enm = 0
    numStr = GetNum(nm)
    If numStr <> "" Then Enm = CInt(numStr)
    
    Dim y As Long: y = Cf.m(1)
    Dim m As Integer: m = Cf.m(2)
    Select Case Enm
        Case Is <= Cf.Start
            If m = 1 Then m = 12: y = y - 1 Else m = m - 1
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 7)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 8)
        Case Is <= Cf.End - 1
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 13)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 14)
        Case Is <= 42
            If m = 12 Then m = 1: y = y + 1 Else m = m + 1
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 7)
            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 8)
        Case Else: Exit Sub
    End Select
    Dim s$: s = Format(DateSerial(y, m, Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).Caption), "YYYY-MM-DD")
    Dim h$: h = Calendar.M3.value & Calendar.MInterval2.value & Calendar.M4.value & Calendar.MInterval3.value & Calendar.M5.value: s = s & " " & h
    Select Case Cs.ResultStyle

    End Select
    Exit Sub
ErrHandler:
End Sub

            Calendar.Controls("Text" & Enm).ForeColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 8)
        Case Is <= Cf.End - 1
            Calendar.Controls("Day" & Enm).BackColor = Cf.Color(Cf.Index, 13)

        Case Is <= 42

Sub PositionWordWindowToLeftHalf()
    Dim screenWidth As Long
    Dim screenHeight As Long
    Dim vbeWidth As Long
    Dim vbeLeft As Long
    Dim workArea As RECT
    screenWidth = GetSystemMetrics(0)
    screenHeight = GetSystemMetrics(1)

    Application.VBE.MainWindow.Visible = True
    On Error GoTo 0
    With Application
        vbeWidth = screenWidth
        vbeLeft = screenHeight
        Application.Top = workArea.Top
        Application.Left = workArea.Left

    End With

Sub ArrangeVBEWindow()
    Dim screenWidth As Long
    Dim screenHeight As Long
    Dim vbeWidth As Long
    Dim vbeLeft As Long
    Dim workArea As RECT
    screenWidth = GetSystemMetrics(0)
    screenHeight = GetSystemMetrics(1)
    ' 获取工作区域（不包含任务栏）
    If SystemParametersInfo(48, 0, workArea, 0) Then
        vbeWidth = (workArea.Right - workArea.Left) / 2
        vbeLeft = workArea.Left + vbeWidth

        On Error Resume Next
        Application.VBE.MainWindow.Visible = True
        On Error GoTo 0
        ' 设置 VBE 窗口位置和大小
        With Application.VBE.MainWindow
            .Left = vbeLeft
            .Top = workArea.Top
            .Width = vbeWidth

        End With
    End If

Sub SplitEveryFivePagesAsDocuments()
    Dim oSrcDoc As Document, oNewDoc As Document
    Dim strSrcName As String, strNewName As String
    Dim oRange As Range
    Dim nIndex As Integer, nSubIndex As Integer, nTotalPages As Integer, nBound As Integer
    Dim fso As Object
    Const nSteps = 2 ' 修改这里控制每隔几页分割一次
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set oSrcDoc = ActiveDocument
    Set oRange = oSrcDoc.Content
    nTotalPages = ActiveDocument.Content.Information(wdNumberOfPagesInDocument)
    oRange.Collapse wdCollapseStart
    oRange.Select
    For nIndex = 1 To nTotalPages Step nSteps
        Set oNewDoc = Documents.Add
        If nIndex + nSteps > nTotalPages Then
            nBound = nTotalPages
        Else
            nBound = nIndex + nSteps - 1
        End If
        For nSubIndex = nIndex To nBound
            oSrcDoc.Activate
            oSrcDoc.Bookmarks("\page").Range.Copy
            oSrcDoc.Windows(1).Activate
            Application.Browser.Target = wdBrowsePage
            Application.Browser.Next
            oNewDoc.Activate
            oNewDoc.Windows(1).Selection.Paste
                    oNewDoc.Application.Selection.EndKey wdStory
        oNewDoc.Application.Selection.Delete wdCharacter, -1
        Next nSubIndex
        strSrcName = oSrcDoc.FullName
        strNewName = fso.BuildPath(fso.GetParentFolderName(strSrcName), _
        fso.GetBaseName(strSrcName) & "_" & (nIndex \ nSteps + 1) & "." & fso.GetExtensionName(strSrcName))
        oNewDoc.SaveAs strNewName
        oNewDoc.Close False
    Next nIndex
    Set oNewDoc = Nothing
    Set oRange = Nothing
    Set oSrcDoc = Nothing
    Set fso = Nothing
    MsgBox "结束！"
End Sub

Function ExtractStrBetween(sourceStr As String, startMark As String, endMark As String) As String
    Dim startPos As Integer, endPos As Integer
    ExtractStrBetween = ""
    If sourceStr = "" Or startMark = "" Or endMark = "" Then Exit Function
    startPos = InStr(1, sourceStr, startMark, vbTextCompare)
    If startPos = 0 Then Exit Function
    endPos = InStr(startPos + Len(startMark), sourceStr, endMark, vbTextCompare)
    If endPos = 0 Then Exit Function
    ExtractStrBetween = Trim(Mid(sourceStr, startPos + Len(startMark), endPos - (startPos + Len(startMark))))
    '清理提取内容中的换行符
    ExtractStrBetween = Replace(ExtractStrBetween, vbCrLf, "")
    ExtractStrBetween = Replace(ExtractStrBetween, vbCr, "")
    ExtractStrBetween = Replace(ExtractStrBetween, vbLf, "")
    ExtractStrBetween = Trim(ExtractStrBetween)
End Function

Sub ExpandCollapseByLevel()
    Dim level As Integer
    Dim doc As Document

    On Error Resume Next
    Set doc = ActiveDocument
    If doc Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "没有打开的文档！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 获取活动窗口
    Set wdWindow = doc.ActiveWindow
    If wdWindow Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "无法获取文档窗口！", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0

    ' 获取用户输入
    level = InputBox("请输入要显示的标题级别（1-9）：" & vbCrLf & _
                     "1 = 只显示1级标题" & vbCrLf & _

                     "设置标题显示级别", 9)

    If level = 0 Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    If level >= 1 And level <= 9 Then

Private Sub FindReplaceChar(ByVal objSel As Object, ByVal strFind As String, _
    ByVal strReplace As String, ByVal FindWrap As Integer, _
    Optional ByVal bWild As Boolean = False, Optional ByVal bByte As Boolean = True)
    '执行查找替换操作

    objSel.Find.Replacement.ClearFormatting
    With objSel.Find
        .Text = strFind
        .Replacement.Text = strReplace
        .Forward = True
        .Wrap = FindWrap  'wdFindStop:停止,替换选定部分,若没选中,则默认替换至文档末尾
        .Format = False
        .MatchCase = False
        .MatchWholeWord = False
        .MatchByte = bByte
        .CorrectHangulEndings = False
        .MatchWildcards = bWild
        .MatchSoundsLike = False
        .MatchAllWordForms = False
        End With
        objSel.Find.Execute Replace:=wdReplaceAll

Sub GetBlankPage()
    Dim IsDelete As Boolean
    Dim PageCount As Long
    Dim rRange As Range
    Dim iInt As Integer, DelCount As Integer
    Dim tmpstr As String
    IsDelete = True
    PageCount = ThisDocument.BuiltInDocumentProperties(wdPropertyPages)
    For iInt = 1 To PageCount
        '超过PageCount退出
        If iInt > PageCount Then Exit For
        '取每一页的内容
        If iInt = PageCount Then
            Set rRange = ThisDocument.Range( _
            Start:=ThisDocument.GoTo(wdGoToPage, wdGoToAbsolute, iInt).Start)
        Else
            Set rRange = ThisDocument.Range(Start:=ThisDocument.GoTo(wdGoToPage, wdGoToAbsolute, iInt).Start, _
            End:=ThisDocument.GoTo(wdGoToPage, wdGoToAbsolute, iInt + 1).Start)
        End If
        If Replace(rRange.Text, Chr(13), "") = "" Or Replace(rRange.Text, Chr(13), "") = Chr(12) Then
        tmpstr = tmpstr & "第 " & iInt & " 页是空页" & vbCrLf
        '删除?
        If IsDelete Then
            DelCount = DelCount + 1
            '删除空白页
            rRange.Text = Replace(rRange.Text, Chr(13), "")
            rRange.Text = ""
            '重算页数
            PageCount = ThisDocument.BuiltInDocumentProperties(wdPropertyPages)
            If iInt <> PageCount Then
                '页删除后，页码变化，重新检查当前页
                iInt = iInt - 1
            Else
                '最后一个空页
                Set rRange = ThisDocument.Range(Start:=ThisDocument.GoTo(wdGoToPage, wdGoToAbsolute, PageCount - 1).Start, End:=ThisDocument.GoTo(wdGoToPage, wdGoToAbsolute, PageCount + 1).Start)
                
                If InStr(1, rRange.Text, Chr(12)) > 0 Then
                    rRange.Characters(InStr(1, rRange.Text, Chr(12))) = ""
                Else
                    '没有分页符,通过选中后删除,最好不这样做，如果判断错误，有误删除的风险
                    Set rRange = ThisDocument.Range(Start:=ThisDocument.GoTo(wdGoToPage, wdGoToAbsolute, iInt).Start)
                    rRange.Select
                    Selection.Delete
                End If
                Exit For
            End If
        End If
    End If
Next

    If tmpstr = "" Then
        MsgBox "没有空页", vbInformation + vbOKOnly
    Else
        MsgBox tmpstr, vbInformation + vbOKOnly
    End If
Else
    If DelCount > 0 Then MsgBox "删除空页 " & DelCount, vbInformation + vbOKOnly

'============================================================================================================================
'-函数名称：    GetNewID
'-功能描述：    高效率的文本型自动编号函数，除了第一次调用，以后每次生成编号时不需要再访问编号字段所在的表，因此效率非常高，
'               表中数据量越大，效果越明显。并且在多用户环境下，也不会出现多个用户基于一个表同时录入时，会出现的编号重复问
'               题。适用于各种单据的编号及流水码等，具体请参考使用示例。
'-输入参数：    TableName       必需的，表名称或查询名称。
'               FieldName       必需的，自动编号字段名。
'               Digit           必需的，不包含前缀的序号位数。
'               Prefixal        可选的，编号前缀字符串，除了单据类型的描述字符，还可以把其它信息要素如部门ID等加入到此参数中。
'               DateFormat      可选的，编号中的日期部分格式，具体使用请参考Format函数中关于日期的数的部分说明。
'-其它说明：    必需要有一个编号维护表配合使用，表名称：USysSN 字段名：TableName|FieldName|LastID ,3个字段均为文本型，大小255。
'-使用注意：
'-返回参数：    返回生成的编号，出错时返回空字符串（""）。
'-兼 容 性：
'-使用示例：    =GetNewID("Orders","OrderID",5,"XS","yymmdd")     返回示例：XS01042500004
'               =GetNewID("Orders","OrderID",5,"XS","-yyyymmdd-") 返回示例：XS-20100425-00004
'               =GetNewID("Orders","OrderID",5,"XS")              返回示例：XS00004
'               =GetNewID("Orders","OrderID",5,"XS","-")          返回示例：XS-00004
'               =GetNewID("Orders","OrderID",5)                   返回示例：00004
'               =GetNewID("Orders","OrderID",5,"【售】")          返回示例：【售】00004
'-相关调用：
'-作    者：    红尘如烟
'-创建日期：    2011-1-25
'=============================================================================================================================Function GetNewID(TableName As String, FieldName As String, Digit As Integer, _
                    Optional Prefixal As String, Optional DateFormat As String) As String
    On Error GoTo Err_GetNewID
    Dim strDate     As String
    Dim strLastID   As String
    Dim strSN       As String
    Dim strWhere    As String
    
    If DateFormat <> "" Then strDate = Format$(Date, DateFormat)
    strSN = String$(Digit, "0")
    strWhere = "TableName='" & TableName & "' AND FieldName='" & FieldName & "'"
    strLastID = Nz(DLookup("LastID", "USysSN", strWhere))
    
    If strLastID = "" Then
        strLastID = Nz(DMax(FieldName, TableName), strSN)
        CurrentDb.Execute "Delete FROM USysSN Where " & strWhere
        CurrentDb.Execute "Insert INTO USysSN(TableName,FieldName) " & _
                          "VALUES('" & TableName & "','" & FieldName & "')"
    End If
    
    strLastID = Prefixal & strDate & Format$(Val(Right$(strLastID, Digit)) + 1, strSN)
    CurrentDb.Execute "Update USysSN SET LastID='" & strLastID & "' Where " & strWhere
    GetNewID = strLastID
    
Exit_GetNewID:
    Exit Function
    
Err_GetNewID:
    GetNewID = ""
    MsgBox Err.Description, vbCritical, "Error #" & Err
    Resume Exit_GetNewID
End Function

Function GetMaxValue(ByVal num1 As Double, ParamArray nums() As Variant) As Double
    Dim allNums() As Variant
    Dim i As Long
    Dim excelApp As Object
    Dim wsFunc As Object
   ' 将第一个数字添加到数组
    ReDim allNums(0 To UBound(nums) + 1)
    allNums(0) = num1
   ' 将ParamArray中的数字添加到数组
    For i = 0 To UBound(nums)
        allNums(i + 1) = nums(i)
    Next i
   ' 后期绑定创建Excel应用程序对象和WorksheetFunction对象
    On Error Resume Next
    Set excelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
    Set wsFunc = excelApp.WorksheetFunction
    If Not wsFunc Is Nothing Then
        GetMaxValue = wsFunc.Max(allNums)
    Else
       ' 如果无法创建WorksheetFunction对象，手动比较获取最大值
        Dim maxVal As Double
        maxVal = num1
        For i = 0 To UBound(nums)
            If nums(i) > maxVal Then
                maxVal = nums(i)
            End If
        Next i
        GetMaxValue = maxVal
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
   ' 清理对象
    If Not wsFunc Is Nothing Then Set wsFunc = Nothing
    If Not excelApp Is Nothing Then
        excelApp.Quit
        Set excelApp = Nothing
    End If
End Function

'提取日期编码的记录并定义为数组，封装成自定义函数便于调用
Function GetDateCode(codeType As String, dateNum As Integer) As Variant
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Dim arr1(2 To 32) As Variant
    Dim arr2(2 To 32) As Variant
    Dim i As Integer
    
    ' 打开当前数据库
    Set db = CurrentDb()
    ' 假设表名为 qry_日期编码，可按需修改
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM qry_日期编码")
    
    ' 检查记录集是否为空
    If Not (rs.EOF And rs.BOF) Then
        rs.MoveFirst
        ' 将第一条记录的第 2 到 32 列存入 arr1
        For i = 2 To 32
            arr1(i) = rs.Fields(i)
        Next i
        
        ' 移动到下一条记录
        rs.MoveNext
        ' 将第二条记录的第 2 到 32 列存入 arr2
        For i = 2 To 32
            arr2(i) = rs.Fields(i)
        Next i
    End If
    
    ' 根据编号类型和日期参数返回对应编码
    Select Case codeType
        Case "数字码"
            GetDateCode = arr1(dateNum)
        Case "字母码"
            GetDateCode = arr2(dateNum)
        Case Else
            GetDateCode = "无效的编号类型"
    End Select
    
    ' 关闭记录集和数据库
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
End Function

Function GetMaxValueInBase(digits As Integer, base As Integer) As Variant                '自定义函数：计算序列号位数能产生的数据量
    If base < 2 Or base > 36 Then
        GetMaxValueInBase = "无效的进制，进制范围应为2到36"
        Exit Function
    End If
    Dim result As Variant
    If digits = 1 Then
        result = base - 1
    Else
        result = base ^ digits - 1
    End If
    '如果结果较小，可以用数值类型表示，否则用字符串表示
If result <= 2147483647 Then
    GetMaxValueInBase = CLng(result)
Else
    GetMaxValueInBase = CStr(result)
End If
End Function

'返回查询字段中包含这种窗体引用条件的查询名称：Like "*" & [Forms]![frm_承认书信息]![CPLH] & "*"));
Sub FindQueriesWithFormControlReferences()
    Dim qdf As DAO.QueryDef
    Dim fld As DAO.Field
    Dim sql As String
    Dim formCtrlStart As Integer
    Dim formCtrlEnd As Integer
    Dim formCtrlRef As String

   '遍历所有查询定义
    For Each qdf In CurrentDb.QueryDefs
       '排除系统查询
        If Left(qdf.Name, 4) <> "MSys" Then
            sql = qdf.sql
            formCtrlStart = 1
            Do
                formCtrlStart = InStr(formCtrlStart, sql, "[Forms]![", vbTextCompare)
                If formCtrlStart > 0 Then
                    formCtrlEnd = InStr(formCtrlStart, sql, "]![", vbTextCompare)
                    If formCtrlEnd > 0 Then
                        formCtrlEnd = InStr(formCtrlEnd, sql, "]", vbTextCompare)
                        If formCtrlEnd > 0 Then
                            formCtrlRef = Mid(sql, formCtrlStart, formCtrlEnd - formCtrlStart + 1)
                            Debug.Print "查询名称: " & qdf.Name & "，使用了窗体控件引用: " & formCtrlRef
                           '遍历查询中的字段
                            For Each fld In qdf.Fields
                                Dim cond As String
                                cond = fld.ValidationRule
                                If cond <> "" And InStr(1, cond, formCtrlRef, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                                    Debug.Print "  字段: " & fld.Name & "，条件内容: " & cond
                                End If
                            Next fld
                            '检查SQL语句中的条件
                            Dim wherePos As Integer
                            Dim whereClause As String
                            wherePos = InStr(1, sql, "WHERE", vbTextCompare)
                            If wherePos > 0 Then
                                whereClause = Mid(sql, wherePos)
                                If InStr(1, whereClause, formCtrlRef, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                                    Debug.Print "  SQL语句中的条件内容: " & whereClause
                                End If
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                    formCtrlStart = formCtrlEnd + 1
                End If
            Loop While formCtrlStart > 0
        End If
    Next qdf
End Sub

'遍历当前数据库中所有的表都并创建查询
    '创建的查询包含对应表的所有字段（不使用*通配符方式）
Sub CreateQueriesForTables()
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim tdf As DAO.TableDef
    Dim qdf As DAO.QueryDef
    Dim fld As DAO.field
    Dim fieldList As String
    
    Set db = CurrentDb
    
    '遍历数据库中的所有表
    For Each tdf In db.TableDefs
        '排除系统表等特殊表
        If Left(tdf.Name, 4) <> "MSys" Then
            fieldList = ""
            '构建字段列表字符串，不使用*号
            For Each fld In tdf.Fields
                fieldList = fieldList & fld.Name & ", "
            Next fld
            '去除最后多余的逗号和空格
            If Len(fieldList) > 0 Then
                fieldList = Left(fieldList, Len(fieldList) - 2)
            End If
    
            '构建查询SQL语句
            Dim sql As String
            sql = "SELECT " & fieldList & " FROM [" & tdf.Name & "]"
    
            '创建查询对象
            Set qdf = db.CreateQueryDef("qry_" & tdf.Name)
            qdf.sql = sql
        End If
    Next tdf
    
    Set qdf = Nothing
    Set tdf = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    Application.RefreshDatabaseWindow
End Sub

    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim tdf As DAO.TableDef
    Dim oldDBPath As String
    Dim newDBPath As String
    Dim newConnect As String
    Dim tableCount As Integer
    Dim updatedCount As Integer
    
    ' 设置旧数据库路径和新数据库路径
    oldDBPath = "D:\变码数据管理系统V1.6-cs\Data--855.accdb"
    newDBPath = "D:\变码数据管理系统V1.6-cs\Data--666.accdb"
    ' 验证路径有效性
    If Len(Trim(oldDBPath)) = 0 Or Len(Trim(newDBPath)) = 0 Then
        MsgBox "数据库路径不能为空!", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取当前数据库对象
    Set db = CurrentDb
    tableCount = 0
    updatedCount = 0
    
    ' 开始处理链接表
    On Error Resume Next
    For Each tdf In db.TableDefs
        ' 跳过系统表
        If Left(tdf.Name, 4) <> "MSys" Then
            ' 检查是否为链接表
            If Not tdf Is Nothing And Len(tdf.Connect) > 0 Then
                ' 调试输出：打印当前处理的表和连接字符串
                Debug.Print "处理表: " & tdf.Name & ", 连接: " & tdf.Connect
                
                ' 使用安全的字符串比较
                If InStr(1, CStr(tdf.Connect), oldDBPath, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                    ' 构建新的连接字符串
                    newConnect = Replace(tdf.Connect, oldDBPath, newDBPath)
                    
                    ' 更新链接
                    tdf.Connect = newConnect
                    tdf.RefreshLink
                    
                    ' 检查更新是否成功
                    If Err.Number = 0 Then
                        updatedCount = updatedCount + 1
                        Debug.Print "成功更新表: " & tdf.Name
                    Else
                        Debug.Print "更新失败: " & tdf.Name & ", 错误: " & Err.Description
                        Err.Clear
                    End If
                End If
                tableCount = tableCount + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next tdf
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 释放对象
    Set tdf = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    
    ' 显示结果
    MsgBox "处理完成!" & vbCrLf & _
           "总表数: " & tableCount & vbCrLf & _
           "已更新: " & updatedCount & vbCrLf & _
           "未修改: " & (tableCount - updatedCount), vbInformation
End Sub

ub BatchDeleteTables_ByPattern()
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim tdf As DAO.TableDef
    Dim tableGroups As Object
    Dim groupName As String
    Dim tableName As String
    Dim prefixPatterns As Variant
    Dim i As Integer
    
    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set tableGroups = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 定义前缀模式和对应的组名
    prefixPatterns = Array( _
        "tbl_采购", "业务表", _
        "tbl_客户", "客户表", _
        "tbl_日志", "日志表", _
        "tbl_系统", "系统表" _
    )
    
    ' 自动识别表并分组
    For Each tdf In db.TableDefs
        If Left(tdf.Name, 4) <> "MSys" Then ' 跳过系统表
            tableName = tdf.Name
            
            ' 检查表名匹配哪个前缀模式
            For i = 0 To UBound(prefixPatterns) Step 2
                If InStr(1, tableName, prefixPatterns(i), vbTextCompare) = 1 Then
                    groupName = prefixPatterns(i + 1)
                    
                    ' 如果组不存在，创建新组
                    If Not tableGroups.Exists(groupName) Then
                        tableGroups.Add groupName, New Collection
                    End If
                    
                    ' 将表添加到对应组
                    tableGroups(groupName).Add tableName
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
        End If
    Next tdf
    
End Sub

'根据表中的表名称来创建查询
    '创建的查询包含对应表的所有字段（不使用*通配符方式）
Sub CreateQueriesForTabless()
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim tdf As DAO.TableDef
    Dim qdf As DAO.QueryDef
    Dim fld As DAO.field
    Dim fieldList As String
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Dim tableName As String
    Dim tblName, Zdname As String
    tblName = "待创建查询的列表"
    Zdname = "要创建查询的表名称"
    Set db = CurrentDb
    
    ' 从 X 表中获取 Zdname 字段的所有表名称
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("SELECT " & Zdname & "  FROM " & tblName)
    
    ' 遍历获取到的表名称
    Do While Not rs.EOF
        tableName = rs.Fields(Zdname).Value
    
        ' 检查该表是否存在
        On Error Resume Next
        Set tdf = db.TableDefs(tableName)
        If Err.Number = 0 Then
            On Error GoTo 0
            fieldList = ""
            ' 构建字段列表字符串，不使用*号
            For Each fld In tdf.Fields
                fieldList = fieldList & fld.Name & ", "
            Next fld
            ' 去除最后多余的逗号和空格
            If Len(fieldList) > 0 Then
                fieldList = Left(fieldList, Len(fieldList) - 2)
            End If
    
            ' 构建查询SQL语句
            Dim sql As String
            sql = "SELECT " & fieldList & " FROM [" & tableName & "]"
    
            ' 创建查询对象
            Set qdf = db.CreateQueryDef("qry_" & tableName)
            qdf.sql = sql
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop
    
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set qdf = Nothing
    Set tdf = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    Application.RefreshDatabaseWindow
End Sub

Sub DeleteInvalidLinkedTables()
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim tdf As DAO.TableDef
    Set db = CurrentDb
    For Each tdf In db.TableDefs
        If (tdf.Attributes And dbAttachedTable) <> 0 Then '判断是否为链接表
            If Not IsLinkedTableValid(tdf.Name) Then '判断是否失效

    Next tdf
    Set tdf = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
End Sub

' 参数：path - 完整文件路径
'       returnType - "name" 返回文件名, "dir" 返回目录路径
Function ParsePath(ByVal path As String, ByVal returnType As String) As String
    Dim lastSlashPos As Long
    
    ' 处理空路径
    If path = "" Then
        ParsePath = ""
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 查找最后一个反斜杠的位置
    lastSlashPos = InStrRev(path, "\")
    
    ' 根据 returnType 参数返回相应部分
    Select Case LCase(returnType)
        Case "name"  ' 返回文件名（带扩展名）
            If lastSlashPos > 0 Then
                ParsePath = Mid(path, lastSlashPos + 1)
            Else
                ParsePath = path  ' 如果没有路径分隔符，整个字符串被视为文件名
            End If
            
        Case "dir"  ' 返回目录路径
            If lastSlashPos > 0 Then
                ParsePath = Left(path, lastSlashPos)
            Else
                ParsePath = ""  ' 如果没有路径分隔符，视为没有目录部分
            End If
            
        Case "namewithout ext"  ' 返回不带扩展名的文件名（可选）
            Dim fileName As String
            fileName = ParsePath(path, "name")
            Dim lastDotPos As Long
            lastDotPos = InStrRev(fileName, ".")
            
            If lastDotPos > 0 Then
                ParsePath = Left(fileName, lastDotPos - 1)
            Else
                ParsePath = fileName
            End If
            
        Case Else  ' 无效参数
            ParsePath = ""
'            MsgBox "无效的返回类型参数。请使用 'name' 或 'dir'。", vbExclamation
    End Select
End Function

Sub ExportTableToTxt()
    Dim tableName As String
    Dim desktopPath As String
    Dim txtFilePath As String
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim txtFile As Object
    Dim fieldCount As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim line As String
    Dim startTime As Double
    Dim endTime As Double
    startTime = Timer                                          ' 在下面写执行代码
    ' 设置要导出的表名，可根据实际情况修改
    tableName = "tbl_流水码"
    ' 获取桌面路径
    desktopPath = CreateObject("WScript.Shell").SpecialFolders("Desktop")
    ' 构建 TXT 文件的完整路径
    txtFilePath = desktopPath & "\" & tableName & ".txt"
    On Error Resume Next
    ' 删除已存在的同名 TXT 文件
    Kill txtFilePath
    On Error GoTo 0
    ' 打开数据库和记录集
    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset(tableName)
    ' 创建文件系统对象
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set txtFile = fso.CreateTextFile(txtFilePath, True)
    ' 获取字段数量
    fieldCount = rs.Fields.Count
    ' 写入字段名
    For i = 0 To fieldCount - 1
        line = line & Replace(Replace(rs.Fields(i).Name, """", ""), ",", "")
        If i < fieldCount - 1 Then
            line = line & " "
        End If
    Next i
    txtFile.WriteLine line
    line = ""
    ' 写入记录数据
    rs.MoveFirst
    Do While Not rs.EOF
        For i = 0 To fieldCount - 1
            line = line & Replace(Replace(rs.Fields(i).Value, """", ""), ",", "")
            If i < fieldCount - 1 Then
                line = line & " "
            End If
        Next i
        txtFile.WriteLine line
        line = ""
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop
    ' 关闭对象
    rs.Close
    txtFile.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set txtFile = Nothing
    Set fso = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    MsgBox "数据已成功导出到 " & txtFilePath
    endTime = Timer
    MsgBox "操作完成，运行时间:" & Format((endTime - startTime), "000") & "秒"
End Sub

            '构建查询SQL语句

    Next tdf

Sub DeleteCodeFromLine()
    Dim vbComp As Object
    Dim codeMod As Object
    Dim startLine As Long
    Dim totalLines As Long
    Dim response As VbMsgBoxResult
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 获取当前模块
    Set vbComp = Application.VBE.ActiveVBProject.VBComponents(Application.VBE.ActiveCodePane.CodeModule.Parent.Name)
    Set codeMod = vbComp.CodeModule
    
    ' 获取模块总行数
    totalLines = codeMod.CountOfLines
    
    If totalLines = 0 Then
        MsgBox "模块为空，没有代码可删除。", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 提示用户输入开始删除的行号
    startLine = Val(InputBox("请输入要开始删除的行号 (当前模块共有 " & totalLines & " 行):", "删除代码"))
    
    ' 验证输入
    If startLine <= 0 Or startLine > totalLines Then
        MsgBox "无效的行号! 请输入 1 到 " & totalLines & " 之间的数字。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 确认删除操作
    response = MsgBox("确定要删除从第 " & startLine & " 行到第 " & totalLines & " 行的所有代码吗?", _
                      vbYesNo + vbQuestion + vbDefaultButton2, "确认删除")
    
    If response = vbNo Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 删除指定行及之后的所有代码
    codeMod.DeleteLines startLine, totalLines - startLine + 1
    
    MsgBox "已成功删除从第 " & startLine & " 行开始的所有代码。", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
    
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "发生错误: " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & _
           "错误号: " & Err.Number, vbCritical
    Exit Sub
End Sub

        db.Execute "CREATE TABLE ProceduresList (" & _
                   "ModuleName TEXT(255), " & _
                   "ProcedureName TEXT(255), " & _
                   "ProcedureType TEXT(50), " & _
                   "StartLine LONG, " & _

    Dim fieldExists As Boolean
    fieldExists = False

    For Each fld In rs.Fields

    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset("ProceduresList", dbOpenDynaset)
    
    ' 获取当前VB项目
    Set vbProj = Application.VBE.ActiveVBProject

    For Each vbComp In vbProj.VBComponents
        If vbComp.Type = vbext_ct_StdModule Or vbComp.Type = vbext_ct_ClassModule Then
            Set codeMod = vbComp.CodeModule
            
            ' 遍历所有行，寻找过程定义
            currentLine = 1
            Do While currentLine < codeMod.CountOfLines
                ' 获取当前行文本
                lineText = codeMod.Lines(currentLine, 1)
                
                ' 检查是否为过程定义行
                If IsProcedureDefinition(lineText, procName, procType) Then
                    procStartLine = currentLine
                    
                    ' 获取过程类型对应的procKind
                    Select Case procType
                        Case "Sub"
                            procKind = vbext_pk_Proc
                        Case "Function"
                            procKind = vbext_pk_Function
                        Case Else ' Property
                            procKind = vbext_pk_PropertyGet ' 默认使用Get类型
                    End Select
                    
                    ' 获取过程行数
                    On Error Resume Next

                        Debug.Print "获取过程行数错误: " & Err.Description & " - 过程: " & procName & ", 类型: " & procType

                        Err.Clear

                    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
                    
                    ' 获取过程前的注释

                    rs.Update

                    currentLine = currentLine + 1
                Else
                    ' 继续检查下一行

                End If

        End If

           "位置: " & Erl

' 检查是否为过程定义行，并提取过程名和类型
Function IsProcedureDefinition(lineText As String, ByRef procName As String, ByRef procType As String) As Boolean
    lineText = Trim(lineText)
    
    ' 检查是否为Sub过程
    If Left(lineText, 3) = "Sub" And InStr(lineText, "(") > 0 Then
        procName = Trim(Mid(lineText, 5, InStr(lineText, "(") - 5))
        procType = "Sub"
        IsProcedureDefinition = True
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 检查是否为Function过程
    If Left(lineText, 8) = "Function" And InStr(lineText, "(") > 0 Then
        procName = Trim(Mid(lineText, 10, InStr(lineText, "(") - 10))
        procType = "Function"
        IsProcedureDefinition = True
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 检查是否为Property过程
    If Left(lineText, 8) = "Property" Then
        Dim propType As String
        Dim propName As String
        Dim spacePos As Long
        
        spacePos = InStr(9, lineText, " ")
        If spacePos > 0 Then
            propType = Trim(Mid(lineText, 9, spacePos - 9))
            If InStr(lineText, "(") > 0 Then
                propName = Trim(Mid(lineText, spacePos + 1, InStr(lineText, "(") - spacePos - 1))
            Else
                propName = Trim(Mid(lineText, spacePos + 1))
            End If
            
            If propName <> "" Then
                procName = propName
                procType = "Property " & propType
                IsProcedureDefinition = True
                Exit Function
            End If
        End If
    End If
    
    IsProcedureDefinition = False
End Function

' 获取过程前的注释文本
Function GetProcedureComment(codeMod As VBIDE.CodeModule, procStartLine As Long) As String
    Dim commentText As String
    Dim currentLine As Long
    
    commentText = ""
    currentLine = procStartLine - 1
    
    ' 向上查找，直到找到非注释行或文件开头
    Do While currentLine > 0
        Dim lineText As String
        lineText = codeMod.Lines(currentLine, 1)
        
        ' 如果是空行，继续检查上一行
        If Trim(lineText) = "" Then
            currentLine = currentLine - 1
            GoTo NextLine
        End If
        
        ' 如果是注释行，添加到注释文本
        If Left(Trim(lineText), 1) = "'" Then
            ' 提取注释内容（去除单引号）
            Dim commentLine As String
            commentLine = Trim(Mid(lineText, 2))
            
            ' 将当前注释行添加到开头（保持正确顺序）
            If commentText = "" Then
                commentText = commentLine
            Else
                commentText = commentLine & vbCrLf & commentText
            End If
            
            currentLine = currentLine - 1
        Else
            ' 不是注释行，停止查找
            Exit Do
        End If
        
NextLine:
    Loop
    
    GetProcedureComment = commentText
End Function

' 主函数，用于替换类模块代码中的字符串
' 需要引用: Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications Extensibility 5.3
Public Sub ReplaceStringInForm(ByVal formName As String, ByVal oldString As String, ByVal newString As String)
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    Dim vbProj As VBIDE.VBProject
    Dim vbComp As VBIDE.VBComponent
    Dim codeMod As VBIDE.CodeModule
    Dim lineCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim lineText As String
    Dim isComment As Boolean
    Dim frm As Form
    Dim componentFound As Boolean
    Dim componentType As String
    
    ' 获取当前VB项目
    Set vbProj = Application.VBE.ActiveVBProject
    
    ' 验证组件是否存在，改进匹配逻辑
    componentFound = False
    For Each vbComp In vbProj.VBComponents
        If StrComp(vbComp.Name, formName, vbTextCompare) = 0 Then
            componentFound = True
            Select Case vbComp.Type
                Case vbext_ct_ClassModule: componentType = "类模块"
                Case vbext_ct_MSForm: componentType = "窗体"
                Case vbext_ct_StdModule: componentType = "标准模块"
                Case vbext_ct_Document: componentType = "文档"
                Case Else: componentType = "未知类型 (" & vbComp.Type & ")"
            End Select
            Exit For
        End If
    Next vbComp
    
    ' 如果组件不存在，详细输出匹配过程信息
    If Not componentFound Then
        Dim componentList As String
        componentList = "可用组件列表:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
        Dim mismatchMsg As String
        mismatchMsg = "以下是遍历组件时的名称匹配情况：" & vbCrLf
        For Each vbComp In vbProj.VBComponents
            componentList = componentList & vbComp.Name & " (" & GetComponentTypeDescription(vbComp.Type) & ")" & vbCrLf
            If StrComp(vbComp.Name, formName, vbTextCompare) <> 0 Then
                mismatchMsg = mismatchMsg & "组件 " & vbComp.Name & " 与传入名称 " & formName & " 不匹配" & vbCrLf
            End If
        Next vbComp
        MsgBox "错误: 未找到组件 '" & formName & "'" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf & componentList & vbCrLf & mismatchMsg, vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 检查组件是否可修改
    If Not CanModifyComponent(vbComp) Then
        MsgBox "错误: 无法修改组件 '" & formName & "' (" & componentType & ")" & vbCrLf & _
               "可能是因为它是只读的或不支持代码模块访问。", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取组件的代码模块
    Set codeMod = vbComp.CodeModule
    lineCount = codeMod.CountOfLines
    
    ' 尝试打开窗体(如果未打开)
    On Error Resume Next
    Set frm = Forms(formName)
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        ' 尝试打开窗体
        DoCmd.OpenForm formName, acDesign
        Set frm = Forms(formName)
    End If
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 如果窗体成功打开，修改控件名称
    If Not frm Is Nothing Then
        Dim ctl As Control
        For Each ctl In frm.Controls
            If InStr(1, ctl.Name, oldString, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
                ctl.Name = Replace(ctl.Name, oldString, newString, 1, -1, vbTextCompare)
            End If
        Next ctl
        
        ' 关闭窗体但不保存更改(我们只修改了代码模块)
        DoCmd.Close acForm, formName, acSaveNo
    Else
        ' 如果无法打开窗体，仅修改代码模块
        Debug.Print "警告: 无法打开窗体 '" & formName & "', 仅修改代码模块"
    End If
    
    ' 遍历代码模块的每一行
    For i = 1 To lineCount
        lineText = codeMod.Lines(i, 1)
        
        ' 检查是否为注释行
        isComment = Left$(Trim(lineText), 1) = "'" Or _
                   (InStr(1, lineText, "Rem ", vbTextCompare) > 0 And _
                    (InStr(1, lineText, "'", vbTextCompare) = 0 Or _
                     InStr(1, lineText, "Rem ", vbTextCompare) < InStr(1, lineText, "'", vbTextCompare)))
        
        ' 如果不是注释且包含要替换的字符串，则替换
        If Not isComment And InStr(1, lineText, oldString, vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            lineText = Replace(lineText, oldString, newString, 1, -1, vbTextCompare)
            codeMod.ReplaceLine i, lineText
        End If
    Next i
    
    MsgBox "替换完成！在组件 '" & formName & "' (" & componentType & ") 中，'" & oldString & "' 已被替换为 '" & newString & "'。", vbInformation
    Exit Sub
    
ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "发生错误: " & Err.Description & vbCrLf & _
           "请确保已启用'信任访问VBA项目对象模型'选项。", vbCritical
    Resume Next
End Sub

    '程序功能：本程序是用来配合自动编号管理的窗体完成自动编号
    '程序名称：自动编号
    '程序参数：输入编号规则名称
    '使用范围：适合所有access
    '使用范例：直接在程序中调用即可  rs!序号=自动编号（表名_序号[规则名称]）
    '程序作者：月皓星隐
    '编外的话：为了方便查看，所以变量用中文的
    '编写时间：2015-09-01
    '******************************************************************************************************************
Function 自动编号(ByVal 规则名称 As String)
    Dim rs As New ADODB.Recordset
    Dim cn As ADODB.Connection
    Dim 循环次数 As Integer
    Dim 日期前缀 As String
    Dim 流水号 As Long
    Dim 流水号后缀 As String
    '1.先根据规则名称找到记录
    Set cn = CurrentProject.Connection
    rs.Open "自动编号管理", cn, adOpenKeyset, adLockOptimistic
    rs.Filter = "[规则名称]='" & 规则名称 & "'"
    '2.根据情况进行编号
    If rs.EOF Or rs.BOF Then MsgBox "没有有效的规则，请确定是否规则名称输入正确": Exit Function
    If IsNull(rs!最后编号) Then
        流水号 = 1
    Else
        流水号 = Val(Right(rs!最后编号, rs!顺序号位数)) + 1
    End If
    For 循环次数 = 1 To rs!顺序号位数
        流水号后缀 = 流水号后缀 & "0"
    Next 循环次数
    '2.1有日期形式加入的情况
    If IsNull(rs!日期格式) = False Then
        日期前缀 = Format(Now(), rs!日期格式)
        自动编号 = rs!编号前缀 & 日期前缀 & Format(流水号, 流水号后缀)
        rs!最后编号 = 自动编号
        rs.Update
    Else
        '2.2没有日期加入编号的情况
        自动编号 = rs!编号前缀 & Format(流水号, 流水号后缀)
        rs!最后编号 = 自动编号
        rs.Update
    End If
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set cn = Nothing
End Function

Private Declare PtrSafe Function OpenClipboard Lib "user32" (ByVal hwnd As LongPtr) As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function CloseClipboard Lib "user32" () As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function EmptyClipboard Lib "user32" () As Long

Private Declare PtrSafe Function GlobalAlloc Lib "kernel32" (ByVal wFlags As Long, ByVal dwBytes As Long) As LongPtr
Private Declare PtrSafe Function GlobalLock Lib "kernel32" (ByVal hMem As LongPtr) As LongPtr
Private Declare PtrSafe Function GlobalUnlock Lib "kernel32" (ByVal hMem As LongPtr) As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function GlobalFree Lib "kernel32" (ByVal hMem As LongPtr) As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function lstrcpy Lib "kernel32" Alias "lstrcpyW" (ByVal lpString1 As LongPtr, ByVal lpString2 As LongPtr) As Long  ' Unicode 版本

' 定义常量（使用 Unicode 格式）
Private Const GMEM_MOVEABLE = &H2
Private Const CF_UNICODETEXT = 13  ' Unicode 文本格式
'API复制内容到剪贴板
Sub CopyStringToClipboard(ByVal strText As String)
    Dim hGlobalMemory As LongPtr
    Dim lpGlobalMemory As LongPtr
    Dim length As Long
    Dim result As LongPtr

    ' 计算 Unicode 字符串长度（每个字符 2 字节，包括终止符）
    length = Len(strText) * 2 + 2  ' 2 字节/字符 + 2 字节终止符（\0\0）

    ' 分配全局内存（Unicode 需双字节对齐）
    hGlobalMemory = GlobalAlloc(GMEM_MOVEABLE, length)
    If hGlobalMemory = 0 Then
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 锁定内存块并获取指针
    lpGlobalMemory = GlobalLock(hGlobalMemory)
    If lpGlobalMemory = 0 Then
        GlobalUnlock hGlobalMemory
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 将 Unicode 字符串复制到内存（使用 StrPtr 获取字符串指针）
    lstrcpy lpGlobalMemory, StrPtr(strText)

    ' 解锁内存块
    GlobalUnlock hGlobalMemory

    ' 打开剪贴板
    result = OpenClipboard(0)
    If result = 0 Then
        GlobalFree hGlobalMemory
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 清空剪贴板
    EmptyClipboard

    ' 设置 Unicode 文本格式
    result = SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, hGlobalMemory)
    If result = 0 Then
        GlobalFree hGlobalMemory
    End If

    ' 关闭剪贴板
    CloseClipboard
End Sub

Function BaseConversion(num As Long, base As Integer, digit As Integer) As String
    Dim digits As String
    Dim result As String
    Dim quotient As Long
    Dim remainder As Integer
    
    ' 根据不同进制设置对应的字符集
    Select Case base
        Case 31
            digits = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRST"
        Case 34
            digits = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWX"
        Case 36
            digits = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
        Case Else
            MsgBox "不支持的进制: " & base
            Exit Function
    End Select
    
    quotient = num
    result = ""
    
    ' 进行进制转换
    Do While quotient > 0
        remainder = quotient Mod base
        result = Mid(digits, remainder + 1, 1) & result
        quotient = quotient \ base
    Loop
    
    ' 如果结果为空，说明输入的数字是 0
    If result = "" Then
        result = "0"
    End If
    
    ' 补齐位数
    If Len(result) < digit Then
        result = String(digit - Len(result), "0") & result
    End If
    
    BaseConversion = result
End Function

'36进制转换成10进制
Function Base36ToBase10(strBase36 As String) As Long
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim digit As Integer
    Dim result As Long
    Dim power As Long
    result = 0
    power = 1
    For i = Len(strBase36) To 1 Step -1
        Select Case Mid(strBase36, i, 1)
            Case "0" To "9"
                digit = CInt(Mid(strBase36, i, 1))
            Case "A" To "Z"
                digit = Asc(UCase(Mid(strBase36, i, 1))) - Asc("A") + 10
            Case Else
                Base36ToBase10 = 0 '如果包含非法字符，返回0
                Exit Function
        End Select
        result = result + digit * power
        power = power * 36
    Next i
    Base36ToBase10 = result
End Function

    Dim hwnd As LongPtr

    Dim classLen As Long

    ' 方法1：尝试通过已知类名查找
    Dim classNames As Variant
    classNames = Array("CorelDRAW", "CorelDRAW.Application", "CorelDRW", "CorelDRAW2024", "CorelDRAW 2024")
    
    For Each vClassName In classNames
        hwnd = FindWindow(CStr(vClassName), vbNullString)
        If hwnd <> 0 Then
            GetCDRWindowHandle = hwnd
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next
    
    ' 方法2：通过窗口标题查找（包含"CorelDRAW"的窗口）
    g_hWndCDR = 0
    g_strWindowTitle = ""
    EnumWindows AddressOf EnumWindowProc, 0
    
    If g_hWndCDR <> 0 Then
        GetCDRWindowHandle = g_hWndCDR
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 方法3：获取前台窗口（如果CDR是活动窗口）
    hwnd = GetForegroundWindow()
    If hwnd <> 0 Then
        titleLen = GetWindowTextLength(hwnd) + 1
        title = String(titleLen, Chr(0))
        GetWindowText hwnd, title, titleLen
        title = Left(title, titleLen - 1)
        
        If InStr(1, title, "CorelDRAW", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then
            GetCDRWindowHandle = hwnd
            Exit Function
        End If
    End If
    
    GetCDRWindowHandle = 0
End Function

'将选中的文本对象转曲
Sub ConvertSelectedTextToCurves()
    Dim s As Shape
    Dim textShapes As New Collection
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim textCount As Integer

    '检查是否有活动文档
    If ActiveDocument Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "没有打开的文档！"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    '检查是否有选中的对象
    If ActiveSelection.Shapes.Count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先选择要转曲的文本对象！"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    textCount = 0

    '遍历选中的所有形状
    For Each s In ActiveSelection.Shapes
        '检查形状是否为文本对象（包括美术字和段落文本）
        If s.Type = cdrTextShape Then
            textShapes.Add s
            textCount = textCount + 1
            '检查是否为标注尺寸文字
        ElseIf s.Type = cdrLinearDimensionShape Or s.Type = cdrAngularDimensionShape Then
            '标注尺寸也是文本对象，需要转曲
            textShapes.Add s
            textCount = textCount + 1
        End If
    Next s

    '如果没有找到文本对象
    If textCount = 0 Then
        MsgBox "选中的对象中没有文本对象！"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    '转换为曲线
    For i = 1 To textShapes.Count
        Set s = textShapes(i)
        On Error Resume Next    '忽略可能的错误
        s.ConvertToCurves
    Next i

    'MsgBox "已完成 " & textCount & " 个选中文本对象的转曲操作！"
End Sub
