'对象对齐页面函数
Sub QuickAlignToPage(alignType As Integer)
    Dim s As shape
    Dim pageW As Double
    Dim pageH As Double
    Dim newX As Double
    Dim newY As Double

    If ActiveDocument Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If ActiveSelection.Shapes.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先选择对象！"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    ' 获取页面尺寸（英寸）
    pageW = ActivePage.SizeWidth
    pageH = ActivePage.SizeHeight

    ActiveDocument.BeginCommandGroup "对齐到页面"
    Application.Optimization = True

    For Each s In ActiveSelection.Shapes
        Select Case alignType
            Case 1  ' 左对齐
                newX = 0
                newY = s.PositionY
            Case 2  ' 水平居中
                newX = (pageW - s.SizeWidth) / 2
                newY = s.PositionY
            Case 3  ' 右对齐
                newX = pageW - s.SizeWidth
                newY = s.PositionY
            Case 4  ' 顶部对齐（对象顶部贴页面顶部）
                newX = s.PositionX
                newY = pageH
            Case 5  ' 垂直居中（对象中心贴页面中心）
                newX = s.PositionX
                newY = (pageH + s.SizeHeight) / 2
            Case 6  ' 底部对齐（对象底部贴页面底部）
                newX = s.PositionX
                newY = pageH - (pageH - s.SizeHeight)
            Case 7  ' 中心对齐（水平+垂直居中）
                newX = (pageW - s.SizeWidth) / 2
                newY = (pageH + s.SizeHeight) / 2
        End Select

        s.SetPosition newX, newY
    Next s
    Application.Optimization = False
    ActiveDocument.EndCommandGroup
    Application.Refresh
End Sub

' 对象对齐函数（alignType:1-7, baseType:1-3）
Sub QuickAlignToPage(ByVal alignType As Integer, ByVal baseType As Integer)
    Dim s As shape
    Dim pageW As Double
    Dim pageH As Double
    Dim newX As Double
    Dim newY As Double
    Dim refShape As shape
    Dim refX As Double
    Dim refY As Double
    Dim refW As Double
    Dim refH As Double
    Dim isSkip As Boolean
    
    ' 检查文档
    If ActiveDocument Is Nothing Then
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 检查选中对象
    If ActiveSelection.Shapes.count = 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先选择对象！"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取参考基准
    If baseType = BASE_PAGE Then
        ' 页面对齐：使用页面尺寸
        pageW = ActivePage.SizeWidth
        pageH = ActivePage.SizeHeight
    Else
        ' 对象对齐：获取参考对象（顶层或底层）
        If baseType = BASE_TOP_OBJECT Then
            Set refShape = GetTopmostShape()
        ElseIf baseType = BASE_BOTTOM_OBJECT Then
            Set refShape = GetBottommostShape()
        End If
        
        ' 检查参考对象
        If refShape Is Nothing Then
            MsgBox "无法获取参考对象！"
            Exit Sub
        End If
        
        ' 获取参考对象的位置和尺寸
        refX = refShape.PositionX
        refY = refShape.PositionY
        refW = refShape.SizeWidth
        refH = refShape.SizeHeight
    End If
    
    ' 开始事务
    ActiveDocument.BeginCommandGroup "对齐对象"
    Application.Optimization = True
    
    ' 遍历所有选中的形状
    For Each s In ActiveSelection.Shapes
        isSkip = False
        
        ' 跳过参考对象本身（对象对齐时）
        If baseType <> BASE_PAGE Then
            If s Is refShape Then
                isSkip = True
            End If
        End If
        
        If Not isSkip Then
            ' 根据基准类型计算新位置
            If baseType = BASE_PAGE Then
                ' 页面对齐
                Select Case alignType
                    Case ALIGN_LEFT
                        newX = 0
                        newY = s.PositionY
                    Case ALIGN_CENTER_H
                        newX = (pageW - s.SizeWidth) / 2
                        newY = s.PositionY
                    Case ALIGN_RIGHT
                        newX = pageW - s.SizeWidth
                        newY = s.PositionY
                    Case ALIGN_TOP
                        newX = s.PositionX
                        newY = pageH
                    Case ALIGN_CENTER_V
                        newX = s.PositionX
                        newY = (pageH + s.SizeHeight) / 2
                    Case ALIGN_BOTTOM
                        newX = s.PositionX
                        newY = pageH - (pageH - s.SizeHeight)
                    Case ALIGN_CENTER
                        newX = (pageW - s.SizeWidth) / 2
                        newY = (pageH + s.SizeHeight) / 2
                End Select
            Else
                ' 对象对齐
                Select Case alignType
                    Case ALIGN_LEFT
                        newX = refX
                        newY = s.PositionY
                    Case ALIGN_CENTER_H
                        newX = refX + (refW - s.SizeWidth) / 2
                        newY = s.PositionY
                    Case ALIGN_RIGHT
                        newX = refX + refW - s.SizeWidth
                        newY = s.PositionY
                    Case ALIGN_TOP
                        newX = s.PositionX
                        newY = refY
                    Case ALIGN_CENTER_V
                        newX = s.PositionX
                        newY = refY + (s.SizeHeight - refH) / 2
                    Case ALIGN_BOTTOM
                        newX = s.PositionX
                        newY = refY + (s.SizeHeight - refH)
                    Case ALIGN_CENTER
                        newX = refX + (refW - s.SizeWidth) / 2
                        newY = refY + (s.SizeHeight - refH) / 2
                End Select
            End If
            
            ' 设置新位置
            s.SetPosition newX, newY
        End If
    Next s
    
    ' 恢复设置
    Application.Optimization = False
    ActiveDocument.EndCommandGroup
    Application.Refresh
End Sub

' 获取选中最顶层的对象（显示在最上面，ZOrder最大）
Function GetTopmostShape() As shape
    Dim s As shape
    Dim topmost As shape
    Dim maxZOrder As Long
    
    ' 初始化
    Set topmost = Nothing
    maxZOrder = 999999
    
    ' 检查选中对象
    If ActiveSelection.Shapes.count = 0 Then
        Set GetTopmostShape = Nothing
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 遍历查找最大 ZOrder（最顶层）
    For Each s In ActiveSelection.Shapes
        If s.ZOrder < maxZOrder Then
            maxZOrder = s.ZOrder
            Set topmost = s

    Next s
    
    Set GetTopmostShape = topmost
End Function

' 使用 Shell32 的文件夹浏览对话框
Sub ImportVBAComponentsFromFolder()
    Dim VBProj As Object
    Dim fso As Object
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim file As Object
    Dim folder As Object
    Dim importCount As Integer
    Dim skipCount As Integer
    Dim fileName As String
    Dim fileExt As String
    Dim compName As String
    Dim existingComp As Object
    Dim overwriteAll As Variant
    Dim overwriteThis As Integer
    
    ' 获取当前VBA工程
    On Error Resume Next
    Set VBProj = Application.VBE.ActiveVBProject
    
    If VBProj Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "无法获取当前VBA工程！" & vbCrLf & _
               "请在VBA编辑器中打开你的项目", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 使用 Shell32 选择文件夹
    folderPath = ShellBrowseForFolder("请选择包含VBA组件的文件夹")
    
    If folderPath = "" Then
        MsgBox "未选择文件夹，操作取消", vbInformation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 创建文件系统对象
    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    
    ' 检查文件夹是否存在
    If Not fso.FolderExists(folderPath) Then
        MsgBox "文件夹不存在：" & folderPath, vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Set folder = fso.GetFolder(folderPath)
    
    importCount = 0
    skipCount = 0
    overwriteAll = Empty
    
    ' 遍历文件夹中的所有文件
    For Each file In folder.Files
        fileName = file.Name
        fileExt = LCase(fso.GetExtensionName(fileName))
        
        Select Case fileExt
            Case "bas", "frm", "cls"
                compName = fso.GetBaseName(fileName)
                
                ' 修复：正确检查组件是否存在
                On Error Resume Next
                Set existingComp = VBProj.VBComponents(compName)
                If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                    ' 组件不存在，清除错误继续
                    Err.Clear
                    Set existingComp = Nothing
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                
                ' 如果组件存在，处理覆盖逻辑
                If Not existingComp Is Nothing Then
                    If IsEmpty(overwriteAll) Then
                        overwriteThis = MsgBox("组件 '" & compName & "' 已存在，是否覆盖？" & vbCrLf & _
                                               "是(Y) - 覆盖此组件" & vbCrLf & _
                                               "否(N) - 跳过此组件" & vbCrLf & _
                                               "全部是(A) - 覆盖所有同名组件" & vbCrLf & _
                                               "全部否(N) - 跳过所有同名组件", _
                                               vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion, "组件已存在")
                        
                        Select Case overwriteThis
                            Case vbYes  ' 仅覆盖当前
                                overwriteAll = False
                            Case vbNo   ' 仅跳过当前
                                skipCount = skipCount + 1
                                GoTo NextFile
                            Case vbCancel  ' 取消操作
                                Exit Sub
                            Case Else
                                GoTo NextFile
                        End Select
                    ElseIf overwriteAll = True Then
                        ' 已经选择了"全部否"，跳过
                        skipCount = skipCount + 1
                        GoTo NextFile
                    End If
                    
                    ' 修复：安全删除已存在的组件
                    On Error Resume Next
                    ' 方法1：通过索引删除
                    Dim idx As Integer
                    For idx = 1 To VBProj.VBComponents.Count
                        If VBProj.VBComponents(idx).Name = compName Then
                            VBProj.VBComponents.Remove VBProj.VBComponents(idx)
                            Exit For
                        End If
                    Next idx
                    
                    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                        ' 如果上面的方法失败，尝试方法2
                        Err.Clear
                        VBProj.VBComponents.Remove VBProj.VBComponents(compName)
                    End If
                    
                    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
                        MsgBox "无法删除现有组件：" & compName & vbCrLf & "错误：" & Err.Description, vbExclamation
                        Err.Clear
                        skipCount = skipCount + 1
                        GoTo NextFile
                    End If
                    On Error GoTo 0
                End If

                On Error Resume Next
                VBProj.VBComponents.Import file.Path
                If Err.Number = 0 Then
                    importCount = importCount + 1
                Else
                    MsgBox "导入失败：" & fileName & vbCrLf & "错误：" & Err.Description, vbExclamation
                    Err.Clear
                    skipCount = skipCount + 1
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
        End Select
NextFile:
    Next file
    
    MsgBox "导入完成！" & vbCrLf & _
           "成功导入：" & importCount & " 个组件" & vbCrLf & _
           "跳过：" & skipCount & " 个组件" & vbCrLf & _

' 核心函数：最小化当前CorelDRAW窗口
' 返回值：True=成功最小化，False=失败
Private Function MinimizeCDRWindow() As Boolean
    MinimizeCDRWindow = False ' 默认为失败
    cdrHwnd = 0 ' 重置窗口句柄
    
    ' 获取当前CorelDRAW进程ID
    targetPID = GetCurrentProcessId()
    
    ' 枚举所有窗口，找到当前进程的可见主窗口
    EnumWindows AddressOf EnumWindowsProc, 0
    
    ' 执行最小化并返回结果
    If cdrHwnd <> 0 Then
        ShowWindow cdrHwnd, 6 ' 6=SW_MINIMIZE
        MinimizeCDRWindow = True
    End If
End Function


' 窗口枚举回调函数（内部使用）
#If VBA7 Then
    Private Function EnumWindowsProc(ByVal hwnd As LongPtr, ByVal lParam As LongPtr) As LongPtr
#Else
    Private Function EnumWindowsProc(ByVal hwnd As Long, ByVal lParam As Long) As Long
#End If
    Dim procId As Variant
    GetWindowThreadProcessId hwnd, procId ' 获取窗口所属进程ID
    
    ' 匹配当前进程且窗口可见
    If procId = targetPID And IsWindowVisible(hwnd) <> 0 Then
        cdrHwnd = hwnd ' 记录窗口句柄
        EnumWindowsProc = 0 ' 停止枚举
    Else
        EnumWindowsProc = 1 ' 继续枚举
    End If
End Function

Sub CheckPPTExpiration()

    Dim expirationDate As Date

    Dim currentUserName As String

Attribute VB_Name = "B002二维码函数"
'联网使用
Function GenerateQRCode(Cell As Range, Optional Size As Integer = 150) As Boolean
    ' 功能：调用在线API生成二维码并插入Excel
    ' 参数：
    '   Cell - 包含内容的单元格
    '   Size - 二维码尺寸（默认150x150像素）
    
    Dim strText As String
    Dim strURL As String
    Dim objHTTP As Object
    Dim imgPath As String
    Dim qrCode As Picture
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 获取单元格内容
    strText = WorksheetFunction.EncodeURL(Cell.Value)
    If strText = "" Then Exit Function
    
    ' 使用QR Code Monkey API（免费）
    strURL = "https://api.qrcode-monkey.com/qr/custom?size=" & Size & "&data=" & strText
    
    ' 创建HTTP请求对象
    Set objHTTP = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    With objHTTP
        .Open "GET", strURL, False
        .Send
    End With
    
    ' 检查请求是否成功
    If objHTTP.Status <> 200 Then
        MsgBox "无法获取二维码，HTTP错误: " & objHTTP.Status, vbExclamation
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 保存临时图片文件
    imgPath = Environ("Temp") & "\QRCode_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmddhhnnss") & ".png"
    
    ' 将响应写入文件
    Dim objStream As Object
    Set objStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    With objStream
        .Type = 1 ' 二进制
        .Open
        .Write objHTTP.responseBody
        .SaveToFile imgPath, 2 ' 覆盖
        .Close
    End With
    
    ' 插入图片到单元格右侧
    Set qrCode = Cell.Parent.Pictures.Insert(imgPath)
    With qrCode
        .Left = Cell.Offset(0, 1).Left
        .Top = Cell.Top
        .ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue
        .Height = Application.CentimetersToPoints(2) ' 约2厘米高
    End With
    
    ' 删除临时文件
    Kill imgPath
    
    GenerateQRCode = True
    Exit Function
    
ErrorHandler:
    GenerateQRCode = False
    MsgBox "生成二维码时出错: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation
End Function

        If UCase(Trim(wsList.Cells(i, "C").Value)) = "Y" Then
            wsName = Trim(wsList.Cells(i, "B").Value)
            If Evaluate("ISREF('" & wsName & "'!A1)") Then ' 检查工作表是否存在
                mergeCount = mergeCount + 1
                sheetsToMerge(mergeCount) = wsName
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    If mergeCount = 0 Then
        MsgBox "没有有效的可合并工作表", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 步骤3：创建结果工作表
    Dim newWs As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set newWs = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets("合并结果")
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    If Not newWs Is Nothing Then
        Application.DisplayAlerts = False
        newWs.Delete
        Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    End If
    
    Set newWs = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=ThisWorkbook.Sheets(ThisWorkbook.Sheets.Count))
    newWs.Name = "合并结果"
    
    ' 步骤4：读取所有数据到数组集合
    Dim dataArrays() As Variant
    ReDim dataArrays(1 To mergeCount)
    
    Dim totalRows As Long, maxCols As Long
    Dim firstWs As Worksheet
    Set firstWs = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(sheetsToMerge(1))
    
    ' 获取列数和表头
    maxCols = firstWs.Cells(headerRows, firstWs.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    
    ' 复制表头
    newWs.Cells(headerRows, 1).Value = "来源工作表"
    firstWs.Range(firstWs.Cells(1, 1), firstWs.Cells(headerRows, maxCols)).Copy newWs.Range("B1")
    
    ' 读取每个工作表的数据到独立数组
    For i = 1 To mergeCount
        With ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(sheetsToMerge(i))
            Dim lastDataRow As Long
            lastDataRow = .Cells(.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
            
            If lastDataRow > headerRows Then
                ' 读取整个数据区域到数组（添加来源表名列）
                Dim tempArray() As Variant
                tempArray = .Range(.Cells(headerRows + 1, 1), .Cells(lastDataRow, maxCols)).Value
                
                ' 创建带来源表名的数组
                Dim combinedArray() As Variant
                ReDim combinedArray(1 To UBound(tempArray, 1), 1 To UBound(tempArray, 2) + 1)
                
                ' 填充数组
                For j = 1 To UBound(tempArray, 1)
                    combinedArray(j, 1) = sheetsToMerge(i) ' 来源表名
                    For k = 1 To UBound(tempArray, 2)
                        combinedArray(j, k + 1) = tempArray(j, k)
                    Next k
                Next j
                
                dataArrays(i) = combinedArray
                totalRows = totalRows + UBound(combinedArray, 1)
            End If
        End With
    Next i
    
    ' 步骤5：合并所有数组到最终数组
    Dim finalArray() As Variant
    ReDim finalArray(1 To totalRows, 1 To maxCols + 1)
    
    Dim currentRow As Long: currentRow = 1
    For i = 1 To mergeCount
        If Not IsEmpty(dataArrays(i)) Then
            Dim arrRows As Long
            arrRows = UBound(dataArrays(i), 1)
            
            For j = 1 To arrRows
                For k = 1 To maxCols + 1
                    finalArray(currentRow, k) = dataArrays(i)(j, k)
                Next k
                currentRow = currentRow + 1
            Next j
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 一次性写入结果
    If currentRow > 1 Then
        newWs.Range("A1")(headerRows + 1, 1).Resize(totalRows, maxCols + 1).Value = finalArray
    End If
    
    ' 自动调整列宽
    newWs.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    
    MsgBox "成功合并 " & mergeCount & " 个工作表数据", vbInformation
End Sub

Sub MergeSameCellsAndCenter()
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim Cell As Range
    Dim firstAddress As String
    Dim mergeRange As Range
    
    ' 检查是否选中了单元格
    If Selection Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选择一列数据", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 确保只处理单列
    Set rng = Intersect(Selection, Selection.EntireColumn)
    If rng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请只选择一列数据", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False ' 禁止合并提示
    
    ' 先取消所有合并单元格
    rng.UnMerge
    
    ' 遍历选中的列
    Set Cell = rng.Cells(1, 1)
    firstAddress = Cell.Address
    Set mergeRange = Cell
    
    For Each Cell In rng
        If Cell.Value <> mergeRange.Cells(1, 1).Value Then
            ' 合并相同内容的单元格
            If mergeRange.Cells.Count > 1 Then
                mergeRange.Merge
                mergeRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
                mergeRange.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
            End If
            Set mergeRange = Cell
        Else
            Set mergeRange = Union(mergeRange, Cell)
        End If
    Next Cell
    
    ' 处理最后一组相同内容
    If Not mergeRange Is Nothing Then
        If mergeRange.Cells.Count > 1 Then
            mergeRange.Merge
            mergeRange.HorizontalAlignment = xlCenter
            mergeRange.VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        End If
    End If
    
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "合并完成!", vbInformation

Function ToFenshu(ByVal xiaoshu As Single) As String
'小数转换为分数，误差小于10^-5
'参考文章：http://club.excelhome.net/thread-810083-1-1.html
Dim i As Long, f As Single
f = xiaoshu - Int(xiaoshu)
If xiaoshu > 1 Then ToFenshu = Int(xiaoshu) & "-"
Do
i = i + 1
Loop Until Abs((i / f) - Round((i / f), 0)) < 0.1 ^ 5
ToFenshu = ToFenshu & i & "/" & Round(i / f)
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "A006批量把工作表另存为工作簿"
'先运行A004，生成SheetNames工作表，然后标记要合并的工作表，运行下面的程序

Sub SaveMarkedSheetsToWorkbooks()
    Dim wsList As Worksheet
    Dim targetFolder As String
    Dim lastRow As Long, i As Long
    Dim sourceWs As Worksheet, newWb As Workbook
    Dim wsName As String, newWbName As String
    Dim savePath As String
    
    ' 设置目标文件夹（用户选择）
    With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)
        .Title = "选择保存位置"
        If .Show <> -1 Then Exit Sub ' 用户取消
        targetFolder = .SelectedItems(1)
        If Right(targetFolder, 1) <> "\" Then targetFolder = targetFolder & "\"
    End With
    
    ' 设置包含列表的工作表（假设当前工作表）
    Set wsList = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = wsList.Cells(wsList.Rows.Count, "B").End(xlUp).Row
      
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 计数器
    Dim savedCount As Long: savedCount = 0
    
    ' 遍历列表
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(wsList.Cells(i, "C").Value)) = "Y" Then
            wsName = Trim(wsList.Cells(i, "B").Value)
            newWbName = Trim(wsList.Cells(i, "D").Value)
            
            ' 检查工作表是否存在
            On Error Resume Next
            Set sourceWs = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(wsName)
            On Error GoTo 0
            
            If Not sourceWs Is Nothing Then
                On Error Resume Next
                Set newWb = Nothing
                
                ' 复制工作表到新工作簿
                sourceWs.Copy
                Set newWb = ActiveWorkbook
                
                ' 构建保存路径（确保文件名有效）
                newWbName = CleanFileName(newWbName) ' 清理非法字符
                If newWbName = "" Then newWbName = "Sheet_" & wsName ' 默认名称
                savePath = targetFolder & newWbName & ".xlsx"
                
                ' 检查文件是否已存在
                If Dir(savePath) <> "" Then
                    savePath = targetFolder & newWbName & "_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmdd_hhmmss") & ".xlsx"
                End If
                
                ' 保存工作簿
                Application.DisplayAlerts = False
                newWb.SaveAs Filename:=savePath, FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook
                newWb.Close False
                Application.DisplayAlerts = True
                
                If Err.Number = 0 Then
                    savedCount = savedCount + 1
                Else
                    MsgBox "保存失败: " & wsName & " 为 " & newWbName & vbCrLf & _
                           "错误: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation
                    Err.Clear
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            Else
                MsgBox "工作表不存在: " & wsName, vbExclamation
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 恢复设置
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "已完成保存 " & savedCount & " 个工作表到指定文件夹", vbInformation
End Sub

' 辅助函数：清理文件名中的非法字符
Function CleanFileName(strName As String) As String
    Dim illegalChars As String
    illegalChars = "\/:*?""<>|" ' Windows文件名非法字符
    
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To Len(illegalChars)
        strName = Replace(strName, Mid(illegalChars, i, 1), "_")
    Next i
    
    ' 去除首尾空格
    strName = Trim(strName)
    
    ' 如果为空则返回默认名称
    If strName = "" Then strName = "Workbook"
    
    CleanFileName = strName
End Function

'批量拆分合并单元格并填充
Sub UnmergeAndFillCells()
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim mergedArea As Range
    Dim Cell As Range
    Dim mergeValue As Variant
    
    ' 检查是否选中了单元格
    If Selection Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请先选择一列数据", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 确保只处理单列
    Set rng = Intersect(Selection, Selection.EntireColumn)
    If rng Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "请只选择一列数据", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 遍历所有单元格
    For Each Cell In rng
        ' 检查是否是合并单元格的一部分
        If Cell.MergeCells Then
            ' 获取合并区域和值
            Set mergedArea = Cell.MergeArea
            mergeValue = mergedArea.Cells(1, 1).Value
            ' 取消合并
            mergedArea.UnMerge
            ' 填充所有原合并区域的单元格
            mergedArea.Value = mergeValue
        End If
    Next Cell
    
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "取消合并并填充完成!", vbInformation
End Sub

Sub ExtractSheetNames()
    Dim ws As Worksheet

    ' 创建一个新工作表来存放结果
    On Error Resume Next
    Set newWs = ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets("SheetNames")

    ' 如果工作表已存在则删除
    If Not newWs Is Nothing Then

    End If

            newWs.Cells(i + 1, 1).Value = i
            newWs.Cells(i + 1, 2).Value = ws.Name

        End If
    Next ws

Private Sub DealOneArea(tar As Range, folder As String, sepor As String)

    For i = 1 To rows

Private Function GetEndDataRow(tar As Excel.Range, iRow As Long) As Long

    End If

  Dim str As String, BeforePoint As String, AfterPoint As String, tmpStr As String

     If Len(AfterPoint) = 1 Then

 End Function
 Private Function DecodeHundred(HundredString As String) As String
     Dim tmp As Integer
     If Len(HundredString) > 0 And Len(HundredString) <= 3 Then
         Select Case Len(HundredString)
             Case 1
                 tmp = CInt(HundredString)
                 If tmp <> 0 Then DecodeHundred = StrNO(tmp)
             Case 2
                 tmp = CInt(HundredString)
                 If tmp <> 0 Then
                     If (tmp < 20) Then
                         DecodeHundred = StrNO(tmp)
                     Else
                         If CInt(Right(HundredString, 1)) = 0 Then
                             DecodeHundred = StrTens(Int(tmp / 10))
                         Else
                             DecodeHundred = StrTens(Int(tmp / 10)) & " " & StrNO(CInt(Right(HundredString, 1)))  '替换-
                         End If
                     End If
                 End If
             Case 3
                 If CInt(Left(HundredString, 1)) <> 0 Then
                     If CInt(Right(HundredString, 2)) <> 0 Then
                         DecodeHundred = StrNO(CInt(Left(HundredString, 1))) & " " & Unit(4) & " " & Unit(8) & " " & DecodeHundred(Right(HundredString, 2))

                     End If
                     
                 Else
                     DecodeHundred = DecodeHundred(Right(HundredString, 2))
                 End If
             Case Else
         End Select

                If InStrRev(oldVal, newVal) + Len(newVal) - 1 = Len(oldVal) Then
                    Target.Value = Replace(oldVal, fenGeFu & newVal, "")
                Else
                    Target.Value = Replace(oldVal, newVal & fenGeFu, "")
                End If
            Else
                Target.Value = oldVal & fenGeFu & newVal
            End If
        End If
    End If

    Application.EnableEvents = True
End Sub

Attribute VB_Name = "B003条形码函数"

'联网使用
Function GenerateBarcodeImage(Cell As Range, Optional BarcodeType As String = "code128", Optional Width As Integer = 300, Optional Height As Integer = 100) As Boolean
    ' 功能：调用在线API生成条形码图片并插入Excel
    ' 参数：
    '   Cell - 包含条形码内容的单元格
    '   BarcodeType - 条形码类型（默认code128，可选：code39,ean13,upca等）
    '   Width - 图片宽度（像素，默认300）
    '   Height - 图片高度（像素，默认100）
    
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    
    ' 检查输入内容
    If Trim(Cell.Value) = "" Then
        MsgBox "单元格内容不能为空", vbExclamation
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 使用BarcodeAPI.net的免费服务
    Dim apiUrl As String
    apiUrl = "https://barcodeapi.org/api/" & BarcodeType & "/" & WorksheetFunction.EncodeURL(Cell.Value)
    
    ' 创建HTTP请求
    Dim httpRequest As Object
    Set httpRequest = CreateObject("MSXML2.XMLHTTP")
    
    With httpRequest
        .Open "GET", apiUrl, False
        .Send
    End With
    
    ' 检查响应状态
    If httpRequest.Status <> 200 Then
        MsgBox "无法获取条形码，HTTP错误: " & httpRequest.Status, vbExclamation
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    ' 创建临时文件路径
    Dim tempFilePath As String
    tempFilePath = Environ("Temp") & "\Barcode_" & Format(Now, "yyyymmddhhnnss") & ".png"
    
    ' 保存图片到临时文件
    Dim stream As Object
    Set stream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    
    With stream
        .Type = 1 ' 二进制模式
        .Open
        .Write httpRequest.responseBody
        .SaveToFile tempFilePath, 2 ' 覆盖已存在文件
        .Close
    End With
    
    ' 插入图片到单元格右侧
    Dim barcodeImage As Picture
    Set barcodeImage = Cell.Parent.Pictures.Insert(tempFilePath)
    
    With barcodeImage
        .Left = Cell.Offset(0, 1).Left
        .Top = Cell.Top
        .Width = Application.CentimetersToPoints(Width / 37.8) ' 像素转厘米再转点
        .Height = Application.CentimetersToPoints(Height / 37.8)
        .Placement = xlMoveAndSize ' 图片随单元格移动和调整大小
    End With
    
    ' 删除临时文件
    Kill tempFilePath
    
    GenerateBarcodeImage = True
    Exit Function
    
ErrorHandler:
    GenerateBarcodeImage = False
    MsgBox "生成条形码时出错: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation
End Function

Option Explicit

'根据某列拆分数据到当前工作簿的各个工作表中
Sub SplitDataByCategory_Optimized()
    Dim wbTarget As Workbook
    Dim wsSource As Worksheet
    Dim wsDest As Worksheet
    Dim rngData As Range, rngHeader As Range, rngCategory As Range
    Dim dict As Object
    Dim arrData(), arrOutput()
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim category As Variant
    Dim key As Variant
    Dim categoryCol As Long
    Dim itemCount As Long
    Dim outputRow As Long
    Dim headerRows As Long
    
    ' 设置目标工作簿
    Set wbTarget = ActiveWorkbook
    Set wsSource = wbTarget.ActiveSheet
    
    ' 创建字典对象
    Set dict = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    
    ' 用户选择区域
    On Error Resume Next
    Set rngHeader = Application.InputBox("请选择表头区域:", "表头选择", wsSource.Range("A1").CurrentRegion.Rows(1).Address, Type:=8)
    If rngHeader Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    
    Set rngData = Application.InputBox("请选择数据区域:", "数据选择", wsSource.Range("A" & rngHeader.Rows.Count + 1).CurrentRegion.Address, Type:=8)
    If rngData Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    
    Set rngCategory = Application.InputBox("请选择类别列:", "类别列选择", Type:=8)
    If rngCategory Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 验证选择
    If rngData.Row <= rngHeader.Row + rngHeader.Rows.Count - 1 Then
        MsgBox "数据区域必须在表头下方!", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    If Intersect(rngCategory, rngData) Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "类别列必须在数据区域内!", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    
    ' 获取相对列号
    categoryCol = rngCategory.Column - rngData.Column + 1
    headerRows = rngHeader.Rows.Count
    
    ' 将数据读入数组
    arrData = rngData.Value
    
    ' 收集类别并统计每类数据量
    For i = 1 To UBound(arrData)
        category = arrData(i, categoryCol)
        If Not IsEmpty(category) Then
            If dict.Exists(category) Then
                dict(category) = dict(category) + 1
            Else
                dict.Add category, 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i
    
    ' 处理每个类别
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    
    For Each key In dict.Keys
        itemCount = dict(key)
        
        ' 准备输出数组 (仅数据部分)
        ReDim arrOutput(1 To itemCount, 1 To UBound(arrData, 2))
        
        ' 筛选匹配数据
        outputRow = 1
        For i = 1 To UBound(arrData)
            If arrData(i, categoryCol) = key Then
                For j = 1 To UBound(arrData, 2)
                    arrOutput(outputRow, j) = arrData(i, j)
                Next j
                outputRow = outputRow + 1
            End If
        Next i
        
        ' 处理目标工作表
        If WorksheetExists(wbTarget, CStr(key)) Then
            Set wsDest = wbTarget.Sheets(CStr(key))
            wsDest.Cells.Clear
        Else
            Set wsDest = wbTarget.Sheets.Add(After:=wbTarget.Sheets(wbTarget.Sheets.Count))
            wsDest.Name = Left(CStr(key), 31)
        End If
        
        ' 复制表头
        rngHeader.Copy wsDest.Range("A1")
        
        ' 一次性输出数据数组到工作表
        wsDest.Range("A" & headerRows + 1).Resize(itemCount, UBound(arrOutput, 2)).Value = arrOutput
        wsDest.UsedRange.Columns.AutoFit
    Next key
    
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    
    MsgBox "数据处理完成! 共创建 " & dict.Count & " 个工作表。", vbInformation
End Sub

Option Explicit

Function SumByColor(DataRange As Range, ColorCell As Range) As Double
    ' 功能：按单元格背景颜色求和
    ' 参数：
    '   DataRange - 需要求和的区域
    '   ColorCell - 包含参考颜色的任意单元格
    
    Dim Cell As Range
    Dim colorValue As Long
    Dim totalSum As Double
    
    ' 获取参考颜色值（包括条件格式）
    colorValue = GetCellColor(ColorCell)
    
    ' 初始化总和
    totalSum = 0
    
    ' 遍历数据区域
    For Each Cell In DataRange
        ' 检查单元格颜色是否匹配且包含数字
        If GetCellColor(Cell) = colorValue And IsNumeric(Cell.Value) Then
            totalSum = totalSum + Cell.Value
        End If
    Next Cell
    
    ' 返回结果
    SumByColor = totalSum
End Function

Private Function GetFileList(folderspec As String, ext As String, d As Object) '遍历子文件夹的搜索
    On Error GoTo l_err
    
    Dim fs
    
    Dim fd As Object
    Dim t As Object
    Dim SerchFD, SerchFF

    
    Set fs = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    Dim extLen As Integer
    extLen = Len(ext)
    
    Set fd = fs.GetFolder(folderspec)
    Set SerchFD = fd.SubFolders   '定义文件夹对象
    Set SerchFF = fd.Files       '定义文件对象
    '遍历子文件夹
    For Each t In SerchFD
        '加上下面这句可遍历子文件夹
        Call GetFileList(folderspec & "\" & t.Name, ext, d)
    Next
    
    '遍历文件
    For Each t In SerchFF
        If Right(t.Name, extLen) = ext Then
            d.Add t.Name, folderspec & "\" & t.Name
        End If
    Next

    Exit Function

End Function

Public Function CheckID(ByVal ID18 As String) As String

        Dim Ai(17) As Integer
        
        Select Case Len(ID18)
            Case 15
                CheckID = "旧身份证号"
                Exit Function
            Case 18
            
            Case 0
                CheckID = ""
                Exit Function
            Case Else
                CheckID = "无效身份证号"

        End Select
    

        
        CC = "10X98765432"
        Wi = Array(7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 4, 2, 1, 6, 3, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 4, 2)

        For i = 0 To 16
            Ai(i) = CInt(mid(ID18, i + 1, 1))

        Next i

Function GetFileListArr(folderspec As String, ext As String, ByRef ik, ByRef iv)

    Dim d As Object
    Set d = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
    
    GetFileList folderspec, ext, d
    
    ik = d.keys()
    iv = d.items()

End Function



Public Function GetFileList(folderspec As String, ext As String, d As Object) '遍历子文件夹的搜索
    On Error GoTo l_err
    
    Dim fs
    
    Dim fd As Object
    Dim t As Object
    Dim SerchFD, SerchFF

    
    Set fs = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")

    Dim extLen As Integer
    extLen = Len(ext)
    
    Set fd = fs.GetFolder(folderspec)
    Set SerchFD = fd.SubFolders   '定义文件夹对象
    Set SerchFF = fd.Files       '定义文件对象
    '遍历子文件夹
    For Each t In SerchFD
        '加上下面这句可遍历子文件夹
        Call GetFileList(folderspec & "\" & t.Name, ext, d)
    Next
    
    '遍历文件
    For Each t In SerchFF
        If Right(t.Name, extLen) = ext Then
            d.Add t.Name, folderspec & "\" & t.Name
        End If
    Next

    Exit Function
l_err:
End Function

Sub 合并同类项()
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True                           '开启提示窗口，比如保存时弹出的提示窗口
    On Error GoTo err
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then MsgBox "请选择单元格！", 65, "提示": Exit Sub
    If Selection.Count = 1 Then Exit Sub                       '只选择一个单元格时退出程序
    If Selection.Columns.Count > 1 Then MsgBox "只对单列数据进行操作！", 65, "提示": Exit Sub
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False                         '禁止屏幕更新
    Application.Calculation = xlManual                         '将计算方式改为手动
    Dim rng As Range, rg As Range, rngs As Range
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False                          '禁止合并单元格时的提示
    Set rngs = Intersect(ActiveSheet.UsedRange, Selection)     '提取选区与已用数据区域的交集
    Set rg = rngs(1)
    For Each rng In rngs.Offset(1, 0).Resize(rngs.Count, 1)    '在选区向下偏移一行的区域中循环
        If rng <> rng.Offset(-1, 0) Then                       '如果对象变量rng与其上一个单元不相等
            Range(rg, rng.Offset(-1, 0)).Merge                 '合并对象变量前面的相同数据区域
            Set rg = rng                                       '重新指定对象变量
        End If
    Next
err:
    Application.Calculation = xlAutomatic                      '将计算方式改为自动
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True                           '还原提示
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True                          '还原屏幕更新
    rngs(1).Select                                             '选择原选区中第一个单元格
End Sub

'设置上标要用到Range.Characters属性和Font.Superscript属性，前者表示单独引用单元格中的部分字符，后则者对这部分字符设置上标
Sub 将指定字符标示为上标()
    Dim cell As Range, Item As Integer, Mystr As String    '声明变量
    Mystr = InputBox("请输入要标示为上标的字符")    '让用户指定需要标示为上标的字符
    If Len(Mystr) = 0 Or Mystr = "False" Then Exit Sub
    '如果没有输入就结束程序
    Mystr = Left(Mystr, 1)    '只取左边一位字符
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False '关闭屏幕更新
    For Each cell In Range("A1:C10")    '遍历A1:C10区域（根据自己的需求修改）
        If Len(cell.Value) > 0 Then    '如果不是空白单元格
            For Item = 1 To Len(cell.Value)    '遍历每一个字符
                '如果某个字符等于用户指定的字符，那么将它标示为上标
                If Mid(cell.Value, Item, 1) = Mystr Then cell.Characters(Start:=Item, Length:=1).Font.Superscript = True
            Next Item
        End If
    Next cell
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True '恢复
End Sub

Function strToUcase(rg As Range) As String
    Dim strTemp As String, strResult As String
    Dim strSplit() As String, lngIndex As Long
    
    strTemp = rg.Text
    strSplit = Split(strTemp, " ")
    
    For lngIndex = LBound(strSplit) To UBound(strSplit)
        strTemp = Trim(strSplit(lngIndex))
        strTemp = LCase(strTemp)
        strSplit(lngIndex) = UCase(Left(strTemp, 1)) & Mid(strTemp, 2)
    Next
    
    If UBound(strSplit) > 0 Then
        ReDim Preserve strSplit(UBound(strSplit) + 1)
        strSplit(UBound(strSplit)) = strSplit(0)
        strSplit(0) = ""
    End If
    
    strTemp = Join(strSplit, " ")
    strToUcase = Trim(strTemp)
End Function

''ModuleName="SevenSortingAlgorithms"
'排序算法常用的有七种，分别是冒泡排序，选择排序，希尔排序，堆排序，桶排序，插入排序和快速排序。
Public Const ZERO = 0

Enum eOrderType
  ASCENDING_ORDER = 0
  DESCENDING_ORDER = 1
End Enum

'用于指明重复次数的全局变量
Public gIterations

'冒泡排序
Sub BubbleSort(MyArray(), ByVal nOrder As eOrderType)
  Dim Index
  Dim TEMP
  Dim NextElement
  '先将已处理的元素个数置为0
  NextElement = ZERO
  '遍历每一个元素
  Do While (NextElement < UBound(MyArray))
    '读取当前最大下标
    Index = UBound(MyArray)
    '与前面的每一个元素比较
    Do While (Index > NextElement)
      '根据是升序或降序进行分别处理
      If nOrder = ASCENDING_ORDER Then
        '升序:如果当前值小于上一个值,则互换
        If MyArray(Index) < MyArray(Index - 1) Then
          TEMP = MyArray(Index)
          MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - 1)
          MyArray(Index - 1) = TEMP
        End If
      ElseIf nOrder = DESCENDING_ORDER Then
        '降序:如果当前值大于上一个值,则互换
        If MyArray(Index) > MyArray(Index - 1) Then
          TEMP = MyArray(Index)
          MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - 1)
          MyArray(Index - 1) = TEMP
        End If
      End If
      '将当前下标移到上一个值
      Index = Index - 1
      '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
      gIterations = gIterations + 1
    Loop
    '将已处理的元素个数加1
    NextElement = NextElement + 1
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Loop
End Sub

'桶排序
Sub Bucket(MyArray(), ByVal nOrder As eOrderType)
  Dim Index
  Dim NextElement
  Dim TheBucket
  '先将已处理的元素个数为最小下标加1
  NextElement = LBound(MyArray) + 1
  '遍历每一个元素
  While (NextElement <= UBound(MyArray))
    '读取当前元素
    TheBucket = MyArray(NextElement)
    '读取当前下标
    Index = NextElement
    Do
      '如果当前下标大于最小下标,则处理
      If Index > LBound(MyArray) Then
        '根据是升序或降序进行分别处理
        If nOrder = ASCENDING_ORDER Then
          '升序:如果当前值小于上一个值
          '则将下一个值放到当前值(当前值在TheBucket中不动)
          If TheBucket < MyArray(Index - 1) Then
            MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - 1)
            Index = Index - 1
          Else
            Exit Do
          End If
        ElseIf nOrder = DESCENDING_ORDER Then
          '降序:如果当前值大于上一个值
          '则将下一个值放到当前值(当前值在TheBucket中不动)
          If TheBucket > MyArray(Index - 1) Then
            MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - 1)
            Index = Index - 1
          Else
            Exit Do
          End If
        End If
      Else
        Exit Do
      End If
      '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
      gIterations = gIterations + 1
    Loop
    MyArray(Index) = TheBucket
    NextElement = NextElement + 1
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Wend
End Sub

'堆排序
Sub Heap(MyArray())
  Dim Index
  Dim Size
  Dim TEMP
  
  '读取最大下标
  Size = UBound(MyArray)
  '将当前要处理的置为1
  Index = 1
  '处理每一个元素
  While (Index <= Size)
    '向上筛选
    Call HeapSiftup(MyArray(), Index)
    Index = Index + 1
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Wend
  Index = Size
  While (Index > 0)
    '当前值与第一个值互换
    TEMP = MyArray(0)
    MyArray(0) = MyArray(Index)
    MyArray(Index) = TEMP
    '向下筛选
    Call HeapSiftdown(MyArray(), Index - 1)
    Index = Index - 1
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Wend
End Sub

'堆排序的向下筛选子程序
Sub HeapSiftdown(MyArray(), M)
  Dim Index
  Dim Parent
  Dim TEMP
  Index = 0
  'Parent位置定位于2 * Index
  Parent = 2 * Index
  Do While (Parent <= M)
    '如果当前Parent位的值后面的值要大,向后移Parent位
    If (Parent < M And MyArray(Parent) < MyArray(Parent + 1)) Then
      Parent = Parent + 1
    End If
    '如果当前值大于Parent位的值,结束筛选
    If MyArray(Index) >= MyArray(Parent) Then
      Exit Do
    End If
    '否则交换两个值
    TEMP = MyArray(Index)
    MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Parent)
    MyArray(Parent) = TEMP
    '当前位置移到Parent
    Index = Parent
    Parent = 2 * Index
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Loop
End Sub

'堆排序的向上筛选子程序
Sub HeapSiftup(MyArray(), M)
  Dim Index
  Dim Parent
  Dim TEMP
  Index = M
  Do While (Index > 0)
    '只要Index / 2位置的值大于当前值就结束筛选
    Parent = Int(Index / 2)
    If MyArray(Parent) >= MyArray(Index) Then
      Exit Do
    End If
    '否则交换两值
    TEMP = MyArray(Index)
    MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Parent)
    MyArray(Parent) = TEMP
    '将当前点移到Index / 2
    Index = Parent
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Loop
  
End Sub


'插入排序
Sub Insertion(MyArray(), ByVal nOrder As eOrderType)
  Dim Index
  Dim TEMP
  Dim NextElement
  '先将已处理的元素个数为最小下标加1
  NextElement = LBound(MyArray) + 1
  '遍历每一个元素
  While (NextElement <= UBound(MyArray))
    '读取当前下标
    Index = NextElement
    Do
      '如果当前下标大于最小下标,则处理
      If Index > LBound(MyArray) Then
        '根据是升序或降序进行分别处理
        If nOrder = ASCENDING_ORDER Then
          '升序:如果当前值小于上一个值,则互换
          If MyArray(Index) < MyArray(Index - 1) Then
            TEMP = MyArray(Index)
            MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - 1)
            MyArray(Index - 1) = TEMP
            Index = Index - 1
          Else
            Exit Do
          End If
        ElseIf nOrder = DESCENDING_ORDER Then
          '降序:如果当前值大于上一个值,则互换
          If MyArray(Index) > MyArray(Index - 1) Then
            TEMP = MyArray(Index)
            MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - 1)
            MyArray(Index - 1) = TEMP
            Index = Index - 1
          Else
            Exit Do
          End If
        End If
      Else
        Exit Do
      End If
      '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
      gIterations = gIterations + 1
    Loop
    NextElement = NextElement + 1
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Wend
End Sub

'快速排序
Sub QuickSort(MyArray(), L, R)
  Dim i, j, X, Y
  i = L
  j = R
  
  '找出数组的中点
  X = MyArray((L + R) / 2)
  
  
  While (i <= j)
    '找出比中点大的数
    While (MyArray(i) < X And i < R)
      i = i + 1
    Wend
    '找出比中点小的数
    While (X < MyArray(j) And j > L)
      j = j - 1
    Wend
    '互换这两个数
    If (i <= j) Then
      Y = MyArray(i)
      MyArray(i) = MyArray(j)
      MyArray(j) = Y
      i = i + 1
      j = j - 1
    End If
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Wend
  '未完成时递归调用
  If (L < j) Then Call QuickSort(MyArray(), L, j)
  If (i < R) Then Call QuickSort(MyArray(), i, R)
End Sub

'选择排序
Sub Selection(MyArray(), ByVal nOrder As eOrderType)
  Dim Index
  Dim Min
  Dim NextElement
  Dim TEMP '已处理的元素的个数置为0 NextElement = 0
  '遍历所有元素
  While (NextElement < UBound(MyArray))
    '读取最大下标,作为当前最小值下标
    Min = UBound(MyArray)
    '取倒数第二个下标
    Index = Min - 1
    '与所有元素比较
    While (Index >= NextElement)
      '根据是升序或降序进行分别处理
      If nOrder = ASCENDING_ORDER Then
        '根据比较结果重置最小下标
        If MyArray(Index) < MyArray(Min) Then
          
          Min = Index
        End If
      ElseIf nOrder = DESCENDING_ORDER Then
        '根据比较结果重置最小下标
        If MyArray(Index) > MyArray(Min) Then
          Min = Index
        End If
      End If
      Index = Index - 1
      '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
      gIterations = gIterations + 1
    Wend
    '根据最小下,与当前值互换
    TEMP = MyArray(Min)
    MyArray(Min) = MyArray(NextElement)
    MyArray(NextElement) = TEMP
    NextElement = NextElement + 1
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations - 1
  Wend
End Sub

'希尔排序
Sub ShellSort(MyArray(), ByVal nOrder As eOrderType)
  Dim Distance
  Dim Size
  Dim Index
  Dim NextElement
  Dim TEMP
  '读取元素的数量
  Size = UBound(MyArray) - LBound(MyArray) + 1
  '定义当前跨度
  Distance = 1
  '将跨度定义为小于元素的数量的2的最大幂
  While (Distance <= Size)
    Distance = 2 * Distance
  Wend
  '再找出跨度的中点
  Distance = (Distance / 2) - 1
  
  While (Distance > 0)
    '读取中点的下标
    NextElement = LBound(MyArray) + Distance
    '移排序并移动中点(不大于最大下标)
    While (NextElement <= UBound(MyArray))
      '将中点作为当前下标
      Index = NextElement
      Do
        '中点在跨度后面则要处理
        If Index >= (LBound(MyArray) + Distance) Then
          '根据是升序或降序进行分别处理
          If nOrder = ASCENDING_ORDER Then
            '升序:如果当前值小于上一个值,则互换
            If MyArray(Index) < MyArray(Index - Distance) Then
              TEMP = MyArray(Index)
              MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - Distance)
              MyArray(Index - Distance) = TEMP
              Index = Index - Distance
              '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
              gIterations = gIterations + 1
            Else
              Exit Do
            End If
          ElseIf nOrder = DESCENDING_ORDER Then
            '降序:如果当前值大于上一个值,则互换
            If MyArray(Index) > MyArray(Index - Distance) Then
              TEMP = MyArray(Index)
              MyArray(Index) = MyArray(Index - Distance)
              MyArray(Index - Distance) = TEMP
              Index = Index - Distance
              '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
              gIterations = gIterations + 1
            Else
              Exit Do
            End If
          End If
        Else
          Exit Do
        End If
      Loop
      NextElement = NextElement + 1
      '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
      gIterations = gIterations + 1
    Wend
    Distance = (Distance - 1) / 2
    '用于指明重复次数的全局变量
    gIterations = gIterations + 1
  Wend
End Sub

Sub QuickSort(ByRef arr, ByRef nLeft&, ByRef nRight&)
  Dim i&, j&, vKey, vSwap
  If nLeft >= nRight Then Exit Sub
  vKey = arr(nLeft)
  i = nLeft + 1:j = nRight
  Do
    Do While i <= nRight
      If arr(i) > vKey Then Exit Do
      i = i + 1
    Loop
    Do While j > nLeft
      If arr(j) < vKey Then Exit Do
      j = j - 1
    Loop
    If i >= j Then Exit Do
    vSwap = arr(i): arr(i) = arr(j): arr(j) = vSwap
  Loop
  If nLeft <> j Then
    vSwap = arr(nLeft): arr(nLeft) = arr(j): arr(j) = vSwap
  End If
  If nLeft < j Then Call QuickSort(arr, nLeft, j)
  If j + 1 < nRight Then Call QuickSort(arr, j + 1, nRight)
End Sub

※定位所有错误值(SpecialCells方法)
'Range.SpecialCells方法表示定位，语法为：Range.SpecialCells(Type, Value)
'参数Type代表单元格类型，赋值为xlCellTypeBlanks表示空白单元格，赋值为xlCellTypeConstants表示常量单元格，xlCellTypeFormulas表示公式单元格，xlCellTypeVisible表示所有可见单元格
'参数Value用于限定值的类型，赋值为16表示错误值，赋值为4表示逻辑值，赋值为4表示数值，赋值为2表示文本
Sub 定位所有错误值()
    Dim ValueErr As Range, FormulaErr As Range, ErrBl As Boolean '声明变量
    On Error Resume Next '如果程序出错继续执行下一句
    Set ValueErr = Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeConstants, 16) '定位错误值单元格
    If Err <> 0 Then '如果定位出错(表示没有)
        ErrBl = True '将布尔变量赋值为True
        Err.Clear    '清除错误，避免影响后续的判断
    End If
    Set FormulaErr = Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeFormulas, 16) '定位错误公式单元格
    If Err <> 0 Then '如果定位出错(表示没有)
        '如果变量ErrBl的值为True，那么提示用户不存在错误值，否则定位错误值所在单元格
        If ErrBl Then MsgBox "活动工作表不存在错误值", vbOKOnly + vbInformation, "友情提示" Else ValueErr.Select
    Else '否则(表示没有错误)
        '如果变量ErrBl的值为True，那么定位错误公式所在单元格，否则定位错误值和错误公式所在单元格
        If ErrBl Then FormulaErr.Select Else Union(ValueErr, FormulaErr).Select
    End If
End Sub

    Filename = Application.GetOpenFilename("Excel文件（*.xls & *.xla & *.xlt）,*.xls;*.xla;*.xlt", , "VBA破解")

        FileCopy Filename, Filename & ".bak"                   '备份文件。
    End If
    Dim GetData As String * 5
    Open Filename For Binary As #1
    Dim CMGs As Long
    Dim DPBo As Long
    For i = 1 To LOF(1)
        Get #1, i, GetData
        If GetData = "CMG=""" Then CMGs = i
        If GetData = "[Host" Then DPBo = i - 2: Exit For
    Next
    If CMGs = 0 Then
        MsgBox "请先对VBA编码设置一个保护密码...", 32, "提示"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Dim St As String * 2
    Dim s20 As String * 1
    '取得一个0D0A十六进制字串
    Get #1, CMGs - 2, St
    '取得一个20十六制字串
    Get #1, DPBo + 16, s20
    '替换加密部份机码
    For i = CMGs To DPBo Step 2
        Put #1, i, St
    Next
    '加入不配对符号
    If (DPBo - CMGs) Mod 2 <> 0 Then
        Put #1, DPBo + 1, s20
    End If
    MsgBox "文件解密成功......", 32, "提示"
    Close #1
End Sub

Option Explicit
Private Declare Sub MoveMemory Lib "kernel32" Alias "RtlMoveMemory" _
        (Destination As Long, Source As Long, ByVal Length As Long)


Private Declare Function VirtualProtect Lib "kernel32" (lpAddress As Long, _
        ByVal dwSize As Long, ByVal flNewProtect As Long, lpflOldProtect As Long) As Long
        
Private Declare Function GetModuleHandleA Lib "kernel32" (ByVal lpModuleName As String) As Long
   
Private Declare Function GetProcAddress Lib "kernel32" (ByVal hModule As Long, _
        ByVal lpProcName As String) As Long
   
Private Declare Function DialogBoxParam Lib "user32" Alias "DialogBoxParamA" (ByVal hInstance As Long, _
        ByVal pTemplateName As Long, ByVal hWndParent As Long, _
        ByVal lpDialogFunc As Long, ByVal dwInitParam As Long) As Integer
        
Dim HookBytes(0 To 5) As Byte
Dim OriginBytes(0 To 5) As Byte
Dim pFunc As Long
Dim Flag As Boolean


Private Function GetPtr(ByVal Value As Long) As Long
    '获得函数的地址
    GetPtr = Value
End Function


Public Sub RecoverBytes()
    '若已经hook,则恢复原API开头的6字节,也就是恢复原来函数的功能
    If Flag Then MoveMemory ByVal pFunc, ByVal VarPtr(OriginBytes(0)), 6
End Sub


Public Function Hook() As Boolean
    Dim TmpBytes(0 To 5) As Byte
    Dim p As Long
    Dim OriginProtect As Long
   
    Hook = False
   
    'VBE6.dll调用DialogBoxParamA显示VB6INTL.dll资源中的第4070号对话框(就是输入密码的窗口)
    '若DialogBoxParamA返回值非0,则VBE会认为密码正确,所以我们要hook DialogBoxParamA函数
    pFunc = GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleA("user32.dll"), "DialogBoxParamA")
   
    '标准api hook过程之一: 修改内存属性,使其可写
    If VirtualProtect(ByVal pFunc, 6, &H40, OriginProtect) <> 0 Then
        '标准api hook过程之二: 判断是否已经hook,看看API的第一个字节是否为&H68,
        '若是则说明已经Hook
        MoveMemory ByVal VarPtr(TmpBytes(0)), ByVal pFunc, 6
        If TmpBytes(0) <> &H68 Then
            '标准api hook过程之三: 保存原函数开头字节,这里是6个字节,以备后面恢复
            MoveMemory ByVal VarPtr(OriginBytes(0)), ByVal pFunc, 6
            '用AddressOf获取MyDialogBoxParam的地址
            '因为语法不允许写成p = AddressOf MyDialogBoxParam,这里我们写一个函数
            'GetPtr,作用仅仅是返回AddressOf MyDialogBoxParam的值,从而实现将
            'MyDialogBoxParam的地址付给p的目的
            p = GetPtr(AddressOf MyDialogBoxParam)
            
            '标准api hook过程之四: 组装API入口的新代码
            'HookBytes 组成如下汇编
            'push MyDialogBoxParam的地址
            'ret
            '作用是跳转到MyDialogBoxParam函数
            HookBytes(0) = &H68
            MoveMemory ByVal VarPtr(HookBytes(1)), ByVal VarPtr(p), 4
            HookBytes(5) = &HC3
            
            '标准api hook过程之五: 用HookBytes的内容改写API前6个字节
            MoveMemory ByVal pFunc, ByVal VarPtr(HookBytes(0)), 6
            '设置hook成功标志
            Flag = True
            Hook = True
        End If
    End If
End Function

Private Function MyDialogBoxParam(ByVal hInstance As Long, _
        ByVal pTemplateName As Long, ByVal hWndParent As Long, _
        ByVal lpDialogFunc As Long, ByVal dwInitParam As Long) As Integer
    If pTemplateName = 4070 Then
        '有程序调用DialogBoxParamA装入4070号对话框,这里我们直接返回1,让
        'VBE以为密码正确了
        MyDialogBoxParam = 1
    Else
        '有程序调用DialogBoxParamA,但装入的不是4070号对话框,这里我们调用
        'RecoverBytes函数恢复原来函数的功能,在进行原来的函数
        RecoverBytes
        MyDialogBoxParam = DialogBoxParam(hInstance, pTemplateName, _
                           hWndParent, lpDialogFunc, dwInitParam)
        '原来的函数执行完毕,再次hook
        Hook
    End If
End Function

Sub CopySheetsStartingWithPToDesktop()

    Dim firstChar As String
    Dim desktopPath As String
    
    ' 设置当前工作簿
    Set wbCurrent = ThisWorkbook
    
    ' 创建一个新的工作簿
    Set wbNew = Workbooks.Add
    
    ' 获取桌面路径
    desktopPath = CreateObject("WScript.Shell").SpecialFolders("Desktop")
    
    ' 遍历当前工作簿中的所有工作表
    For Each ws In wbCurrent.Sheets
        ' 获取工作表名称的第一个字符
        firstChar = Left(ws.Name, 1)
        ' 检查第一个字符是否为 "P"
        If UCase(firstChar) = "P" Then
            ' 复制工作表到新工作簿
            If wbNew.Sheets.Count = 1 Then
                ws.Copy Before:=wbNew.Sheets(1)
            Else
                ws.Copy After:=wbNew.Sheets(wbNew.Sheets.Count)
            End If
        End If
    Next ws
    
    ' 删除新工作簿中默认创建的工作表
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Do While wbNew.Sheets.Count > wbCurrent.Sheets.Count
        wbNew.Sheets(1).Delete
    Loop
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    
    ' 保存新工作簿到桌面
    wbNew.SaveAs Filename:=desktopPath & "\P_Sheets.xlsx", FileFormat:=xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wbNew.Close SaveChanges:=False
    
    ' 提示操作完成
    MsgBox "所有名称以 'P' 开头的工作表已复制到新工作簿并保存到桌面。", vbInformation
End Sub

Sub 工作表拆分工作簿()
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False                         '关闭屏幕闪动，提速
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False                          '关闭窗口提示
    kk = 2
    Set dic = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
    With ThisWorkbook.Worksheets(ActiveSheet.Name)             '根据自己的工作簿自行修改
        cln = InputBox("请输入需要按列拆分的列:" & Chr(10) & "英文列标", "输入列标", "A")    'inputbox提示输入需要拆分的列标
        cln2 = .Range("a1").End(xlToRight).Column              '获取最大列数，为了增加通用性
        If .Range(cln & 2) = "" Then Exit Sub
        rrow = .Cells(Rows.Count, cln).End(xlUp).Row
        arr = WorksheetFunction.Transpose(.Range(cln & 1 & ":" & cln & rrow))
        For i = 1 To UBound(arr)                               '将拆分条件列数据写入字典，为了去重复。
            If Not dic.exists(arr(i)) Then                     '若字典中不存在该字符串，则写入。
                dic.Add arr(i), .Range("a" & i).Resize(1, cln2)
            Else
                Set dic.Item(arr(i)) = Union(dic.Item(arr(i)), .Range("a" & i).Resize(1, cln2))
            End If
        Next
        k = dic.keys
        l = dic.items
        For ss = 0 To dic.Count - 1
            Set wb = Workbooks.Add                             '新建工作簿
            With wb.Worksheets(1)
                l(ss).Copy .Range("a1")
            End With
            wb.SaveAs ThisWorkbook.Path & "\" & k(ss) & ".xlsx" '将新建的工作簿保存在代码工作簿下
            wb.Close True                                      '关闭工作簿，并保存
            Set wb = Nothing                                   '释放内存
        Next
    End With
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    MsgBox "完成"
End Sub

Sub 工作簿拆分()
  On Error Resume Next
  Dim Pathstr As String, i As Long, ActiveWB As String
  With Application.FileDialog(msoFileDialogFolderPicker)    '创建文件对话框的实例
    If .Show Then  '如果在对话框中单击了"确定"
      Pathstr = .SelectedItems(1)  '将选定的路径赋予变量
    Else
      Exit Sub  '否则退出程序
    End If
  End With
  Pathstr = Pathstr & IIf(Right(Pathstr, 1) = "\", "", "\")    '如果不是“\”结尾则添加“\”
  Application.ScreenUpdating = False
  ActiveWB = ActiveWorkbook.Name    '记录活工作簿名
  For i = 1 To Sheets.Count    '循环所有工作表
    Sheets(i).Copy    '复制工作表到新工作簿中（忽略了参数）
    '将工作簿另存，文件名由工作表名决定。而文件的后缀名则由Excel程序的版本决定
    ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs Filename:=Pathstr & Workbooks(ActiveWB).Sheets(i).Name & IIf(Application.Version * 1 < 12, ".xls", ".xlsx"), FileFormat:=xlWorkbookDefault, CreateBackup:=False
    With ActiveSheet.UsedRange    '引用已用区域
      '查找“=*]*'!”，也就是检查是否存在外部引用
      Set cell = .Find("=*]*'!", LookIn:=xlFormulas, SearchOrder:=xlByRows, LookAt:=xlPart, MatchCase:=True)
      If cell Is Nothing Then GoTo line
      FirstAddress = cell.Address    '记录第一个找到的地址
      Do
        cell = cell.Value  '将公式转换成值
        Set cell = .FindNext(cell)  '查找下一个
        If cell Is Nothing Then Exit Do  '如果未找进到则退出循环
        If cell.Address = FirstAddress Then Exit Do  '如果回到第一次找到的单元格则退出循环
      Loop
    End With
line:
    ActiveWindow.Close  '关闭窗口
    Workbooks(ActiveWB).Activate  '激活待拆分的工作簿
  Next i
  Application.ScreenUpdating = True  '恢复屏幕更新
  Shell "EXPLORER.EXE " & Pathstr, vbNormalFocus  '打开文件夹
End Sub

Sub 把一列中不同项目分拆到不同工作簿()
    Tm = Timer
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Set d = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
    a = 1 '//标题行
    b = 1 '//拆分项目所在的列
    arr = Range(Cells(a + 1, b), Cells(Rows.Count, b).End(3))
    For x = 1 To UBound(arr)
        d(arr(x, 1)) = x
    Next
    brr = d.keys
    For i = 0 To UBound(brr)
        Workbooks.Add.SaveAs ThisWorkbook.Path & "\" & brr(i)
        With ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1)
            .Rows(a).AutoFilter Field:=b, Criteria1:=brr(i)
            .AutoFilter.Range.SpecialCells(12).Copy Sheets(1).Range("A1")
        End With
        ActiveWorkbook.Close 1
    Next
    ThisWorkbook.Sheets(1).ShowAllData  '消除筛选
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "拆分完成，用时：" & Format(Timer - Tm, "0.00秒"), 64, "拆分报表"
End Sub

Private Function FileList(Folderpath, Optional Pstr = "*", Optional Dimensions = 2)

  End If
  FileList = arr

Sub DelEmtyDir(ByVal strPath As String)


    Set fso = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    If strPath = "Fase" Or strPath = "" Then Exit Sub
    
    If Right(strPath, 1) <> "\" Then strPath = strPath & "\"
    strDirName = Dir(strPath, vbDirectory)  '取得子文件夹
    Do While strDirName <> ""
        '指定文件夹下有子文件夹
        If strDirName <> "." And strDirName <> ".." Then    '判断是否为子文件夹
            If (GetAttr(strPath & strDirName) And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory Then
                LastDir = strDirName
                Set fld = fso.GetFolder(strPath & strDirName)
                If fld.Size = 0 Then    '文件夹大小为0,表示为空
                   fld.Delete   '删除该文件夹
                    '取得上级文件夹的名称字符串
                   strFld = Left(strPath & strDirName, InStrRev(strPath$ & strDirName, "\") - 1)
                   Call DelEmtyDir(strFld)  '递归调用本过程删除上级文件夹
                Else    '文件夹不为空
                  Call DelEmtyDir(strPath & strDirName)
                    '递归调用本过程删除下级子文件夹
                End If
                strDirName = Dir(strPath, vbDirectory)  '处理下一个子文件夹
                Do Until strDirName = LastDir Or strDirName = ""
                    strDirName = Dir
                Loop
                If strDirName = "" Then Exit Do '若没有子文件夹,退出该过程
            End If
        End If
        strDirName = Dir    '处理下一个子文件夹
    Loop
    
    Set fso = Nothing
End Sub

Sub ExtractXLSMData_WithLog()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long, j As Long
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim xlsmFile As String
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim sourceWs As Worksheet
    Dim targetAddress As String
    Dim resultRow As Long
    Dim logMsg As String
    Dim successCount As Long, failCount As Long
    
    ' 初始化统计变量
    successCount = 0
    failCount = 0
    
    ' 设置当前工作表
    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "A").End(xlUp).Row       ' 获取 A 列最后一行
    
    ' 开启屏幕更新（可选，处理大量数据时可关闭提升速度）
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 遍历 A 列的文件夹路径（从第 2 行开始，第 1 行是表头）
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        logMsg = ""
        folderPath = ws.Cells(i, "A").Value
        resultRow = i                                          ' 结果写入当前行
    
        ' 1. 检查文件夹路径是否为空
        If folderPath = "" Then
            logMsg = "A" & i & " 单元格路径为空，跳过"
            failCount = failCount + 1
            GoTo NextIteration
        End If
    
        ' 2. 检查路径是否存在
        If Dir(folderPath, vbDirectory) = "" Then
            logMsg = "路径不存在: " & folderPath
            failCount = failCount + 1
            GoTo NextIteration
        End If
    
        ' 3. 查找文件夹下的 .xlsm 文件（只取第一个）
        xlsmFile = Dir(folderPath & "\*.xlsm")
        If xlsmFile = "" Then
            logMsg = "未找到 .xlsm 文件: " & folderPath
            failCount = failCount + 1
            GoTo NextIteration
        End If
    
        ' 4. 尝试打开 .xlsm 文件
        On Error Resume Next
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folderPath & "\" & xlsmFile, ReadOnly:=True)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If wb Is Nothing Then
            logMsg = "无法打开文件: " & folderPath & "\" & xlsmFile
            failCount = failCount + 1
            GoTo NextIteration
        End If
    
        ' 5. 获取文件中的第一个工作表（可根据实际需求改工作表名，如 Worksheets("Sheet1")）
        On Error Resume Next
        Set sourceWs = wb.Worksheets(1)
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            logMsg = "文件 " & xlsmFile & " 无有效工作表，跳过"
            wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
            Set wb = Nothing
            failCount = failCount + 1
            On Error GoTo 0
            GoTo NextIteration
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    
        ' 6. 遍历 C1:K1 获取目标单元格地址并提取内容
        Dim hasData As Boolean
        hasData = False
        For j = 4 To 13
            targetAddress = ws.Cells(1, j).Value               ' 读取 C1、D1...K1 的单元格地址
            If targetAddress <> "" Then
                On Error Resume Next
                ' 提取目标地址内容并写入当前行对应列
                ws.Cells(resultRow, j).Value = sourceWs.Range(targetAddress).Value
                If Err.Number = 0 Then
                    hasData = True
                Else
                    logMsg = logMsg & " 读取 " & targetAddress & " 失败"
                    Err.Clear
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
            End If
        Next j
    
        ' 7. 写入工作表名称到 L 列
        On Error Resume Next
        ws.Cells(resultRow, "M").Value = sourceWs.name
        If Err.Number <> 0 Then
            logMsg = logMsg & " 写入工作表名称失败"
            Err.Clear
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
    
        ' 8. 关闭工作簿
        wb.Close SaveChanges:=False
        Set wb = Nothing
    
        ' 9. 统计成功情况
        If hasData Then
            successCount = successCount + 1
            logMsg = "处理成功: " & folderPath & "\" & xlsmFile & logMsg
        Else
            failCount = failCount + 1
            logMsg = "无有效数据提取: " & folderPath & "\" & xlsmFile & logMsg
        End If
    
NextIteration:
        ' 输出日志到立即窗口（按 Ctrl+G 可查看）
        '        Debug.Print "行 " & i & " | " & logMsg
    Next i
    
    ' 关闭屏幕更新
    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    
    ' 弹出结果统计
    MsgBox "处理完成！" & vbCrLf & _
            "成功提取: " & successCount & " 条" & vbCrLf & _
            "失败/跳过: " & failCount & " 条" & vbCrLf & _
            "详情可查看【立即窗口】(Ctrl+G)", vbInformation
End Sub

Function searchFile(ByVal fd As Folder)

    With regex1
      .Global = True '设置全局可用
      .Pattern = "(xls)$" '输入后缀名用|隔开"(xls|xlsx|docx|doc)$
    End With
    ReDim Preserve ArryFile(1 To nFile + i)
    For Each fl In fd.Files
      If regex1.test(fl.Name) = True Then

        ArryFile(nFile) = fl.Path

    Next
  End If
  If fd.SubFolders.Count = 0 Then Exit Function
  For Each subfd In fd.SubFolders
    searchFile subfd
  Next

Function DirFiles(ByVal mypath, Optional ByVal fileStr = "*.*")
  '返回一个数组2列 '1 列 -纯文件名+后缀 '2 列 -完整路径
  '3 列  纯文件名
  '4列  纯后缀
  '本函数默认不搜索 隐藏文件
  If mypath Like "*\" Then '总是把传进来的路径处理成不带斜杠的数据
    mypath = Left(mypath, Len(mypath) - 1) '去掉最后的分隔符
  End If
  Dim dic
  Set dic = CreateObject("scripting.dictionary")
  Dim fname, k
  fname = Dir(mypath & "\" & fileStr)
  k = 0
  Do While fname <> "" '不为空的时候 往下循环
    k = k + 1
    If fname Like fileStr Then '实现模糊搜索文件
      '这里可以自己定义搜索条件 暂时用like方法一般就是 *匹配模糊搜索
      dic(k) = fname '写入第一个文件
    End If
    fname = Dir
  Loop
  Dim brr
  If dic.Count = 0 Then
    ReDim brr(0, 0)
  Else
    ReDim brr(1 To dic.Count, 1 To 4) '1列纯文件名 2列完整文件名
    For i = 1 To dic.Count
      brr(i, 1) = dic(i) '纯文件名
      brr(i, 2) = mypath & "\" & brr(i, 1) '完整路径+文件名
      brr(i, 3) = Left(brr(i, 1), InStrRev(brr(i, 1), ".") - 1) '纯文件名
      brr(i, 4) = Mid(brr(i, 1), InStrRev(brr(i, 1), ".") + 1) '路径
    Next
  End If
  DirFiles = brr
  '返回结果字典
End Function

Public Sub 查找(ByVal 路径 As String)  '查找文件的过程
  Dim Dirs() As String, Dir_Count As Long, File_Name As String, File_Name_2 As String, j
  If Right(路径, 1) <> "\" Then 路径 = 路径 & "\" '如果路径最后一位非\则追加一个\
  File_Name = Dir(路径 & "*.*", vbDirectory)  '获取文件文录名称
  Do While Len(File_Name) <> 0  '只要文件目录名存在（目录字符长度大于字）就循环下去
    If Left$(File_Name, 1) <> "." Then  '如果左边第一字符为"."
      File_Name_2 = 路径 & File_Name  '获取子目录
      If (GetAttr(File_Name_2) And vbDirectory) = vbDirectory Then  '如果是文件夹
        Dir_Count = Dir_Count + 1  '计算子目录数量
        ReDim Preserve Dirs(1 To Dir_Count) As String  '重新声明数组的储存空间
        Dirs(Dir_Count) = File_Name_2  '将子目录名称写入数组Dirs中
      Else  '如果不是文件夹目录
        i = i + 1  '累加变量，该变量等于文件数量
        ReDim Preserve arr(1 To 3, 1 To i)  '重新声明数组的储存空间
        arr(1, i) = 路径  '将文件路径写入数组
        arr(2, i) = File_Name  '将文件名写入数组
        arr(3, i) = FileLen(路径 & File_Name) / 1024 / 1024  '将文件大小写入数组
      End If
    End If
    File_Name = Dir()  '查找下一个文件
  Loop
  For j = 1 To Dir_Count  '遍历数组Dirs，即将子目录进行查找
    查找 Dirs(j)  '调用自身再执行文件查找
  Next j
End Sub

Function ListAllFso(myPath$, Optional sb& = 0, Optional SpFile$ = "") '递归检查子文件夹的过程代码

    On Error Resume Next
    If sb >= 0 Or Len(SpFile) Then '如果模式为0或1、或指定了匹配文件要求，则遍历各个文件
        For Each f In fld.Files '用FSO方法遍历文件.Files
            t = False '匹配状态初始化
            n = InStrRev(f.Name, "."): fnm = Left(f.Name, n - 1): x = LCase(Mid(f.Name, n))
            If Err.Number Then Err.Clear
            If SpFile = " " Then 'Space 如果匹配要求为空则匹配全部
                t = True
            ElseIf SpFile Like ".*" Then '如果匹配要求为文件类型则
                If x Like SpFile Then t = True '当文件符合文件类型要求时匹配，否则不匹配
            Else '否则为需要匹配文件名称中的一部分
                If InStr(fnm, SpFile) Then t = True '如果匹配则状态为True
            End If
            If t Then k = k + 1: jg(k, 0) = x: jg(k, 1) = "'" & fnm: jg(k, 2) = fld.Name: jg(k, 3) = fld.Path
        Next
        Application.StatusBar = Format(Timer - tms, "0.0s") & " Get " & k & " Files , Searching in Folder ... " & fld.Path
    End If
    For Each fd In fld.SubFolders '然后遍历检查所有子文件夹.SubFolders
        If sb < 0 And Len(SpFile) = 0 Then k = k + 1: jg(k, 0) = "fld": jg(k, 1) = k: jg(k, 2) = fd.Name: jg(k, 3) = fld.Path

    Next
End Function

Sub DoSql_Execute1()
    Dim cnn As Object, rst As Object
    Dim Mypath As String, Str_cnn As String, Sql As String
    Dim i As Long
    Set cnn = CreateObject("adodb.connection")
    Mypath = ThisWorkbook.FullName
    If Application.Version Then
        Str_cnn = "Provider=Microsoft.jet.OLEDB.4.0;Extended Properties=Excel 8.0;Data"
        Source = " & Mypath"
    Else
        Str_cnn = "Provider=Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0;Extended Properties=Excel 12.0;Data"
        Source = " & Mypath"
    End If
    cnn.Open Str_cnn
    '以上是第二步，建立链接
    '
    Sql = "SELECT 姓名,成绩 FROM [Sheet1$] WHERE 成绩>=80"
    'Sql语句，查询Sheet1表成绩大于80……姓名和成绩的记录
    Set rst = cnn.Execute(Sql)
    'cnn.Execute()执行SQL语句，始终得到一个新的记录集rst
    '以上是第三步，编写并使用SQL语句
    '
    [d:e].ClearContents
    '清空[d:e]区域的值
    For i = 0 To rst.Fields.Count - 1
        '利用fields属性获取所有字段名，fields包含了当前记录有关的所有字段,fields.count得到字段的数量
        '由于Fields.Count下标为0，又从0开始遍历，因此总数-1
        Cells(1, i + 4) = rst.Fields(i).Name
    Next
    Range("d2").CopyFromRecordset rst
    '使用单元格对象的CopyFromRecordset方法将rst内容复制到D2单元格为左上角的单元格区域
    '以上是第四步，将SQL查询结果和字段名写入表格指定区域
    cnn.Close
    '关闭链接
    Set cnn = Nothing
    '释放内存
End Sub

Sub MergeCells(rng As Range)
    If rng.Rows.Count=1 Then Exit Sub
    arr = rng.Value
    ReDim brr(1 To UBound(arr), 1 To 2)
    '结果数组，第一列保存值，第二列保存合并行数
    For i = 1 To UBound(arr)
        strTemp = ""
        For j = 1 To UBound(arr, 2)
            strTemp = strTemp & "♀" & arr(i, j)
            '合并多列字符串为单个字符串
        Next
        brr(i, 1) = strTemp
        '字符串装入结果数组
        If i > 1 Then
        '如果不是第一行
            If brr(i - 1, 1) = strTemp Then
                If lngBK = 0 Then lngBK = i - 1
                'lngBK变量赋值结果数组用于存放合并行数的位置
                    brr(lngBK, 2) = brr(lngBK, 2) + 1
                    '累计相同值的行数
            Else
                lngBK = i
            End If
        End If
    Next
    lngRowFirst = rng.Row
    '用户选择单元格区域的开始行
    lngClnFirst = rng.Column
    '用户选择单元格区域的开始列
    For i = 1 To UBound(brr)
        If brr(i, 2) > 0 Then
            For j = 1 To UBound(arr, 2)
                Set rngMerge = rng.Parent.Cells(i + lngRowFirst - 1, lngClnFirst + j - 1)
                rngMerge.Resize(brr(i, 2) + 1, 1).Merge
            Next
        End If
    Next
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)

    Dim rngDV As Range

    Dim newVal As String
    Dim fenGeFu As String

    fenGeFu = "," '规定用逗号分隔

    On Error Resume Next
    Set rngDV = Cells.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeAllValidation)

    If rngDV Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If Intersect(Target, rngDV) Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    Application.EnableEvents = False
    newVal = Target.Value
    Application.Undo
    oldVal = Target.Value
    Target.Value = newVal

    If oldVal <> "" Then
        If newVal <> "" Then
            If InStr(fenGeFu & oldVal & fenGeFu, fenGeFu & newVal & fenGeFu) > 0 Then
                If InStrRev(oldVal, newVal) + Len(newVal) - 1 = Len(oldVal) Then
                    Target.Value = Replace(oldVal, fenGeFu & newVal, "")
                Else
                    Target.Value = Replace(oldVal, newVal & fenGeFu, "")
                End If
            Else
                Target.Value = oldVal & fenGeFu & newVal
            End If
        End If
    End If

    Application.EnableEvents = True
End Sub

Const GW_HWNDNEXT = 2
Function GetHwndByTitle(ByVal sWTitle As String)
    '根据窗口标题模糊查询获取符合条件的窗户句柄数组
    Dim oDic As Object
    Set oDic = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    '先获取一个顶级窗口的句柄
    hwnd = FindWindow(vbNullString, vbNullString)
    '定义一个变量存储类名
    Dim sCN As String
    '定义一个变量存储窗口的标题名字
    Dim sTitle As String
    Do Until hwnd = 0
        hwnd = GetWindow(hwnd, GW_HWNDNEXT)
        '先填充空格
        sCN = Space(1024)
        sTitle = Space(1024)
        Dim iLen1, iLen2
        '获得实际的类名和标题名称的字符长度,如果是中文，则是字节数
        iLen1 = GetClassName(hwnd, sCN, 1024)
        iLen2 = GetWindowText(hwnd, sTitle, 1024)
        sCN = Replace(Trim(Left(sCN, iLen1)), Chr(0), "")
        sTitle = Replace(Trim(Left(sTitle, iLen2)), Chr(0), "")
        sValue = sTitle & "!" & hwnd & "!" & sCN
        oDic.Add sValue, ""
    Loop
    arrKey = oDic.keys
    arr = VBA.Filter(arrKey, sWTitle)
    If UBound(arr) >= 0 Then
        GetHwndByTitle = arr
    Else
        GetHwndByTitle = 0
    End If
End Function

Sub 单元格尺寸适应图片尺寸()
    Dim i As Integer, ShWidth, NewWidth, ShHeight, MaxWidth

            End If
        Next i
    End With
End Sub

Sub ImportAllModules()
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Dim folderPath As String
    Dim file As String
    Dim vbc As VBComponent
    
   '设置要导入模块的工作簿为当前工作簿
    Set wb = ThisWorkbook

   '获取文件夹下第一个文件

    Do While file <> ""
        On Error Resume Next
       '尝试导入文件作为标准模块
        Set vbc = wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Import(folderPath & "\" & file)
        If vbc Is Nothing Then
           '如果导入标准模块失败，尝试导入为类模块
            file = Replace(file, ".bas", ".cls")
            Set vbc = wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Import(folderPath & "\" & file)
            If vbc Is Nothing Then
               '如果导入类模块失败，尝试导入为用户窗体
                file = Replace(file, ".cls", ".frm")
                Set vbc = wb.VBProject.VBComponents.Import(folderPath & "\" & file)
            End If
        End If
        On Error GoTo 0
       '获取下一个文件
        file = Dir
    Loop
    
    MsgBox "所有模块已尝试导入。"
    Set vbc = Nothing
    Set wb = Nothing
End Sub

Sub RenameSheetsAccordingToA1()
    Dim ws As Worksheet

        '判断当前工作表是否为隐藏状态，如果不是隐藏状态（即Visible属性不等于xlSheetHidden），则进入下面的代码块进行操作
        If Not ws.Visible = xlSheetHidden Then
            '定义一个字符串变量namePart，用于存放从当前工作表A1单元格内容中提取的最后4个字符
            Dim namePart As String
            '使用Right函数从当前工作表（由ws表示）的A1单元格（Range("A1")）内容中提取最后4个字符，并赋值给namePart变量
            namePart = Right(ws.Range("A1").Value, 4)
            '将当前非隐藏工作表（ws）的名称修改为提取出来的4个字符（namePart变量所存储的内容）

        End If
    Next ws

Sub DeleteUserFormsExceptSpecified()
    Dim vbProj As VBIDE.VBProject
    Dim vbComp As VBIDE.VBComponent
    Dim formsCount As Integer
    Dim excludedForms As Variant
    Dim formName As String
    
    ' 设置要排除的窗体名称（不删除这些窗体）
    excludedForms = Array("MainForm", "ReportForm", "SettingsForm")
    ' 修改为您需要保留的窗体名称
    
    On Error Resume Next
    
    ' 设置对VBA项目的引用
    Set vbProj = ThisWorkbook.VBProject
    formsCount = 0
    
    ' 遍历所有VBA组件
    For Each vbComp In vbProj.VBComponents
        ' 检查是否是窗体对象
        If vbComp.Type = vbext_ct_MSForm Then
            formName = vbComp.Name
            
            ' 检查是否在排除列表中
            Dim shouldExclude As Boolean
            shouldExclude = False
            For Each exclude In excludedForms
                If formName = CStr(exclude) Then
                    shouldExclude = True
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next
            
            ' 如果不在排除列表中，则删除
            If Not shouldExclude Then
                vbProj.VBComponents.Remove vbComp
                formsCount = formsCount + 1
            End If
        End If
    Next vbComp
    
    ' 显示结果
    MsgBox "已删除 " & formsCount & " 个窗体对象" & vbCrLf & _
           "保留的窗体: " & Join(excludedForms, ", "), vbInformation, "操作完成"
    
    ' 清理
    Set vbComp = Nothing
    Set vbProj = Nothing
End Sub

Sub CreateCustomForm()
    Dim rng As Range
    Dim c As Range
    Dim vbProj As VBIDE.VBProject
    Dim vbComp As VBIDE.VBComponent
    Dim ctl As Object
    Dim formWidth As Single, formHeight As Single
    Dim minLeft As Single, minTop As Single
    Dim maxRight As Single, maxBottom As Single
    Dim cellLeft As Single, cellTop As Single
    
    ' ====== 可调参数 ======
    Const COL_SPACING As Single = 5    ' 列间距 (像素)
    Const ROW_SPACING As Single = 3     ' 行间距 (像素)
    Const FORM_MARGIN As Single = 10    ' 窗体边距 (像素)
    ' =====================
    
    ' 检查VBA访问权限
    On Error Resume Next
    Set vbProj = ThisWorkbook.VBProject
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        MsgBox "请启用对VBA工程对象模型的访问：" & vbCrLf & _
               "文件→选项→信任中心→信任中心设置→宏设置" & vbCrLf & _
               "勾选'信任对VBA工程对象模型的访问'", vbCritical
        Exit Sub
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ' 使用当前选中的区域
    If TypeName(Selection) <> "Range" Then
        MsgBox "请先选择一个单元格区域", vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set rng = Selection
    
    ' 计算区域边界
    minLeft = rng.Cells(1, 1).Left
    minTop = rng.Cells(1, 1).Top
    maxRight = rng.Cells(rng.Rows.Count, rng.Columns.Count).Left + rng.Cells(rng.Rows.Count, rng.Columns.Count).Width
    maxBottom = rng.Cells(rng.Rows.Count, rng.Columns.Count).Top + rng.Cells(rng.Rows.Count, rng.Columns.Count).Height
    
    ' 计算窗体尺寸（添加间距和边距）
    formWidth = (maxRight - minLeft) + (rng.Columns.Count - 1) * COL_SPACING + 2 * FORM_MARGIN
    formHeight = (maxBottom - minTop) + (rng.Rows.Count - 1) * ROW_SPACING + 2 * FORM_MARGIN
    
    ' 创建新窗体
    Set vbComp = vbProj.VBComponents.Add(vbext_ct_MSForm)
    vbComp.Properties("Name") = "CustomForm_" & Format(Now, "yymmdd_hhmmss")
    vbComp.Properties("Caption") = "自定义窗体"
    vbComp.Properties("Width") = formWidth
    vbComp.Properties("Height") = formHeight
    
    ' 遍历选中的单元格
    For Each c In rng.Cells
        ' 跳过空白单元格
        If IsEmpty(c) Then GoTo NextCell
        
        ' 计算相对位置（添加间距和边距）
        cellLeft = (c.Left - minLeft) + (c.Column - rng.Column) * COL_SPACING + FORM_MARGIN
        cellTop = (c.Top - minTop) + (c.Row - rng.Row) * ROW_SPACING + FORM_MARGIN
        
        ' 获取单元格字体格式
        Dim cellFont As Font
        Set cellFont = c.Font
        
        ' 根据单元格内容创建控件
        Select Case LCase(Trim(c.Value))
            Case "标签", "label"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1")
                ctl.Caption = "标签"
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                
            Case "文本框", "textbox", "输入框"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.TextBox.1")
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                ctl.Text = ""
                
            Case "组合框", "combobox", "下拉框"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.ComboBox.1")
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                ' 添加示例选项
                ctl.AddItem "选项1"
                ctl.AddItem "选项2"
                ctl.AddItem "选项3"
                
            Case "按钮", "commandbutton", "命令按钮"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.CommandButton.1")
                ctl.Caption = "按钮"
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                ctl.BackColor = RGB(200, 200, 255)
                
            Case "复选框", "checkbox", "选择框"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.CheckBox.1")
                ctl.Caption = "选项"
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                
            Case "列表框", "listbox"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.ListBox.1")
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                ' 添加示例选项
                ctl.AddItem "项目1"
                ctl.AddItem "项目2"
                ctl.AddItem "项目3"
                
            Case "选项按钮", "optionbutton", "单选按钮"
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.OptionButton.1")
                ctl.Caption = "选项"
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                
            Case Else
                Set ctl = vbComp.Designer.Controls.Add("Forms.Label.1")
                ctl.Caption = c.Value
                ctl.Width = c.Width
                ctl.Height = c.Height
                ctl.ForeColor = RGB(100, 100, 100)
        End Select
        
        ' 设置控件位置和样式
        With ctl
            .Top = cellTop
            .Left = cellLeft
            .Font.Name = cellFont.Name
            .Font.Size = cellFont.Size
            .Font.Bold = cellFont.Bold
            .Font.Italic = cellFont.Italic
            .ForeColor = cellFont.Color
            .BackColor = c.Interior.Color
        End With
        
NextCell:
    Next c
    
    ' 显示窗体（无确定/取消按钮）
    VBA.UserForms.Add(vbComp.Name).Show
    
    ' 清理对象
    Set rng = Nothing
    Set vbComp = Nothing
    Set vbProj = Nothing
End Sub

Public Function WebTime()
    Dim obj, OBJStatus, url, GetText, i
    Dim Retrieval
    url = "http://www.163.com"
    WebTime = ""
    '判断网络是否连接
    If url <> "" Then
        Set Retrieval = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2")
        Set obj = Retrieval.ExecQuery("Select * From Win32_PingStatus Where Address = '" & Mid(url, 8) & "'")
        For Each OBJStatus In obj
            If IsNull(OBJStatus.StatusCode) Or OBJStatus.StatusCode <> 0 Then
                MsgBox "网络未连接！"
                Exit Function
            Else
                Exit For    '已连接则继续
            End If
        Next
    End If

    '通过下载网页头信息获取网络时间
    Set Retrieval = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP")
    With Retrieval
        .Open "Get", url, False, "", ""
        .setRequestHeader "If-Modified-Since", "0"
        .setRequestHeader "Cache-Control", "no-cache"
        .setRequestHeader "Connection", "close"
        .Send
        If .Readystate <> 4 Then Exit Function
        GetText = .getAllResponseHeaders()
        i = InStr(1, GetText, "date:", vbTextCompare)
        If i > 0 Then    '网页下载成功
            i = InStr(i, GetText, ",", vbTextCompare)
            GetText = Trim(Mid(GetText, i + 1))
            i = InStr(1, GetText, " GMT", vbTextCompare)
            GetText = Left(GetText, i - 1)
            WebTime = CDate(GetText) + #8:00:00 AM#
        End If
    End With
    Set Retrieval = Nothing
    Set OBJStatus = Nothing
    Set obj = Nothing
End Function
